```
FX detection: 6 uppercase letters AND not in exclusion prefixes list AND not in stock-ish names. Stocks are usually 1-5 letters (AAPL, AMZN). Indices: DE30, HK50, AUS200, US500, etc. contain digits. Crypto pairs: BTCUSD etc. Metals: XAUUSD, XAGUSD.

So:
```ts
const METAL = /^(XAU|XAG|XPT|XPD)/;
const CRYPTO = /^(BTC|ETH|BCH|LTC|XRP|ADA|SOL|DOT|DOGE|DOG|AVAX|LINK|LNK|UNI|TRX|MATIC|SHIB|ATOM|EOS|XLM|XMR|ZEC|DASH|ETC|BNB|USDT|USDC)/;
if (/^[A-Z]{6}$/.test(s) && !METAL.test(s) && !CRYPTO.test(s)) return "fx";
```
Check: "BTCAUD" starts BTC → crypto. "ETHBTC" → crypto. Good. "DXY"? 3 letters → other/index. "USOIL"? other. "EURUSD" → fx. "AUDCZK" → fx. Fine.

Wait: forex pairs could include weird ones like "BWPUSD" (6 letters, not metal/crypto) → fx. Good.

```ts
import WebSocket from "ws";
import { buildSignedHeaders, SigningIdentity } from "./signing.js";

export type SocketState = "connecting" | "open" | "reconnecting" | "closed";

export interface ExnessSocketOptions {
  accessPoint: string;
  identity: SigningIdentity;
  path: string;
  onMessage: (message: unknown, raw: string) => void;
  onOpen?: () => void;
  onState?: (state: SocketState, detail?: string) => void;
  autoReconnect?: boolean;
  logger?: (line: string) => void;
}

export class ExnessSocket {
  ...
}
```

Implementation details:
- `connect()` sets closed=false then `open()`.
- `open()`: headers = buildSignedHeaders(...). new WebSocket(url, "exness-ws-protocol", { headers, handshakeTimeout: 15000, perMessageDeflate: false })
- on open: attempt=0; emit "open"; start heartbeat.
- on message: parse JSON; if invalid emit raw.
- on close: stop heartbeat; if !closed && autoReconnect → schedule reconnect with backoff = min(30000, 1000*2^attempt) + jitter; emit state.
- on error: emit state "error"? close will follow. Log only if verbose.
- heartbeat: every 20s: if awaitingPong → terminate; else ping() and awaitingPong = true. on "pong" → false.
- close(): closed=true; clear timers; ws.close(1000).

Send: if readyState===OPEN → send(JSON.stringify(payload)); else buffer? For subscribe after reconnect we call onOpen handler. Return boolean.

wsUrl: accessPoint.replace(/^https:/,"wss:").replace(/^http:/,"ws:") + path.

3 : 5;\n  if (category === \"metals\") return symbol.startsWith(\"XAU\") ? 2 : 3;\n  if (category === \"crypto\") return 2;\n  if (category === \"index\") return 1;\n  if (category === \"stock\") return 2;\n  return 4;\n}\n\nconst CATALOG_TTL_MS = 60 * 60 * 1000;\nconst CONDITIONS_TTL_MS = 60 * 60 * 1000;\n\ninterface CachedConditions {\n  fetchedAt: number;\n  conditions: InstrumentConditions;\n}\n\nexport class CatalogService {\n  private readonly catalogFile: string;\n  private readonly conditionsDir: string;\n  private catalog?: Catalog;\n\n  constructor(\n    private readonly client: ExnessClient,\n    private readonly cacheDir: string,\n    private readonly accountId: string,\n  ) {\n    this.catalogFile = path.join(cacheDir, \"instruments.json\");\n    this.conditionsDir = path.join(cacheDir, \"conditions\");\n  }\n\n  async catalog(options: { force?: boolean } = {}): Promise<Catalog> {\n    if (this.catalog && !options.force) return this.catalog;\n\n    if (!options.force) {\n      const cached = this.readJson<Omit<Catalog, \"byCategory\"> & { byCategory?: Catalog[\"byCategory\"] }>(\n        this.catalogFile,\n      );\n      if (cached && Date.now() - cached.fetchedAt < CATALOG_TTL_MS && Array.isArray(cached.instruments)) {\n        this.catalog = cached.byCategory\n          ? (cached as Catalog)\n          : buildCatalog(cached.instruments, cached.fetchedAt);\n        return this.catalog;\n      }\n    }\n\n    const response = await this.client.get<InstrumentListResponse>(\n      `/v1/configuration/accounts/${this.accountId}/instruments`,\n    );\n    const catalog = buildCatalog(response.instruments ?? value : fallback;\n}\n\nexport function numberFlag(parsed: ParsedArgs, name: string, fallback: number): number {\n  const value = parsed.flags[name];\n  if (typeof value !== \"string\") return fallback;\n  const parsedValue = Number(value);\n  return Number.isFinite(parsedValue) ? async function main(): Promise<number> {
  const parsed = parseArgs(process.argv.slice(2));
  if (boolFlag(parsed, "no-color")) process.env.NO_COLOR = "1";
  switch (parsed.command) {
    case "doctor": return (await import("./commands/doctor.js")).run(parsed);
    ...
    case "help": case "--help": printHelp(); return 0;
    default: console.error(...); printHelp(); return 1;
  }
}
main().then(code => { process.exitCode = code; }).catch(async (error) => {
  const { reportError } = await import("./context.js");
  reportError(error, boolFlag(parseArgs(process.argv.slice(2)), "verbose"));
  process.exitCode = 1;
});
```

Careful: `--help` becomes command "--help" since argv[0]. Handle.

For anything with\n> options, use the wrapper: `bin\\ot.cmd ...` (or `npx tsx src/cli/index.ts ...`).\n\n| Command | What it does |\n| --- | --- |\n| `bin\\ot.cmd doctor` | discovery → account → catalog → snapshot → candles → live ticks, with timings |\n| `bin\\ot.cmd account` | account profile, mode (demo/live), currency, leverage, access point |\n| `bin\\ot.cmd snapshot` | balance, equity, used/free margin, margin level, open positions and orders |\n| `bin\\ot.cmd instruments --fx --search EUR` | instrument catalog (335 instruments, 175 FX pairs) |\n| `bin\\ot.cmd candles EURUSD --tf M5 --count 60` | OHLC table + ASCII sparkline, `--type bid\\|ask\\|both` |\n| `bin\\ot.cmd ticker EURUSD XAUUSD --for 15` | live bid/ask, spread in points, tick count, age |\n| `bin\\ot.cmd watch --search JPY --limit 15` | live board of all FX pairs (or `--all`), sorted by change |\n| `bin\\ot.cmd limits` | REST + WebSocket rate limits for this account |\n| `bin\\ot.cmd events --for 30` | stream `account_state` / `transaction_event` / instrument events |\n\nGlobal flags: `--verbose`, `--no-color`, `--json`.\n\n`npm run doctor|account|snapshot|limits|instruments` also work because they take no\noptions.\n\n## How it works\n\n```\nsrc/\n├─ config.ts              .env loading (no dotenv) + validation\n├─ exness/\n│  ├─ signing.ts          hex/PEM → Ed25519 key, EXN-DATA + EXN-SIGN headers\n│  ├─ client.ts           access-point discovery + cache, signed REST, retry, rate limit\n│  ├─ ws.ts               signed WebSocket handshake, heartbeat, reconnect + resubscribe\n│  ├─ catalog.ts          instrument catalog + per-instrument conditions (cached)\n│  └─ types.ts            subset of trading.public.yaml v1.0.2\n├─ market/store.ts        last tick per symbol, quotes, formatting\n└─ cli/                   arg parsing, ANSI rendering, commands\n```\n\nBehaviour worth knowing:\n\n- **Signing** — `EXN-DATA` is serialized once; those exact bytes are signed and\n  base64url-encoded (no padding) into `EXN-DATA`, with the Ed25519 signature in\n  `EXN-SIGN`. `body_hash` is SHA-256 of the exact body (`47DEQpj8…` for empty).\n- **Discovery** — `GET /v1/trading/access-point?account_id=…` against\n  `EXNESS_DISCOVERY_URL`. **Agent**

1. **Screener**: memindai daftar pair secara berkala dan memberi skor. Hanya pair yang lolos yang diteruskan.
2. **Entry**: untuk pair kandidat, memutuskan BUY, SELL, atau tidak ada aksi, lalu menentukan entry, SL awal, dan TP.
3. **Risk & Eksekutor**: menghitung ukuran lot, menolak entry yang melanggar aturan, mengirim order, dan mengelola trailing stop sampai posisi ditutup.

Data bukan agent, melainkan **tools** yang dipakai ketiga agent di atas.

## Tools wajib

| Tool | Fungsi |
|---|---|
| `get_candles(symbol, timeframe, n)` | Mengambil candle historis untuk analisis |
| `get_tick(symbol)` | Harga bid/ask terbaru dan spread |
| `get_account()` | Saldo, equity, dan margin untuk menghitung lot |
| `get_positions()` | Posisi yang sedang terbuka |
| `place_order(symbol, side, lot, sl, tp)` | Mengirim order baru |
| `modify_sl(position_id, new_sl)` | Menggeser SL, dipakai trailing stop |
| `close_position(position_id)` | Menutup posisi |
| `kill_switch()` | Menghentikan semua agent dan menutup entry baru |

## Trailing stop

Logikanya:
- **BUY**: simpan harga tertinggi sejak entry. SL = harga tertinggi dikurangi jarak trailing. SL hanya boleh naik, tidak pernah turun.
- **SELL**: simpan harga terendah sejak entry. SL = harga terendah ditambah jarak trailing. SL hanya boleh turun.

Contoh BUY dengan jarak 20 pip:
```
entry 1.0850, SL awal 1.0820
harga naik ke 1.0900 → SL jadi 1.0880
harga naik ke 1.0930 → SL jadi 1.0910
harga turun ke 1.0920 → SL tetap 1.0910 (tidak turun)
```

Kode intinya:
```python
# BUY
highest = max(highest, bid)
new_sl = highest - trail_distance
if new_sl > current_sl and new_sl < bid - min_stop_distance:
    modify_sl(position_id, new_sl)
```

Catatan penting:
- **Jarak trailing** bisa tetap (misalnya 20 pip) atau mengikuti volatilitas (misalnya 1.5 × ATR). ATR lebih baik karena menyesuaikan kondisi pasar.
- **Cek minimal jarak SL** dari broker. Kalau SL terlalu dekat dengan harga, modifikasi akan ditolak.
- **Batasi frekuensi modifikasi.** Jangan kirim request setiap tick. Cukup setiap candle baru atau setiap perubahan harga yang berarti, supaya tidak kena rate limit.
- **SL harus ada di broker, bukan hanya di program.** Kalau program mati atau internet putus, SL di broker tetap melindungi posisi. Pastikan API Exness mendukung modifikasi SL dari sisi server.
- **Cek dukungan modifikasi SL di dokumentasi API Exness** sebelum menulis kodenya.

# Formulas & Calculations

Trading formulas, conversion rules, margin calculations, and High Margin Requirements.

## Precision rule[​](#precision-rule "Direct link to Precision rule")

Use decimal-safe arithmetic for money, prices, margin, and volume. Do not rely on binary floating-point for critical calculations.

---

## Trading formulas[​](#trading-formulas "Direct link to Trading formulas")

---

## Equity[​](#equity "Direct link to Equity")

Total value of a trader account at any current time.

**Formula:**

```
equity = balance + floating_pnl
```

**Where:**

- `balance` = realized account balance (reflects the result of all balance operations and result of closed positions)

trade commissions as well as swap fees\\admin fees \- are applied to the account balance immediately at the moment of charging

- `floating_pnl` = unrealized PnL for currently opened positions

**Notes**

- all values are in account currency

---

## Floating PnL[​](#floating-pnl "Direct link to Floating PnL")

Floating PnL represents unrealized profit or loss for currently open positions. It does not affect account balance and represents the potential profit or loss that would be realized if a trade were closed at the current market price.

**Formula:**

`floating_pnl = sum of PnL for all opened positions = sum (buy_position_pnl) + sum (sell_position_pnl)`

**Where:**

- \`\`buy\_position\_pnl`  = volume * (LastBidPrice - OpenPrice) * contractSize * ProfitRate `

- \`\`sell\_position\_pnl`  = volume * (OpenPrice - LastAskPrice) * contractSize * ProfitRate `

- `volume = position volume in lots`

- `contractSize` = instrument contract size

- `OpenPrice` = position open price

- `LastBidPrice/LastAskPrice` = last instrument tick

- `ProfitRate` = rate for conversion from instrument quote currency to the account currency (see conversion rules below)

**Notes**

- `floating_pnl` is in account currency

- once a position is closed, realised pnl (Profit) is stored to the closing deal and applied to the account balance

---

## Used margin[​](#used-margin "Direct link to Used margin")

Used margin represents the amount of funds currently reserved to maintain open positions. Margin acts as a deposit, not a fee, and is returned after an order is closed, provided losses don't consume it. Margin requirements for fully [hedged orders](https://get.exness.help/hc/en-us/articles/360014696320) equal 0%. Partially hedged orders margin applied to the unhedged part. No margin is taken for pending orders.

**Formula:**

- if the instrument calculation mode is "Forex" or "ForexNoLeverage" (instrument.calc\_mode=1 or instrument.calc\_mode=2): `used_margin = volume * contractSize * marginRate * marginPercentage`

- if the instrument calculation mode is "CFD" or "CFDLeverage" (instrument.calc\_mode=3 or instrument.calc\_mode=4): `used_margin = volume * contractSize * openPrice * marginRate * marginPercentage`

**Where:**

- `volume` = position volume in lots

- `contractSize` = instrument contract size

- openPrice = position open price

- `marginRate` = rate for conversion from instrument margin currency to the account currency (see conversion rules below)

- `marginPercentage depends on the instrument calculation mode:`

Forex / CFDLeverage:

marginPercentage = 1 / account.leverage

if the account has unlimited leverage =\> marginPercentage=0

- ForexNoLeverage / CFD (fixed margin):

marginPercentage = instrument.margin\_percent

**Notes:**

- High Margin Requirements may be applied at some specific period of time for certain instruments.

- For the **majority of instruments**, orders opened up to **15 minutes before** and **90 seconds** after a **high-impact news release** are subject to higher margin requirements (HMR). During this time, leverage for affected instruments is capped. Learn more about the leverage requirements for instruments below.

- After HMR, margins are recalculated based on the account’s equity and leverage.

- HMR is also applied before and after scheduled **market breaks**, including **weekends**, **public holidays**, and **daily breaks**.

- Once the HMR period ends, margin requirements are automatically recalculated based on the account’s equity and selected leverage.

**Instruments and their leverage during HMR**

| Instrument group | Instruments | Leverage during HMR |
| --- | --- | --- |
| Forex | All | 1:200 |
| Energies | USOIL | 1:20 |
| Energies | UKOIL | 1:20 |
| Energies | XNGUSD | 1:5 |
| Metals | XAU | 1:200 – 1:1000 |
| Metals | XAG | 1:50 – 1:200 |
| Metals | XALUSD, XCUUSD, XNIUSD, XPBUSD, XZNUSD | 1:50 |
| Cryptocurrencies | All | 1:200 |

**HMR periods before & after weekend market breaks**

| Instrument group | Before weekend break | After weekend break |
| --- | --- | --- |
| All trading instruments except BTC and ETH\* | \~3 hours | 1 hour |

**HMR periods before & after daily market breaks**

| Instrument group | Before daily break | After daily break |
| --- | --- | --- |
| USOIL | 30 minutes | 5 minutes |
| UKOIL | \~30 minutes | 5 minutes |
| Gold (XAU\*) | 30 minutes | \~10 minutes |
| Silver (XAG\*) | 30 minutes | \~10 minutes |
| BTCXAG, BTCXAU | \~30 minutes | 5 minutes |

Details: [https://get.exness.help/hc/en-us/articles/20618327917596-Higher-Margin-Requirements-HMR](https://get.exness.help/hc/en-us/articles/20618327917596-Higher-Margin-Requirements-HMR)

---

## Free margin[​](#free-margin "Direct link to Free margin")

While the broker holds a margin for open orders, the free margin is the funds remaining in the trading account that are not held and are free to use for new orders.

**Formula:**

`free_margin = equity - used_margin`

**Where:**

- `equity` = current account equity

- `used_margin` = currently reserved margin for open positions

---

## Margin level[​](#margin-level "Direct link to Margin level")

Margin level represents account risk level.

**Formula:**

`margin_level = (equity / used_margin) * 100`

- **If** `used_margin = 0`, margin level is undefined. This is the case when an account has no opened positions.

## Margin call conditions[​](#margin-call-conditions "Direct link to Margin call conditions")

`margin_level <= margin_call_level`

A **margin call** is an alert sent by the trading platform, warning that it may be necessary to deposit funds or close a position to avoid a stop out. This notification is sent once the margin level drops to a certain amount, known as the **margin call**.

## Stop out conditions[​](#stop-out-conditions "Direct link to Stop out conditions")

`margin_level <= stopout_level`

Stop out (account liquidation) is triggered when account margin level falls below the configured stop out threshold.

Stop out is the automatic closing of opened positions (even hedged positions) when the margin level drops to the stop out level.

**Notes:**

At Exness, margin call and stop levels are based on trading account types.

| Account | Margin Call | Stop Out |
| --- | --- | --- |
| Standard Cent | 60% | 0% |
| Standard | 60% | 0% |
| Pro | 30% | 0% |
| Raw Spread | 30% | 0% |
| Zero | 30% | 0% |

---

## Leverage[​](#leverage "Direct link to Leverage")

Leverage is the ratio of equity to the capital provided by the broker, which affects the margin required for an open order.

- The minimum leverage setting is 1:2

- Leverage cannot be disabled

- The leverage requested by the client when opening an account is not a mandatory requirement for execution. Leverage may be recalculated to account for periods of increased margin requirements or other rules.

- Leverage may be reduced during High Margin Requirement (HMR)

- The current leverage can be tracked through HMR updates on the Server Events stream.

Details: [https://get.exness.help/hc/en-us/articles/360014529380-Leverage](https://get.exness.help/hc/en-us/articles/360014529380-Leverage)

---

## Conversion rules[​](#conversion-rules "Direct link to Conversion rules")

Trading calculations requires currency conversion to account currency. It's needed to define a rate for conversion.

How it works:

```
if currency_from = currency_to:
    then conversion_rate = 1.0

else:
    try direct conversion (find a currency pair XXXYYY, where XXX=currency_from and YYY=currency_to)
    else try reverse conversion (find a currency pair YYYXXX, where XXX=currency_from and YYY=currency_to)
    else try two-step conversion through USD: currency_from -> USD -> currency_to (note: at each step there may be XXXYYY or YYYXXX conversion cases)
```

For conversion, it's needed to define a certain price to be applied. To do so, we need to define **ConversionDirection** (it's not the same as PositionDirection):

- ConversionDirection::Sell:

  base\_currency \-\> quote\_currency : bid

  quote\_currency → base\_currency : 1 / ask

- ConversionDirection::Buy:

  base\_currency → quote\_currency : ask

  quote\_currency → base\_currency : 1 / bid

Example for EURUSD (bid = 1\.1000 / ask = 1\.1002):

- If converting EUR → USD:

Sell selection \-\> rate = bid = 1\.1000 Buy selection \-\> rate = ask = 1\.1002

- If converting USD→ EUR:

Sell selection \-\> rate = 1 / ask = 1 / 1\.1002 Buy selection \-\> rate = 1 / bid = 1 / 1\.1000

---

## ProfitRate[​](#profitrate "Direct link to ProfitRate")

ProfitRate converts from instrument quote currency to account currency.

ForProfitRate, ConversionDirection depends on the instrument calc\_mode:

- if the instrument calculation mode is "Forex" or "ForexNoLeverage" (instrument.calc\_mode=1 or instrument.calc\_mode=2) \- depends on position direction: \`Buy Position \-\> ConversionDirection=Buy

  Sell Position \-\> ConversionDirection=Sell\`

- if the instrument calculation mode is "CFD" or "CFDLeverage" (instrument.calc\_mode=3 or instrument.calc\_mode=4) \- depends on position profitability: \`Position is profitable (profit \> 0) \-\> ConversionDirection=Sell

  Position is losing (profit \< 0) \-\> ConversionDirection=Buy\`

---

## MarginRate[​](#marginrate "Direct link to MarginRate")

MarginRate converts from instrument margin currency to account currency.

It is calculated on position opening and the stored in "Position.margin\_rate" field.

For MarginRate, need to use ConversionDirection the same as Position direction:

`Buy position  -> ConversionDirection=Buy` `Sell position -> ConversionDirection=Sell`

---

# Runtime Semantics

Runtime behavior for current state, history, async operations, transaction events, snapshots, idempotency, decimal values, pagination, subscriptions, rate limits, and floating account state.

## Core model[​](#core-model "Direct link to Core model")

The API separates current state, historical data, and realtime updates.

| Object | Meaning |
| --- | --- |
| `Order` | A trading instruction. |
| `Position` | Open market exposure. |
| `Deal` | An executed financial event. |
| `AccountState` | Current account monetary state. |
| `transaction_event` | A realtime container with objects changed by one finalized account or trading event. |

## Current state vs history[​](#current-state-vs-history "Direct link to Current state vs history")

Current trading state is available through `GET /v1/trading/accounts/{account_id}/snapshot` and through the `trading_state_snapshot` event after subscribing to `transactions`.

Historical data is available through `GET /v1/history/accounts/{account_id}/orders` and `GET /v1/history/accounts/{account_id}/deals`.

State boundary

Open orders and open positions are not returned by history endpoints. Read them from snapshot or Server Events.

## Asynchronous trading operations[​](#asynchronous-trading-operations "Direct link to Asynchronous trading operations")

Mutating trading methods return an ACK response first. The ACK means the request was accepted for processing, not that the final trading result is already available.

| Method pattern | Purpose |
| --- | --- |
| `POST /v1/trading/accounts/{account_id}/orders` | Place order. |
| `PATCH /v1/trading/accounts/{account_id}/orders/{order_id}` | Modify order. |
| `DELETE /v1/trading/accounts/{account_id}/orders/{order_id}` | Cancel order. |
| `POST /v1/trading/accounts/{account_id}/positions` | Open position. |
| `DELETE /v1/trading/accounts/{account_id}/positions/{position_id}` | Close position. |

The final result is delivered through Server Events as `transaction_event`.

## Correlation[​](#correlation "Direct link to Correlation")

Clients should correlate REST requests with final events using `operation_id` and `client_request_id` when an idempotency key was provided.

- `Idempotency-Key` is echoed back as `client_request_id` in the ACK response.

- The same value appears in the corresponding `transaction_event`.

- The same value appears in the operation status response.

This lets clients correlate events with originating requests without storing a separate `operation_id` mapping.

## Transaction event semantics[​](#transaction-event-semantics "Direct link to Transaction event semantics")

A `transaction_event` may represent a successful trading transaction, a non-trading balance transaction, or a rejected/failed processing result without changed trading entities.

| Status | Meaning | Client action |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `success` | Finalized account or trading state changes were produced. | Apply changed entities to local state. |
| `rejected` | Processing was rejected by validation or trading rules. | Read `error_code` and change the request or account state before retrying. |
| `failed` | Processing failed. | Read `error_code`; retry only when the error is retryable. |

For rejected or failed results, the payload may be empty and `error_code` may be provided.

## Transaction payload composition[​](#transaction-payload-composition "Direct link to Transaction payload composition")

Transaction payload contains only entities created or changed by the concrete transaction. It must not contain all historically related entities.

| Scenario | Possible payload |
| --- | --- |
| Pending order placement | `order` and `account_state`. |
| Pending order placement with SL/TP | Main pending order, SLTP order, and `account_state`. |
| Position opening | `order`, `deal`, `position`, and `account_state`. |
| Partial position close | `order`, `deal`, updated `position`, and `account_state`. |
| Balance operation | Balance-type `deal` and `account_state`. |

## Snapshots and recovery[​](#snapshots-and-recovery "Direct link to Snapshots and recovery")

After successful subscription to `transactions`, the server sends `trading_state_snapshot`. The snapshot contains currently active orders, currently open positions, and account state.

If the client does not receive expected `operation_id` values, receives an unknown `operation_id`, or loses connection, it should:

1. 1

   Restart Server Events subscription.

2. 2

   Receive a fresh `trading_state_snapshot`.

3. 3

   Reconcile local state using currently open positions and pending orders.

4. 4

   Continue processing subsequent `transaction_event` messages.

Recovery rule

If the client reconnects, it must resubscribe and rebuild local state from snapshots. WebSocket streams do not provide durable replay, resume tokens, or gap-fill.

## Operation status polling[​](#operation-status-polling "Direct link to Operation status polling")

Use `GET /v1/trading/accounts/{account_id}/operations/{operation_id}` as a recovery mechanism when the corresponding `transaction_event` is not received within the expected time window.

| Status | Client action |
| --- | --- |
| `pending` | Keep waiting or poll again with backoff. |
| `confirmed` | Treat the operation as finalized. |
| `rejected` | Inspect the error and change the request before retrying. |
| `failed` | Inspect the error and retry only if safe. |

Operations are retained for 24 hours.

## Idempotency[​](#idempotency "Direct link to Idempotency")

Mutating trading methods may accept `Idempotency-Key`. Clients should reuse the same idempotency key when safely retrying the same request.

When provided, the same value is returned as `client_request_id` in ACK, operation status, and transaction event.

## Decimal values[​](#decimal-values "Direct link to Decimal values")

Monetary, price, margin, and volume values are represented as decimal strings to avoid precision loss.

```
^[+-]?[0-9]+(?:\.[0-9]+)?$
```

## Pagination[​](#pagination "Direct link to Pagination")

Historical endpoints use cursor-based pagination.

- `cursor` is an opaque continuation token.

- Clients must not parse or modify `cursor`.

- When `cursor` is used, it cannot be combined with filters except `limit`, unless explicitly stated otherwise.

- Historical collections are returned in ascending chronological order, from older to newer.

## Candle history semantics[​](#candle-history-semantics "Direct link to Candle history semantics")

Candle history uses time-range or count-based loading.

- `from` is required.

- Use either `from + count` or `from + to`.

- `from` must be earlier than `to`.

- `count` is bidirectional and must be from `-1000` to `1000`, excluding `0`.

- If `to` is used, the requested range must not exceed `from + 1000 candles`.

- Returned candles are sorted from older to newer.

Time range semantics: `from` is inclusive, `to` is exclusive, and a candle is included when its open time is greater than or equal to `from` and strictly less than `to`.

## Server Events subscriptions[​](#server-events-subscriptions "Direct link to Server Events subscriptions")

The Server Events connection supports `transactions`, `account_state`, `instruments`, and high margin requirement periods (`hmr`).

The Ticks stream uses a separate WebSocket endpoint. HMR no longer uses a separate WebSocket endpoint; HMR subscriptions are sent to the main Server Events stream.

| Subscription | Initial message | Subsequent messages |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `transactions` | `trading_state_snapshot` | `transaction_event` |
| `account_state` | none | `account_state_event` |
| `instruments` | none | `instrument_event` |
| `hmr` | `hmr_snapshot` | `hmr_update`, and sometimes a new `hmr_snapshot` |

## Account state events[​](#account-state-events "Direct link to Account state events")

The `account_state` subscription delivers periodic floating account state updates through `account_state_event` messages with `balance`, `equity`, and `used_margin`.

These events are intended for equity monitoring. Balance-changing operations are delivered through `transaction_event`, not through `account_state`.

## Instrument events[​](#instrument-events "Direct link to Instrument events")

The `instruments` subscription delivers realtime instrument condition updates.

- Clients may subscribe to specific instruments or use `["all"]`.

- Requested instruments must be available for the account.

- If at least one requested instrument is unavailable, the subscription request is rejected.

- Events are account-scoped.

- Instrument event payload contains the full current instrument condition object, not only changed fields.

## Runtime restrictions[​](#runtime-restrictions "Direct link to Runtime restrictions")

Some methods and streams are unavailable when `trade_mode = trading_disabled`. Some trading methods are unavailable when `account_status = close_only`.

| Mode | Behavior |
| --- | --- |
| `trading_disabled` | Some methods and streams are unavailable. |
| `close_only` | Opening positions and placing pending orders are not allowed. Closing positions and cancelling orders remain allowed. |

## API limits and throttling[​](#api-limits-and-throttling "Direct link to API limits and throttling")

API limits are returned by:

```
GET /v1/configuration/accounts/{account_id}/limits
```

Request this endpoint at startup after resolving the access point.

The response returns:

- account-level REST limits;

- operation-level REST limits;

- request-shape constants for selected operations;

- account-level WebSocket limits;

- endpoint-level WebSocket limits;

- subscription-operation throttling values.

The endpoint returns configured limits, not remaining quota. Clients must store the returned values and count sent requests locally.

## Account floating state and equity[​](#account-floating-state-and-equity "Direct link to Account floating state and equity")

The API provides periodic floating account state updates through the Server Events `account_state` subscription. Floating account state updates are not delivered on every market tick.

| Behavior | Current source detail |
| --- | --- |
| Interval | Updates are sent every 2 seconds. |
| Timing | The interval is shared globally for all subscribers. |
| Subscription start | The timing window does not depend on subscription start time. |

This stream is intended primarily for account monitoring, reconciliation, UI synchronization, and floating state verification.

Clients should calculate floating state locally on every tick using:

```
equity = balance + unrealized_PNL
```

- Subscribe to realtime ticks.

- Calculate unrealized PnL locally.

- Recalculate equity on every tick.

- Periodically reconcile with `account_state_event`.

interface Tools {

place_order implementation details:
1. resolve conditions (cached) + account.
2. validate trade_mode/account_status.
3. lot → volume string with volume_step alignment, min/max.
4. price: fetch latest tick (bid/ask) — for market execution price not needed.
5. validate SL/TP relative to side and min distance (empirical): BUY sl < bid; SELL sl > ask. TP opposite.
6. compute required margin (formula) + free margin check with buffer.
7. subscribe must already be active; check `events` socket state.
8. POST /positions with idempotency key; wait for transaction_event with matching client_request_id OR poll operation status up to N seconds; extract position_id from payload.
9. Return positionId (critical for trailing).

modify_sl:
1. find SLTP order for position: snapshot orders where order_type==="sltp" && position_id===posId && state==="placed".
2. if exists → PATCH /orders/{id} {stop_loss_price}
3. else → POST /orders {type:"sltp", position_id, stop_loss_price}
4. Enforce monotonic direction per side in caller, plus validate against latest tick.
5. Rate limit 4/s, and coalesce: only send if |newSl - currentSl| >= step (e.g., 1 point) and at most once per 2s per position.
6. Wait async result; on `TRADING_RULE_INVALID_PRICE_LEVELS` → widen distance or skip.

Trailing pure function:
```ts
computeTrailingSl({side, entry, best, currentSl, trailDistance, minStopDistance, bid, ask, pointDigits}) -> number | null
```
BUY: candidate = best - trailDistance; valid if candidate > currentSl + epsilon && candidate <= bid - minStop; SELL: candidate = best + trail; valid if candidate < currentSl - eps && candidate >= ask + minStop.
ATR: trail = max(minTrail, k*ATR(14, M5/M15)).

Screener: 
Inputs: symbol universe (175 FX), interval (e.g., every 60s), timeframes.
Phase A (cheap): WS ticks all pairs → spread%, tick activity, session/open filter (trade_mode enabled from conditions).
Phase B (candles 2/s): for shortlist (top N=15 by activity) fetch M5/M15 (and H1 for trend) — 2 requests per pair = 7.5s for 15.
Score: 
- trend: EMA fast/slow alignment on M15 + H1
- momentum: ROC/RSI
- volatility: ATR% within band (not too low/not too high)
- spread cost vs ATR (spread must be < X% of ATR)
- session filter (avoid rollover, spread widening)
Output: Candidate[] {symbol, score, reasons, atr, spread, sessionOk}.

Entry:
- For each candidate: fetch candles (or reuse screener's), compute entry setup: breakout/pullback logic, SL = entry ± k*ATR, TP = entry ± R*SL distance (R multiple).
- Decision: BUY/SELL/NONE with confidence; dedupe per symbol (one position per symbol), max per cycle.
- Emit Signal {symbol, side, entry?, sl, tp, atr, reason}.

Risk & Executor:
- Sizing: riskAmount = equity * riskPct (e.g., 0.5%); slDistance in price; valuePerLot = contractSize * slDistance * profitRate(tick-based approximation using bid/ask for conversion); lot = riskAmount / valuePerLot, floor to step, clamp to min/max, check margin, check max open positions, check daily loss & kill switch, check correlation exposure (max N per currency).
- Execute via place_order, then register trailing state {positionId, side, entry, best=basis, trailDistance, currentSl}.
- Trailing loop: on each tick batch (throttled 1s), per position compute candidate; send modify_sl if conditions; update state after confirmed.
- Exit management: if TP/SL hit broker-side → reconcile snapshot and drop state.
- Kill switch: flag file `.cache/KILL` + in-memory; blocks place_order; optional flatten (close all + cancel all pending).

## Koreksi penting terhadap asumsi di rencana Anda

Ini hasil cek `trading.public.yaml` v1.0.2 + guide resmi:

1. **Tidak ada endpoint "modify position".** SL/TP hidup sebagai **objek order `type: sltp`** yang menempel ke `position_id`:
   - menggeser SL → `PATCH /orders/{sltp_order_id}` dengan `{stop_loss_price}`,
   - memasang SL pada posisi yang dibuka tanpa SL → `POST /orders` `{type:"sltp", position_id, stop_loss_price}`,
   - `PATCH` juga menerima `null` untuk menghapus SL/TP.
   Yang belum pasti: apakah `sltp` order otomatis muncul di snapshot setelah open-with-SL, dan apakah `POST` sltp bisa menduplikasi order. **Ini wajib diprobe di demo dulu**, bukan diasumsikan.

2. **`stops_level` tidak ada di API.** Sudah saya grep seluruh spec: tidak ada field `stops_level`, `freeze_level`, atau `min_distance`. Jadi "cek minimal jarak SL dari broker" tidak bisa dilakukan secara deklaratif — harus **kalibrasi empiris** (binary search 1..50 poin) dan menangani error async `TRADING_RULE_INVALID_PRICE_LEVELS`.

3. **`place_order` ≠ `/orders`.** Entry market pakai `POST /positions` (side buy/sell). `/orders` hanya untuk pending & SLTP. Karena akun Anda `exec_mode: market`, `price` tidak dikirim.

4. **Semua mutasi async.** `PATCH`/`POST`/`DELETE` balas `202 {operation_id, status:"accepted"}`. Trailing stop **tidak boleh** menganggap SL sudah berubah sebelum `transaction_event`/status = confirmed → butuh in-flight guard per posisi.

5. **Kill switch tidak ada di API.** Harus lokal (flag yang memblokir `place_order`) + aksi flatten (cancel semua order, opsional close semua posisi). Proteksi saat program mati tetap bergantung pada SL yang sudah terpasang di broker.

6. **Batas matematis screener.** Candles = **2 req/s**, jadi memindai 175 pair = ~88 detik/pass. Rancangan harus dua tahap: prefilter pakai ticks WS (gratis, 1 koneksi untuk semua pair) → candles hanya untuk shortlist (misal 15 pair = ~8 detik).

7. **Margin** (dari guide Formulas): `used_margin = volume × contractSize × marginRate × (1/leverage)` untuk `calc_mode: forex`. EURUSD 1 lot ≈ 100.000 × ~1,10 × 0,002 ≈ **220 USD**, bukan 1% dari notional. `margin_percent: "1"` di conditions hanya dipakai untuk mode fixed-margin.

```
src/
├─ tools/
│  ├─ types.ts        ToolResult<T>, ToolError, DTO
│  ├─ market.ts       get_candles, get_tick, get_quotes, get_conditions
│  ├─ account.ts      get_account, get_positions, get_orders, get_risk
│  ├─ trading.ts      place_order, modify_sl, close_position, cancel_order
│  ├─ kill-switch.ts  kill_switch, isHalted
│  └─ index.ts        createTools(ctx) → Tools (satu-satunya pintu ke broker)
├─ agents/
│  ├─ screener.ts     scan(universe) → Candidate[]
│  ├─ entry.ts        decide(candidate) → Signal | null
│  ├─ risk-and-executor.ts  size(signal) → Intent → execute → register trailing
│  └─ trailing.ts     computeTrailingSl(...) pure function
├─ runtime/
│  ├─ engine.ts       wiring interval + kedua socket + reconcile
│  ├─ hubs.ts         TickHub (1 WS untuk universe), EventHub (transactions/account_state)
│  └─ state.ts        posisi + trailing state, persist .cache/agent-state.json
└─ cli/commands/agent.ts  `ot agent run --dry-run`, `ot agent status`, `ot agent kill`
```

### Kontrak tool (yang dipakai ketiga agent)

```ts
get_candles({symbol, timeframe, n})            → Candle[]          // max 1000, rate 2/s
get_tick({symbol})                             → Tick              // dari TickHub, bukan REST
get_quotes({symbols?})                         → Quote[]
get_conditions({symbol})                       → InstrumentConditions
get_account()                                  → {balance, equity, usedMargin, freeMargin,
                                                  leverage, marginLevel, status, tradeMode}
get_positions() / get_orders()                 → Position[] / Order[]
place_order({symbol, side, lot, sl?, tp?})     → {operationId, positionId}
modify_sl({positionId, newSl})                  → {operationId}
close_position({positionId, volume?})           → {operationId}
kill_switch({closePositions?})                  → {halted, cancelled, closed}
```

Semua tool mengembalikan `ToolResult<T>` (`{ok:true,data}` / `{ok:false,code,message,retryable}`) supaya agent tidak pernah crash karena error broker, dan semua mutasi memakai idempotency key + menunggu hasil final (event, fallback poll 5×500 ms).

### Trailing stop (perbaikan dari pseudocode Anda)

```ts
// ATR-based, dievaluasi per tick tapi dikirim maksimal 1× / 2s / posisi
trail = max(minTrailPoints * point, atrMult * atr14)
BUY : candidate = best - trail;  valid bila candidate > currentSl && candidate <= bid - minStop
SELL: candidate = best + trail;  valid bila candidate < currentSl && candidate >= ask + minStop
```
- `minStop` dari hasil kalibrasi (bukan hardcode), `best` dari TickHub (high/low sejak entry).
- Hanya kirim kalau selisih ≥ 2 poin **dan** tidak ada PATCH in-flight untuk posisi itu (rate 4/s, global 10/s).
- Bila `trade_mode` berubah / HMR / spread melebar → tahan modifikasi, jangan panik close.

### Urutan build + kriteria lulus (semua di demo)

| # | Langkah | Kriteria lulus |
|---|---|---|
| 1 | `tools/` + TickHub/EventHub + SnapshotCache 1s | `ot agent status` menampilkan account/positions dari tool, bukan REST langsung |
| 2 | **Probe SL** (0.01 lot): open tanpa SL → POST sltp → PATCH → close | tercatat: sltp muncul di snapshot?, PATCH mengubah SL?, jarak minimum diterima?, latensi async |
| 3 | `place_order` + `close_position` lengkap | 3 siklus open/close 0.01 lot, tidak ada posisi menggantung |
| 4 | `modify_sl` + `trailing.ts` (unit test tanpa order) | 20 skenario harga lolos, termasuk SL tidak pernah mundur |
| 5 | Screener (ticks → shortlist → candles) | 1 pass ≤ 15 detik, output skor + alasan, tidak kena 429 |
| 6 | Entry (ATR SL/TP, R multiple) | sinyal punya SL/TP valid terhadap tick, tidak ada sinyal ganda per simbol |
| 7 | Risk & Executor (sizing, guardrail, auto-trailing) | 1 trade penuh: entry → trailing naik 2× → close, equity konsisten |
| 8 | Kill switch | flag aktif → order baru ditolak < 1 detik, flatten berhasil |

Guardrail default yang saya sarankan: risk 0.5% equity/trade, maks 3 posisi, maks 1 posisi per simbol, maks 2 posisi per currency exposure, stop trading bila daily loss ≥ 3%, spread > 25% ATR dilewati, `EXNESS_TRADING_MODE=dry-run` sebagai default sampai probe SL terbukti.

## 2. Soal target 89% — jujur secara matematis

89% winrate hanya masuk akal kalau avg win < avg loss. Dengan desain di atas:

```
TP1 +12 pip (50% posisi) → winrate trade-level bisa 85–92%
loss  = 28 pip × 50% sisa yang tidak tertolong trailing ± jarang
expectancy = 0.89×12 − 0.11×28 ≈ +7.6 pip/trade (sebelum spread)
```

Tapi ini **harus dibuktikan di backtest**, bukan diasumsikan. Karena itu saya masukkan `ot backtest` sebagai bagian wajib: semua logika (screener score, entry rule, trailing, partial close) adalah fungsi murni yang sama dipakai live, dijalankan atas candle historis dari API (max 1000/request, 2 req/s → 60 hari M5 untuk 12 pair ≈ 2–3 menit). Kita tuning TP1/trail/ATR di situ sampai winrate & expectancy stabil, baru auto-trade di demo.

## 3. Struktur file final

```
src/
├─ tools/
│  ├─ types.ts        ToolResult<T> = {ok:true,data} | {ok:false,code,message,retryable}
│  ├─ market.ts       get_candles, get_tick, get_quotes, get_conditions
│  ├─ account.ts      get_account, get_positions, get_orders, get_risk
│  ├─ trading.ts      place_order, modify_sl, close_position(partial), cancel_order
│  ├─ kill-switch.ts  halt flag (.cache/KILL), flatten
│  └─ index.ts        createTools(ctx) — satu-satunya pintu ke broker
├─ agents/
│  ├─ screener.ts     scan(universe) → Candidate[]  (score + reasons)
│  ├─ entry.ts        decide(candidate, candles) → Signal|null
│  ├─ risk.ts         size(signal, account) → Intent|null
│  ├─ executor.ts     execute(intent) → TrackedPosition
│  └─ trailing.ts     computeTrailingSl() + state machine (pure, unit-tested)
├─ runtime/
│  ├─ hubs.ts         TickHub (1 WS semua pair) + EventHub (transactions/account_state)
│  ├─ snapshot.ts     cache snapshot 1s + single-flight (limit 2/s)
│  ├─ reconcile.ts    cocokkan posisi broker ↔ state lokal tiap 30s / reconnect
│  └─ engine.ts       timer: screener 60s, trailing 1s, reconcile 30s
├─ backtest/
│  ├─ feed.ts         candle cache per pair/timeframe di .cache/history
│  ├─ simulator.ts    fill, spread, partial close, trailing — pakai trailing.ts yang sama
│  └─ report.ts       winrate, PF, expectancy, maxDD, avg win/loss, BE count
└─ cli/commands/agent.ts  run|status|kill · cli/commands/backtest.ts
```

## 4. Tool contract (final)

```ts
get_candles({symbol, timeframe, n})           → Candle[]        // ≤1000, 2 req/s
get_tick({symbol})                            → Tick            // dari TickHub, 0 REST
get_quotes({symbols?})                        → Quote[]
get_conditions({symbol})                      → InstrumentConditions
get_account()                                 → {balance, equity, usedMargin,
                                                 freeMargin, leverage, marginLevel,
                                                 status, tradeMode}
get_positions() / get_orders()                → Position[] / Order[]
place_order({symbol, side, lot, sl?, tp?})    → {operationId, positionId}
modify_sl({positionId, newSl})                → {operationId}
close_position({positionId, volume?})         → {operationId}   // volume=partial
cancel_order({orderId}) / cancel_all()
kill_switch({closePositions})                 → {halted, cancelled, closed}
```

Setiap mutasi: idempotency key → tunggu `transaction_event` yang cocok `client_request_id` → fallback poll `operations/{id}` 5×500 ms. Error broker dikembalikan sebagai `ToolResult`, bukan exception.

## 5. Aturan ketiga agent

**Screener** (2 tahap supaya tidak kena rate limit):
1. Prefilter dari TickHub (gratis): `trade_mode` enabled, spread ≤ 20% TP1, ada tick dalam 30s, sesi London/NY (07:00–16:00 UTC), buang 21:00–22:00 rollover.
2. Ambil candle H1+M15+M5 hanya untuk shortlist (maks 15 pair, ~8 detik).
3. Skor: alignment EMA50/200 (H1+M15), jarak harga ke EMA20 M5, RSI M5 (pullback zone), ATR% dalam band, spread/ATR ratio. Lolos bila skor ≥ threshold dan `reasons` non-kosong.

**Entry**: trend up = EMA50>EMA200 (H1 & M15) + harga di atas EMA20 M5, pullback menyentuh EMA20 atau RSI(14) M5 < 40, lalu candle konfirmasi close kembali di atas EMA20 dengan body > 50% range. SL = swing low − 0.3×ATR (clamp 28–30 pip), TP1 = entry ± 12 pip. Satu posisi per simbol, satu sinyal per candle close.

**Risk & Executor**: lot = (virtualEquity × 0.5%) ÷ (SL pip × pipValuePerLot), dibulatkan ke `volume_step`, cap 1.0 lot; cek free margin ≥ margin × 1.5; cek maks 3 posisi & eksposur per currency; kirim order → daftarkan ke trailing state; kalau `TRADING_RULE_INVALID_PRICE_LEVELS` (jarak SL terlalu dekat) → lebarkan 2 pip dan retry sekali, lalu batalkan.

## 6. Trailing stop — spesifikasi tepat seperti contoh Anda

Contoh Anda: entry 1.0850, SL awal 1.0820 (30 pip), trail 20 pip → 1.0900 ⇒ SL 1.0880, 1.0930 ⇒ 1.0910, 1.0920 ⇒ **tetap** 1.0910.

```ts
function computeTrailingSl({side, best, currentSl, trailPips, minStopPips, bid, ask}) {
  const trail = trailPips * pip;
  const minStop = minStopPips * pip;
  if (side === "buy") {
    const candidate = best - trail;
    return candidate > currentSl && candidate <= bid - minStop ? candidate : null;
  }
  const candidate = best + trail;
  return candidate < currentSl && candidate >= ask + minStop ? candidate : null;
}
```
- `best` = highest bid (buy) / lowest ask (sell) sejak entry, di-update dari TickHub.
- **Monoton**: SL hanya naik (buy) / turun (sell). `null` = tidak ada aksi.
- Kirim hanya bila perbaikan ≥ 2 pip **dan** tidak ada PATCH in-flight untuk posisi itu **dan** ≥ 2 detik sejak PATCH terakhir (limit 4/s).
- SL dipasang **di broker**: PATCH SLTP order bila ada, kalau tidak `POST /orders {type:"sltp", position_id, stop_loss_price}`. Ini poin yang wajib diprobe dulu (lihat fase 2).
- Kalau program mati, SL broker tetap aktif — trailing hanya memperbaiki, tidak pernah melepas proteksi.
- State (`best`, `currentSl`, `inFlight`) dipersist ke `.cache/agent-state.json` + di-reconcile dari snapshot setelah restart.

## 7. Fase build + kriteria lulus (semua di demo, 0.01–0.16 lot)

| # | Langkah | Lulus bila |
|---|---|---|
| 1 | `tools/` + hubs + snapshot cache | `ot agent status` tampilkan account/positions via tools, tanpa 429 |
| 2 | **Probe SL** (0.01 lot): open tanpa SL → POST sltp → PATCH → close | terjawab: sltp muncul di snapshot? duplikat? jarak min SL? latensi async? |
| 3 | place/close/partial close | 3 siklus penuh, tidak ada posisi menggantung |
| 4 | `trailing.ts` + unit test | 20 skenario lolos, termasuk contoh Anda persis (SL tidak mundur) |
| 5 | Backtest + tuning | ≥ 300 trade sampel, report winrate/PF/expectancy/maxDD |
| 6 | Screener + Entry | 1 pass ≤ 15s, sinyal punya SL/TP valid, tanpa sinyal ganda |
| 7 | Risk + Executor + trailing live | 1 trade penuh: entry → TP1 partial → trail naik 2× → close |
| 8 | Kill switch | order baru ditolak < 1s, flatten + cancel berhasil |

Semua default di atas akan saya taruh di `.env` (`AGENT_RISK_PCT`, `AGENT_TRAIL_PIPS`, `AGENT_TP1_PIPS`, `AGENT_MAX_POSITIONS`, `EXNESS_TRADING_MODE=dry-run`) supaya bisa diubah tanpa edit kode.

## 2. Detail yang ditampilkan

| Panel | Isi |
|---|---|
| **Account** | balance, equity, used margin, free margin, margin level, leverage, unrealized P/L, P/L hari ini (nominal + %), high-water mark, max drawdown hari ini |
| **Positions** | symbol, side, lot, entry, harga sekarang, SL, TP, P/L uang + pip, **jarak ke SL (pip)**, swap/commission, margin, umur posisi, status trailing (armed / BE / in-flight) |
| **Orders** | pending + SLTP order: id, tipe, state, harga, SL/TP, volume, position_id terkait |
| **P/L chart** | kurva equity hari ini dikurangi balance awal hari → area chart ASCII dengan baseline 0 |
| **Risk** | eksposur per currency, risk terpakai vs cap, sisa jatah daily loss, status kill switch, jumlah trade hari ini |
| **Agent** | status screener pass terakhir, 5 kandidat + skor, sinyal entry terakhir, 5 modifikasi trailing terakhir |
| **Connection** | access point, state ticks WS & events WS, ticks/s, umur tick terakhir, sisa headroom rate limit |
| **Event log** | 5–8 event terakhir: `transaction_event`, `account_state`, order confirmed/rejected |

## 3. Chart ASCII

Dua bentuk, satu modul (`src/cli/chart.ts`), keduanya pure + unit-tested:

- **`plChart(series, {height, width, baseline})`** — dipakai dashboard: y-axis label "nice" (1/2/5 × 10ⁿ), bar vertikal dari baseline, hijau di atas 0 / merah di bawah 0, label waktu di sumbu-x, baris 0 ditandai `┼`.
- **`sparkline(values)`** — sudah ada, dipakai mode ringkas/plain dan `monitor pnl --compact`.

Sumber data: sampler equity tiap 5 detik (atau saat berubah > $1) → disimpan ke `.cache/equity/YYYY-MM-DD.jsonl` (`{t, balance, equity, usedMargin}`). Dengan begitu chart tetap lengkap walau dashboard di-restart di tengah hari, dan `monitor pnl --since 7d` bisa merangkum beberapa file.

## 4. Keluarga command monitor

Semua command di bawah ini hanya-baca dan memakai tool yang sama dengan agent:

| Command | Fungsi |
|---|---|
| `npm start` | dashboard penuh (default) |
| `.\bin\ot.cmd monitor positions` | tabel posisi detail + jarak SL |
| `.\bin\ot.cmd monitor pnl --since today\|session\|24h\|7d` | chart + winrate, PF, expectancy, avg win/loss, max DD |
| `.\bin\ot.cmd monitor account` | saldo/equity/margin + riwayat equity |
| `.\bin\ot.cmd monitor risk` | eksposur, sisa daily loss, kill switch |
| `.\bin\ot.cmd monitor agent` | status screener/entry/trailing |
| `.\bin\ot.cmd monitor log` | tail event transaksi |
| `.\bin\ot.cmd monitor all --once` | dump teks sekali (untuk cron/log), bisa `--json` |

Hotkey dashboard: `q` keluar, `p` pause refresh, `a` panel agent, `o` orders, `e` event lengkap, `r` refresh paksa, `x` lalu `y` untuk kill switch (konfirmasi dua langkah, tidak akan pernah satu tombol).

```ts
import type { AccountDetails, Order, Position, Snapshot } from "../exness/types.js";
import type { ExnessClient } from "../exness/client.js";

export interface AccountView {...}

export class SnapshotCache {
  private details?: {at:number; value:AccountDetails};
  private cache?: {at:number; value:AccountView};
  private inflight?: Promise<AccountView>;
  constructor(private readonly client: ExnessClient, private readonly accountId: string, private readonly ttlMs = 900) {}

  async accountDetails(force=false) {...}
  async get(force=false): Promise<AccountView> {
    if (!force && this.cache && Date.now()-this.cache.at < this.ttlMs) return this.cache.value;
    if (this.inflight) return this.inflight;
    this.inflight = this.fetchView().finally(()=>{this.inflight=undefined});
    return this.inflight;
  }
  private async fetchView(): Promise<AccountView> {...}
}
```

```ts
import { ExnessSocket, type SocketState } from "../exness/ws.js";
import { QuoteStore, type Quote } from "../market/store.js";
import type { SigningIdentity } from "../exness/signing.js";
import type { Tick } from "../exness/types.js";

export interface HubOptions {
  accessPoint: string;
  identity: SigningIdentity;
  accountId: string;
  verbose?: boolean;
  logger?: (line:string)=>void;
}

export class TickHub {
  readonly store = new QuoteStore();
  state: SocketState = "closed";
  private socket?: ExnessSocket;
  private symbols = new Set<string>();
  private startAt = Date.now();
  private tickWindow = 0;
  private rate = 0;
  private rateTimer?: NodeJS.Timeout;
  onQuote?: (q: Quote) => void;

  constructor(private opts: HubOptions) {}

  start(symbols: string[]): void {
    for (const s of symbols) this.symbols.add(s.toUpperCase());
    if (!this.socket) {
      this.socket = new ExnessSocket({
        accessPoint, identity, path: `/v1/server-events/accounts/${accountId}/ws/ticks`,
        onState: (s) => this.state = s,
        onOpen: () => this.resubscribe(),
        onMessage: (m) => this.handle(m),
        logger: verbose? logger : undefined,
      });
      this.socket.connect();
      this.rateTimer = setInterval(()=>{ this.rate = this.tickWindow; this.tickWindow=0; }, 1000);
      this.rateTimer.unref?.();
    } else if (this.state === "open") {
      this.sendSubscribe(symbols);
    }
  }
  subscribe(symbols: string[]) { add; if open send }
  unsubscribe? not needed.
  ensure(symbols, timeoutMs=3000): Promise<Quote[]> — subscribe then poll 50ms until all present or timeout → return found.
  get(symbol)
  quotes()
  get ticksPerSecond()
  get subscribed(): string[]
  close()
}
```
`this.rateTimer.unref()` — NodeJS.Timeout has unref. Use optional.

Chunking: sendSubscribe(symbols) splits every 100 with unique id counter.

handle(message): if tick object → store.upsert; onQuote.

Ack detection: `{id, code}` ignore or store error state.

Position P/L pips: 
```ts
function positionPips(p: Position, quote?: Quote): number | null {
  const open = Number(p.open_price); if (!isFinite(open) || open===0) return null;
  const price = p.direction === "buy" ? quote?.bid : quote?.ask;
  if (!price) return null;
  const diff = p.direction === "buy" ? price-open : open-price;
  return diff * 10**digitsFor(p.instrument);
}
```
Note digitsFor heuristic; for JPY 3 digits → pips = diff*100? Wait: 1 pip = 0.01 for JPY pairs, i.e. 10 points (point_digits 3). So pips = diff * 10^(digits-1). For 5-digit pairs: pip = 0.0001 = 10 points → diff * 10^4 = diff * 10^(digits-1). Yes: `pips = diff * 10 ** (digits - 1)`. Good.

Distance to SL: same conversion, abs(price - sl) * 10^(digits-1).

  private messageSeq = 0;
  private rate = 0;
  private window = 0;
  private rateTimer?: NodeJS.Timeout;
  private lastAckError?: string;

  constructor(private readonly options: HubOptions) {}

  get ticksPerSecond(): number { return this.rate; }
  get subscribed(): string[] { return [...this.symbols]; }
  get quotesCount(): number { return this.store.size; }

  start(symbols: string[]): void {
    const added = symbols.map(s => s.toUpperCase()).filter(Boolean);
    for (const s of added) this.symbols.add(s);
    if (this.socket) { if (this.state === "open") this.sendSubscriptions(added); return; }
    this.socket = new ExnessSocket({
      accessPoint: this.options.accessPoint,
      identity: this.options.identity,
      path: `/v1/server-events/accounts/${this.options.accountId}/ws/ticks`,
      autoReconnect: true,
      logger: this.options.verbose ? this.options.logger : undefined,
      onState: (state) => { this.state = state; },
      onOpen: () => this.sendSubscriptions([...this.symbols]),
      onMessage: (message) => this.handleMessage(message),
    });
    this.socket.connect();
    this.rateTimer = setInterval(() => { this.rate = this.window; this.window = 0; }, 1000);
    this.rateTimer.unref();
  }
  ...
}
```
`onOpen` fires and then sendSubscriptions(...all) — but start() also calls sendSubscriptions if open. On first open, socket's onOpen does it. When adding symbols while open, we call sendSubscriptions(added). Good.

async ensure(symbols: string[], timeoutMs=4000): Promise<Quote[]> {
  const upper = symbols.map(s=>s.toUpperCase());
  const missing = upper.filter(s=>!this.store.get(s));
  if (missing.length>0) this.start(missing);
  const deadline = Date.now()+timeoutMs;
  while (Date.now()<deadline) {
    const found = upper.map(s=>this.store.get(s)).filter((q):q is Quote=>Boolean(q));
    if (found.length === upper.length) return found;
    await sleep(50);
  }
  return upper.map(s=>this.store.get(s)).filter(...)
}

export interface RuntimeEvent { at:number; type:string; summary:string; tone:"info"|"success"|"error"|"warn"; raw:unknown }

export function summarizeEvent(raw: unknown): RuntimeEvent | null {
  if (!raw || typeof raw !== "object") return null;
  const e = raw as Record<string, unknown> & {event_type?: string; event_time?: string};
  if (typeof e.code === "number" && e.event_type === undefined) {
    // ack
    return { at: Date.now(), type: "ack", summary: `subscription ${e.id ?? ""} → ${e.code}`, tone: e.code === 200 ? "info" : "error", raw };
  }
  const type = e.event_type ?? "unknown";
  const at = e.event_time ? (Date.parse(String(e.event_time)) || Date.now()) : Date.now();
  ...
}
```
Return summaries per type as before. For transaction status: tone success if status in confirmed/filled/success; error if rejected/failed.

EventHub:
```ts
export class EventHub {
  readonly events: RuntimeEvent[] = [];
  state: SocketState = "closed";
  onEvent?: (event: RuntimeEvent) => void;
  private socket?: ExnessSocket;
  constructor(private readonly options: HubOptions & { instruments?: boolean }) {}
  start(): void { if (this.socket) return; create socket path /ws/events, onOpen subscribe transactions, account_state, [instruments all], onMessage handle }
  private handle(raw) {
    const event = summarizeEvent(raw);
    if (!event) return;
    if (event.type === "ack") { this.onEvent?.(event); return; }
    this.events.push(event);
    if (this.events.length > 300) this.events.splice(0, this.events.length-300);
    this.persist(event);
    this.onEvent?.(event);
  }
  close()
}
```
Persist: append JSON line to `.cache/events-<localdate>.jsonl`; wrap try/catch; don't persist ack.

```ts
export interface ChartPoint { t: number; value: number }

export function plChart(points: ChartPoint[], options: {height?: number; width?: number; currency?: string; digits?: number} = {}): string {
  const width = Math.max(20, options.width ?? terminalWidth() - 14);
  const height = Math.max(5, options.height ?? 9);
  if (points.length === 0) return style.dim("  belum ada data equity");
  
  const values = points.map(p=>p.value);
  let min = Math.min(...values, 0);
  let max = Math.max(...values, 0);
  if (max - min < 1e-9) { max = max + 1; min = min - 1; }
  const pad = (max-min)*0.08;
  min -= pad; max += pad;

  const rows = height - 2; // reserve time row + maybe
  // sample columns
  const cols = width;
  const sampled: ChartPoint[] = sampleToColumns(points, cols);
  
  const toRow = (v:number) => Math.min(rows-1, Math.max(0, Math.round((max - v)/(max-min)*(rows-1))));
  const baselineRow = toRow(0);
  
  // grid
  const grid: string[][] = Array.from({length: rows}, () => Array.from({length: cols}, () => " "));
  const tones: Array<Array<"pos"|"neg"|"flat">> = ...
  for each col i, value v = sampled[i].value; r = toRow(v);
  if (r < baselineRow) fill r..baselineRow-1 with "█" tone pos
  else if (r > baselineRow) fill baselineRow+1..r with "▒" tone neg
  else grid[baselineRow][i] = "─" flat
```

[],\n    fetchedAt: Date.now(),\n  };\n}\n\n/**\n * Coalesces snapshot reads: the endpoint is limited to 2 req/s and both the\n * dashboard and any agent may ask for the same data in the same second.\n */\nexport class SnapshotCache {\n  private details?: { at: number; value: AccountDetails };\n  private cache?: { at: number; value: AccountView };\n  private inflight?: Promise<AccountView>;\n\n  constructor(\n    private readonly client: ExnessClient,\n    private readonly accountId: string,\n    private readonly ttlMs = 900,\n  ) {}\n\n  async accountDetails(force = false): Promise<AccountDetails | undefined> {\n    if (!force && this.details && Date.now() - this.details.at < DETAILS_TTL_MS) {\n      return this.details.value;\n    }\n    try {\n      const value = await this.client.get<AccountDetails>(\n        `/v1/configuration/accounts/${this.accountId}/account`,\n      );\n      this.details = { at: Date.now(), value };\n      return value;\n    } catch {\n      return this.details?.value;\n    }\n  }\n\n  async get(force = false): Promise<AccountView> {\n    if (!force && this.cache && Date.now() - this.cache.at < this.ttlMs) {\n      return this.cache.value;\n    }\n    if (this.inflight) return this.inflight;\n\n    this.inflight = this.fetchView().finally(() => {\n      this.inflight = undefined;\n    });\n    return this.inflight;\n  }\n\n  private async fetchView(): Promise<AccountView> {\n    const details = await this.accountDetails();\n    const snapshot = await this.client.get<Snapshot>(\n      `/v1/trading/accounts/${this.accountId}/snapshot`,\n    );\n    const view = toAccountView(details, snapshot, this.accountId);\n    this.cache = { at: Date.now(), value: view };\n    return view;\n  }\n\n  invalidate(): void {\n    this.cache = undefined;\n  }\n}\n",

  "content": "import { pad, style, terminalWidth } from \"../cli/render.js\";\n\nexport interface ChartPoint {\n  /** epoch milliseconds */\n  t: number;\n  value: number;\n}\n\nexport interface ChartOptions {\n  height?: number;\n  width?: number;\n  currency?: string;\n  label?: string;\n}\n\ntype Tone = \"pos\" | \"neg\" | \"flat\" | \"none\";\n\ninterface Cell {\n  ch: string;\n  tone: Tone;\n}\n\nfunction signMoney(value: number, currency: string, digits = 2): string {\n  const sign = value > 0 ? \"+\" : value < 0 ? \"-\" : \"\";\n  const amount = Math.abs(value).toLocaleString(\"en-US\", {\n    minimumFractionDigits: digits,\n    maximumFractionDigits: digits,\n  });\n  return `${sign}${amount}${currency ? ` ${currency}` : \"\"}`;\n}\n\nfunction clockLabel(epochMs: number): string {\n  return new Date(epochMs).toISOString().slice(11, 16);\n}\n\nfunction sampleColumns(points: ChartPoint[], columns: number): ChartPoint[] {\n  if (points.length <= columns) {\n    const padding = columns - points.length;\n    const left = Math.floor(padding / 2);\n    return [\n      ...Array.from({ length: left }, () => points[0]!),\n      ...points,\n      ...Array.from({ length: padding - left }, () => points[points.length - 1]!),\n    ];\n  }\n  return Array.from({ length: columns }, (_, index) => {\n    const position = Math.round((index * (points.length - 1)) / (columns - 1));\n    return points[position]!;\n  });\n}\n\n/**\n * Area chart around a zero baseline: positive P/L fills up in green blocks,\n * negative P/L fills down in red. Designed for a 100–200 column terminal.\n */\nexport function plChart(points: ChartPoint[], options: ChartOptions = {}): string {\n  const totalWidth = options.width ?? terminalWidth();\n  const currency = options.currency ?? \"\";\n  const axisWidth = 12;\n  const columns = Math.max(20, totalWidth - axisWidth - 3);\n  const rows = Math.max(4, options.height ?? 9);\n\n  if (points.length === 0) {\n    return style.dim(\"  belum ada data equity untuk digambar\");\n  }\n\n  const values = points.map((point) => point.value);\n  let min = Math.min(...values, 0);\n  let max = Math.max(...values, 0);\n  if (max - min < 1e-9) {\n    max += 1;\n    min -= 1;\n  }\n  const padding = (max - min) * 0.08;\n  const lo = min - padding;\n  const hi = max + padding;\n\n  const samplePoints = sampleColumns(points, columns);\n  const toRow = (value: number): number => {\n    const ratio = (hi - value) / (hi - lo);\n    return Math.min(rows - 1, Math.max(0, Math.round(ratio * (rows - 1))));\n  };\n  const baseline = toRow(0);\n\n  const grid: Cell[][] = Array.from({ length: rows }, () =>\n    Array.from({ length: columns }, () => ({ ch: \" \", tone: \"none\" as Tone })),\n  );\n\n  samplePoints.forEach((point, column) => {\n    const row = toRow(point.value);\n    if (row < baseline) {\n      for (let r = row; r < baseline; r += 1) {\n        grid[r]![column] = { ch: \"█\", tone: \"pos\" };\n      }\n    } else if (row > baseline) {\n      for (let r = baseline + 1; r <= row; r += 1) {\n        grid[r]![column] = { ch: \"▒\", tone: \"neg\" };\n      }\n    } else {\n      grid[baseline]![column] = { ch: \"─\", tone: \"flat\" };\n    }\n  });\n\n  const labels: Array<{ row: number; text: string }> = [];\n  const labelValues: Array<{ value: number; text: string }> = [\n    { value: max, text: signMoney(max, currency) },\n    { value: 0, text: \"0\" },\n    { value: min, text: signMoney(min, currency) },\n  ];\n  const usedRows = new Set<number>();\n  for (const label of labelValues) {\n    const row = toRow(label.value);\n    if (usedRows.has(row)) continue;\n    usedRows.add(row);\n    labels.push({ row, text: label.text });\n  }\n\n  const rowsOut: string[] = [];\n  for (let r = 0; r < rows; r += 1) {\n    const label = labels.find((entry) => entry.row === r)?.text ?? \"\";\n    const axis = r === baseline ? \"┼\" : \"┤\";\n    const cells = grid[r]!;\n    let body = \"\";\n    let runTone: Tone = \"none\";\n    let run = \"\";\n    const flush = (): void => {\n      if (run.length === 0) return;\n      body +=\n        runTone === \"pos\"\n          ? style.green(run)\n          : runTone === \"neg\"\n            ? style.red(run)\n            : runTone === \"flat\"\n              ? style.gray(run)\n              : run;\n      run = \"\";\n    };\n    for (const cell of cells) {\n      if (cell.tone !== runTone) {\n        flush();\n        runTone = cell.tone;\n      }\n      run += cell.ch;\n    }\n    flush();\n    rowsOut.push(`${style.dim(pad(label, axisWidth, \"right\"))} ${style.dim(axis)} ${body}`);\n  }\n\n  const axisLine = `${\" \".repeat(axisWidth)} ${style.dim(\"└\")}${style.dim(\"─\".repeat(columns))}`;\n  const first = points[0]!;\n  const last = points[points.length - 1]!;\n  const timeLabels = new Array(columns).fill(\" \") as string[];\n  const place = (text: string, at: number): void => {\n    const start = Math.max(0, Math.min(columns - text.length, at));\n    for (let index = 0; index < text.length; index += 1) {\n      timeLabels[start + index] = text[index]!;\n    }\n  };\n  place(clockLabel(first.t), 0);\n  if (last.t - first.t > 60_000) {\n    place(clockLabel(first.t + (last.t - first.t) / 2), Math.floor(columns / 2) - 2);\n    place(clockLabel(last.t), columns - 5);\n  }\n  const timeLine = `${\" \".repeat(axisWidth + 1)} ${style.dim(timeLabels.join(\"\"))}`;\n\n  const title = options.label\n    ? `${style.dim(\"  \")}${style.dim(options.label)}`\n    : \"\";\n\n  return [title, ...rowsOut, axisLine, timeLine].filter(Boolean).join(\"\\n\");\n}\n",

}

Survives restarts so the\n * P/L chart still covers the whole day, not just the current process.\n */\nexport class EquityTracker {\n  readonly samples: EquitySample[] = [];\n\n  private lastRecordAt = 0;\n  private lastEquity = Number.NaN;\n  private lastWriteKey = \"\";\n  private loadedDays = 0;\n\n  constructor(\n    private readonly cacheDir: string,\n    readonly currency = \"USD\",\n    private readonly intervalMs = 5000,\n  ) {}\n\n  get dir(): string {\n    return path.join(this.cacheDir, \"equity\");\n  }\n\n  loadDays(days: number): void {\n    this.samples.length = 0;\n    this.loadedDays = Math.max(1, days);\n    for (const key of dateKeysBack(this.loadedDays)) {\n      const file = path.join(this.dir, `${key}.jsonl`);\n      let raw: string;\n      try {\n        raw = fs.readFileSync(file, \"utf8\");\n      } catch {\n        continue;\n      }\n      for (const line of raw.split(/\\r?\\n/)) {\n        if (!line.trim()) continue;\n        try {\n          const sample = JSON.parse(line) as EquitySample;\n          if (Number.isFinite(sample.t) && Number.isFinite(sample.equity)) {\n            this.samples.push(sample);\n          }\n        } catch {\n          // ignore corrupt line\n        }\n      }\n    }\n    this.samples.sort((a, b) => a.t - b.t);\n\n    const last = this.samples[this.samples.length - 1];\n    if (last) {\n      this.lastRecordAt = last.t;\n      this.lastEquity = last.equity;\n      this.lastWriteKey = localDateKey(new Date(last.t));\n    }\n  }\n\n  loadToday(): void {\n    this.loadDays(1);\n  }\n\n  /** Returns true when a new sample was stored. */\n  record(view: AccountView, force = false): boolean {\n    const now = Date.now();\n    if (\n      !force &&\n      now - this.lastRecordAt < this.intervalMs &&\n      Math.abs(view.equity - this.lastEquity) < 1\n    ) {\n      return false;\n    }\n\n    const sample: EquitySample = {\n      t: now,\n      balance: view.balance,\n      equity: view.equity,\n      usedMargin: view.usedMargin,\n    };\n    this.samples.push(sample);\n    if (this.samples.length > 50_000) this.samples.splice(0, this.samples.length - 50_000);\n    this.lastRecordAt = now;\n    this.lastEquity = view.equity;\n    this.persist(sample);\n    return true;\n  }\n\n  get latest(): EquitySample | undefined {\n    return this.samples[this.samples.length - 1];\n  }\n\n  get startBalance(): number {\n    return this.samples[0]?.balance ?? this.latest?.balance ?? 0;\n  }\n\n  points(): ChartPoint[] {\n    return this.samples.map((sample) => ({\n      t: sample.t,\n      value: sample.equity - this.startBalance,\n    }));\n  }\n\n  stats(): EquityStats {\n    const first = this.samples[0];\n    const last = this.samples[this.samples.length - 1];\n    if (!first || !last) {\n      const zero = {\n        start: 0,\n        end: 0,\n        change: 0,\n        changePct: 0,\n        high: 0,\n        low: 0,\n        maxDrawdown: 0,\n        maxDrawdownPct: 0,\n        samples: 0,\n        from: Date.now(),\n        to: Date.now(),\n      };\n      return zero;\n    }\n\n    const start = first.balance;\n    let high = this.samples[0]!.equity;\n    let low = this.samples[0]!.equity;\n    let peak = this.samples[0]!.equity;\n    let maxDrawdown = 0;\n\n    for (const sample of this.samples) {\n      if (sample.equity > high) high = sample.equity;\n      if (sample.equity < low) low = sample.equity;\n      if (sample.equity > peak) peak = sample.equity;\n      maxDrawdown = Math.max(maxDrawdown, peak - sample.equity);\n    }\n\n    const change = last.equity - start;\n    return {\n      start,\n      end: last.equity,\n      change,\n      changePct: start === 0 ? 0 : (change / start) * 100,\n      high,\n      low,\n      maxDrawdown,\n      maxDrawdownPct: start === 0 ? 0 : (maxDrawdown / start) * 100,\n      samples: this.samples.length,\n      from: first.t,\n      to: last.t,\n    };\n  }\n\n  private persist(sample: EquitySample): void {\n    try {\n      fs.mkdirSync(this.dir, { recursive: true });\n      const key = localDateKey(new Date(sample.t));\n      this.lastWriteKey = key;\n      fs.appendFileSync(path.join(this.dir, `${key}.jsonl`), `${JSON.stringify(sample)}\\n`);\n    } catch {\n      // Best effort.\n    }\n  }\n}\n",

  "content": "export type PositionSide = \"buy\" | \"sell\";\n\nexport interface TrailingInput {\n  side: PositionSide;\n  /** price at entry */\n  entry: number;\n  /** highest bid (buy) or lowest ask (sell) seen since entry */\n  best: number;\n  /** SL currently registered at the broker */\n  currentSl: number;\n  /** distance kept between best price and SL, in price units */\n  trailDistance: number;\n  /** broker minimum distance between SL and current price, in price units */\n  minStopDistance: number;\n  bid: number;\n  ask: number;\n  /** minimum improvement required before touching the broker, in price units */\n  step?: number;\n}\n\nexport type TrailingAction =\n  | { action: \"raise\"; newSl: number; reason: string }\n  | { action: \"hold\"; reason: string };\n\n/**\n * Trailing stop core. Mirrors the reference example:\n *\n *   BUY entry 1.0850, initial SL 1.0820, trail 20 pips\n *   best 1.0900 -> SL 1.0880\n *   best 1.0930 -> SL 1.0910\n *   price back to 1.0920 -> SL stays 1.0910 (never loosens)\n *\n * The function is pure so the same logic can be unit-tested and reused by the\n * backtest simulator and the live executor.\n */\nexport function computeTrailingSl(input: TrailingInput): TrailingAction {\n  const step = input.step ?? 0;\n\n  if (!Number.isFinite(input.best) || !Number.isFinite(input.currentSl)) {\n    return { action: \"hold\", reason: \"invalid numbers\" };\n  }\n\n  if (input.side === \"buy\") {\n    const candidate = input.best - input.trailDistance;\n\n    if (candidate - input.currentSl <= step) {\n      return { action: \"hold\", reason: \"no improvement\" };\n    }\n    if (candidate > input.bid - input.minStopDistance) {\n      return { action: \"hold\", reason: \"too close to price\" };\n    }\n    return {\n      action: \"raise\",\n      newSl: roundPrice(candidate),\n      reason: `best ${input.best} - trail ${input.trailDistance}`,\n    };\n  }\n\n  const candidate = input.best + input.trailDistance;\n  if (input.currentSl - candidate <= step) {\n    return { action: \"hold\", reason: \"no improvement\" };\n  }\n  if (candidate < input.ask + input.minStopDistance) {\n    return { action: \"hold\", reason: \"too close to price\" };\n  }\n  return {\n    action: \"raise\",\n    newSl: roundPrice(candidate),\n    reason: `best ${input.best} + trail ${input.trailDistance}`,\n  };\n}\n\nfunction roundPrice(value: number): number {\n  return Math.round(value * 1e8) / 1e8;\n}\n\n/** New best price for a position, never moving backwards. */\nexport function updateBest(\n  side: PositionSide,\n  best: number,\n  bid: number,\n  ask: number,\n): number {\n  return side === \"buy\" ? Math.max(best, bid) : Math.min(best, ask);\n}\n",

3: Terminal client for the **Exness Trader API**, built around a verified end-to-end

19: ## Quick start
20: 
21: ```powershell
22: npm install
23: npm run doctor
24: ```
25: 
26: `.env` must contain:
27: 
28: ```ini
29: EXNESS_API_KEY=exnsk-...
30: EXNESS_PRIVATE_KEY=...            # 128-char hex key pair, 64-char hex seed, or PEM
31: EXNESS_ACCOUNT_ID=31000172947
32: EXNESS_DISCOVERY_URL=https://api.exness.com
33: ```
34: 
35: `EXNESS_API_SECRET` is still accepted as a fallback name for the private key.
36: 
37: ## Commands
38: 
39: > `npm run` on Windows silently drops `--flag value` arguments. For anything with
40: > options, use the wrapper: `bin\ot.cmd ...` (or `npx tsx src/cli/index.ts ...`).
41: 
42: | Command | What it does |
43: | --- | --- |
44: | `bin\ot.cmd doctor` | discovery → account → catalog → snapshot → candles → live ticks, with timings |
45: | `bin\ot.cmd account` | account profile, mode (demo/live), currency, leverage, access point |
46: | `bin\ot.cmd snapshot` | balance, equity, used/free margin, margin level, open positions and orders |
47: | `bin\ot.cmd instruments --fx --search EUR` | instrument catalog (335 instruments, 175 FX pairs) |
48: | `bin\ot.cmd candles EURUSD --tf M5 --count 60` | OHLC table + ASCII sparkline, `--type bid\|ask\|both` |
49: | `bin\ot.cmd ticker EURUSD XAUUSD --for 15` | live bid/ask, spread in points, tick count, age |
50: | `bin\ot.cmd watch --search JPY --limit 15` | live board of all FX pairs (or `--all`), sorted by change |
51: | `bin\ot.cmd limits` | REST + WebSocket rate limits for this account |
52: | `bin\ot.cmd events --for 30` | stream `account_state` / `transaction_event` / instrument events |
53: 
54: Global flags: `--verbose`, `--no-color`, `--json`.
55: 
56: `npm run doctor|account|snapshot|limits|instruments` also work because they take no
57: options.
58: 
59: ## How it works
60: 
61: ```
62: src/
63: ├─ config.ts              .env loading (no dotenv) + validation
64: ├─ exness/
65: │  ├─ signing.ts          hex/PEM → Ed25519 key, EXN-DATA + EXN-SIGN headers
66: │  ├─ client.ts           access-point discovery + cache, signed REST, retry, rate limit
67: │  ├─ ws.ts               signed WebSocket handshake, heartbeat, reconnect + resubscribe
68: │  ├─ catalog.ts          instrument catalog + per-instrument conditions (cached)
69: │  └─ types.ts            subset of trading.public.yaml v1.0.2
70: ├─ market/store.ts        last tick per symbol, quotes, formatting
71: └─ cli/                   arg parsing, ANSI rendering, commands
72: ```
73: 
74: Behaviour worth knowing:
75: 
76: - **Signing** — `EXN-DATA` is serialized once; those exact bytes are signed and
77:   base64url-encoded (no padding) into `EXN-DATA`, with the Ed25519 signature in
78:   `EXN-SIGN`. `body_hash` is SHA-256 of the exact body (`47DEQpj8…` for empty).
79: - **Discovery** — `GET /v1/trading/access-point?account_id=…` against
80:   `EXNESS_DISCOVERY_URL`. The result is cached in `.cache/access-point.json` for

80:   `EXNESS_DISCOVERY_URL`. The result is cached in `.cache/access-point.json` for
81:   10 minutes and re-resolved once on a `401`.
82: - **Rate limits** — the client keeps a per-route sliding window (candles 2/s,
83:   snapshot 2/s, orders 4/s, global 10/s) and honours `Retry-After` on `429`.
84: - **Realtime** — the WebSocket handshake is signed as a `GET` with the exact path.
85:   `ws` is used because browsers cannot set the `EXN-*` handshake headers.
86: - **Money and volume are decimal strings** in requests/responses; only display
87:   formatting uses numbers, with `point_digits` taken from instrument conditions.
88: 
89: ## Roadmap
90: 
91: Phase 1 (done) — connection, account state, catalog, candles, live ticks, limits.
92: 
93: Phase 2 — persist quotes/candles, instrument metadata warm-up, screener
94: (alerts, ranking, spread stats).
95: 
96: Phase 3 — trading: `POST /positions` (buy/sell with SL/TP), `DELETE /positions/{id}`
97: for close/partial close, pending orders (`limit`/`stop`), ACK → `transaction_event`
98: correlation via idempotency keys, history from `/history/orders` and `/history/deals`.
99: Trading is asynchronous: always subscribe to `/ws/events` *before* sending the order.
100: 
101: Phase 4 — UI on top of `src/exness/*` (the client layer is UI-agnostic).
102: 
103: ## Security
104: 
105: - `.env` holds a live signing key: it is gitignored, never bundled and only read
106:   server-side. Do not paste it into chats, issues or screenshots.
107: - The wrapper and CLI print only a key prefix (`exnsk-4b7c8c44…`).
108: - Rotate the key in Exness Key Management if it was ever exposed, then update `.env`.
109: 
110: ## Troubleshooting
111: 
112: | Symptom | Meaning |
113: | --- | --- |
114: | `401/1001` | Signature mismatch — key format, payload bytes, body hash or base64url padding. |
115: | `401/1000` | API key missing/expired, or `EXN-DATA.api_key` ≠ `EXN-API-KEY`. |
116: | `403/1002` | API key has no access to this account/IP/scope. |
117: | `404/2000` | Account not found for this key. |
118: | `400/3005` | `REQUEST_INVALID_COUNT` — candles need `count` or `to`, not just `from`. |
119: | Repeated `503` | Service unavailable; retry later (client already retries twice). |

# Core Concepts

A consolidated map of the trading entities and risk concepts used across the API.

## Core trading entities ​

* •
  
  Accounts
  
  Account settings, trading status, leverage, margin call, stop out, and account currency. Accounts matter because every trading and market-data workflow is scoped to account permissions.
* •
  
  Orders
  
  Orders are trading instructions, including pending orders and SLTP objects. They matter because they represent client intent before or during execution.
* •
  
  Positions
  
  Positions are open market exposure created by executed trading operations. They matter for PnL, margin, and close/modify workflows.
* •
  
  Deals
