189: 
190: function eventTime(raw: Record<string, unknown>): number {
191:   const value = raw.event_time;
192:   if (typeof value === "string") {
193:     const parsed = Date.parse(value);
194:     if (!Number.isNaN(parsed)) return parsed;
195:   }
196:   return Date.now();
197: }
198: 
199: export function summarizeEvent(raw: unknown): RuntimeEvent | null {
200:   if (!raw || typeof raw !== "object") return null;
201:   const event = raw as Record<string, unknown>;
202: 
203:   // Subscription acknowledgements: { id, code, error_message? }
204:   const rawCode = event.code;
205:   if ((typeof rawCode === "number" || typeof rawCode === "string") && event.event_type === undefined) {
206:     const code = Number(rawCode);
207:     if (code === 200) return null;
208:     return {
209:       at: Date.now(),
210:       type: "subscription",
211:       summary: `${String(event.id ?? "subscription")} rejected: ${String(code)} ${String(event.error_message ?? "")}`.trim(),
212:       tone: "error",
213:       raw,
214:     };
215:   }
216: 
217:   const type = typeof event.event_type === "string" ? event.event_type : "event";
218:   const at = eventTime(event);
219: 
220:   switch (type) {
221:     case "account_state_event": {
222:       const state = (event.payload as { account_state?: Record<string, string> } | undefined)
223:         ?.account_state;
224:       return {
225:         at,
226:         type,
227:         summary: `equity ${state?.equity ?? "?"} · balance ${state?.balance ?? "?"} · margin ${state?.used_margin ?? "?"}`,
228:         tone: "info",
229:         raw,
230:       };
231:     }
232:     case "trading_state_snapshot": {
233:       const payload = event.payload as
234:         | { positions?: unknown[]; orders?: unknown[]; account_state?: Record<string, string> }
235:         | undefined;
236:       return {
237:         at,
238:         type,
239:         summary: `${payload?.positions?.length ?? 0} positions · ${payload?.orders?.length ?? 0} orders · equity ${payload?.account_state?.equity ?? "?"}`,
240:         tone: "info",
241:         raw,
242:       };
243:     }
244:     case "transaction_event": {
245:       const status = typeof event.status === "string" ? event.status : "?";
246:       const okStatus = ["confirmed", "filled", "success"].includes(status);
247:       const failed = ["rejected", "failed"].includes(status);
248:       const detail = failed
249:         ? ` ${String(event.error_code ?? "")} ${String(event.error_message ?? "")}`.trimEnd()
250:         : "";
251:       return {
252:         at,
253:         type,
254:         summary: `${status} · op ${String(event.operation_id ?? "?")}${detail}`,
255:         tone: okStatus ? "success" : failed ? "error" : "warn",
256:         raw,
257:       };
258:     }
259:     case "instrument_event": {
260:       const instrument = typeof event.instrument === "string" ? event.instrument : "?";
261:       const action = typeof event.action === "string" ? event.action : "";
262:       return { at, type, summary: `${instrument} ${action}`.trim(), tone: "info", raw };
263:     }
264:     case "hmr_snapshot":
265:     case "hmr_update":
266:       return { at, type, summary: "instrument metadata refresh", tone: "warn", raw };
267:     default:
268:       return { at, type, summary: "", tone: "info", raw };
269:   }
270: }

272: function localDateKey(date = new Date()): string {
273:   const year = date.getFullYear();
274:   const month = String(date.getMonth() + 1).padStart(2, "0");
275:   const day = String(date.getDate()).padStart(2, "0");
276:   return `${year}-${month}-${day}`;
277: }

280:   return path.join(cacheDir, "events", `${localDateKey(date)}.jsonl`);
281: }

283: export function readRecentEvents(cacheDir: string, limit = 20): RuntimeEvent[] {
284:   const file = eventLogPath(cacheDir);
285:   try {
286:     const lines = fs.readFileSync(file, "utf8").split(/\r?\n/).filter(Boolean);
287:     return lines
288:       .slice(-limit)
289:       .map((line) => {
290:         try {
291:           return JSON.parse(line) as RuntimeEvent;
292:         } catch {
293:           return null;
294:         }
295:       })
296:       .filter((event): event is RuntimeEvent => event !== null && event.summary !== "");
297:   } catch {
298:     return [];
299:   }
300: }

302: export class EventHub {
303:   readonly events: RuntimeEvent[] = [];
304:   state: SocketState = "closed";
305:   onEvent?: (event: RuntimeEvent) => void;
306: 
307:   private socket?: ExnessSocket;
308:   private readonly listeners = new Set<(event: RuntimeEvent) => void>();
309: 
310:   constructor(private readonly options: HubOptions & { instruments?: boolean }) {}
311: 
312:   /** Multiple consumers (dashboard, execution gateway) can listen at once. */
313:   on(listener: (event: RuntimeEvent) => void): () => void {
314:     this.listeners.add(listener);
315:     return () => this.listeners.delete(listener);
316:   }
317: 
318:   start(): void {
319:     if (this.socket) return;
320: 
321:     this.socket = new ExnessSocket({
322:       accessPoint: this.options.accessPoint,
323:       identity: this.options.identity,
324:       path: `/v1/server-events/accounts/${this.options.accountId}/ws/events`,
325:       autoReconnect: true,
326:       logger: this.options.verbose ? this.options.logger : undefined,
327:       onState: (state) => {
328:         this.state = state;
329:       },
330:       onOpen: () => {
331:         this.socket?.send({ id: "events-transactions", subscribe: { event: "transactions" } });
332:         this.socket?.send({ id: "events-account", subscribe: { event: "account_state" } });
333:         if (this.options.instruments) {
334:           this.socket?.send({
335:             id: "events-instruments",
336:             subscribe: { event: "instruments", instruments: ["all"] },
337:           });
338:         }
339:       },
340:       onMessage: (message) => this.handleMessage(message),
341:     });
342:     this.socket.connect();
343:   }
344: 
345:   close(): void {
346:     this.socket?.close();
347:     this.socket = undefined;
348:     this.state = "closed";
349:   }
350: 
351:   private handleMessage(message: unknown): void {
352:     const event = summarizeEvent(message);
353:     if (!event) return;
354: 
355:     this.events.push(event);
356:     if (this.events.length > 300) this.events.splice(0, this.events.length - 300);
357:     this.persist(event);
358:     this.onEvent?.(event);
359:     for (const listener of this.listeners) {
360:       try {
361:         listener(event);
362:       } catch {
363:         // A consumer must not break the event stream for others.
364:       }
365:     }
366:   }
367: 
368:   private persist(event: RuntimeEvent): void {
369:     if (!this.options.cacheDir) return;
370:     try {
371:       const file = eventLogPath(this.options.cacheDir);
372:       fs.mkdirSync(path.dirname(file), { recursive: true });
373:       fs.appendFileSync(file, `${JSON.stringify(event)}\n`);
374:     } catch {
375:       // Best effort: monitoring must never break because a log write failed.
376:     }
377:   }
378: }

80: export function positionPips(position: Position, quote: Quote | undefined): number | null {
81:   const open = Number(position.open_price);
82:   if (!Number.isFinite(open) || open === 0) return null;
83:   const price = position.direction === "buy" ? quote?.bid : quote?.ask;
84:   if (!price) return null;
85:   const diff = position.direction === "buy" ? price - open : open - price;
86:   return diff / pipSize(position.instrument, digitsFor(position.instrument));

189: export function spreadSpikes(ticks: TickHub): number {
190:   const quotes = ticks.store.all();
191:   if (quotes.length < 5) return 0;
192:   // Absolute threshold (5 bp) instead of a median multiple: exotic pairs are
193:   // structurally wide, so a relative measure would flag them permanently.
194:   return quotes.filter((quote) => Number.isFinite(quote.spreadPct) && quote.spreadPct >= 0.05)
195:     .length;
196: }

198: export function dailyCap(view: AccountView, equity: EquityTracker, capPct = 3): {
199:   start: number;
200:   change: number;
201:   cap: number;
202:   remaining: number;
203: } {
204:   const start = equity.startBalance || view.balance;
205:   const change = view.equity - start;
206:   const cap = (start * capPct) / 100;
207:   return { start, change, cap, remaining: cap + Math.min(0, change) };
208: }

210: export function exposureByCurrency(positions: Position[]): Array<[string, number]> {
211:   const totals = new Map<string, number>();
212:   for (const position of positions) {
213:     const base = position.instrument.slice(0, 3);
214:     totals.set(base, (totals.get(base) ?? 0) + Number(position.volume));
215:   }
216:   return [...totals.entries()].sort((a, b) => b[1] - a[1]);
217: }

468:   parts.push(renderPositionsTable(state.view, state.ticks, positionLimit));
469:

481:

483:     parts.push(section(`ORDERS (${state.view.orders.length})`, width));
484:     parts.push(renderOrdersTable(state.view, state.ticks, 5));

500:       : style.dim(
501:           "  q quit · p pause · o orders · e events · a agent · r refresh · x kill switch",
502:         ),
503:   );
504: 
505:   return parts.join("\n");
506: }

`truncateAnsi` implementation scanning codes:
```ts
function truncateAnsi(text: string, width: number): string {
  let out = ""; let count = 0; let i=0; let sawAnsi=false;
  while (i < text.length && count < width - 1) {
    const code = text.slice(i).match(/^\u001b\[[0-9;]*m/);
    if (code) { out += code[0]; sawAnsi=true; i += code[0].length; continue; }
    out += text[i]; count++; i++;
  }
  // Need to add ellipsis at last visible slot
  return (sawAnsi ? out + "\u001b[0m" : out) + "…";
}
```

\"no signal\"}`);\n          continue;\n        }\n\n        this.lastSignal = decision.signal;\n        this.deps.log(\n          `sinyal ${decision.signal.side.toUpperCase()} ${candidate.symbol} ` +\n            `entry ${decision.signal.entry} sl ${decision.signal.stopLoss} tp ${decision.signal.takeProfit} ` +\n            `(${decision.signal.slPips.toFixed(1)}p/${decision.signal.tpPips.toFixed(1)}p)`,\n        );\n\n        if (!this.deps.live) {\n          entered.push(`${candidate.symbol} (dry)`);\n          continue;\n        }\n\n        // Refresh the snapshot so margin and per-symbol limits see the\n        // positions opened earlier in this same scan.\n        view = await this.deps.snapshot.get();\n        const opened = await this.deps.executor.open(decision.signal, view);\n        if (opened.ok && opened.managed) {\n          this.lastSignal = { ...decision.signal, lot: opened.managed.volume };\n          entered.push(`${opened.managed.symbol} ${opened.managed.volume} lot`);\n          this.deps.log(\n            `open ${opened.managed.symbol} ${opened.managed.volume} lot ` +\n              `@ ${opened.managed.entry} sl ${opened.managed.currentSl}`,\n          );\n          continue;\n        }\n        this.deps.log(`open ditolak ${candidate.symbol}: ${opened.reason ?? \"?\"}`);\n        tried.push(`${candidate.symbol}: ${opened.reason ?? \"rejected\"}`);\n      }\n\n      if (entered.length > 0) {\n        this.note = this.deps.live\n          ? `opened ${entered.length}: ${entered.join(\" · \")}`\n          : `dry-run signals: ${entered.join(\" · \")}`;\n      } else if (tried.length > 0) {\n        this.note = tried[0] ?? \"\";\n        this.deps.log(`entry ${tried.join(\" · \")}`);\n      }\n      this.writeState(true, view);"
}

type PanelTone = "cyan" | "green" | "yellow" | "magenta" | "blue" | "gray";

function toneColor(tone: PanelTone, text: string): string { ... }

const ANSI_AT = /^\u001b\[[0-9;]*m/;

function cut(text: string, width: number): string {
  if (width <= 0) return "";
  if (visibleLength(text) <= width) return text;
  let out="", count=0, i=0, ansi=false;
  while (i < text.length && count < width - 1) {
    const match = text.slice(i).match(ANSI_AT);
    if (match) { out += match[0]; ansi=true; i += match[0].length; continue; }
    out += text[i]; count++; i++;
  }
  if (ansi) out += "\u001b[0m";
  return out + "…";
}

function fitLine(text: string, width: number): string { ... }

export function panel(title: string, lines: string[], width: number, tone: PanelTone = "gray"): string {
  const total = Math.max(12, width);
  const label = ` ${title} `;
  const fill = Math.max(0, total - 2 - visibleLength(label));
  const border = (text: string) => toneColor(tone, text);
  const inner = Math.max(0, total - 4);
  const out: string[] = [];
  out.push(border("╭") + toneColor(tone, label) + border("─".repeat(fill)) + border("╮"));

  }
  out.push(border("╰") + border("─".repeat(total - 2)) + border("╯"));
  return out.join("\n");
}

20: const WS_PROTOCOL = "exness-ws-protocol";
21: const HEARTBEAT_MS = 20_000;
22: const MAX_BACKOFF_MS = 30_000;
23: 
24: function toWebSocketUrl(accessPoint: string, path: string): string {
25:   const base = accessPoint.replace(/^https:/i, "wss:").replace(/^http:/i, "ws:").replace(/\/+$/, "");
26:   return `${base}${path}`;
27: }
28: 
29: export class ExnessSocket {
30:   private socket?: WebSocket;
31:   private closedByClient = false;
32:   private attempt = 0;
33:   private heartbeat?: NodeJS.Timeout;
34:   private awaitingPong = false;
35:   private reconnectTimer?: NodeJS.Timeout;
36:   private readonly autoReconnect: boolean;
37:   private readonly url: string;
38: 
39:   constructor(private readonly options: ExnessSocketOptions) {
40:     this.autoReconnect = options.autoReconnect ?? true;
41:     this.url = toWebSocketUrl(options.accessPoint, options.path);
42:   }
43: 
44:   get state(): SocketState {
45:     if (this.closedByClient) return "closed";
46:     if (!this.socket) return "connecting";
47:     const readyState = this.socket.readyState;
48:     if (readyState === WebSocket.OPEN) return "open";
49:     if (readyState === WebSocket.CONNECTING) return "connecting";
50:     return "reconnecting";
51:   }
52: 
53:   connect(): void {
54:     this.closedByClient = false;
55:     this.open();
56:   }
57: 
58:   private open(): void {
59:     this.options.onState?.("connecting");
60: 
61:     // Fresh headers for every handshake; the signature is bound to the path.
62:     const headers = buildSignedHeaders({
63:       identity: this.options.identity,
64:       method: "GET",
65:       pathWithQuery: this.options.path,
66:       body: "",
67:       idempotencyKey: "",
68:     });
69: 
70:     let socket: WebSocket;
71:     try {
72:       socket = new WebSocket(this.url, WS_PROTOCOL, {
73:         headers,
74:         handshakeTimeout: 15_000,
75:         perMessageDeflate: false,
76:       });
77:       this.socket = socket;
78:     } catch (error) {
79:       this.handleError(error as Error);
80:       this.scheduleReconnect();
81:       return;
82:     }
83: 
84:     socket.on("open", () => {
85:       this.attempt = 0;
86:       this.startHeartbeat();
87:       this.options.onState?.("open");
88:       this.options.onOpen?.();
89:     });
90: 
91:     socket.on("message", (data, isBinary) => {
92:       if (isBinary) return;
93:       const raw = data.toString();
94:       try {
95:         this.options.onMessage(JSON.parse(raw), raw);
96:       } catch {
97:         this.options.onMessage(raw, raw);
98:       }
99:     });
100: 
101:     socket.on("pong", () => {
102:       this.awaitingPong = false;
103:     });
104: 
105:     socket.on("error", (error) => {
106:       this.handleError(error);
107:     });
108: 
109:     socket.on("close", (code, reason) => {
110:       this.stopHeartbeat();
111:       if (this.closedByClient) {
112:         this.options.onState?.("closed");
113:         return;
114:       }
115:       const detail = `${code}${reason.length ? ` ${reason.toString()}` : ""}`;
116:       this.options.onState?.("reconnecting", detail);
117:       this.options.logger?.(`socket closed (${detail}); reconnecting`);
118:       this.scheduleReconnect();
119:     });
120:   }
121: 
122:   send(payload: unknown): boolean {
123:     if (!this.socket || this.socket.readyState !== WebSocket.OPEN) return false;
124:     this.socket.send(JSON.stringify(payload));
125:     return true;
126:   }
127: 
128:   close(): void {
129:     this.closedByClient = true;
130:     this.stopHeartbeat();
131:     if (this.reconnectTimer) clearTimeout(this.reconnectTimer);
132:     this.reconnectTimer = undefined;
133:     try {
134:       this.socket?.close(1000, "client shutdown");
135:     } catch {
136:       // ignore
137:     }
138:     this.socket = undefined;
139:   }
140: 
141:   private scheduleReconnect(): void {
142:     if (!this.autoReconnect || this.closedByClient) return;
143:     const backoff = Math.min(1000 * 2 ** this.attempt, MAX_BACKOFF_MS);
144:     const delay = backoff + Math.floor(Math.random() * 300);
145:     this.attempt += 1;
146:     this.options.logger?.(`reconnecting in ${delay}ms (attempt ${this.attempt})`);
147:     this.reconnectTimer = setTimeout(() => this.open(), delay);
148:   }
149: 
150:   private startHeartbeat(): void {
151:     this.stopHeartbeat();
152:     this.awaitingPong = false;
153:     this.heartbeat = setInterval(() => {
154:       if (!this.socket || this.socket.readyState !== WebSocket.OPEN) return;
155:       if (this.awaitingPong) {
156:         this.socket.terminate();
157:         return;
158:       }
159:       this.awaitingPong = true;
160:       this.socket.ping();
161:     }, HEARTBEAT_MS);
162:   }
163: 
164:   private stopHeartbeat(): void {
165:     if (this.heartbeat) clearInterval(this.heartbeat);
166:     this.heartbeat = undefined;
167:   }
168: 
169:   private handleError(error: Error): void {
170:     this.options.onError?.(error);
171:     this.options.logger?.(`socket error: ${error.message}`);
172:   }
173: }

```ts
private tokens = 20;
private lastRefill = Date.now();
private pumpTimer?: NodeJS.Timeout;
private readonly pending = new Map<string,string>();

private pumpSubscriptions(): void {
  if (this.state !== "open") return;
  if (this.pumpTimer) return; // one scheduled
  const now = Date.now();
  const elapsed = now - this.lastRefill;
  if (elapsed > 0) {
    this.tokens = Math.min(20, this.tokens + (elapsed / 1000) * 20);
    this.lastRefill = now;
  }
  if (this.queued.length === 0) return;
  if (this.tokens < 1) { schedule in 50ms; return; }
  while (this.tokens >= 1 && this.queued.length > 0) {
    const symbol = this.queued.shift()!;
    if (this.sent.has(symbol) || this.failed.has(symbol) || [...this.pending.values()].includes(symbol)) continue;
    this.tokens -= 1;
    const id = `ticks-${++this.sequence}`;
    this.pending.set(id, symbol);
    this.socket?.send({ id, subscribe: { event:"ticks", instruments:[symbol] } });
  }
  if (this.queued.length > 0) {
    this.pumpTimer = setTimeout(()=>{this.pumpTimer=undefined; this.pumpSubscriptions();}, 50);
    this.pumpTimer.unref();
  }
}
```

Interesting: the broker still has BOTH CADJPY positions mentally open, but the executor **finalized 12394149 as closed** and removed it from managed. The monitor shows both open. So the executor incorrectly thought 12394149 disappeared. Why? It likely uses the snapshot's `positions` list and checks each managed position. Between the open and the next manage tick, the snapshot was stale (TTL 1200ms) and didn't include the new position; `manage()` saw it missing and finalized it! The `open()` method probably calls `invalidateSnapshot` only if the position isn't found, but on success it doesn't invalidate. The manage loop then uses a cached snapshot from before the open → position missing → finalize.

This is critical. Fix: after a successful open, `snapshot.invalidate()` and/or add the new position to a grace period. Best both:
- In `RiskExecutor.open`, after success, call `this.deps.tools.invalidateSnapshot()` (TradeTools has invalidateSnapshot) or `snapshot.invalidate()`.
- In `manage`, when a managed position is missing, if its `openedAt` is within e.g. 5 seconds, skip finalization (grace).
- Also if the position is missing once, require 2 consecutive misses before finalize (debounce), to avoid transient snapshot inconsistencies.

Hotkeys: stdin raw mode is never enabled! They save `wasRaw` but don't call `stdin.setRawMode(true)` or `stdin.resume()`. In canonical mode, keypresses won't be delivered until Enter. That's why hotkeys don't work. Need to enable raw mode:
```ts
if (stdin.isTTY) {
  stdin.setRawMode(true);
  stdin.resume();
}
```
before on("data"). Also maybe `process.stdout.rows` etc. Fix.

117: function fitLine(text: string, width: number): string {
118:   if (width <= 0) return "";
119:   const clipped = visibleLength(text) > width ? cutAnsi(text, width) : text;
120:   return clipped + " ".repeat(Math.max(0, width - visibleLength(clipped)));
121: }
122: 
123: function spreadLine(left: string, right: string, width: number): string {
124:   const gap = Math.max(1, width - visibleLength(left) - visibleLength(right));
125:   return `${left}${" ".repeat(gap)}${right}`;
126: }
127: 
128: /** A rounded container with a coloured border and an inset content row. */
129: export function panel(
130:   title: string,
131:   lines: string[],
132:   width: number,
133:   tone: PanelTone = "gray",
134: ): string {
135:   const total = Math.max(16, width);
136:   const border = (text: string): string => paintTone(tone, text);
137:   const rawLabel = ` ${title} `;
138:   const label = visibleLength(rawLabel) > total - 2 ? cutAnsi(rawLabel, total - 2) : rawLabel;
139:   const fill = Math.max(0, total - 2 - visibleLength(label));
140:   const inner = Math.max(1, total - 4);
141:   const content = lines.length > 0 ? lines : [""];
142: 
143:   return [
144:     `${border("╭")}${border(label)}${border("─".repeat(fill))}${border("╮")}`,
145:     ...content.map((line) => `${border("│")} ${fitLine(line, inner)} ${border("│")}`),
146:     `${border("╰")}${border("─".repeat(total - 2))}${border("╯")}`,
147:   ].join("\n");
148: }
149: 
150: /** Compose already-rendered panels into an equal-height row. */
151: export function row(panels: string[], gap = " "): string {
152:   if (panels.length === 0) return "";
153:   const blocks = panels.map((entry) => entry.split("\n"));
154:   const widths = blocks.map((block) =>
155:     Math.max(...block.map((line) => visibleLength(line))),
156:   );
157:   const height = Math.max(...blocks.map((block) => block.length));
158:   const out: string[] = [];
159:   for (let line = 0; line < height; line += 1) {
160:     out.push(
161:       blocks
162:         .map((block, index) => block[line] ?? " ".repeat(widths[index] ?? 0))
163:         .join(gap),
164:     );
165:   }
166:   return out.join("\n");
167: }
168: 
169: function splitWidths(total: number, parts: number, gap = 1): number[] {
170:   const available = total - gap * (parts - 1);
171:   const base = Math.floor(available / parts);
172:   const remainder = available - base * parts;
173:   return Array.from({ length: parts }, (_, index) => base + (index < remainder ? 1 : 0));
174: }

177:   let peak = Number.NEGATIVE_INFINITY;
178:   return equity.samples.map((sample) => {
179:     if (sample.equity > peak) peak = sample.equity;
180:     return { t: sample.t, value: sample.equity - peak };
181:   });
182: }

340: export function spreadSpikes(ticks: TickHub): number {
341:   const quotes = ticks.store.all();
342:   if (quotes.length < 5) return 0;
343:   // Absolute threshold (5 bp) instead of a median multiple: exotic pairs are
344:   // structurally wide, so a relative measure would flag them permanently.
345:   return quotes.filter((quote) => Number.isFinite(quote.spreadPct) && quote.spreadPct >= 0.05)
346:     .length;
347: }

349: export function dailyCap(view: AccountView, equity: EquityTracker, capPct = 3): {
350:   start: number;
351:   change: number;
352:   cap: number;
353:   remaining: number;
354: } {
355:   const start = equity.startBalance || view.balance;
356:   const change = view.equity - start;
357:   // The agent sizes and caps on virtual risk equity, not the demo balance.
358:   const riskEquity = Number(process.env.EXNESS_VIRTUAL_EQUITY ?? 10_000);
359:   const cap = (riskEquity * capPct) / 100;
360:   return { start, change, cap, remaining: cap + Math.min(0, change) };
361: }

363: export function exposureByCurrency(positions: Position[]): Array<[string, number]> {
364:   const totals = new Map<string, number>();
365:   for (const position of positions) {
366:     const base = position.instrument.slice(0, 3);
367:     totals.set(base, (totals.get(base) ?? 0) + Number(position.volume));
368:   }
369:   return [...totals.entries()].sort((a, b) => b[1] - a[1]);
370: }

384:     );
385:     const candidates = await this.screener.scan(this.deps.universe);
386:     const decisions: Array<{ symbol: string; signal: EntrySignal | null; rejects: string[] }> = [];
387:     // Check every screened pair, not just the first few: the screener is the
388:     // gate, so a single scan can preview every entry it would take.
389:     for (const candidate of candidates) {

391:         symbol: candidate.symbol,

393:         n: 120,

396:       if (!m5.ok || !quote) continue;

400:         quote,
401:         config: entryConfigFrom(this.deps.config),

403:       decisions.push({

405:         signal: decision.signal,

407:       });

49: /**
50:  * Tick-only momentum memory. Keeps at most one sample per second per symbol so
51:  * the screener can rank ~175 pairs without asking the candle endpoint for them.
52:  */
53: export class MomentumTracker {
54:   private readonly samples = new Map<string, MomentumSample[]>();
55: 
56:   observe(quote: Quote): void {
57:     const series = this.samples.get(quote.symbol) ?? [];
58:     const last = series[series.length - 1];
59:     if (last && quote.timestamp - last.t < SAMPLE_INTERVAL_MS) {
60:       // Keep the newest price inside the sampling bucket without growing memory.
61:       last.mid = quote.mid;
62:       last.t = quote.timestamp;
63:       return;
64:     }
65:     series.push({ t: quote.timestamp, mid: quote.mid });
66:     const cutoff = quote.timestamp - MOMENTUM_WINDOW_MS;
67:     while (series.length > 1 && series[0]!.t < cutoff) series.shift();
68:     this.samples.set(quote.symbol, series);
69:   }
70: 
71:   /** Percentage change over the last `minutes`, or null while warming up. */
72:   changePct(symbol: string, minutes: number): number | null {
73:     const series = this.samples.get(symbol);
74:     if (!series || series.length < 2) return null;
75:     const latest = series[series.length - 1]!;
76:     const target = latest.t - minutes * 60_000;
77:     if (latest.t - series[0]!.t < minutes * 60_000 * 0.75) return null;
78: 
79:     let reference: MomentumSample | undefined;
80:     for (const sample of series) {
81:       if (sample.t <= target) reference = sample;
82:       else break;
83:     }
84:     reference ??= series[0]!;
85:     if (reference.mid === 0) return null;
86:     return ((latest.mid - reference.mid) / reference.mid) * 100;
87:   }
88: 
89:   spanMs(symbol: string): number {
90:     const series = this.samples.get(symbol);
91:     if (!series || series.length < 2) return 0;
92:     return series[series.length - 1]!.t - series[0]!.t;
93:   }
94: 
95:   size(): number {
96:     return this.samples.size;
97:   }
98: }

109:     .map(([key, value]) => `  ${style.dim(pad(key, width))} ${value}`)
110:     .join("\n");
111: }
112: 
113: export function heading(text: string): string {
114:   return `\n${style.bold(text)}`;
115: }
116: 
117: export function success(text: string): string {
118:   return style.green(`✔ ${text}`);
119: }
120: 
121: export function failure(text: string): string {
122:   return style.red(`✖ ${text}`);
123: }
124: 
125: export function warn(text: string): string {
126:   return style.yellow(`! ${text}`);
127: }
128: 
129: export function info(text: string): string {
130:   return style.cyan(`→ ${text}`);
131: }
132: 
133: export function formatDuration(ms: number): string {
134:   if (ms < 1000) return `${Math.round(ms)}ms`;
135:   return `${(ms / 1000).toFixed(2)}s`;
136: }
137: 
138: export function formatTime(epochMs: number): string {
139:   return new Date(epochMs).toISOString().replace("T", " ").replace("Z", " UTC");
140: }
141: 
142: export function clockTime(epochMs: number): string {
143:   return new Date(epochMs).toISOString().slice(11, 23);
144: }
145: 
146: export function terminalWidth(): number {
147:   const columns = process.stdout.columns ?? 120;
148:   return Math.max(60, Math.min(columns, 200));
149: }
150: 
151: export function clearScreen(): void {
152:   if (!process.stdout.isTTY) return;
153:   process.stdout.write("\u001b[2J\u001b[3J\u001b[H");
154: }
155: 
156: export function hideCursor(): void {
157:   if (process.stdout.isTTY) process.stdout.write("\u001b[?25l");
158: }
159: 
160: export function showCursor(): void {
161:   if (process.stdout.isTTY) process.stdout.write("\u001b[?25h");
162: }
163: 
164: export function moveHome(): void {
165:   if (process.stdout.isTTY) process.stdout.write("\u001b[H");
166: }
167: 
168: export function truncate(text: string, width: number): string {
169:   if (visibleLength(text) <= width) return text;
170:   return `${text.slice(0, Math.max(0, width - 1))}…`;
171: }

The engine persists the tail of this\n * journal inside agent-state.json; it is not a trading audit log (that is the\n * per-trade JSONL file).\n */\nexport class AgentJournal {\n  private entries: AgentActivity[] = [];\n\n  constructor(private readonly limit = 120) {}\n\n  record(agent: AgentRole, message: string, tone: AgentTone = \"info\"): void {\n    const text = message.trim();\n    if (!text) return;\n    this.entries.push({ at: Date.now(), agent, message: text, tone });\n    if (this.entries.length > this.limit) {\n      this.entries.splice(0, this.entries.length - this.limit);\n    }\n  }\n\n  all(): AgentActivity[] {\n    return [...this.entries];\n  }\n\n  recent(limit = 40): AgentActivity[] {\n    return this.entries.slice(-Math.max(1, limit));\n  }\n\n  /** Restore a recent tail after a restart; old sessions are not replayed. */\n  restore(entries: AgentActivity[] | undefined, maxAgeMs = 10 * 60_000): void {\n    if (!Array.isArray(entries)) return;\n    const cutoff = Date.now() - maxAgeMs;\n    this.entries = entries.filter((entry) => entry && entry.at >= cutoff).slice(-this.limit);\n  }\n}\n"

  const showCharts = state.showCharts;
  const showEvents = state.showEvents;
  const showOrders = state.showOrders;
  const sideAgent = width >= 96;
  const sideCharts = width >= 100;
  const sideRows = width >= 110;
  const sideRisk = width >= 120;

  const groups: string[] = [];
  // header same
  ...
  // KPI same
  ...
  // agent containers + log
  if (showAgent) {
    groups.push(renderAgentContainers(state.agent, width));
    const logLimit = height >= 64 ? 5 : height >= 50 ? 4 : 3;
    const logLines = renderAgentLogLines(state.agent, logLimit);
    groups.push(panel(`AGENT LOG · ${state.agent?.running ? "live" : "idle"}`, logLines, width, "gray"));
  }
  // positions
  const positionLimit = height >= 64 ? 10 : height >= 50 ? 6 : 4;
  groups.push(panel(...));
  // account/market/risk
  const acctLines = accountPanelLines(state);
  const mktLines = marketPanelLines(state.ticks);
  const riskLines = riskPanelLines(...);
  if (sideRisk) { split 3; row }
  else if (width >= 100) { split 2 account/risk; + market full }
  else { stack account, market, risk }
  // charts
  if (showCharts) { chartHeight = height>=64?5:4; ... }
  // events/orders
  ...
  return groups.join("\n\n");
}

30:   ✔ PASS ticks          2 symbols ticked in 1247 ms · EURUSD 1.11554/1.11562
31:   ✔ account connected · 6/6 checks in 1.63s
32: ```
33: 
34: ## Quick start
35: 
36: ```powershell
37: npm install
38: npm run doctor
39: npm start            # full-screen dashboard (q to quit)
40: ```
41: 
42: `.env` must contain:
43: 
44: ```ini
45: EXNESS_API_KEY=exnsk-...
46: EXNESS_PRIVATE_KEY=...            # 128-char hex key pair, 64-char hex seed, or PEM
47: EXNESS_ACCOUNT_ID=31000172947
48: EXNESS_DISCOVERY_URL=https://api.exness.com
49: ```
50: 
51: `EXNESS_API_SECRET` is still accepted as a fallback name for the private key.
52: 
53: ## Commands
54: 
55: > `npm run` on Windows silently drops `--flag value` arguments. For anything with
56: > options, use the wrapper: `bin\ot.cmd ...` (or `npx tsx src/cli/index.ts ...`).
57: 
58: | Command | What it does |
59: | --- | --- |
60: | `bin\ot.cmd doctor` | discovery → account → catalog → snapshot → candles → live ticks, with timings |
61: | `bin\ot.cmd account` | account profile, mode (demo/live), currency, leverage, access point |
62: | `bin\ot.cmd snapshot` | balance, equity, used/free margin, margin level, open positions and orders |
63: | `bin\ot.cmd instruments --fx --search EUR` | instrument catalog (335 instruments, 175 FX pairs) |
64: | `bin\ot.cmd candles EURUSD --tf M5 --count 60` | OHLC table + ASCII sparkline, `--type bid\|ask\|both` |
65: | `bin\ot.cmd ticker EURUSD XAUUSD --for 15` | live bid/ask, spread in points, tick count, age |
66: | `bin\ot.cmd watch --search JPY --limit 15` | live board of all FX pairs (or `--all`), sorted by change |
67: | `bin\ot.cmd limits` | REST + WebSocket rate limits for this account |
68: | `bin\ot.cmd events --for 30` | stream `account_state` / `transaction_event` / instrument events |
69: 
70: Global flags: `--verbose`, `--no-color`, `--json`.
71: 
72: `npm run doctor|account|snapshot|limits|instruments` also work because they take no
73: options.
74: 
75: ## How it works
76: 
77: ```
78: src/
79: ├─ config.ts              .env loading (no dotenv) + validation
80: ├─ exness/
81: │  ├─ signing.ts          hex/PEM → Ed25519 key, EXN-DATA + EXN-SIGN headers
82: │  ├─ client.ts           access-point discovery + cache, signed REST, retry, rate limit
83: │  ├─ ws.ts               signed WebSocket handshake, heartbeat, reconnect + resubscribe
84: │  ├─ catalog.ts          instrument catalog + per-instrument conditions (cached)
85: │  └─ types.ts            subset of trading.public.yaml v1.0.2
86: ├─ market/store.ts        last tick per symbol, quotes, formatting
87: └─ cli/                   arg parsing, ANSI rendering, commands
88: ```
89: 
90: Behaviour worth knowing:
91: 
92: - **Signing** — `EXN-DATA` is serialized once; those exact bytes are signed and
93:   base64url-encoded (no padding) into `EXN-DATA`, with the Ed25519 signature in
94:   `EXN-SIGN`. `body_hash` is SHA-256 of the exact body (`47DEQpj8…` for empty).
95: - **Discovery** — `GET /v1/trading/access-point?account_id=…` against
96:   `EXNESS_DISCOVERY_URL`. The result is cached in `.cache/access-point.json` for
97:   10 minutes and re-resolved once on a `401`.
98: - **Rate limits** — the client keeps a per-route sliding window (candles 2/s,
99:   snapshot 2/s, orders 4/s, global 10/s) and honours `Retry-After` on `429`.
100: - **Realtime** — the WebSocket handshake is signed as a `GET` with the exact path.
101:   `ws` is used because browsers cannot set the `EXN-*` handshake headers.
102: - **Money and volume are decimal strings** in requests/responses; only display
103:   formatting uses numbers, with `point_digits` taken from instrument conditions.
104: 
105: ## Roadmap
106: 
107: Phase 1 (done) — connection, account state, catalog, candles, live ticks, limits.
108: 
109: Phase 2 — persist quotes/candles, instrument metadata warm-up, screener
110: (alerts, ranking, spread stats).
111: 
112: Phase 3 — trading: `POST /positions` (buy/sell with SL/TP), `DELETE /positions/{id}`
113: for close/partial close, pending orders (`limit`/`stop`), ACK → `transaction_event`
114: correlation via idempotency keys, history from `/history/orders` and `/history/deals`.
115: Trading is asynchronous: always subscribe to `/ws/events` *before* sending the order.
116: 
117: Phase 4 — UI on top of `src/exness/*` (the client layer is UI-agnostic).
118: 
119: ## Security
120: 
121: - `.env` holds a live signing key: it is gitignored, never bundled and only read
122:   server-side. Do not paste it into chats, issues or screenshots.
123: - The wrapper and CLI print only a key prefix (`exnsk-4b7c8c44…`).
124: - Rotate the key in Exness Key Management if it was ever exposed, then update `.env`.
125: 
126: ## Troubleshooting
127: 
128: | Symptom | Meaning |
129: | --- | --- |
130: | `401/1001` | Signature mismatch — key format, payload bytes, body hash or base64url padding. |
131: | `401/1000` | API key missing/expired, or `EXN-DATA.api_key` ≠ `EXN-API-KEY`. |
132: | `403/1002` | API key has no access to this account/IP/scope. |
133: | `404/2000` | Account not found for this key. |
134: | `400/3005` | `REQUEST_INVALID_COUNT` — candles need `count` or `to`, not just `from`. |
135: | Repeated `503` | Service unavailable; retry later (client already retries twice). |

158:   const height = Math.max(...blocks.map((block) => block.length));

The dashboard reads\n`.cache/agent-state.json`; the three containers and the activity log stay\npopulated while the agent runs, and show the last session (plus an `agent idle`\nhint) when it is stopped.\n\n`.env` must contain:\n\n```ini\nEXNESS_API_KEY=exnsk-...\nEXNESS_PRIVATE_KEY=...            # 128-char hex key pair, 64-char hex seed, or PEM\nEXNESS_ACCOUNT_ID=31000172947\nEXNESS_DISCOVERY_URL=https://api.exness.com\n```\n\n`EXNESS_API_SECRET` is still accepted as a fallback name for the private key.\n\n## Dashboard keys\n\nThe board is rendered as a scrollable viewport, so every section is available\neven in a short terminal. prints candidates + diagnostics |\n| `bin\\ot.cmd agent --live` | continuous screener → entry → risk, sends orders |\n| `bin\\ot.cmd agent --live --for 120` | bounded live session |\n| `bin\\ot.cmd agent --live --scan 15` | override the scan interval (seconds) |\n| `bin\\ot.cmd agent --live --symbols EURUSD,XAUUSD` | restrict the universe |\n| `bin\\ot.cmd instruments --fx --search EUR` | instrument catalog (335 total, 175 FX) |\n| `bin\\ot.cmd candles EURUSD --tf M5 --count 60` | OHLC table + sparkline |\n| `bin\\ot.cmd ticker EURUSD XAUUSD --for 15` | live bid/ask, spread, tick count, age |\n| `bin\\ot.cmd watch --search JPY --limit 15` | live board, sorted by change |\n| `bin\\ot.cmd limits` | REST + WebSocket rate limits |\n| `bin\\ot.cmd events --for 30` | stream account/transaction/instrument events |\n\nGlobal flags: `--verbose`, `--no-color`, `--json`.\n\nTests and typecheck:\n\n```powershell\nnpm test\nnpm run typecheck\n```\n\n## Agents\n\n| Agent | Responsibility |\n| --- | --- |\n| **Screener** | Ranks every account instrument: M15 EMA trend, ATR, RSI, distance from EMA20, spread, momentum.    open / patch-or-create SLTP / close, digits cache\n├─ monitor/equity.ts      daily equity samples + start balance\n├─ agents/\n│  ├─ config.ts           thresholds and risk limits\n│  ├─ screener.ts         prefilter, ranking, scan diagnostics\n│  ├─ entry.ts            trend/pullback/reclaim gate, FX vs non-FX SL/TP\n│  ├─ risk-and-executor.ts sizing, gating, TP1, trailing, adoption\n│  ├─ engine.ts           scan loop, manage loop, state writer\n│  ├─ journal.ts          per-agent activity feed for the dashboard\n│  └─ trailing.ts         monotonic trailing-stop math\n└─ cli/                   args, ANSI rendering, charts, commands, dashboard\n```\n\nBehaviour worth knowing:\n\n- **Signing** — `EXN-DATA` is serialized once; those exact bytes are signed and\n  base64url-encoded (no padding) into `EXN-DATA`, with the Ed25519 signature in\n  `EXN-SIGN`. `body_hash` is SHA-256 of the exact body.\n- **Discovery** — `GET /v1/trading/access-point?account_id=…` against\n  `EXNESS_DISCOVERY_URL`. The result is cached for 10 minutes and re-resolved\n  once on a `401`.\n- **Rate limits** — per-route sliding windows (candles 2/s, snapshot 2/s, orders\n  4/s, global 10/s) plus `Retry-After` on `429`. Tick subscriptions use a\n  separate 20/s token bucket; ticks are subscribed one instrument per message.\n- **Money and volume are decimal strings** in requests/responses; only display\n  formatting uses numbers, with `point_digits` from instrument conditions.\n- **State is on disk** so a restarted agent re-adopts open positions from the\n  trade log and `.cache/agent-state.json` instead of leaving them unmanaged.\n\n## Roadmap\n\n- Phase 1 (done) — connection, account state, catalog, candles, live ticks, limits.\n- Phase 2 (done) — persists quotes/candles/equity, instrument metadata, screener,\n  monitoring views and the full-screen dashboard.\n- Phase 3 (done) — market entries, broker-side SLTP, partial close, close, ACK\n  correlation, deterministic screener/entry/risk agents, orphan adoption, state.\n- Phase 4 (done) — terminal dashboard with per-agent containers, journal, charts,\n  events/orders and scrollable hotkeys.\n- Next — backtest module reusing `computeTrailingSl` + `decideEntry`, then tune\n  TP1/trail and the aggressive scan thresholds on historical M5/M15 data.\n\n## Security\n\n- `.env` holds a live signing key: it is gitignored, never bundled and only read\n  locally. Do not paste it into chats, issues or screenshots.\n- The wrapper and CLI print only a key prefix (`exnsk-4b7c8c44…`).\n- Rotate the key in Exness Key Management if it was ever exposed, then update\n  `.env`. Use a demo account while iterating.\n\n## Troubleshooting\n\n| Symptom | Meaning |\n| --- | --- |\n| `401/1001` | Signature mismatch — key format, payload bytes, body hash or base64url padding. |\n| `401/1000` | API key missing/expired, or `EXN-DATA.api_key` ≠ `EXN-API-KEY`. |\n| `403/1002` | API key has no access to this account/IP/scope. |\n| `404/2000` | Account not found for this key. |\n| `400/3005` | `REQUEST_INVALID_COUNT` — candles need `count` or `to`, not just `from`. |\n| `400/3015` | Request rate limit. Wait; the client already paces REST and subscriptions. |\n| `400/4000` | `MARKET_INSTRUMENT_NOT_FOUND` — a catalog symbol is not subscribable; dropped individually. |\n| `400/4001` | `MARKET_TRADE_DISABLED` — instrument is visible but not tradable; the agent logs and skips it. |\n| `400/5005` | Stop/take-profit is on the wrong side or too tight for the broker. |\n| Repeated `503` | Service unavailable; retry later. |\n"
}

## User

# Plan final: screener, entry, dan trailing

## Alur keseluruhan

```
Screener (tiap candle M15 tutup)
   │  kandidat pair
   ▼
Entry (per kandidat)
   │  usulan: BUY/SELL, entry, SL darurat, alasan
   ▼
Risk & Executor
   │  setuju? → hitung lot → kirim order + SL darurat
   ▼
Trailing (kode, tiap tick + update jarak tiap candle tutup)
   │  stop virtual naik/turun → tutup posisi saat kena
   ▼
Jurnal (semua keputusan dan hasil dicatat)
```

## 1. Screener

**Kapan jalan:** setiap candle M15 tutup. Tidak perlu tiap tick.

**Kriteria awal (3 saja):**
- **Tren:** EMA50 di atas EMA200 pada H1 untuk BUY, sebaliknya untuk SELL.
- **Pullback:** RSI M15 di zona 40 sampai 60, dan harga mendekati EMA50 M15.
- **Spread:** di bawah batas yang ditentukan, misalnya 2 pip.

**Output:** daftar pair kandidat dengan arah dan skor. Pair yang tidak lolos tidak diteruskan.

## 2. Entry

**Input:** satu pair kandidat dari screener.

**Aturan:**
- Entry hanya setelah candle M15 konfirmasi tutup searah dengan arah tren. Ini mengurangi entry palsu.
- Tentukan SL darurat yang jauh (misalnya 3 × ATR) dan kirim bersama order ke broker, kalau API mendukungnya.

**Output:**
```json
{
  "symbol": "EURUSD",
  "action": "BUY",
  "entry_ref": 1.0850,
  "sl_emergency": 1.0790,
  "reason": "tren H1 naik, pullback ke EMA50 M15, RSI 45 naik"
}
```

## 3. Risk & Executor

Satu-satunya bagian yang bisa mengirim order. Punya hak veto.

**Aturan yang dicek sebelum order:**
- Risiko per trade maksimal 1% dari equity.
- Maksimal 1 posisi terbuka (bisa dinaikkan nanti).
- Batas rugi harian, misalnya 2%. Kalau tercapai, berhenti trading hari itu.
- Spread masih di bawah batas saat order dikirim.

**Lot dihitung dari jarak SL awal** (`entry − sl_emergency`), bukan dari jarak trailing. Trailing tidak mengubah ukuran posisi.

**Output saat setuju:**
```json
{
  "approved": true,
  "lot": 0.10,
  "risk_percent": 1.0,
  "trail": { "atr_period": 14, "atr_tf": "M15", "atr_mult": 2.0, "min_trail": 0.0008 }
}
```

Parameter `trail` diteruskan ke modul trailing.

## 4. Trailing (di kode, bukan di LLM)

**Dua lapis perlindungan:**
- **Lapis 1 (broker):** SL darurat yang jauh. Melindungi kalau program mati.
- **Lapis 2 (program):** stop virtual dengan trailing dinamis. Ini penutupan normal.

**Logika:**
- **Update jarak:** setiap candle M15 tutup, hitung ATR lalu jarak = max(ATR × pengali, batas minimum).
- **Update stop:** setiap tick, hanya ketika harga mencetak rekor baru.
  - BUY: `best = max(best, bid)`, `stop = max(stop, best − jarak)`. Stop hanya naik.
  - SELL: `best = min(best, ask)`, `stop = min(stop, best + jarak)`. Stop hanya turun.
- **Penutupan:** BUY ditutup saat bid ≤ stop. SELL ditutup saat ask ≥ stop.
- **Tanpa TP.** Posisi keluar lewat trailing stop atau SL darurat.

**Contoh dengan jarak tetap 20 pip, sesuai ilustrasi kamu:**
```
entry 1.0850, stop awal 1.0820
harga 1.0900 → stop 1.0880
harga 1.0930 → stop 1.0910
harga 1.0920 → stop tetap 1.0910
```
Jarak yang dipakai sebenarnya dinamis, tapi logikanya sama.

## 5. Kebutuhan wajib

- **State disimpan ke file atau database** (`best`, `stop`, jarak, id posisi). Saat restart, state dimuat dan trailing dilanjutkan, bukan mulai ulang.
- **Rekonsiliasi saat startup:** cocokkan posisi di broker dengan state lokal. Posisi yatim harus ditangani.
- **Watchdog:** kalau koneksi putus lebih dari beberapa detik, coba ulang. Kalau gagal, kirim alarm.
- **Kill switch:** satu perintah untuk menutup semua posisi dan menghentikan entry baru.
- **Jurnal:** catat setiap screen, entry, keputusan risk, dan setiap perubahan stop.

## 6. Yang masih terbuka

- **Dukungan modifikasi SL di API Exness** belum saya pastikan. Ini menentukan apakah SL darurat bisa diubah di broker, dan apakah trailing bisa dijalankan di sisi server. Cek di API reference, bagian orders.
- **`EXNESS_API_HOST`** belum diketahui. Ini harus didapat dari halaman host setup dulu.
- **Parameter** seperti pengali ATR, batas minimum, batas spread, dan batas rugi harian perlu diuji di backtest dan demo, bukan dipilih begitu saja.

## Urutan pembangunan

1. Dapatkan `EXNESS_API_HOST` dan pastikan request bertanda tangan berhasil di demo.
2. Ambil candle historis, lalu uji fungsi `atr` dan `trail_distance`.
3. Uji screener di data historis: berapa kandidat per minggu, dan apakah kandidatnya masuk akal.
4. Uji trailing dengan candle historis, termasuk skenario gap dan spike.
5. Kirim order kecil di demo, lalu uji modifikasi atau penutupan.
6. Uji skenario program mati saat posisi terbuka.
7. Baru setelah semua itu lolos, pertimbangkan akun real dengan volume kecil.

23:   | { action: "hold"; reason: string };
24: 
25: /**
26:  * Trailing stop core. Mirrors the reference example:
27:  *
28:  *   BUY entry 1.0850, initial SL 1.0820, trail 20 pips
29:  *   best 1.0900 -> SL 1.0880
30:  *   best 1.0930 -> SL 1.0910
31:  *   price back to 1.0920 -> SL stays 1.0910 (never loosens)
32:  *
33:  * The function is pure so the same logic can be unit-tested and reused by the
34:  * backtest simulator and the live executor.
35:  */
36: export function computeTrailingSl(input: TrailingInput): TrailingAction {
37:   const step = input.step ?? 0;
38: 
39:   if (!Number.isFinite(input.best) || !Number.isFinite(input.currentSl)) {
40:     return { action: "hold", reason: "invalid numbers" };
41:   }
42: 
43:   if (input.side === "buy") {
44:     const candidate = input.best - input.trailDistance;
45: 
46:     if (candidate - input.currentSl <= step) {
47:       return { action: "hold", reason: "no improvement" };
48:     }
49:     if (candidate > input.bid - input.minStopDistance) {
50:       return { action: "hold", reason: "too close to price" };
51:     }
52:     return {
53:       action: "raise",
54:       newSl: roundPrice(candidate),
55:       reason: `best ${input.best} - trail ${input.trailDistance}`,
56:     };
57:   }
58: 
59:   const candidate = input.best + input.trailDistance;
60:   if (input.currentSl - candidate <= step) {
61:     return { action: "hold", reason: "no improvement" };
62:   }
63:   if (candidate < input.ask + input.minStopDistance) {
64:     return { action: "hold", reason: "too close to price" };
65:   }
66:   return {
67:     action: "raise",
68:     newSl: roundPrice(candidate),
69:     reason: `best ${input.best} + trail ${input.trailDistance}`,
70:   };
71: }
72: 
73: function roundPrice(value: number): number {
74:   return Math.round(value * 1e8) / 1e8;
75: }
76: 
77: /** New best price for a position, never moving backwards. */
78: export function updateBest(
79:   side: PositionSide,
80:   best: number,
81:   bid: number,
82:   ask: number,
83: ): number {
84:   return side === "buy" ? Math.max(best, bid) : Math.min(best, ask);
85: }

56:   observe(quote: Quote): void {

58:     const last = series[series.length - 1];
59:     if (last && quote.timestamp - last.t < SAMPLE_INTERVAL_MS) {
60:       // Keep the newest price inside the sampling bucket without growing memory.
61:       last.mid = quote.mid;
62:       last.t = quote.timestamp;
63:       return;
64:     }
65:     series.push({ t: quote.timestamp, mid: quote.mid });
66:     const cutoff = quote.timestamp - MOMENTUM_WINDOW_MS;
67:     while (series.length > 1 && series[0]!.t < cutoff) series.shift();
68:     this.samples.set(quote.symbol, series);

75:     const latest = series[series.length - 1]!;
76:     const target = latest.t - minutes * 60_000;

85:     if (reference.mid === 0) return null;
86:     return ((latest.mid - reference.mid) / reference.mid) * 100;

113: export function scoreCandidate(input: CandleScoreInput): Candidate | null {

129:     return null;

132: 
133:   const trendAtr = (ema20 - ema50) / atrValue;
134:   if (Math.abs(trendAtr) < options.minTrendAtr) return null;
135: 
136:   const direction: Direction = trendAtr > 0 ? "buy" : "sell";
137:   const sign = direction === "buy" ? 1 : -1;
138:   const alignedTrend = trendAtr * sign;
139:   const distanceAtr = ((close - ema20) / atrValue) * sign;
140:   // Deep pullbacks are allowed now: the entry stage decides whether the
141:   // pullback is still healthy, while the screener keeps every trend alive.
142:   if (distanceAtr < -1.1 || distanceAtr > options.maxDistanceAtr) return null;
143: 
144:   const previousEma20 = valueAt(ema20Series, index - 5);
145:   if (previousEma20 === undefined) return null;

149:   const atrPct = atrPercent(candles, atrValue);

156:   if (alignedMom5 !== null && alignedMom5 < -0.05) return null;

158:   const trendScore = clamp(alignedTrend / 0.8, 0, 1) * 30;
159:   const slopeScore = clamp(alignedSlope / 0.4, 0, 1) * 15;

177:     `pullback ${distanceAtr.toFixed(2)}×ATR`,

241:   }

243:   async scan(universe: string[]): Promise<Candidate[]> {
244:     const started = Date.now();
245:     this.lastScanAt = started;
246: 
247:     const now = Date.now();
248:     type Pre = { quote: Quote; mom5: number | null; mom1: number | null; prelim: number };
249:     const pre: Pre[] = [];
250:     let withQuote = 0;
251:     let fresh = 0;
252: 
253:     for (const symbol of universe) {
254:       const quote = this.ticks.get(symbol);
255:       if (!quote) continue;
256:       withQuote += 1;
257:       if (now - quote.timestamp > this.options.maxQuoteAgeMs) continue;
258:       fresh += 1;
259:       if (!(quote.spreadPct > 0) || quote.spreadPct > this.options.maxSpreadPct * 1.2) continue;
260: 
261:       const mom5 = this.momentum.changePct(symbol, 5);
262:       const mom1 = this.momentum.changePct(symbol, 1);
263:       const spreadQuality = clamp(1 - quote.spreadPct / this.options.maxSpreadPct, 0, 1);
264:       const activity = clamp(quote.ticks / 20, 0, 1);
265:       const move = mom5 === null ? 0.4 : clamp(Math.abs(mom5) / 0.08, 0, 1);
266:       const prelim = spreadQuality * 35 + activity * 15 + move * 50;
267:       pre.push({ quote, mom5, mom1, prelim });

269: 
270:     pre.sort((a, b) => b.prelim - a.prelim);
271:     const shortlist = pre.slice(0, this.options.shortlistSize);
272: 
273:     const candidates: Candidate[] = [];
274:     let candleFails = 0;
275:     for (const entry of shortlist) {
276:       const result = await this.tools.get_candles({
277:         symbol: entry.quote.symbol,
278:         timeframe: "M15",
279:         n: 150,
280:       });
281:       if (!result.ok) {
282:         candleFails += 1;
283:         continue;
284:       }
285:       const candidate = scoreCandidate({
286:         symbol: entry.quote.symbol,
287:         candles: result.data,
288:         quote: entry.quote,
289:         momentum5m: entry.mom5,
290:         momentum1m: entry.mom1,
291:         options: this.options,
292:       });
293:       if (candidate) candidates.push(candidate);
294:     }
295: 
296:     candidates.sort((a, b) => b.score - a.score);
297:     this.lastScanDurationMs = Date.now() - started;
298:     const capped = candidates.slice(0, this.options.maxCandidates);
299:     this.lastDiagnostics = {
300:       universe: universe.length,
301:       withQuote,
302:       fresh,
303:       prefiltered: pre.length,
304:       shortlist: shortlist.length,
305:       candleFails,
306:       scored: shortlist.length - candleFails,
307:       passed: capped.length,

178:     ? clamp(config.tp1RR * slDistance, config.tp1MinPips * pip, config.tp1MaxPips * pip)
179:     : config.tp1RR * slDistance;
180: 
181:   const stopLoss = roundPrice(entry - sign * slDistance, digits);
182:   const takeProfit = roundPrice(entry + sign * tpDistance, digits);
183:   const slPips = Math.abs(entry - stopLoss) / pip;
184:   const tpPips = Math.abs(takeProfit - entry) / pip;
185: 
186:   const reasons = [
187:     ...candidate.reasons,
188:     `M15 ${side === "buy" ? "bull" : "bear"} reclaim`,
189:     `M5 aligned`,
190:     `entry ${entry.toFixed(digits)}`,
191:     `SL ${slPips.toFixed(1)}p · TP1 ${tpPips.toFixed(1)}p`,
192:   ];
193: 
194:   return {
195:     signal: {
196:       symbol,
197:       side,
198:       entry,
199:       stopLoss,
200:       takeProfit,
201:       digits,
202:       pip,
203:       slPips,
204:       tpPips,
205:       riskReward: tpPips / slPips,
206:       atr: atrValue,
207:       trailDistance: Math.max(config.trailPips * pip, config.trailAtrFactor * atrValue),
208:       trailDistanceAfterTp1: Math.max(config.trailPipsAfterTp1 * pip, 0.8 * atrValue),
209:       score: candidate.score,
210:       reasons,
211:       createdAt: now,
212:       expiresAt: now + 60_000,
213:     },
214:     rejects: [],
215:   };
216: }
217: 
218: function roundPrice(value: number, digits: number): number {
219:   const factor = 10 ** digits;
220:   return Math.round(value * factor) / factor;
221: }

105: /**
106:  * Fixed-fractional sizing on the virtual risk equity. Always floors to the
107:  * volume step so a trade can never risk more than the configured percentage.
108:  */
109: export function computeLots(input: SizingInput): SizingResult {
110:   if (!(input.slPips > 0) || !(input.pipValuePerLot > 0) || !(input.volumeStep > 0)) {
111:     return { lots: 0, riskUsd: 0, reason: "invalid sizing inputs" };
112:   }
113:   const riskUsd = (input.equity * input.riskPct) / 100;
114:   const rawLots = riskUsd / (input.slPips * input.pipValuePerLot);
115:   let lots = roundVolumeDown(Math.min(rawLots, input.maxLots), input.volumeStep);
116:   if (lots > input.volumeMax) lots = roundVolumeDown(input.volumeMax, input.volumeStep);
117:   if (lots < input.volumeMin) {
118:     return {
119:       lots: 0,
120:       riskUsd,
121:       reason: `risk ${riskUsd.toFixed(2)} = ${rawLots.toFixed(3)} lot < volume_min ${input.volumeMin}`,
122:     };
123:   }
124:   return { lots, riskUsd: lots * input.slPips * input.pipValuePerLot };
125: }

127: /** Rate used to convert the instrument's quote currency into USD. */
128: export function quoteToUsdRate(
129:   quoteCurrency: string,
130:   quotes: Map<string, Quote>,
131: ): number | undefined {
132:   if (quoteCurrency === "USD") return 1;
133:   const direct = quotes.get(`${quoteCurrency}USD`);
134:   if (direct && direct.bid > 0) return direct.bid;
135:   const inverse = quotes.get(`USD${quoteCurrency}`);
136:   if (inverse && inverse.ask > 0) return 1 / inverse.ask;
137: 
138:   // Triangulate through a liquid USD pair. Example: CAD -> USD can be derived
139:   // from CADJPY / USDJPY even when the synthetic CADUSD symbol does not exist
140:   // or has not ticked yet. Sell the quote currency and buy USD, hence bid/ask.
141:   for (const pivot of ["JPY", "CHF", "EUR", "GBP", "AUD", "NZD", "CAD"]) {
142:     if (pivot === quoteCurrency) continue;
143:     const quotePivot = quotes.get(`${quoteCurrency}${pivot}`);
144:     const usdPivot = quotes.get(`USD${pivot}`);
145:     if (quotePivot && usdPivot && quotePivot.bid > 0 && usdPivot.ask > 0) {
146:       const rate = quotePivot.bid / usdPivot.ask;
147:       if (Number.isFinite(rate) && rate > 0) return rate;
148:     }
149:     const pivotQuote = quotes.get(`${pivot}${quoteCurrency}`);
150:     const pivotUsd = quotes.get(`${pivot}USD`);
151:     if (pivotQuote && pivotUsd && pivotQuote.ask > 0 && pivotUsd.bid > 0) {
152:       const rate = pivotUsd.bid / pivotQuote.ask;
153:       if (Number.isFinite(rate) && rate > 0) return rate;
154:     }
155:   }
156:   return undefined;
157: }
158: 
159: /** USD value of one base-currency unit, used for a conservative margin check. */
160: export function baseToUsdRate(
161:   baseCurrency: string,
162:   price: number,
163:   quoteCurrency: string,
164:   quotes: Map<string, Quote>,
165: ): number | undefined {
166:   if (baseCurrency === "USD") return 1;
167:   const direct = quotes.get(`${baseCurrency}USD`);
168:   if (direct && direct.bid > 0) return direct.bid;
169:   const inverse = quotes.get(`USD${baseCurrency}`);
170:   if (inverse && inverse.ask > 0) return 1 / inverse.ask;
171:   const quoteRate = quoteToUsdRate(quoteCurrency, quotes);
172:   if (quoteRate !== undefined && price > 0) return price * quoteRate;
173:   return undefined;
174: }

382:       lastSignal: lastSignal

405:       })),

409:       },

413:       tradeLog: this.deps.executor.statePayload().tradeLog,
414:       executor: this.deps.executor.statePayload(),
415:     };
416:   }
417: 
418:   writeState(force = false, view?: AccountView): void {
419:     const now = Date.now();

421:     if (view) this.lastView = view;
422:     this.lastStateAt = now;
423:     try {

425:       fs.writeFileSync(this.stateFile, `${JSON.stringify(this.state(view), null, 2)}\n`);

427:       // monitoring is best effort
428:     }
429:   }

432:   async scanOnce(): Promise<{
433:     candidates: Candidate[];
434:     decisions: Array<{ symbol: string; signal: EntrySignal | null; rejects: string[] }>;
435:     diagnostics: ScanDiagnostics;

444:         (this.deps.ticks.lastAckError ? ` · ack ${this.deps.ticks.lastAckError}` : ""),
445:     );
446:     const candidates = await this.screener.scan(this.deps.universe);
447:     const decisions: Array<{ symbol: string; signal: EntrySignal | null; rejects: string[] }> = [];
448:     // Check every screened pair, not just the first few: the screener is the
449:     // gate, so a single scan can preview every entry it would take.
450:     for (const candidate of candidates) {

452:         symbol: candidate.symbol,
453:         timeframe: this.deps.config.entryTimeframe,
454:         n: 120,

456:       const quote = this.deps.ticks.get(candidate.symbol);

461:         quote,

463:       });
464:       decisions.push({
465:         symbol: candidate.symbol,
466:         signal: decision.signal,

19: /** Floor a volume to the instrument step (never rounds risk up). */
20: export function roundVolumeDown(volume: number, step: number): number {
21:   if (!Number.isFinite(volume) || !Number.isFinite(step) || step <= 0) return 0;
22:   return Math.floor((volume + 1e-9) / step) * step;

25: export function roundVolumeToStep(volume: number, step: number): number {
26:   if (!Number.isFinite(volume) || !Number.isFinite(step) || step <= 0) return 0;
27:   // Volumes arrive as tiny binary fractions (0.06999999); round to 8 decimals
28:   // before snapping to the step so legitimate values are not floored away.
29:   const snapped = Math.round((volume + 1e-12) / step) * step;
30:   return Number(snapped.toFixed(Math.max(decimalsOf(step), 2)));
31: }

34:   return roundVolumeToStep(volume, step).toFixed(decimalsOf(step));

63: /**
64:  * Wraps every mutating trading call with the async contract of the API:
65:  *
66:  *   POST/PATCH/DELETE -> 202 { operation_id, client_request_id, status: accepted }
67:  *   transaction_event (matched by client_request_id) -> final result
68:  *   GET /operations/{id} -> fallback when the event was missed
69:  *
70:  * The waiter is registered *before* the request is sent so a fast event cannot
71:  * be lost, and the ACK's operation id is used for the fallback poll.
72:  */
73: export class ExecutionGateway {
74:   private readonly waiters = new Map<string, Waiter>();
75: 
76:   constructor(
77:     private readonly client: import("../exness/client.js").ExnessClient,
78:     private readonly events: EventHub,
79:     private readonly log: (line: string) => void = () => {},
80:     private readonly accountId: string = client.accountId,
81:   ) {
82:     this.events.on((event) => this.handleEvent(event));
83:   }
84: 
85:   private basePath(): string {
86:     return `/v1/trading/accounts/${this.accountId}`;
87:   }
88: 
89:   async openPosition(request: OpenPositionRequest): Promise<OperationResult> {
90:     return this.submit("open", "POST", `${this.basePath()}/positions`, request, true);
91:   }
92: 
93:   async closePosition(positionId: string, volume?: string): Promise<OperationResult> {
94:     return this.submit("close", "DELETE", `${this.basePath()}/positions/${positionId}`, undefined, true, {
95:       volume,
96:     });
97:   }
98: 
99:   async createSltp(
100:     positionId: string,
101:     patch: SltpPatch & { stop_loss_price?: string },
102:   ): Promise<OperationResult> {
103:     if (patch.stop_loss_price === undefined && patch.take_profit_price === undefined) {
104:       return this.immediateFailure("sltp", "SLTP needs stop_loss_price or take_profit_price");
105:     }
106:     return this.submit(
107:       "sltp",
108:       "POST",
109:       `${this.basePath()}/orders`,
110:       { position_id: positionId, type: "sltp", ...patch },
111:       true,
112:     );
113:   }
114: 
115:   async modifyOrder(orderId: string, patch: SltpPatch): Promise<OperationResult> {
116:     return this.submit("modify", "PATCH", `${this.basePath()}/orders/${orderId}`, patch, true);
117:   }
118: 
119:   async cancelOrder(orderId: string): Promise<OperationResult> {
120:     return this.submit("cancel", "DELETE", `${this.basePath()}/orders/${orderId}`, undefined, true);
121:   }
122: 
123:   async getOperation(operationId: string): Promise<OperationStatusResponse> {
124:     return this.client.get<OperationStatusResponse>(
125:       `${this.basePath()}/operations/${operationId}`,
126:     );
127:   }
128: 
129:   close(): void {
130:     for (const [key, waiter] of this.waiters) {
131:       clearTimeout(waiter.timer);
132:       this.waiters.delete(key);
133:     }
134:   }
135: 
136:   private async submit(
137:     kind: OperationKind,
138:     method: "POST" | "PATCH" | "DELETE",
139:     path: string,
140:     body: unknown,
141:     mutating: boolean,
142:     query?: Record<string, string | undefined>,
143:   ): Promise<OperationResult> {
144:     const clientRequestId = createIdempotencyKey(`ot-${kind}`);
145:     const started = Date.now();
146:     const eventPromise = this.waitForEvent(clientRequestId);
147: 
148:     let ack: AckResponse;
149:     try {
150:       ack = await this.client.request<AckResponse>(method, path, {
151:         body,
152:         query: query as Record<string, string | undefined>,
153:         idempotencyKey: mutating ? clientRequestId : undefined,
154:       });
155:     } catch (error) {
156:       this.cancelWaiter(clientRequestId);
157:       const apiError = error instanceof ExnessApiError ? error : undefined;
158:       return {
159:         ok: false,
160:         kind,
161:         clientRequestId,
162:         status: "error",
163:         errorCode: apiError?.code ?? apiError?.status,
164:         errorMessage: apiError?.message ?? (error instanceof Error ? error.message : String(error)),
165:         latencyMs: Date.now() - started,
166:       };
167:     }
168: 
169:     let event = await eventPromise;
170:     const operationId = ack?.operation_id;
171:     if (!event && operationId) {
172:       event = await this.pollOperation(operationId);
173:     }
174:     this.cancelWaiter(clientRequestId);
175: 
176:     if (!event) {
177:       return {
178:         ok: false,
179:         kind,
180:         clientRequestId,
181:         operationId,
182:         status: "timeout",
183:         errorCode: undefined,
184:         errorMessage: `No transaction_event within ${EVENT_TIMEOUT_MS}ms and no final operation status`,
185:         latencyMs: Date.now() - started,
186:       };
187:     }
188: 
189:     const status = event.status === "success" ? "confirmed" : event.status === "rejected" ? "rejected" : "failed";
190:     return {
191:       ok: status === "confirmed",
192:       kind,
193:       clientRequestId,
194:       operationId: event.operation_id ?? operationId,
195:       status,
196:       errorCode: event.error_code,
197:       errorMessage: event.error_message,
198:       data: event.payload,
199:       latencyMs: Date.now() - started,
200:       event,
201:     };
202:   }
203: 
204:   private waitForEvent(clientRequestId: string): Promise<TransactionEvent | null> {
205:     return new Promise((resolve) => {
206:       const timer = setTimeout(() => {
207:         this.waiters.delete(clientRequestId);
208:         resolve(null);
209:       }, EVENT_TIMEOUT_MS);
210:       timer.unref?.();
211: 
212:       this.waiters.set(clientRequestId, {
213:         resolve: (event) => resolve(event),
214:         timer,
215:       });
216:     });
217:   }
218: 
219:   private cancelWaiter(clientRequestId: string): void {
220:     const waiter = this.waiters.get(clientRequestId);
221:     if (!waiter) return;
222:     clearTimeout(waiter.timer);
223:     this.waiters.delete(clientRequestId);
224:   }
225: 
226:   private async pollOperation(operationId: string): Promise<TransactionEvent | null> {
227:     for (let attempt = 0; attempt < POLL_ATTEMPTS; attempt += 1) {
228:       await sleep(POLL_DELAY_MS);
229:       try {
230:         const status = await this.getOperation(operationId);
231:         if (status.status === "confirmed") {
232:           return {
233:             event_type: "transaction_event",
234:             operation_id: status.operation_id,
235:             client_request_id: status.client_request_id,
236:             status: "success",
237:             event_time: status.updated_at,
238:           };
239:         }
240:         if (status.status === "rejected" || status.status === "failed") {
241:           return {
242:             event_type: "transaction_event",
243:             operation_id: status.operation_id,
244:             client_request_id: status.client_request_id,
245:             status: status.status,
246:             error_code: status.error_code,
247:             error_message: status.error_message,
248:             event_time: status.updated_at,
249:           };
250:         }
251:       } catch (error) {
252:         this.log(
253:           `operation poll failed for ${operationId}: ${
254:             error instanceof Error ? error.message : String(error)
255:           }`,
256:         );
257:       }
258:     }
259:     return null;
260:   }
261: 
262:   private handleEvent(event: RuntimeEvent): void {
263:     const transaction = asTransactionEvent(event.raw);
264:     if (!transaction) return;
265:     const key = transaction.client_request_id;
266:     if (!key) return;
267: 
268:     const waiter = this.waiters.get(key);
269:     if (!waiter) return;
270:     clearTimeout(waiter.timer);
271:     this.waiters.delete(key);
272:     waiter.resolve(transaction);
273:   }
274: 
275:   private immediateFailure(kind: OperationKind, message: string): OperationResult {
276:     return {
277:       ok: false,
278:       kind,
279:       clientRequestId: createIdempotencyKey(`ot-${kind}`),
280:       status: "error",
281:       errorMessage: message,
282:       latencyMs: 0,
283:     };
284:   }
285: }

156:         this.socket.terminate();
157:         return;
158:       }
159:       this.awaitingPong = true;
160:       this.socket.ping();
161:     }, HEARTBEAT_MS);
162:   }
163: 
164:   private stopHeartbeat(): void {
165:     if (this.heartbeat) clearInterval(this.heartbeat);
166:     this.heartbeat = undefined;
167:   }
168: 
169:   private handleError(error: Error): void {
170:     this.options.onError?.(error);
171:     this.options.logger?.(`socket error: ${error.message}`);
172:   }
173: }

50: /**
51:  * Trend-following pullback entry.
52:  *
53:  * M15 decides the trend and the pullback; M5 must confirm the short-term
54:  * direction. The stop is volatility based, and TP1 is deliberately smaller than
55:  * the stop (a high-hit-rate first target) while the remainder is trailed.
56:  */
57: export function decideEntry(input: {
58:   candidate: Candidate;
59:   m5: NormalizedCandle[];
60:   quote: Quote;
61:   config: EntryConfig;
62:   now?: number;
63: }): EntryDecision {
64:   const { candidate, m5, quote, config } = input;
65:   const rejects: string[] = [];
66:   const now = input.now ?? Date.now();
67: 
68:   const symbol = candidate.symbol;
69:   const side = candidate.direction;
70:   const sign = side === "buy" ? 1 : -1;
71:   const digits = digitsFor(symbol);
72:   const pip = pipSize(symbol, digits);
73: 
74:   if (!(quote.spreadPct > 0) || quote.spreadPct > config.maxSpreadPct) {
75:     rejects.push(`spread ${quote.spreadPct.toFixed(3)}% > ${config.maxSpreadPct}%`);
76:   }
77:   if (now - quote.timestamp > config.maxQuoteAgeMs) {
78:     rejects.push(`quote ${now - quote.timestamp}ms old`);
79:   }
80: 
81:   const m15 = candidate.candles;
82:   const closeSeries = closes(m15);
83:   const ema20Series = ema(closeSeries, 20);
84:   const ema50Series = ema(closeSeries, 50);
85:   const atrSeries = atr(m15, 14);
86:   const rsiSeries = rsi(closeSeries, 14);
87:   const index = m15.length - 1;
88: 
89:   const ema20 = valueAt(ema20Series, index);
90:   const ema50 = valueAt(ema50Series, index);
91:   const atrValue = valueAt(atrSeries, index);
92:   const rsiValue = valueAt(rsiSeries, index);
93:   if (
94:     ema20 === undefined ||
95:     ema50 === undefined ||
96:     atrValue === undefined ||
97:     atrValue <= 0 ||
98:     rsiValue === undefined
99:   ) {
100:     return { signal: null, rejects: ["M15 indicators not ready"] };
101:   }
102: 
103:   const alignedTrend = ((ema20 - ema50) / atrValue) * sign;
104:   if (alignedTrend < config.minTrendAtr) {
105:     rejects.push(`trend ${alignedTrend.toFixed(2)}×ATR < ${config.minTrendAtr}`);
106:   }
107: 
108:   const last = m15[index]!;
109:   const distanceAtr = ((last.close - ema20) / atrValue) * sign;
110:   if (distanceAtr < -1.1) rejects.push(`price ${distanceAtr.toFixed(2)}×ATR against trend`);
111:   if (distanceAtr > config.maxDistanceAtr) {
112:     rejects.push(`price extended ${distanceAtr.toFixed(2)}×ATR`);
113:   }
114: 
115:   // The pullback must have touched the EMA20 area in the last eight M15 bars.
116:   let touched = false;
117:   for (let offset = Math.max(0, index - 7); offset <= index; offset += 1) {
118:     const bar = m15[offset]!;
119:     if (side === "buy" ? bar.low <= ema20 + 0.8 * atrValue : bar.high >= ema20 - 0.8 * atrValue) {
120:       touched = true;
121:       break;
122:     }
123:   }
124:   if (!touched) rejects.push("no pullback touch on EMA20");
125: 
126:   // Reclaim candle: green/red body, or a close that reclaims the EMA20 and
127:   // beats the previous M15 close. Two ways in keeps the trigger frequent.
128:   const previousClose = m15[index - 1]!.close;
129:   const reclaimed =
130:     side === "buy"
131:       ? (last.close > last.open && last.close > previousClose) ||
132:         (last.close > ema20 && last.close > previousClose)
133:       : (last.close < last.open && last.close < previousClose) ||
134:         (last.close < ema20 && last.close < previousClose);
135:   if (!reclaimed) rejects.push("no reclaim candle");
136: 
137:   if (side === "buy" ? rsiValue < 30 || rsiValue > 80 : rsiValue > 70 || rsiValue < 20) {
138:     rejects.push(`RSI ${rsiValue.toFixed(0)} outside pullback band`);
139:   }
140: 
141:   // M5 trend filter.
142:   const m5Closes = closes(m5);
143:   const m5Ema20 = valueAt(ema(m5Closes, 20), m5Closes.length - 1);
144:   const m5Ema50 = valueAt(ema(m5Closes, 50), m5Closes.length - 1);
145:   const m5Last = m5Closes[m5Closes.length - 1];
146:   if (m5Ema20 === undefined || m5Ema50 === undefined || m5Last === undefined) {
147:     rejects.push("M5 indicators not ready");
148:   } else {
149:     // Accept either an aligned M5 EMA stack or a reclaim of the M5 EMA20:
150:     // during a pullback price sits below EMA20, so requiring both was too strict.
151:     const aligned =
152:       side === "buy"
153:         ? m5Ema20 > m5Ema50 || m5Last > m5Ema20
154:         : m5Ema20 < m5Ema50 || m5Last < m5Ema20;
155:     if (!aligned) rejects.push("M5 trend not aligned");
156:   }
157: 
158:   const mid = quote.mid;
159:   const chaseAtr = Math.abs(mid - last.close) / atrValue;
160:   if (chaseAtr > config.maxChaseAtr) {
161:     rejects.push(`chasing ${chaseAtr.toFixed(2)}×ATR from M15 close`);
162:   }
163: 
164:   if (rejects.length > 0) return { signal: null, rejects };
165: 
166:   const entry = roundPrice(side === "buy" ? quote.ask : quote.bid, digits);
167:   // FX pip clamps stay exactly as tuned. Metals, indices, crypto and stocks
168:   // have no meaningful pip size, so their stop/target is pure ATR based.
169:   const fx = categorize(symbol) === "fx";
170:   const slDistance = fx
171:     ? clamp(
172:         config.slAtrFactor * atrValue,
173:         Math.max(config.minSlPips * pip, config.minStopPips * pip),
174:         config.maxSlPips * pip,
175:       )
176:     : Math.max(config.slAtrFactor * atrValue, quote.spread * 3, config.minStopPips * pip);
177:   const tpDistance = fx
178:     ? clamp(config.tp1RR * slDistance, config.tp1MinPips * pip, config.tp1MaxPips * pip)
179:     : config.tp1RR * slDistance;

181:   const stopLoss = roundPrice(entry - sign * slDistance, digits);
182:   const takeProfit = roundPrice(entry + sign * tpDistance, digits);
183:   const slPips = Math.abs(entry - stopLoss) / pip;
184:   const tpPips = Math.abs(takeProfit - entry) / pip;
185: 
186:   const reasons = [
187:     ...candidate.reasons,
188:     `M15 ${side === "buy" ? "bull" : "bear"} reclaim`,
189:     `M5 aligned`,
190:     `entry ${entry.toFixed(digits)}`,
191:     `SL ${slPips.toFixed(1)}p · TP1 ${tpPips.toFixed(1)}p`,
192:   ];
193: 
194:   return {

197:       side,
198:       entry,
199:       stopLoss,
200:       takeProfit,
201:       digits,
202:       pip,
203:       slPips,
204:       tpPips,
205:       riskReward: tpPips / slPips,
206:       atr: atrValue,
207:       trailDistance: Math.max(config.trailPips * pip, config.trailAtrFactor * atrValue),
208:       trailDistanceAfterTp1: Math.max(config.trailPipsAfterTp1 * pip, 0.8 * atrValue),
209:       score: candidate.score,
210:       reasons,
211:       createdAt: now,
212:       expiresAt: now + 60_000,
213:     },
214:     rejects: [],
215:   };
216: }

25: /**

28:  *   BUY entry 1.0850, initial SL 1.0820, trail 20 pips
29:  *   best 1.0900 -> SL 1.0880
30:  *   best 1.0930 -> SL 1.0910
31:  *   price back to 1.0920 -> SL stays 1.0910 (never loosens)
32:  *
33:  * The function is pure so the same logic can be unit-tested and reused by the
34:  * backtest simulator and the live executor.
35:  */
36: export function computeTrailingSl(input: TrailingInput): TrailingAction {
37:   const step = input.step ?? 0;
38: 
39:   if (!Number.isFinite(input.best) || !Number.isFinite(input.currentSl)) {
40:     return { action: "hold", reason: "invalid numbers" };
41:   }
42: 
43:   if (input.side === "buy") {
44:     const candidate = input.best - input.trailDistance;
45: 
46:     if (candidate - input.currentSl <= step) {
47:       return { action: "hold", reason: "no improvement" };
48:     }
49:     if (candidate > input.bid - input.minStopDistance) {
50:       return { action: "hold", reason: "too close to price" };
51:     }
52:     return {
53:       action: "raise",
54:       newSl: roundPrice(candidate),
55:       reason: `best ${input.best} - trail ${input.trailDistance}`,
56:     };
57:   }
58: 
59:   const candidate = input.best + input.trailDistance;
60:   if (input.currentSl - candidate <= step) {
61:     return { action: "hold", reason: "no improvement" };
62:   }
63:   if (candidate < input.ask + input.minStopDistance) {
64:     return { action: "hold", reason: "too close to price" };
65:   }
66:   return {

60:       // Keep the newest price inside the sampling bucket without growing memory.
61:       last.mid = quote.mid;
62:       last.t = quote.timestamp;
63:       return;

65:     series.push({ t: quote.timestamp, mid: quote.mid });

68:     this.samples.set(quote.symbol, series);

75:     const latest = series[series.length - 1]!;

85:     if (reference.mid === 0) return null;
86:     return ((latest.mid - reference.mid) / reference.mid) * 100;

109: /**

113: export function scoreCandidate(input: CandleScoreInput): Candidate | null {
114:   const { symbol, candles, quote, options } = input;
115:   if (candles.length < 60) return null;
