117:   const closeSeries = closes(candles);
118:   const ema20Series = ema(closeSeries, 20);
119:   const ema50Series = ema(closeSeries, 50);
120:   const atrSeries = atr(candles, 14);
121:   const rsiSeries = rsi(closeSeries, 14);
122:   const index = candles.length - 1;
123: 
124:   const ema20 = valueAt(ema20Series, index);
125:   const ema50 = valueAt(ema50Series, index);
126:   const atrValue = valueAt(atrSeries, index);
127:   const close = closeSeries[index];
128:   if (ema20 === undefined || ema50 === undefined || atrValue === undefined || close === undefined) {
129:     return null;
130:   }
131:   if (atrValue <= 0) return null;
132: 
133:   const trendAtr = (ema20 - ema50) / atrValue;
134:   if (Math.abs(trendAtr) < options.minTrendAtr) return null;
135: 
136:   const direction: Direction = trendAtr > 0 ? "buy" : "sell";
137:   const sign = direction === "buy" ? 1 : -1;
138:   const alignedTrend = trendAtr * sign;
139:   const distanceAtr = ((close - ema20) / atrValue) * sign;
140:   // Deep pullbacks are allowed now: the entry stage decides whether the
141:   // pullback is still healthy, while the screener keeps every trend alive.
142:   if (distanceAtr < -1.1 || distanceAtr > options.maxDistanceAtr) return null;
143: 
144:   const previousEma20 = valueAt(ema20Series, index - 5);
145:   if (previousEma20 === undefined) return null;
146:   const alignedSlope = (((ema20 - previousEma20) / atrValue) * sign) / 5;
147:   if (alignedSlope <= 0.005) return null;
148: 
149:   const atrPct = atrPercent(candles, atrValue);
150:   if (atrPct < options.minAtrPct || atrPct > options.maxAtrPct) return null;
151:   if (!(quote.spreadPct > 0) || quote.spreadPct > options.maxSpreadPct) return null;
152: 
153:   const momentum5m = input.momentum5m;
154:   const momentum1m = input.momentum1m;
155:   const alignedMom5 = momentum5m === null ? null : momentum5m * sign;
156:   if (alignedMom5 !== null && alignedMom5 < -0.05) return null;
157: 
158:   const trendScore = clamp(alignedTrend / 0.8, 0, 1) * 30;
159:   const slopeScore = clamp(alignedSlope / 0.4, 0, 1) * 15;
160:   const distanceQuality =
161:     distanceAtr < 0
162:       ? clamp(1 + distanceAtr / 0.6, 0, 1) * 0.6
163:       : distanceAtr <= 1.2
164:         ? 1
165:         : clamp(1 - (distanceAtr - 1.2) / 0.6, 0, 1);
166:   const momentumScore =
167:     alignedMom5 === null ? 8 : clamp((alignedMom5 + 0.02) / 0.1, 0, 1) * 20;
168:   const spreadScore = clamp(1 - quote.spreadPct / options.maxSpreadPct, 0, 1) * 15;
169:   const score =
170:     trendScore + slopeScore + distanceQuality * 15 + momentumScore + spreadScore + 5;
171:   if (score < options.minScore) return null;
172: 
173:   const rsiValue = valueAt(rsiSeries, index) ?? 50;
174:   const reasons = [
175:     `trend ${alignedTrend.toFixed(2)}×ATR`,
176:     `slope ${alignedSlope.toFixed(2)}`,
177:     `pullback ${distanceAtr.toFixed(2)}×ATR`,
178:     `RSI ${rsiValue.toFixed(0)}`,
179:     `spread ${(quote.spreadPct * 100).toFixed(1)}bp`,
180:     `ATR ${atrPct.toFixed(3)}%`,
181:   ];
182:   if (alignedMom5 !== null) reasons.push(`mom5 ${alignedMom5.toFixed(3)}%`);
183: 
184:   return {
185:     symbol,
186:     direction,
187:     score,
188:     price: close,
189:     spreadPct: quote.spreadPct,
190:     atr: atrValue,
191:     atrPct,
192:     ema20,
193:     ema50,
194:     rsi: rsiValue,
195:     trendAtr: alignedTrend,
196:     distanceAtr,
197:     momentum5m: alignedMom5,
198:     momentum1m: momentum1m === null ? null : momentum1m * sign,
199:     reasons,
200:     candles,
201:   };
202: }

217: export class Screener {
218:   readonly momentum = new MomentumTracker();
219:   lastScanAt = 0;
220:   lastScanDurationMs = 0;
221:   lastDiagnostics: ScanDiagnostics = {
222:     universe: 0,
223:     withQuote: 0,
224:     fresh: 0,
225:     prefiltered: 0,
226:     shortlist: 0,
227:     candleFails: 0,
228:     scored: 0,
229:     passed: 0,
230:     top: [],
231:   };
232: 
233:   constructor(
234:     private readonly tools: Tools,
235:     private readonly ticks: TickHub,
236:     private readonly options: ScreenerOptions,
237:   ) {}
238: 
239:   observe(quote: Quote): void {
240:     this.momentum.observe(quote);
241:   }
242: 
243:   async scan(universe: string[]): Promise<Candidate[]> {
244:     const started = Date.now();
245:     this.lastScanAt = started;
246: 
247:     const now = Date.now();
248:     type Pre = { quote: Quote; mom5: number | null; mom1: number | null; prelim: number };
249:     const pre: Pre[] = [];
250:     let withQuote = 0;
251:     let fresh = 0;
252: 
253:     for (const symbol of universe) {
254:       const quote = this.ticks.get(symbol);
255:       if (!quote) continue;
256:       withQuote += 1;
257:       if (now - quote.timestamp > this.options.maxQuoteAgeMs) continue;
258:       fresh += 1;
259:       if (!(quote.spreadPct > 0) || quote.spreadPct > this.options.maxSpreadPct * 1.2) continue;
260: 
261:       const mom5 = this.momentum.changePct(symbol, 5);
262:       const mom1 = this.momentum.changePct(symbol, 1);
263:       const spreadQuality = clamp(1 - quote.spreadPct / this.options.maxSpreadPct, 0, 1);
264:       const activity = clamp(quote.ticks / 20, 0, 1);
265:       const move = mom5 === null ? 0.4 : clamp(Math.abs(mom5) / 0.08, 0, 1);
266:       const prelim = spreadQuality * 35 + activity * 15 + move * 50;
267:       pre.push({ quote, mom5, mom1, prelim });
268:     }
269: 
270:     pre.sort((a, b) => b.prelim - a.prelim);
271:     const shortlist = pre.slice(0, this.options.shortlistSize);
272: 
273:     const candidates: Candidate[] = [];
274:     let candleFails = 0;
275:     for (const entry of shortlist) {
276:       const result = await this.tools.get_candles({
277:         symbol: entry.quote.symbol,
278:         timeframe: "M15",
279:         n: 150,
280:       });
281:       if (!result.ok) {
282:         candleFails += 1;
283:         continue;
284:       }
285:       const candidate = scoreCandidate({
286:         symbol: entry.quote.symbol,
287:         candles: result.data,
288:         quote: entry.quote,
289:         momentum5m: entry.mom5,
290:         momentum1m: entry.mom1,
291:         options: this.options,
292:       });
293:       if (candidate) candidates.push(candidate);
294:     }
295: 
296:     candidates.sort((a, b) => b.score - a.score);
297:     this.lastScanDurationMs = Date.now() - started;
298:     const capped = candidates.slice(0, this.options.maxCandidates);
299:     this.lastDiagnostics = {
300:       universe: universe.length,
301:       withQuote,
302:       fresh,
303:       prefiltered: pre.length,
304:       shortlist: shortlist.length,
305:       candleFails,
306:       scored: shortlist.length - candleFails,
307:       passed: capped.length,
308:       top: shortlist.slice(0, 6).map((entry) => ({
309:         symbol: entry.quote.symbol,
310:         prelim: Number(entry.prelim.toFixed(1)),
311:         spreadPct: Number(entry.quote.spreadPct.toFixed(4)),
312:         mom5: entry.mom5 === null ? null : Number(entry.mom5.toFixed(3)),
313:       })),
314:     };
315:     return capped;
316:   }
317: }

323:     minScore: config.minScore,
324:     maxSpreadPct: config.maxSpreadPct,

105: /**
106:  * Fixed-fractional sizing on the virtual risk equity. Always floors to the
107:  * volume step so a trade can never risk more than the configured percentage.
108:  */
109: export function computeLots(input: SizingInput): SizingResult {
110:   if (!(input.slPips > 0) || !(input.pipValuePerLot > 0) || !(input.volumeStep > 0)) {
111:     return { lots: 0, riskUsd: 0, reason: "invalid sizing inputs" };
112:   }
113:   const riskUsd = (input.equity * input.riskPct) / 100;
114:   const rawLots = riskUsd / (input.slPips * input.pipValuePerLot);
115:   let lots = roundVolumeDown(Math.min(rawLots, input.maxLots), input.volumeStep);
116:   if (lots > input.volumeMax) lots = roundVolumeDown(input.volumeMax, input.volumeStep);
117:   if (lots < input.volumeMin) {
118:     return {
119:       lots: 0,
120:       riskUsd,
121:       reason: `risk ${riskUsd.toFixed(2)} = ${rawLots.toFixed(3)} lot < volume_min ${input.volumeMin}`,
122:     };
123:   }
124:   return { lots, riskUsd: lots * input.slPips * input.pipValuePerLot };
125: }

127: /** Rate used to convert the instrument's quote currency into USD. */
128: export function quoteToUsdRate(
129:   quoteCurrency: string,
130:   quotes: Map<string, Quote>,
131: ): number | undefined {
132:   if (quoteCurrency === "USD") return 1;
133:   const direct = quotes.get(`${quoteCurrency}USD`);
134:   if (direct && direct.bid > 0) return direct.bid;
135:   const inverse = quotes.get(`USD${quoteCurrency}`);
136:   if (inverse && inverse.ask > 0) return 1 / inverse.ask;
137: 
138:   // Triangulate through a liquid USD pair. Example: CAD -> USD can be derived
139:   // from CADJPY / USDJPY even when the synthetic CADUSD symbol does not exist
140:   // or has not ticked yet. Sell the quote currency and buy USD, hence bid/ask.
141:   for (const pivot of ["JPY", "CHF", "EUR", "GBP", "AUD", "NZD", "CAD"]) {
142:     if (pivot === quoteCurrency) continue;
143:     const quotePivot = quotes.get(`${quoteCurrency}${pivot}`);
144:     const usdPivot = quotes.get(`USD${pivot}`);
145:     if (quotePivot && usdPivot && quotePivot.bid > 0 && usdPivot.ask > 0) {
146:       const rate = quotePivot.bid / usdPivot.ask;
147:       if (Number.isFinite(rate) && rate > 0) return rate;
148:     }
149:     const pivotQuote = quotes.get(`${pivot}${quoteCurrency}`);
150:     const pivotUsd = quotes.get(`${pivot}USD`);
151:     if (pivotQuote && pivotUsd && pivotQuote.ask > 0 && pivotUsd.bid > 0) {
152:       const rate = pivotUsd.bid / pivotQuote.ask;
153:       if (Number.isFinite(rate) && rate > 0) return rate;
154:     }
155:   }
156:   return undefined;
157: }

159: /** USD value of one base-currency unit, used for a conservative margin check. */
160: export function baseToUsdRate(
161:   baseCurrency: string,
162:   price: number,
163:   quoteCurrency: string,
164:   quotes: Map<string, Quote>,
165: ): number | undefined {
166:   if (baseCurrency === "USD") return 1;
167:   const direct = quotes.get(`${baseCurrency}USD`);
168:   if (direct && direct.bid > 0) return direct.bid;
169:   const inverse = quotes.get(`USD${baseCurrency}`);
170:   if (inverse && inverse.ask > 0) return 1 / inverse.ask;
171:   const quoteRate = quoteToUsdRate(quoteCurrency, quotes);
172:   if (quoteRate !== undefined && price > 0) return price * quoteRate;
173:   return undefined;
174: }

176: function parseNumber(value: string | null | undefined, fallback: number): number {
177:   const parsed = Number(value ?? "");
178:   return Number.isFinite(parsed) && parsed > 0 ? parsed : fallback;
179: }
180: 
181: function dealProfit(deal: Deal): number {
182:   const profit = Number(deal.profit?.amount ?? 0);
183:   const commission = Number(deal.commission ?? 0);
184:   return (Number.isFinite(profit) ? profit : 0) + (Number.isFinite(commission) ? commission : 0);
185: }

613:   private async takePartial(managed: ManagedPosition): Promise<void> {
614:     if (this.busy.has(managed.positionId)) return;
615:     this.busy.add(managed.positionId);
616:     try {
617:       const half = roundVolumeDown(managed.volume * this.deps.config.tp1Fraction, managed.step);
618:       const canSplit = half >= managed.step && managed.volume - half >= managed.step - 1e-9;
619: 
620:       if (canSplit) {
621:         const result = await this.deps.tools.close(managed.positionId, half, managed.step);
622:         if (!result.ok) {
623:           managed.lastError = result.errorMessage ?? result.status;
624:           this.log({
625:             at: Date.now(),
626:             action: "error",
627:             symbol: managed.symbol,
628:             positionId: managed.positionId,
629:             reason: `partial close failed: ${managed.lastError}`,
630:             ok: false,
631:           });
632:           return;
633:         }
634:         managed.volume = roundVolumeToStep(managed.volume - half, managed.step);
635:         this.log({

714:     if (managed.closing || this.busy.has(managed.positionId)) return;
715:     managed.closing = true;
716:     this.busy.add(managed.positionId);
717:     try {
718:       const result = await this.deps.tools.close(managed.positionId);
719:       if (!result.ok) {
720:         managed.closing = false;
721:         managed.lastError = result.errorMessage ?? result.status;
722:         this.log({
723:           at: Date.now(),
724:           action: "error",
725:           symbol: managed.symbol,
726:           positionId: managed.positionId,
727:           reason: `close failed: ${managed.lastError}`,
728:           ok: false,
729:         });
730:         return;
731:       }
732:       this.log({
733:         at: Date.now(),
734:         action: "hardstop",
735:         symbol: managed.symbol,
736:         positionId: managed.positionId,
737:         side: managed.side,
738:         reason,
739:         ok: true,
740:       });
741:     } finally {
742:       this.busy.delete(managed.positionId);
743:     }
744:   }
745: 
746:   private async finalize(managed: ManagedPosition): Promise<void> {
747:     let realized = this.realized.get(managed.positionId);
748:     if (realized === undefined) {
749:       realized = await this.dealHistoryProfit(managed);
750:     }
751: 
752:     this.stats.trades += 1;
753:     this.stats.netProfit += realized;
754:     if (realized > 0.005) {
755:       this.stats.wins += 1;
756:       this.stats.consecutiveLosses = 0;
757:     } else if (realized < -0.005) {
758:       this.stats.losses += 1;
759:       this.stats.consecutiveLosses += 1;
760:       if (this.stats.consecutiveLosses >= this.deps.config.maxConsecutiveLosses) {
761:         this.stats.pausedUntil = Date.now() + this.deps.config.cooldownMs;
762:       }
763:     } else {
764:       this.stats.flats += 1;
765:       this.stats.consecutiveLosses = 0;
766:     }
767: 
768:     this.log({
769:       at: Date.now(),
770:       action: "close",
771:       symbol: managed.symbol,
772:       positionId: managed.positionId,
773:       side: managed.side,
774:       volume: managed.volume,
775:       reason: `net ${realized.toFixed(2)} USD`,
776:       ok: true,
777:     });
778:     this.managed.delete(managed.positionId);
779:     this.realized.delete(managed.positionId);
780:     this.persist(true);
781:   }
782: 
783:   private async dealHistoryProfit(managed: ManagedPosition): Promise<number> {
784:     const from = new Date(managed.openedAt - 60_000).toISOString();
785:     const to = new Date(Date.now() + 60_000).toISOString();
786:     try {
787:       const response = await this.deps.client.get<DealsHistoryResponse>(
788:         `/v1/history/accounts/${this.deps.accountId}/deals`,
789:         { query: { from, to, limit: 200 } },
790:       );
791:       let total = 0;
792:       for (const item of response.items) {
793:         const deal = "deal" in item ? item.deal : item;
794:         if (deal.position_id !== managed.positionId) continue;
795:         if (deal.type === "open") continue;
796:         total += dealProfit(deal);
797:       }
798:       return total;
799:     } catch {
800:       return 0;
801:     }
802:   }
803: 
804:   private trackDeals(raw: unknown): void {
805:     if (!raw || typeof raw !== "object") return;
806:     const event = raw as TransactionEvent;
807:     if (event.event_type !== "transaction_event") return;
808:     if (event.status !== "success") return;
809:     for (const deal of event.payload?.deals ?? []) {
810:       if (!deal.position_id) continue;
811:       if (deal.type === "open") continue;
812:       if (!this.managed.has(deal.position_id)) continue;
813:       this.realized.set(
814:         deal.position_id,
815:         (this.realized.get(deal.position_id) ?? 0) + dealProfit(deal),
816:       );
817:     }
818:   }
819: 
820:   private findOpenedPosition(
821:     result: OperationResult,
822:     symbol: string,
823:     beforeIds: Set<string>,
824:   ): Position | undefined {
825:     return result.data?.positions?.find(
826:       (position) =>
827:         position.state === "open" &&
828:         position.instrument === symbol &&
829:         !beforeIds.has(position.position_id),
830:     );
831:   }
832: 
833:   private log(entry: TradeLogEntry): void {
834:     this.tradeLog.push(entry);
835:     if (this.tradeLog.length > 200) this.tradeLog.splice(0, this.tradeLog.length - 200);
836:     const line = `${entry.action.padEnd(9)} ${entry.symbol ?? ""} ${entry.side ?? ""} ${
837:       entry.volume ? `${entry.volume} lot ` : ""
838:     }${entry.sl ? `sl ${entry.sl} ` : ""}${entry.reason ?? ""}`.replace(/\s+/g, " ").trim();
839:     this.deps.log(line);
840:     const tone: AgentTone =
841:       entry.ok === false || entry.action === "error"
842:         ? "error"
843:         : entry.action === "close" || entry.action === "partial" || entry.action === "breakeven"
844:           ? "success"
845:           : entry.action === "skip"
846:             ? "warn"
847:             : "info";
848:     this.deps.journal?.record("trader", line, tone);
849:     try {
850:       fs.mkdirSync(path.join(this.deps.cacheDir, "trades"), { recursive: true });
851:       const key = new Date().toISOString().slice(0, 10);
852:       fs.appendFileSync(
853:         path.join(this.deps.cacheDir, "trades", `${key}.jsonl`),
854:         `${JSON.stringify(entry)}\n`,
855:       );
856:     } catch {
857:       // audit trail is best effort
858:     }
859:   }
860: 
861:   private persist(force = false): void {
862:     const now = Date.now();
863:     if (!force && now - this.lastPersistAt < 2_000) return;
864:     this.lastPersistAt = now;
865:   }
866: }

434:     decisions: Array<{ symbol: string; signal: EntrySignal | null; rejects: string[] }>;
435:     diagnostics: ScanDiagnostics;
436:   }> {
437:     this.deps.events.start();
438:     this.deps.ticks.start(this.deps.universe);
439:     // Give the websocket time to deliver the first quote for a wide universe.
440:     await sleep(5000);
441:     this.deps.log(
442:       `ticks ${this.deps.ticks.state} · ${this.deps.ticks.quotesCount} quotes · ` +
443:         `${this.deps.ticks.subscribed.length} subscribed` +
444:         (this.deps.ticks.lastAckError ? ` · ack ${this.deps.ticks.lastAckError}` : ""),
445:     );
446:     const candidates = await this.screener.scan(this.deps.universe);
447:     const decisions: Array<{ symbol: string; signal: EntrySignal | null; rejects: string[] }> = [];
448:     // Check every screened pair, not just the first few: the screener is the
449:     // gate, so a single scan can preview every entry it would take.
450:     for (const candidate of candidates) {
451:       const m5 = await this.deps.tools.get_candles({
452:         symbol: candidate.symbol,
453:         timeframe: this.deps.config.entryTimeframe,
454:         n: 120,
455:       });
456:       const quote = this.deps.ticks.get(candidate.symbol);
457:       if (!m5.ok || !quote) continue;
458:       const decision = decideEntry({
459:         candidate,
460:         m5: m5.data,
461:         quote,
462:         config: entryConfigFrom(this.deps.config),
463:       });
464:       decisions.push({
465:         symbol: candidate.symbol,
466:         signal: decision.signal,
467:         rejects: decision.rejects,
468:       });
469:     }
470:     return { candidates, decisions, diagnostics: this.screener.lastDiagnostics };
471:   }
472: }

801: export function marketPanelLines(ticks: TickHub): string[] {
802:   const quotes = ticks.store.all().filter((quote) => Number.isFinite(quote.mid) && quote.mid > 0);
803:   // A first tick has firstMid === mid, so every symbol looks like a 0.00%
804:   // mover. Only rank instruments that have actually changed at least once.
805:   const movers = quotes
806:     .filter((quote) => quote.ticks > 1)
807:     .sort((a, b) => Math.abs(changePct(b)) - Math.abs(changePct(a)))
808:     .slice(0, 3)
809:     .map((quote) => `${quote.symbol} ${formatSignedPct(changePct(quote), 2)}`)
810:     .join(" · ");
811:   const spreads = quotes
812:     .map((quote) => quote.spreadPct * 100)
813:     .filter((value) => Number.isFinite(value) && value >= 0);
814:   const average = spreads.length
815:     ? spreads.reduce((sum, value) => sum + value, 0) / spreads.length
816:     : 0;
817:   const widest = quotes.reduce<Quote | undefined>(
818:     (best, quote) => (!best || quote.spreadPct > best.spreadPct ? quote : best),
819:     undefined,
820:   );
821:   const age = ticks.lastTickAt ? `${Date.now() - ticks.lastTickAt}ms` : "—";
822:   return [
823:     `quotes ${ticks.quotesCount} live · ${ticks.subscribed.length} ws · ${ticks.ticksPerSecond}/s`,
824:     `ticks ${ticks.state} · last ${age}`,
825:     movers ? `top ${movers}` : style.dim("menunggu tick"),
826:     `avg spread ${average.toFixed(1)}bp`,
827:     widest
828:       ? `wide ${widest.symbol} ${(widest.spreadPct * 100).toFixed(1)}bp`
829:       : style.dim("menunggu spread"),
830:   ];
831: }

341: export function spreadSpikes(ticks: TickHub): number {
342:   const quotes = ticks.store.all();
343:   if (quotes.length < 5) return 0;
344:   // Absolute threshold (5 bp) instead of a median multiple: exotic pairs are
345:   // structurally wide, so a relative measure would flag them permanently.
346:   return quotes.filter((quote) => Number.isFinite(quote.spreadPct) && quote.spreadPct >= 0.05)
347:     .length;

350: export function dailyCap(view: AccountView, equity: EquityTracker, capPct = 3): {
351:   start: number;
352:   change: number;
353:   cap: number;
354:   remaining: number;
355: } {
356:   const start = equity.startBalance || view.balance;
357:   const change = view.equity - start;
358:   // The agent sizes and caps on virtual risk equity, not the demo balance.
359:   const riskEquity = Number(process.env.EXNESS_VIRTUAL_EQUITY ?? 10_000);
360:   const cap = (riskEquity * capPct) / 100;
361:   return { start, change, cap, remaining: cap + Math.min(0, change) };
362: }

370:   return [...totals.entries()].sort((a, b) => b[1] - a[1]);

199: export function positionPips(position: Position, quote: Quote | undefined): number | null {
200:   const open = Number(position.open_price);
201:   if (!Number.isFinite(open) || open === 0) return null;
202:   const price = position.direction === "buy" ? quote?.bid : quote?.ask;
203:   if (!price) return null;
204:   const diff = position.direction === "buy" ? price - open : open - price;
205:   return diff / pipSize(position.instrument, digitsFor(position.instrument));
206: }

12: function makeQuote(price: number): Quote {
13:   const bid = price - 0.00004;
14:   const ask = price + 0.00004;
15:   return {
16:     symbol: "EURUSD",
17:     bid,
18:     ask,
19:     mid: (bid + ask) / 2,
20:     spread: ask - bid,
21:     spreadPct: ((ask - bid) / ((bid + ask) / 2)) * 100,
22:     timestamp: Date.now(),

29: function candle(index: number, open: number, close: number): NormalizedCandle {
30:   return {
31:     time: new Date(Date.UTC(2026, 9, 29, 0, index * 15)).toISOString(),
32:     open,
33:     high: Math.max(open, close) + 0.00015,
34:     low: Math.min(open, close) - 0.00015,
35:     close,
36:     volume: 100,
37:   };
38: }

40: /** Uptrend with a 5-bar pullback into the EMA20 and a reclaim candle. */
41: function pullbackSeries(): NormalizedCandle[] {
42:   const out: NormalizedCandle[] = [];
43:   let previous = 1.08;
44:   for (let index = 0; index < 150; index += 1) {
45:     let close = 1.08 + index * 0.00003 + 0.00002 * Math.sin(index * 1.3);
46:     if (index >= 144 && index <= 148) close -= (index - 143) * 0.00007;
47:     if (index === 149) {
48:       const base = 1.08 + 148 * 0.00003 + 0.00002 * Math.sin(148 * 1.3);
49:       close = base - 5 * 0.00007 + 0.0001;
50:     }
51:     out.push(candle(index, previous, close));
52:     previous = close;
53:   }
54:   return out;
55: }
56: 
57: function steadySeries(count: number): NormalizedCandle[] {
58:   const out: NormalizedCandle[] = [];
59:   let previous = 1.08;
60:   for (let index = 0; index < count; index += 1) {
61:     const close = 1.08 + index * 0.00003;
62:     out.push(candle(index, previous, close));
63:     previous = close;
64:   }
65:   return out;
66: }

47: export function describeError(error: unknown): string[] {
48:   if (error instanceof ExnessApiError) {
49:     const lines = [`${error.label} ${error.message}`];
50:     if (error.hint) lines.push(style.dim(error.hint));
51:     return lines;
52:   }
53:   if (error instanceof SigningError) {
54:     return [error.message];
55:   }
56:   if (error instanceof Error) {
57:     const lines = [error.message];
58:     if (error.name === "TypeError" && /fetch failed/i.test(error.message)) {
59:       lines.push(style.dim("Network error: check the discovery URL and your connection."));
60:     }
61:     return lines;
62:   }
63:   return [String(error)];
64: }
65: 
66: export function reportError(error: unknown, verbose = false): void {
67:   const [first, ...rest] = describeError(error);
68:   process.stderr.write(`${style.red("✖")} ${first}\n`);
69:   for (const line of rest) process.stderr.write(`  ${line}\n`);
70:   if (verbose && error instanceof Error && error.stack) {
71:     process.stderr.write(`${style.dim(error.stack)}\n`);
72:   }
73: }

3: /** Simple moving average, NaN until the window is filled. */
4: export function sma(values: number[], period: number): number[] {
5:   const out = new Array<number>(values.length).fill(Number.NaN);
6:   if (period <= 0) return out;
7:   let sum = 0;
8:   for (let index = 0; index < values.length; index += 1) {
9:     sum += values[index]!;
10:     if (index >= period) sum -= values[index - period]!;
11:     if (index >= period - 1) out[index] = sum / period;
12:   }
13:   return out;
14: }
15: 
16: /** Exponential moving average seeded with the first SMA window. */
17: export function ema(values: number[], period: number): number[] {
18:   const out = new Array<number>(values.length).fill(Number.NaN);
19:   if (period <= 0 || values.length < period) return out;
20:   let sum = 0;
21:   for (let index = 0; index < period; index += 1) sum += values[index]!;
22:   out[period - 1] = sum / period;
23:   const k = 2 / (period + 1);
24:   for (let index = period; index < values.length; index += 1) {
25:     out[index] = values[index]! * k + out[index - 1]! * (1 - k);
26:   }
27:   return out;
28: }

36:   let losses = 0;
37:   for (let index = 1; index <= period; index += 1) {
38:     const delta = values[index]! - values[index - 1]!;
39:     if (delta >= 0) gains += delta;
40:     else losses -= delta;
41:   }
42:   let avgGain = gains / period;
43:   let avgLoss = losses / period;
44:   out[period] = avgLoss === 0 ? 100 : 100 - 100 / (1 + avgGain / avgLoss);
45: 
46:   for (let index = period + 1; index < values.length; index += 1) {
47:     const delta = values[index]! - values[index - 1]!;
48:     const gain = delta > 0 ? delta : 0;
49:     const loss = delta < 0 ? -delta : 0;
50:     avgGain = (avgGain * (period - 1) + gain) / period;
51:     avgLoss = (avgLoss * (period - 1) + loss) / period;
52:     out[index] = avgLoss === 0 ? 100 : 100 - 100 / (1 + avgGain / avgLoss);
53:   }
54:   return out;
55: }
56: 
57: /** Wilder ATR. */
58: export function atr(candles: NormalizedCandle[], period = 14): number[] {
59:   const out = new Array<number>(candles.length).fill(Number.NaN);
60:   if (candles.length <= period) return out;
61: 
62:   const trueRanges: number[] = [];
63:   for (let index = 0; index < candles.length; index += 1) {
64:     const candle = candles[index]!;
65:     if (index === 0) {
66:       trueRanges.push(candle.high - candle.low);
67:       continue;
68:     }
69:     const previousClose = candles[index - 1]!.close;
70:     trueRanges.push(
71:       Math.max(
72:         candle.high - candle.low,
73:         Math.abs(candle.high - previousClose),
74:         Math.abs(candle.low - previousClose),
75:       ),
76:     );
77:   }
78: 
79:   let sum = 0;
80:   for (let index = 0; index < period; index += 1) sum += trueRanges[index]!;
81:   out[period - 1] = sum / period;
82:   for (let index = period; index < candles.length; index += 1) {
83:     out[index] = (out[index - 1]! * (period - 1) + trueRanges[index]!) / period;
84:   }
85:   return out;
86: }
87: 
88: export function closes(candles: NormalizedCandle[]): number[] {
89:   return candles.map((candle) => candle.close);
90: }
91: 
92: export function lastFinite(values: number[]): number | undefined {
93:   for (let index = values.length - 1; index >= 0; index -= 1) {
94:     const value = values[index];
95:     if (value !== undefined && Number.isFinite(value)) return value;
96:   }
97:   return undefined;
98: }
99: 
100: export function valueAt(values: number[], index: number): number | undefined {
101:   const value = values[index];
102:   return value !== undefined && Number.isFinite(value) ? value : undefined;
103: }
104: 
105: export function clamp(value: number, min: number, max: number): number {
106:   return Math.min(max, Math.max(min, value));
107: }
108: 
109: export function round(value: number, digits: number): number {
110:   const factor = 10 ** digits;
111:   return Math.round(value * factor) / factor;
112: }
113: 
114: /** Average absolute move per candle in percent of price. */
115: export function atrPercent(candles: NormalizedCandle[], atrValue: number): number {
116:   const last = candles[candles.length - 1];
117:   if (!last || last.close === 0) return 0;
118:   return (atrValue / last.close) * 100;
119: }

1: # open-trader
2: 
3: Terminal trading system for the **Exness Trader API**. Phase 1 (connection +
4: market data), Phase 2 (live monitoring dashboard) and Phase 3 (broker-side
5: trading tools + deterministic agents) are implemented.
6: 
7: The agents are **plain TypeScript rules**, not an LLM: a screener ranks the whole
8: instrument universe, an entry agent confirms a pullback/reclaim, and a risk
9: executor sizes, opens, trails and closes positions. `agent` is dry-run by
10: default; only `--live` sends orders.
11: 
12: ```
13: open-trader · DEMO
14:   BALANCE / EQUITY / FREE MARGIN / POSITIONS
15:   SCREENER · ENTRY · TRADER        (side-by-side containers)
16:   AGENT LOG                        (what each agent is doing)
17:   POSITIONS                        (all open lots, live price, SL/TP, age)
18:   ACCOUNT · MARKET · RISK
19:   EQUITY / DRAWDOWN                (line charts, side by side)
20:   EVENTS · ORDERS                  (side by side)
21: ```
22: 
23: ## Quick start
24: 
25: ```powershell
26: npm install
27: npm run doctor
28: npm start                         # full-screen dashboard
29: ```
30: 
31: In a second terminal, start the agents:
32: 
33: ```powershell
34: npm run trade                     # same as: bin\ot.cmd agent --live
35: npm run scan                      # same as: bin\ot.cmd agent --once (read-only)
36: bin\ot.cmd agent --live --for 120 # bounded live session
37: ```
38: 
39: `npm start` is the dashboard only. The dashboard reads
40: `.cache/agent-state.json`; the three containers and the activity log stay
41: populated while the agent runs, and show the last session (plus an `agent idle`
42: hint) when it is stopped.
43: 
44: `.env` must contain:
45: 
46: ```ini
47: EXNESS_API_KEY=exnsk-...
48: EXNESS_PRIVATE_KEY=...            # 128-char hex key pair, 64-char hex seed, or PEM
49: EXNESS_ACCOUNT_ID=31000172947
50: EXNESS_DISCOVERY_URL=https://api.exness.com
51: ```
52: 
53: `EXNESS_API_SECRET` is still accepted as a fallback name for the private key.
54: 
55: ## Dashboard keys
56: 
57: The board is rendered as a scrollable viewport, so every section is available
58: even in a short terminal. The footer is pinned at the bottom.
59: 
60: | Key | Action |
61: | --- | --- |
62: | `q` / `Ctrl+C` | quit |
63: | `p` | pause / resume account polling |
64: | `a` | show / hide agent containers + log |
65: | `c` | show / hide equity + drawdown charts |
66: | `o` | show / hide orders |
67: | `e` | show / hide events |
68: | `r` | force a fresh REST snapshot |
69: | `x`, then `y` | arm / confirm the local kill switch (`n` cancels) |
70: | `↑` / `↓`, `j` / `k` | scroll one line |
71: | `PgUp` / `PgDn` | scroll ten lines |
72: | `g` / `G` | jump to top / bottom |
73: 
74: The kill switch is local: while active, the agent refuses new entries but keeps
75: managing open positions. The browser-side SL/TP orders remain at the broker.
76: 
77: ## Commands

79: > `npm run` on Windows silently drops `--flag value` arguments. For anything with
80: > options, use the wrapper: `bin\ot.cmd ...` (or `npx tsx src/cli/index.ts ...`).

83: | --- | --- |
84: | `npm start` / `bin\ot.cmd dashboard` | full-screen dashboard; `--once` renders one frame |
85: | `bin\ot.cmd doctor` | discovery → account → catalog → snapshot → candles → live ticks |
86: | `bin\ot.cmd account` | account profile, mode, currency, leverage, access point |
87: | `bin\ot.cmd snapshot` | balance, equity, margins, positions and active orders |
88: | `bin\ot.cmd monitor positions` | one-shot positions, live quotes where available |
89: | `bin\ot.cmd monitor pnl --days 3` | equity chart + drawdown from the daily log |
90: | `bin\ot.cmd monitor risk` | daily loss cap, margin, exposure, kill switch |
91: | `bin\ot.cmd monitor agent` | persisted agent state and trade log |
92: | `bin\ot.cmd monitor log --once` | replay the persisted event log |
93: | `bin\ot.cmd monitor all --json` | machine-readable aggregate |
94: | `npm run scan` / `bin\ot.cmd agent --once` | read-only screener scan; prints candidates + diagnostics |
95: | `npm run trade` / `bin\ot.cmd agent --live` | continuous screener → entry → risk, sends orders |
96: | `bin\ot.cmd agent --live --for 120` | bounded live session |
97: | `bin\ot.cmd agent --live --scan 15` | override the scan interval (seconds) |
98: | `bin\ot.cmd agent --live --symbols EURUSD,XAUUSD` | restrict the universe |
99: | `bin\ot.cmd instruments --fx --search EUR` | instrument catalog (335 total, 175 FX) |
100: | `bin\ot.cmd candles EURUSD --tf M5 --count 60` | OHLC table + sparkline |
101: | `bin\ot.cmd ticker EURUSD XAUUSD --for 15` | live bid/ask, spread, tick count, age |
102: | `bin\ot.cmd watch --search JPY --limit 15` | live board, sorted by change |
103: | `bin\ot.cmd limits` | REST + WebSocket rate limits |

114: 
115: ## Agents
116: 
117: | Agent | Responsibility |
118: | --- | --- |
119: | **Screener** | Ranks every account instrument: M15 EMA trend, ATR, RSI, distance from EMA20, spread, momentum. Shortlists the best 24, fetches M5 candles, and passes candidates above `minScore`. |
120: | **Entry** | Requires an aligned trend plus a pullback that reclaims in the trend direction. Rejects wide spreads, stale quotes, chasing, and missing reclaims. Computes SL/TP from ATR. |
121: | **Risk / trader** | Sizes in lots from virtual equity and stop distance, opens market orders, creates broker-side SLTP orders, moves to TP1, trails, hard-stops, adopts orphans, and persists state. |
122: 
123: Important behaviour:
124: 
125: - **Universe = all instruments** the account can trade (335 here: FX, metals,
126:   indices, crypto, stocks, other). No symbol is hard-coded; the screener decides.
127: - **Unlimited entries** (`AGENT_MAX_POSITIONS=0`) with a soft concentration cap of
128:   2 positions per symbol. Every qualifying candidate is considered each scan.
129: - **One instrument per WebSocket subscription message**, token-bucketed at about
130:   20/s. Bad symbols are dropped individually with `4000`, not in batches.
131: - **Async execution** — the gateway subscribes to `/ws/events` before sending an
132:   order and correlates ACK / `transaction_event` by `client_request_id`, with
133:   operation polling as a fallback.
134: - **Trailing is broker-side** via a `PATCH` on the position's SLTP order (or a
135:   `POST` SLTP if none exists). It never moves backward.
136:

### Trailing virtual module

```ts
export type PositionSide = "buy" | "sell";

export function updateBest(side, best, bid, ask): number {
  if (!Number.isFinite(bid) || !Number.isFinite(ask)) return best;
  return side === "buy" ? Math.max(best, bid) : Math.min(best, ask);
}

export function trailDistanceFromAtr(atr, minDistance, atrFactor): number {
  if (!Number.isFinite(atr) || atr <= 0) return minDistance;
  return Math.max(atr * atrFactor, minDistance);
}

export function initialVirtualStop(side, entry, distance): number {
  return side === "buy" ? entry - distance : entry + distance;
}

export function advanceVirtualStop(side, current, best, distance): number {
  const candidate = side==="buy" ? best-distance : best+distance;
  if (!finite current) return candidate;
  return side==="buy" ? Math.max(current, candidate) : Math.min(current, candidate);
}

export function virtualStopHit(side, stop, bid, ask): boolean {
  return side==="buy" ? bid <= stop : ask >= stop;
}
```

We can keep `scanIntervalMs` default 900000 and schedule anchored to M15. Need implement `nextM15Delay(now)`:
```ts
const M15_MS = 15*60*1000;
function msUntilNextM15(now=Date.now(), graceMs=3000): number {
  const next = Math.floor(now/M15_MS)*M15_MS + M15_MS + graceMs;
  return next - now;
}
```
At start, after warmup, initial scan immediately. Then schedule next at next boundary + 3s. `schedule()`:

export function dropFormingCandle(candles: NormalizedCandle[], timeframeMs: number, now = Date.now()): NormalizedCandle[] {
  if (candles.length === 0) return candles;

}

      this.log({at:now, action:"close", ... reason:"kill switch: close all", ok:true});
    } else { this.killAttempts.delete(id); log error; }
  }
  // forget IDs no longer open
  const openIds = new Set(view.positions.map(p=>p.position_id));
  for (const id of this.killAttempts.keys()) if (!openIds.has(id)) this.killAttempts.delete(id);

  for (const managed of [...this.managed.values()]) {
    if (!openIds.has(managed.positionId)) await this.finalize(managed);
  }
}

But `finalize` logs close with net; good. If position still open, keep managed. On each tick, closeAll attempts; eventually missing -> finalize.

`killActive`: helper.

Potential issue: current 15 open positions restored from state with old fields. `tradingAllowed` maxPositions 1 will block new entries, but manage will trail them. The old managed state has `currentSl` (broker trailed) and `best`; restore sets `trailStop = currentSl`, `trailDistance` old. The new virtual stop will start at currentSl (maybe near price) and close on slight move. That may close all 15 quickly. Is that okay? It might be desired to clean up old positions. But `emergencySl` set currentSl (tight) and broker SL is currentSl. Fine. If user doesn't want, run kill. We'll mention.

```

Need `marketTools.get_candles` returns ToolResult; use `ok`.
`refreshTrailDistance`:
```ts
const result = await this.deps.marketTools.get_candles({symbol,timeframe:"M15",n:60});
if (!result.ok) { log error maybe; return false;}
const closed = dropFormingCandle(result.data, M15_MS);
const atrValue = lastFinite(atr(closed, config.trailAtrPeriod));
if (!atrValue || atrValue<=0) return false;
const distance = trailDistanceFromAtr(atrValue, config.trailAtrFactor, config.trailMinPips*managed.pip);
const next = advanceVirtualStop(side, managed.trailStop, managed.best, distance);
const improved = side==="buy" ? next > managed.trailStop + epsilon : next < managed.trailStop - epsilon;
managed.atr = atrValue; managed.trailDistance = distance;
if (improved) { set stop; log trail reason `ATR ...`; }
return true;
```
- If distance grows and stop doesn't change, still set `trailDistance`.
- Do we want to update stop based on **current best** after ATR refresh even if no new high? Yes; formula can tighten. The plan says update distance each M15 close; stop update only on new high. But a smaller ATR at close would tighten stop without new high. That's consistent with "stop only rises". Fine.
- If `best` is entry and `trailStop=emergency`, new distance maybe 3×ATR? `best - distance` could be above emergency if trail distance < emergency distance (2 ATR < 3 ATR), so it would raise stop to entry - 2ATR at the first M15 close even with no profit. Is that desirable? Maybe yes, tightens to normal trailing after one candle. But it could cause stop closer; plan says stop = max(stop, best-jarak) at update. If best=entry, candidate=entry-2ATR, > emergency (3ATR), so raise. That effectively sets virtual stop at 2ATR after first close. Good. At open we set emergency; after first M15 close, virtual tightens to 2ATR. That is a nice compromise.
- At entry, `trailStop = emergency`; on first manage tick no ATR refresh (lastAtrSyncAt = current boundary), so no advance. At next M15 close, tightens to 2ATR. Good.

`best` update:
- `updateBest` every tick; it records high. If price goes up then down, best stays.
- Stop advance only when new best; but if ATR refresh happens, advance.
- If `trailStop` is emergency and new best candidate `best - 2ATR` is still below emergency (e.g., best advanced 5 pips, emergency 30 pips), hold; later at 10 pips maybe candidate > emergency? For best entry+10, candidate entry+10-20 = entry-10 > entry-30, so raises. That means after a 10-pip move, stop jumps to 10 pips below entry; locks at -10? Actually stop entry-10, not profit. It reduces risk. At best entry+20, stop entry+0; at +30, stop +10. This is normal. Good.

`virtualStopHit` for buy: bid <= trailStop. If trailStop is entry-10, and price drops, close. Good.
- On close, broker emergency remains far, but market close executes. Good.

`closeFull`:
- Use `managed.closing`/busy; call `tools.close`; log `"close"` reason. Do not finalize immediately; finalize when snapshot missing. Current code left position. Good.
- If close fails, `closing=false`, log error. retry next tick.
- The close log reason "virtual trail hit" etc. Then finalize logs net. Fine.
- In `manage`, after close call `continue`; managed still in map with closing true; next tick missing -> finalize.

`killAll` close requests: If managed position close request accepted, then `manage` returns; next tick still KILL, `closeAll` sees position maybe gone and finalizes. Good.
- If no positions, `closeAll` loops none and finalizes managed missing. Good.

`stats` and daily cap: Current `tradingAllowed` uses `view.positions.length` all, not managed. Good.

`quoteToUsdRate` / `baseToUsdRate` / `computeLots` keep.

341: export function spreadSpikes(ticks: TickHub): number {
342:   const quotes = ticks.store.all();
343:   if (quotes.length < 5) return 0;
344:   // Absolute threshold (5 bp) instead of a median multiple: exotic pairs are
345:   // structurally wide, so a relative measure would flag them permanently.
346:   return quotes.filter((quote) => Number.isFinite(quote.spreadPct) && quote.spreadPct >= 0.05)
347:     .length;
348: }
349: 
350: export function dailyCap(view: AccountView, equity: EquityTracker, capPct = 3): {
351:   start: number;
352:   change: number;
353:   cap: number;
354:   remaining: number;
355: } {
356:   const start = equity.startBalance || view.balance;
357:   const change = view.equity - start;
358:   // The agent sizes and caps on virtual risk equity, not the demo balance.
359:   const riskEquity = Number(process.env.EXNESS_VIRTUAL_EQUITY ?? 10_000);
360:   const cap = (riskEquity * capPct) / 100;
361:   return { start, change, cap, remaining: cap + Math.min(0, change) };
362: }
363: 
364: export function exposureByCurrency(positions: Position[]): Array<[string, number]> {
365:   const totals = new Map<string, number>();
366:   for (const position of positions) {
367:     const base = position.instrument.slice(0, 3);
368:     totals.set(base, (totals.get(base) ?? 0) + Number(position.volume));
369:   }
370:   return [...totals.entries()].sort((a, b) => b[1] - a[1]);
371: }

391:     `  kill switch ${halted ? style.red("ON — entry diblokir") : style.green("OFF")} · spread lebar ${spikes > 0 ? style.yellow(String(spikes)) : style.dim("0")} pair · tick terakhir ${tickAge === Number.POSITIVE_INFINITY ? style.dim("—") : `${tickAge}ms`}`,
392:   ].join("\n");

549: function gateSide(side: string | undefined): string {

555: /** Five dense lines sized for the side-by-side agent card. */
556: function agentPanelLines(agent: AgentStateFile | null | undefined): string[] {
557:   if (!agent) {
558:     return [
559:       style.dim("agent belum berjalan"),
560:       "",
561:       style.dim("jalankan `ot agent --live`"),
562:       "",
563:       "",
564:     ];
565:   }
566:   const stats = agent.stats;
567:   const open = agent.openPositions ?? [];
568:   const candidates = agent.screener?.candidates ?? [];
569:   const signal = agent.lastSignal;
570:   const trailing = (agent.trailing ?? []).slice(-3);
571:   const decided = (stats?.wins ?? 0) + (stats?.losses ?? 0);
572:   const winRate = stats?.winRate ?? (decided > 0 ? ((stats?.wins ?? 0) / decided) * 100 : 0);
573: 
574:   const lines = [
575:     `${agent.running ? style.green("● running") : style.dim("○ idle")} · ` +
576:       `${agent.mode === "live" ? style.green("LIVE") : style.yellow("DRY-RUN")} · ` +
577:       `${agent.universe ?? 0} pairs · ${agent.screener?.pass ?? candidates.length} kandidat`,
578:     stats && stats.trades
579:       ? `trades ${stats.trades} · win ${winRate.toFixed(1)}% ` +
580:         `(${stats.wins ?? 0}W/${stats.losses ?? 0}L) · net ${formatSignedMoney(stats.netProfit ?? 0)}`
581:       : style.dim("belum ada trade tertutup"),
582:     `daily ${formatSignedMoney(agent.dailyPnl ?? 0)} · open ${open.length} · ` +
583:       `scan ${agent.updatedAt ? formatAge(Date.now() - agent.updatedAt) : "—"} lalu`,
584:     signal
585:       ? `last ${gateSide(signal.side)} ${signal.symbol ?? "?"} · ${signal.lot ?? 0} lot · ` +
586:         `entry ${signal.entry ?? "—"}`
587:       : style.dim("belum ada sinyal entry"),
588:     trailing.length > 0
589:       ? `trail ${trailing.map((entry) => `${entry.symbol ?? "?"}→${entry.sl ?? "?"}`).join(" ")}`
590:       : agent.note
591:         ? style.dim(agent.note)
592:         : style.dim("trailing menunggu TP1"),
593:   ];
594:   return lines;
595: }

597: /** Five dense lines sized for the side-by-side risk card. */
598: function riskPanelLines(
599:   view: AccountView,
600:   ticks: TickHub,
601:   equity: EquityTracker,
602:   halted: boolean,
603: ): string[] {
604:   const cap = dailyCap(view, equity);
605:   const lots = view.positions.reduce((sum, position) => sum + Number(position.volume), 0);
606:   const exposure = exposureByCurrency(view.positions)
607:     .slice(0, 3)
608:     .map(([currency, volume]) => `${currency} ${volume.toFixed(2)}`)
609:     .join(" · ");
610:   const spikes = spreadSpikes(ticks);
611:   const tickAge = ticks.lastTickAt ? `${Date.now() - ticks.lastTickAt}ms` : "—";
612:   return [
613:     `pos ${view.positions.length} · lots ${lots.toFixed(2)} · free ${formatCompactMoney(view.freeMargin)}`,
614:     `daily ${formatSignedMoney(cap.change, view.currency)} / cap -${formatMoney(cap.cap, view.currency, 0)}`,
615:     `left ${formatCompactMoney(Math.max(0, cap.remaining))} · ` +
616:       `lvl ${view.usedMargin > 0 ? formatCompactPct(view.marginLevel) : "—"}`,
617:     `kill ${halted ? style.red("ON") : style.green("OFF")} · wide ` +
618:       `${spikes > 0 ? style.yellow(String(spikes)) : style.dim("0")} · tick ${tickAge}`,
619:     exposure ? `exposure ${exposure}` : style.dim("belum ada exposure"),
620:   ];
621: }

623: // ------------------------------------------------------- per-agent containers
624: 
625: const AGENT_LABEL: Record<AgentRole, string> = {
626:   screener: "SCREENER",
627:   entry: "ENTRY",
628:   trader: "TRADER",
629: };
630: 
631: function agentColor(role: AgentRole): (text: string) => string {
632:   if (role === "screener") return style.cyan;
633:   if (role === "entry") return style.green;
634:   return style.yellow;
635: }
636: 
637: function agentTag(role: AgentRole): string {
638:   return agentColor(role)(AGENT_LABEL[role].padEnd(8));
639: }
640: 
641: function shortClock(epochMs: number): string {
642:   return clockTime(epochMs).slice(0, 8);
643: }
644: 
645: function agentMode(agent: AgentStateFile | null | undefined): string {
646:   if (!agent || !agent.running) return style.dim("idle");
647:   return agent.mode === "live" ? style.green("LIVE") : style.yellow("DRY-RUN");
648: }
649: 
650: function lastAgentActivity(
651:   agent: AgentStateFile | null | undefined,
652:   role: AgentRole,
653: ): string | undefined {
654:   const entries = (agent?.activity ?? []).filter((entry) => entry.agent === role);
655:   return entries[entries.length - 1]?.message;
656: }
657: 
658: function screenerPanelLines(agent: AgentStateFile | null | undefined): string[] {
659:   if (!agent) {
660:     return [
661:       style.dim("belum ada agent-state.json"),
662:       style.dim("jalankan ot agent --live"),
663:       "",
664:       "",
665:     ];
666:   }
667:   const screener = agent.screener;
668:   const diagnostics = screener?.diagnostics;
669:   const age = screener?.at ? formatAge(Date.now() - screener.at) : "—";
670:   const duration = ((screener?.durationMs ?? 0) / 1000).toFixed(1);
671:   return [
672:     `${agentMode(agent)} · ${agent.universe ?? 0} pairs`,
673:     diagnostics
674:       ? `scan ${duration}s · fresh ${diagnostics.fresh ?? 0}/${diagnostics.withQuote ?? 0} · short ${diagnostics.shortlist ?? 0}`
675:       : `scan ${age} lalu · ${screener?.pass ?? 0} kandidat`,
676:     diagnostics
677:       ? `pass ${diagnostics.passed ?? 0} · fail ${diagnostics.candleFails ?? 0} · ${age} lalu`
678:       : style.dim("menunggu scan pertama"),
679:     `› ${lastAgentActivity(agent, "screener") ?? "belum ada aktivitas"}`,
680:   ];
681: }
682: 
683: function entryPanelLines(agent: AgentStateFile | null | undefined): string[] {
684:   if (!agent) {
685:     return [style.dim("menunggu sinyal"), "", "", ""];
686:   }
687:   const signal = agent.lastSignal;
688:   const open = agent.openPositions ?? [];
689:   return [
690:     `${agentMode(agent)} · signals ${signal ? 1 : 0} · open ${open.length}`,
691:     signal
692:       ? `last ${gateSide(signal.side)} ${signal.symbol ?? "?"} · lot ${signal.lot || "—"}`
693:       : style.dim("belum ada sinyal entry"),
694:     signal
695:       ? `entry ${signal.entry ?? "—"} · sl ${signal.sl ?? "—"} · tp ${signal.tp ?? "—"}`
696:       : style.dim("screener → entry → risk"),
697:     `› ${lastAgentActivity(agent, "entry") ?? "belum ada aktivitas"}`,
698:   ];
699: }
700: 
701: function traderPanelLines(agent: AgentStateFile | null | undefined): string[] {
702:   if (!agent) {
703:     return [style.dim("belum ada posisi dikelola"), "", "", ""];
704:   }
705:   const stats = agent.stats;
706:   const open = agent.openPositions ?? [];
707:   const tp1 = open.filter((position) => position.tp1Hit).length;
708:   const decided = (stats?.wins ?? 0) + (stats?.losses ?? 0);
709:   const winRate = stats?.winRate ?? (decided > 0 ? ((stats?.wins ?? 0) / decided) * 100 : 0);
710:   return [
711:     `${agentMode(agent)} · ${open.length} managed · ${tp1} TP1`,
712:     `${stats?.trades ?? 0} trades · win ${decided > 0 ? `${winRate.toFixed(1)}%` : "—"} · ` +
713:       `${stats?.wins ?? 0}W/${stats?.losses ?? 0}L`,
714:     `net ${formatSignedMoney(stats?.netProfit ?? 0)} · daily ${formatSignedMoney(agent.dailyPnl ?? 0)}`,
715:     `› ${lastAgentActivity(agent, "trader") ?? "menunggu trailing"}`,
716:   ];
717: }

719: export function renderAgentContainers(
720:   agent: AgentStateFile | null | undefined,
721:   width: number,
722: ): string {
723:   const status = agent?.running ? "live" : "idle";
724:   if (width >= 96) {
725:     const widths = splitWidths(width, 3, 1);
726:     return row(
727:       [

729:         panel(`ENTRY · ${status}`, entryPanelLines(agent), widths[1]!, "green"),
730:         panel(`TRADER · ${status}`, traderPanelLines(agent), widths[2]!, "yellow"),
731:       ],
732:       " ",

734:   }
735:   return [
736:     panel(`SCREENER · ${status}`, screenerPanelLines(agent), width, "cyan"),
737:     panel(`ENTRY · ${status}`, entryPanelLines(agent), width, "green"),
738:     panel(`TRADER · ${status}`, traderPanelLines(agent), width, "yellow"),
739:   ].join("\n");
740: }

767: }

31: In a second terminal, start the agents:
32: 
33: ```powershell
34: npm run trade                     # same as: bin\ot.cmd agent --live
35: npm run scan                      # same as: bin\ot.cmd agent --once (read-only)
36: bin\ot.cmd agent --live --for 120 # bounded live session
37: ```
38: 
39: `npm start` is the dashboard only. The dashboard reads
40: `.cache/agent-state.json`; the three containers and the activity log stay
41: populated while the agent runs, and show the last session (plus an `agent idle`
42: hint) when it is stopped.
43: 
44: `.env` must contain:
45: 
46: ```ini
47: EXNESS_API_KEY=exnsk-...
48: EXNESS_PRIVATE_KEY=...            # 128-char hex key pair, 64-char hex seed, or PEM
49: EXNESS_ACCOUNT_ID=31000172947
50: EXNESS_DISCOVERY_URL=https://api.exness.com
51: ```
52: 
53: `EXNESS_API_SECRET` is still accepted as a fallback name for the private key.
54: 
55: ## Dashboard keys
56: 
57: The board is rendered as a scrollable viewport, so every section is available
58: even in a short terminal. The footer is pinned at the bottom.
59: 
60: | Key | Action |
61: | --- | --- |
62: | `q` / `Ctrl+C` | quit |
63: | `p` | pause / resume account polling |
64: | `a` | show / hide agent containers + log |
65: | `c` | show / hide equity + drawdown charts |
66: | `o` | show / hide orders |
67: | `e` | show / hide events |
68: | `r` | force a fresh REST snapshot |
69: | `x`, then `y` | arm / confirm the local kill switch (`n` cancels) |
70: | `↑` / `↓`, `j` / `k` | scroll one line |
71: | `PgUp` / `PgDn` | scroll ten lines |
72: | `g` / `G` | jump to top / bottom |
73: 
74: The kill switch is local: while active, the agent refuses new entries but keeps
75: managing open positions. The browser-side SL/TP orders remain at the broker.
76: 
77: ## Commands
78: 
79: > `npm run` on Windows silently drops `--flag value` arguments. For anything with
80: > options, use the wrapper: `bin\ot.cmd ...` (or `npx tsx src/cli/index.ts ...`).
81: 
82: | Command | What it does |
83: | --- | --- |
84: | `npm start` / `bin\ot.cmd dashboard` | full-screen dashboard; `--once` renders one frame |
85: | `bin\ot.cmd doctor` | discovery → account → catalog → snapshot → candles → live ticks |
86: | `bin\ot.cmd account` | account profile, mode, currency, leverage, access point |
87: | `bin\ot.cmd snapshot` | balance, equity, margins, positions and active orders |
88: | `bin\ot.cmd monitor positions` | one-shot positions, live quotes where available |
89: | `bin\ot.cmd monitor pnl --days 3` | equity chart + drawdown from the daily log |
90: | `bin\ot.cmd monitor risk` | daily loss cap, margin, exposure, kill switch |
91: | `bin\ot.cmd monitor agent` | persisted agent state and trade log |
92: | `bin\ot.cmd monitor log --once` | replay the persisted event log |
93: | `bin\ot.cmd monitor all --json` | machine-readable aggregate |
94: | `npm run scan` / `bin\ot.cmd agent --once` | read-only screener scan; prints candidates + diagnostics |
95: | `npm run trade` / `bin\ot.cmd agent --live` | continuous screener → entry → risk, sends orders |
96: | `bin\ot.cmd agent --live --for 120` | bounded live session |
97: | `bin\ot.cmd agent --live --scan 15` | override the scan interval (seconds) |
98: | `bin\ot.cmd agent --live --symbols EURUSD,XAUUSD` | restrict the universe |
99: | `bin\ot.cmd instruments --fx --search EUR` | instrument catalog (335 total, 175 FX) |
100: | `bin\ot.cmd candles EURUSD --tf M5 --count 60` | OHLC table + sparkline |
101: | `bin\ot.cmd ticker EURUSD XAUUSD --for 15` | live bid/ask, spread, tick count, age |
102: | `bin\ot.cmd watch --search JPY --limit 15` | live board, sorted by change |
103: | `bin\ot.cmd limits` | REST + WebSocket rate limits |
104: | `bin\ot.cmd events --for 30` | stream account/transaction/instrument events |
105: 
106: Global flags: `--verbose`, `--no-color`, `--json`.
107: 
108: Tests and typecheck:
109: 
110: ```powershell
111: npm test
112: npm run typecheck
113: ```
114: 
115: ## Agents
116: 
117: | Agent | Responsibility |
118: | --- | --- |
119: | **Screener** | Ranks every account instrument: M15 EMA trend, ATR, RSI, distance from EMA20, spread, momentum. Shortlists the best 24, fetches M5 candles, and passes candidates above `minScore`. |
120: | **Entry** | Requires an aligned trend plus a pullback that reclaims in the trend direction. Rejects wide spreads, stale quotes, chasing, and missing reclaims. Computes SL/TP from ATR. |
121: | **Risk / trader** | Sizes in lots from virtual equity and stop distance, opens market orders, creates broker-side SLTP orders, moves to TP1, trails, hard-stops, adopts orphans, and persists state. |
122: 
123: Important behaviour:
124: 
125: - **Universe = all instruments** the account can trade (335 here: FX, metals,
126:   indices, crypto, stocks, other). No symbol is hard-coded; the screener decides.
127: - **Unlimited entries** (`AGENT_MAX_POSITIONS=0`) with a soft concentration cap of
128:   2 positions per symbol. Every qualifying candidate is considered each scan.
129: - **One instrument per WebSocket subscription message**, token-bucketed at about
130:   20/s. Bad symbols are dropped individually with `4000`, not in batches.
131: - **Async execution** — the gateway subscribes to `/ws/events` before sending an
132:   order and correlates ACK / `transaction_event` by `client_request_id`, with
133:   operation polling as a fallback.
134: - **Trailing is broker-side** via a `PATCH` on the position's SLTP order (or a
135:   `POST` SLTP if none exists). It never moves backward.
136: 
137: ### Risk defaults
138: 
139: | Setting | Value |
140: | --- | --- |
141: | Virtual equity for sizing | 10,000 USD (`EXNESS_VIRTUAL_EQUITY`) |
142: | Risk per trade | 0.5% (`AGENT_RISK_PCT`) |
143: | Max lots per trade | 0.5 (`AGENT_MAX_LOTS`) |
144: | Max positions | unlimited (`AGENT_MAX_POSITIONS=0`) |
145: | Max per symbol | 2 (`AGENT_MAX_PER_SYMBOL`) |
146: | Daily loss cap | 3% ≈ 300 USD |
147: | Consecutive-loss cooldown | 3 losses → 4 hours |
148: | FX stop | 1.5×ATR, clamped 10–25 pips |
149: | Non-FX stop | pure ATR, no pip clamp |
150: | TP1 | 0.4R (FX clamped 6–14 pips), close 50% |
151: | After TP1 | SL → breakeven +2 pips, trail 8 pips |
152: | Initial trail | max(12 pips, 1.2×ATR) |
153: | Hard stop before TP1 | −0.8R |
154: | Max quote age | 30 s (`AGENT_MAX_QUOTE_AGE_MS`) |
155: | Margin buffer | ×3 |
156: 
157: Trailing example: entry `1.0850`, initial SL `1.0820`. At `1.0900` the SL becomes
158: `1.0880`; at `1.0930` it becomes `1.0910`; if price falls back to `1.0920`, the SL
159: stays at `1.0910`.
160: 
161: Agent state and audit trail:
162: 
163: ```
164: .cache/agent-state.json           managed positions, stats, activity journal
165: .cache/trades/YYYY-MM-DD.jsonl    open / trail / partial / close events
166: .cache/equity/YYYY-MM-DD.jsonl    equity samples for charts
167: .cache/events/YYYY-MM-DD.jsonl    raw runtime events
168: .cache/KILL                       local kill switch flag
169: ```
170: 
171: ## How it works
172: 
173: ```
174: src/
175: ├─ config.ts              .env loading (no dotenv) + validation
176: ├─ exness/
177: │  ├─ signing.ts          hex/PEM → Ed25519 key, EXN-DATA + EXN-SIGN headers
178: │  ├─ client.ts           access-point discovery + cache, signed REST, retry, rate limit
179: │  ├─ ws.ts               signed WebSocket handshake, heartbeat, reconnect + resubscribe
180: │  ├─ catalog.ts          instrument catalog + per-instrument conditions (cached)
181: │  └─ types.ts            subset of trading.public.yaml v1.0.2
182: ├─ market/
183: │  ├─ candles.ts          candle normalisation + pip/point helpers
184: │  ├─ indicators.ts       EMA/SMA/RSI/ATR
185: │  └─ store.ts            last tick per symbol, quotes, formatting
186: ├─ runtime/
187: │  ├─ hubs.ts             TickHub / EventHub, one-instrument subscriptions, token bucket
188: │  ├─ snapshot.ts         account snapshot cache (1200 ms TTL, invalidate)
189: │  └─ execution.ts        ACK/event correlation, operation polling, order gateway
190: ├─ tools/
191: │  ├─ index.ts            read-only account/catalog/candle tools
192: │  └─ trading.ts          open / patch-or-create SLTP / close, digits cache
193: ├─ monitor/equity.ts      daily equity samples + start balance
194: ├─ agents/
195: │  ├─ config.ts           thresholds and risk limits
196: │  ├─ screener.ts         prefilter, ranking, scan diagnostics
197: │  ├─ entry.ts            trend/pullback/reclaim gate, FX vs non-FX SL/TP
198: │  ├─ risk-and-executor.ts sizing, gating, TP1, trailing, adoption
199: │  ├─ engine.ts           scan loop, manage loop, state writer
200: │  ├─ journal.ts          per-agent activity feed for the dashboard
201: │  └─ trailing.ts         monotonic trailing-stop math
202: └─ cli/                   args, ANSI rendering, charts, commands, dashboard
203: ```
204: 
205: Behaviour worth knowing:
206: 
207: - **Signing** — `EXN-DATA` is serialized once; those exact bytes are signed and
208:   base64url-encoded (no padding) into `EXN-DATA`, with the Ed25519 signature in
209:   `EXN-SIGN`. `body_hash` is SHA-256 of the exact body.
210: - **Discovery** — `GET /v1/trading/access-point?account_id=…` against
211:   `EXNESS_DISCOVERY_URL`. The result is cached for 10 minutes and re-resolved
212:   once on a `401`.
213: - **Rate limits** — per-route sliding windows (candles 2/s, snapshot 2/s, orders
214:   4/s, global 10/s) plus `Retry-After` on `429`. Tick subscriptions use a
215:   separate 20/s token bucket; ticks are subscribed one instrument per message.
216: - **Money and volume are decimal strings** in requests/responses; only display
217:   formatting uses numbers, with `point_digits` from instrument conditions.
218: - **State is on disk** so a restarted agent re-adopts open positions from the
219:   trade log and `.cache/agent-state.json` instead of leaving them unmanaged.
220: 
221: ## Roadmap
222: 
223: - Phase 1 (done) — connection, account state, catalog, candles, live ticks, limits.
224: - Phase 2 (done) — persists quotes/candles/equity, instrument metadata, screener,
225:   monitoring views and the full-screen dashboard.
226: - Phase 3 (done) — market entries, broker-side SLTP, partial close, close, ACK
227:   correlation, deterministic screener/entry/risk agents, orphan adoption, state.
228: - Phase 4 (done) — terminal dashboard with per-agent containers, journal, charts,
229:   events/orders and scrollable hotkeys.
230: - Next — backtest module reusing `computeTrailingSl` + `decideEntry`, then tune
231:   TP1/trail and the aggressive scan thresholds on historical M5/M15 data.
232: 
233: ## Security
234: 
235: - `.env` holds a live signing key: it is gitignored, never bundled and only read
236:   locally. Do not paste it into chats, issues or screenshots.
237: - The wrapper and CLI print only a key prefix (`exnsk-4b7c8c44…`).
238: - Rotate the key in Exness Key Management if it was ever exposed, then update
239:   `.env`. Use a demo account while iterating.
240: 
241: ## Troubleshooting
242: 
243: | Symptom | Meaning |
244: | --- | --- |
245: | `401/1001` | Signature mismatch — key format, payload bytes, body hash or base64url padding. |
246: | `401/1000` | API key missing/expired, or `EXN-DATA.api_key` ≠ `EXN-API-KEY`. |
247: | `403/1002` | API key has no access to this account/IP/scope. |
248: | `404/2000` | Account not found for this key. |
249: | `400/3005` | `REQUEST_INVALID_COUNT` — candles need `count` or `to`, not just `from`. |
250: | `400/3015` | Request rate limit. Wait; the client already paces REST and subscriptions. |
251: | `400/4000` | `MARKET_INSTRUMENT_NOT_FOUND` — a catalog symbol is not subscribable; dropped individually. |
252: | `400/4001` | `MARKET_TRADE_DISABLED` — instrument is visible but not tradable; the agent logs and skips it. |
253: | `400/5005` | Stop/take-profit is on the wrong side or too tight for the broker. |
254: | Repeated `503` | Service unavailable; retry later. |

147:   async start(): Promise<void> {

156:     this.record(

159:         `risk ${this.deps.config.riskPct}% of ${this.deps.config.virtualEquity} USD · ` +

162:     );
163:     this.deps.events.start();

165:     for (let i = 0; i < 50 && this.deps.events.state !== "open"; i += 1) await sleep(100);
166:     // The WS subscribes one instrument per message (~20/s). Scanning after the
167:     // very first tick would only see a handful of pairs and waste the cycle.
168:     const warmTarget = Math.min(this.deps.universe.length, 100);
169:     for (let i = 0; i < 60 && this.deps.ticks.quotesCount < warmTarget; i += 1) {
170:       await sleep(250);
171:     }
172:     this.record(
173:       "screener",
174:       `feed warm ${this.deps.ticks.quotesCount}/${this.deps.universe.length} quotes · starting scan`,

191:   private scheduleScan(): void {

195:       ? M15_MS - (now % M15_MS) + M15_SCAN_GRACE_MS
196:       : Math.max(1_000, this.deps.config.scanIntervalMs);
197:     this.nextScanAt = now + delay;
198:     const timer = setTimeout(() => {
199:       void this.scanAndEnter().finally(() => this.scheduleScan());
200:     }, delay);

224:   private async manageTick(): Promise<void> {
225:     if (this.managing || this.stopped) return;
226:     this.managing = true;
227:     try {
228:       this.watchdog();
229:       const view = await this.deps.snapshot.get();
230:       this.deps.equity.record(view);
231:       await this.deps.executor.manage(view);
232:       if (Date.now() - this.lastStateAt >= this.deps.config.stateIntervalMs) {
233:         this.writeState(true, view);
234:       }
235:     } catch (error) {
236:       this.record("trader", `manage error: ${error instanceof Error ? error.message : String(error)}`, "error");
237:     } finally {

242:   /**
243:    * Watchdog: the WS layer reconnects with backoff, but a wedged connection
244:    * needs a nudge. Alarm once, then force a fresh socket after 45 seconds.
245:    */
246:   private watchdog(): void {
247:     const now = Date.now();
248:     const state = this.deps.ticks.state;
249:     if (state === "open") {
250:       this.feedDownSince = 0;
251:       const lastTick = this.deps.ticks.lastTickAt;
252:       if (lastTick > 0 && now - lastTick > 60_000 && now - this.lastFeedWarnAt > 60_000) {
253:         this.lastFeedWarnAt = now;
254:         this.record(
255:           "trader",
256:           `watchdog: no ticks for ${Math.round((now - lastTick) / 1000)}s · ${this.deps.ticks.quotesCount} quotes cached`,
257:           "warn",
258:         );
259:       }
260:       return;
261:     }
262: 
263:     if (this.feedDownSince === 0) this.feedDownSince = now;
264:     const downMs = now - this.feedDownSince;
265:     if (downMs > 5_000 && now - this.lastFeedWarnAt > 30_000) {
266:       this.lastFeedWarnAt = now;
267:       this.record("trader", `watchdog: tick feed ${state} for ${Math.round(downMs / 1000)}s`, "warn");
268:     }
269:     if (downMs > 45_000 && now - this.lastFeedRestartAt > 60_000) {
270:       this.lastFeedRestartAt = now;
271:       this.feedDownSince = now;
272:       this.record("trader", "watchdog: restarting tick websocket", "error");
273:       this.deps.ticks.restart();
274:     }
275:   }

277:   async scanAndEnter(): Promise<void> {
278:     if (this.scanning || this.stopped) return;
279:     this.scanning = true;
280:     const started = Date.now();
281:     try {
282:       this.record("screener", `scan started · ${this.deps.universe.length} pairs`);
283:       const candidates = await this.screener.scan(this.deps.universe);
284:       this.candidates = candidates;
285:       this.lastScanAt = started;
286:       this.lastScanDurationMs = this.screener.lastScanDurationMs;
287: 
288:       let view = await this.deps.snapshot.get();
289:       const gate = this.deps.executor.tradingAllowed(view);
290:       this.note = gate.ok ? "" : gate.reason ?? "";
291: 
292:       const diagnostics = this.screener.lastDiagnostics;
293:       this.record(
294:         "screener",
295:         `fresh ${diagnostics.fresh}/${diagnostics.withQuote} · prefilter ${diagnostics.prefiltered} · ` +
296:           `shortlist ${diagnostics.shortlist} · candle fail ${diagnostics.candleFails} · pass ${diagnostics.passed}`,
297:       );
298:       if (diagnostics.top.length > 0) {
299:         this.record(
300:           "screener",
301:           `top ${diagnostics.top
302:             .slice(0, 4)
303:             .map((entry) => `${entry.symbol} ${entry.prelim}`)
304:             .join(" · ")}`,
305:         );
306:       }
307:       this.record(
308:         "screener",
309:         `scan ${((Date.now() - started) / 1000).toFixed(1)}s · ${candidates.length} kandidat` +
310:           (candidates[0]
311:             ? ` · ${candidates[0].symbol} ${candidates[0].direction} ${candidates[0].score.toFixed(0)}`
312:             : "") +
313:           (gate.ok ? "" : ` · ${gate.reason}`),
314:         gate.ok ? "success" : "warn",
315:       );
316: 
317:       if (!gate.ok) {
318:         this.writeState(true, view);
319:         return;
320:       }
321: 
322:       // Every pair the screener passes is a candidate. Entry only needs the
323:       // last closed M15 confirmation candle; there is no M5 step and no TP.
324:       const tried: string[] = [];
325:       const entered: string[] = [];
326:       for (const candidate of candidates) {
327:         if (
328:           this.deps.config.maxPositions > 0 &&
329:           this.deps.executor.count >= this.deps.config.maxPositions
330:         ) {
331:           break;
332:         }
333:         const quote = this.deps.ticks.get(candidate.symbol);
334:         if (!quote) {
335:           tried.push(`${candidate.symbol}: no live quote`);
336:           continue;
337:         }
338: 
339:         const decision = decideEntry({
340:           candidate,
341:           quote,
342:           config: entryConfigFrom(this.deps.config),
343:         });
344:         if (!decision.signal) {
345:           tried.push(`${candidate.symbol}: ${decision.rejects[0] ?? "no signal"}`);
346:           continue;
347:         }
348: 
349:         this.lastSignal = decision.signal;
350:         this.record(
351:           "entry",
352:           `sinyal ${decision.signal.side.toUpperCase()} ${candidate.symbol} ` +
353:             `entry ${decision.signal.entry} emergency SL ${decision.signal.emergencySl} ` +
354:             `trail ${decision.signal.trailDistance.toFixed(5)} ` +
355:             `(${decision.signal.slPips.toFixed(1)}p)`,
356:           "success",
357:         );
358: 
359:         if (!this.deps.live) {
360:           entered.push(`${candidate.symbol} (dry)`);
361:           continue;
362:         }
363: 
364:         // Refresh the snapshot so margin and per-symbol limits see the
365:         // positions opened earlier in this same scan.
366:         view = await this.deps.snapshot.get();
367:         const opened = await this.deps.executor.open(decision.signal, view);
368:         if (opened.ok && opened.managed) {
369:           this.lastSignal = { ...decision.signal, lot: opened.managed.volume };
370:           entered.push(`${opened.managed.symbol} ${opened.managed.volume} lot`);
371:           this.record(
372:             "entry",
373:             `open ${opened.managed.symbol} ${opened.managed.volume} lot ` +
374:               `@ ${opened.managed.entry} emergency SL ${opened.managed.emergencySl} ` +
375:               `virtual ${opened.managed.trailStop}`,
376:             "success",
377:           );
378:           continue;
379:         }
380:         this.record(
381:           "entry",
382:           `open ditolak ${candidate.symbol}: ${opened.reason ?? "?"}`,
383:           "warn",
384:         );
385:         tried.push(`${candidate.symbol}: ${opened.reason ?? "rejected"}`);
386:       }
387: 
388:       if (entered.length > 0) {
389:         this.note = this.deps.live
390:           ? `opened ${entered.length}: ${entered.join(" · ")}`
391:           : `dry-run signals: ${entered.join(" · ")}`;
392:       } else if (tried.length > 0) {
393:         this.note = tried[0] ?? "";
394:         this.record("entry", `entry ${tried.join(" · ")}`, "warn");
395:       }
396:       this.writeState(true, view);
397:     } catch (error) {
398:       this.record(
399:         "screener",
400:         `scan error: ${error instanceof Error ? error.message : String(error)}`,
401:         "error",
402:       );
403:     } finally {
404:       this.scanning = false;
405:     }
406:   }
407: 
408:   state(view?: AccountView): AgentStateFile {
409:     const stats = this.deps.executor.stats;
410:     const decided = stats.wins + stats.losses;
411:     const lastSignal = this.lastSignal;
412:     const trailing = this.deps.executor.statePayload().trailing;
413:     // stop() writes the final state without a fresh snapshot. Reuse the last
414:     // one so the dashboard does not show daily P/L resetting to zero.
415:     const lastView = view ?? this.lastView;
416: 
417:     return {
418:       running: this.running,
419:       mode: this.deps.live ? "live" : "dry-run",
420:       updatedAt: Date.now(),
421:       startedAt: this.startedAt,
422:       universe: this.deps.universe.length,
423:       nextScanAt: this.nextScanAt,
424:       screener: {
425:         at: this.lastScanAt,
426:         durationMs: this.lastScanDurationMs,
427:         pass: this.candidates.length,
428:         candidates: this.candidates.map((candidate) => ({
429:           symbol: candidate.symbol,
430:           direction: candidate.direction,
431:           score: Number(candidate.score.toFixed(1)),
432:           spreadPct: Number(candidate.spreadPct.toFixed(4)),
433:           spreadPips: Number(candidate.spreadPips.toFixed(2)),
434:           rsi: Number(candidate.rsi.toFixed(1)),
435:           atrPct: Number(candidate.atrPct.toFixed(3)),
436:           reasons: candidate.reasons,
437:         })),
438:         diagnostics: this.screener.lastDiagnostics,
439:       },
440:       lastSignal: lastSignal
441:         ? {
442:             at: lastSignal.createdAt,
443:             symbol: lastSignal.symbol,
444:             side: lastSignal.side,
445:             lot: lastSignal.lot ?? 0,
446:             entry: lastSignal.entry,
447:             sl: lastSignal.emergencySl,
448:             trail: lastSignal.trailDistance,
449:             score: lastSignal.score,
450:             reasons: lastSignal.reasons,
451:           }
452:         : null,
453:       trailing: trailing.slice(-8),
454:       openPositions: [...this.deps.executor.managed.values()].map((position) => ({
455:         positionId: position.positionId,
456:         symbol: position.symbol,
457:         side: position.side,
458:         volume: position.volume,
459:         entry: position.entry,
460:         sl: position.emergencySl,
461:         trail: position.trailStop,
462:         best: position.best,
463:         trailDistance: position.trailDistance,
464:         atr: position.atr,
465:         score: position.score,
466:       })),
467:       stats: {
468:         ...stats,
469:         winRate: decided > 0 ? (stats.wins / decided) * 100 : 0,
470:       },
471:       dailyPnl: lastView ? lastView.equity - this.deps.equity.startBalance : 0,
472:       note: this.note,
473:       activity: this.journal.recent(80),
474:       tradeLog: this.deps.executor.statePayload().tradeLog,
475:       executor: this.deps.executor.statePayload(),
476:     };
477:   }
478: 
479:   writeState(force = false, view?: AccountView): void {
480:     const now = Date.now();
481:     if (!force && now - this.lastStateAt < this.deps.config.stateIntervalMs) return;
482:     if (view) this.lastView = view;
483:     this.lastStateAt = now;
484:     try {
485:       fs.mkdirSync(path.dirname(this.stateFile), { recursive: true });
486:       fs.writeFileSync(this.stateFile, `${JSON.stringify(this.state(view), null, 2)}\n`);
487:     } catch {
488:       // monitoring is best effort
489:     }
490:   }
491: 
492:   /** Read-only single scan for `agent --once`. */
493:   async scanOnce(): Promise<{
494:     candidates: Candidate[];
495:     decisions: Array<{ symbol: string; signal: EntrySignal | null; rejects: string[] }>;
496:     diagnostics: ScanDiagnostics;
497:   }> {
498:     this.deps.events.start();
499:     this.deps.ticks.start(this.deps.universe);
500:     // Give the websocket time to deliver the first quote for a wide universe.
501:     await sleep(5000);
502:     this.deps.log(
503:       `ticks ${this.deps.ticks.state} · ${this.deps.ticks.quotesCount} quotes · ` +
504:         `${this.deps.ticks.subscribed.length} subscribed` +
505:         (this.deps.ticks.lastAckError ? ` · ack ${this.deps.ticks.lastAckError}` : ""),
506:     );
507:     const candidates = await this.screener.scan(this.deps.universe);
508:     const decisions: Array<{ symbol: string; signal: EntrySignal | null; rejects: string[] }> = [];
509:     // Check every screened pair, not just the first few: the screener is the
510:     // gate, so a single scan can preview every entry it would take.
511:     for (const candidate of candidates) {
512:       const quote = this.deps.ticks.get(candidate.symbol);
513:       if (!quote) continue;
514:       const decision = decideEntry({
515:         candidate,
516:         quote,
517:         config: entryConfigFrom(this.deps.config),
518:       });
519:       decisions.push({
520:         symbol: candidate.symbol,
521:         signal: decision.signal,
522:         rejects: decision.rejects,
523:       });
524:     }
525:     return { candidates, decisions, diagnostics: this.screener.lastDiagnostics };
526:   }
527: }

134: /**
135:  * Fixed-fractional sizing on the virtual risk equity. Always floors to the
136:  * volume step so a trade can never risk more than the configured percentage.
137:  */
138: export function computeLots(input: SizingInput): SizingResult {
139:   if (!(input.slPips > 0) || !(input.pipValuePerLot > 0) || !(input.volumeStep > 0)) {
140:     return { lots: 0, riskUsd: 0, reason: "invalid sizing inputs" };
141:   }
142:   const riskUsd = (input.equity * input.riskPct) / 100;
143:   const rawLots = riskUsd / (input.slPips * input.pipValuePerLot);
144:   let lots = roundVolumeDown(Math.min(rawLots, input.maxLots), input.volumeStep);
145:   if (lots > input.volumeMax) lots = roundVolumeDown(input.volumeMax, input.volumeStep);
146:   if (lots < input.volumeMin) {
147:     return {
148:       lots: 0,
149:       riskUsd,
150:       reason: `risk ${riskUsd.toFixed(2)} = ${rawLots.toFixed(3)} lot < volume_min ${input.volumeMin}`,
151:     };
152:   }
153:   return { lots, riskUsd: lots * input.slPips * input.pipValuePerLot };
154: }
