156: /** Rate used to convert the instrument's quote currency into USD. */
157: export function quoteToUsdRate(
158:   quoteCurrency: string,
159:   quotes: Map<string, Quote>,
160: ): number | undefined {
161:   if (quoteCurrency === "USD") return 1;
162:   const direct = quotes.get(`${quoteCurrency}USD`);
163:   if (direct && direct.bid > 0) return direct.bid;
164:   const inverse = quotes.get(`USD${quoteCurrency}`);
165:   if (inverse && inverse.ask > 0) return 1 / inverse.ask;
166: 
167:   // Triangulate through a liquid USD pair. Example: CAD -> USD can be derived
168:   // from CADJPY / USDJPY even when the synthetic CADUSD symbol does not exist
169:   // or has not ticked yet. Sell the quote currency and buy USD, hence bid/ask.
170:   for (const pivot of ["JPY", "CHF", "EUR", "GBP", "AUD", "NZD", "CAD"]) {
171:     if (pivot === quoteCurrency) continue;
172:     const quotePivot = quotes.get(`${quoteCurrency}${pivot}`);
173:     const usdPivot = quotes.get(`USD${pivot}`);
174:     if (quotePivot && usdPivot && quotePivot.bid > 0 && usdPivot.ask > 0) {
175:       const rate = quotePivot.bid / usdPivot.ask;
176:       if (Number.isFinite(rate) && rate > 0) return rate;
177:     }
178:     const pivotQuote = quotes.get(`${pivot}${quoteCurrency}`);
179:     const pivotUsd = quotes.get(`${pivot}USD`);
180:     if (pivotQuote && pivotUsd && pivotQuote.ask > 0 && pivotUsd.bid > 0) {
181:       const rate = pivotUsd.bid / pivotQuote.ask;
182:       if (Number.isFinite(rate) && rate > 0) return rate;
183:     }
184:   }
185:   return undefined;
186: }
187: 
188: /** USD value of one base-currency unit, used for a conservative margin check. */
189: export function baseToUsdRate(
190:   baseCurrency: string,
191:   price: number,
192:   quoteCurrency: string,
193:   quotes: Map<string, Quote>,
194: ): number | undefined {
195:   if (baseCurrency === "USD") return 1;
196:   const direct = quotes.get(`${baseCurrency}USD`);
197:   if (direct && direct.bid > 0) return direct.bid;
198:   const inverse = quotes.get(`USD${baseCurrency}`);
199:   if (inverse && inverse.ask > 0) return 1 / inverse.ask;
200:   const quoteRate = quoteToUsdRate(quoteCurrency, quotes);
201:   if (quoteRate !== undefined && price > 0) return price * quoteRate;
202:   return undefined;
203: }

555:   private adoptOrphans(view: AccountView): void {

583:       const pip = pipSize(symbol, digits);

585:       // new 2×ATR trail is in the right ballpark. Broker SL, if already moved,

55: interface MomentumSample {
56:   t: number;
57:   mid: number;
58: }

60: const MOMENTUM_WINDOW_MS = 15 * 60_000;
61: const SAMPLE_INTERVAL_MS = 1_000;
62: 
63: /**
64:  * Tick-only momentum memory. It is used only to rank the prefilter shortlist
65:  * (which pairs are active enough to be worth two candle requests); it is not a
66:  * hard screener criterion.
67:  */
68: export class MomentumTracker {
69:   private readonly samples = new Map<string, MomentumSample[]>();
70: 
71:   observe(quote: Quote): void {
72:     const series = this.samples.get(quote.symbol) ?? [];
73:     const last = series[series.length - 1];
74:     if (last && quote.timestamp - last.t < SAMPLE_INTERVAL_MS) {
75:       last.mid = quote.mid;
76:       last.t = quote.timestamp;
77:       return;
78:     }
79:     series.push({ t: quote.timestamp, mid: quote.mid });
80:     const cutoff = quote.timestamp - MOMENTUM_WINDOW_MS;
81:     while (series.length > 1 && series[0]!.t < cutoff) series.shift();
82:     this.samples.set(quote.symbol, series);
83:   }
84: 
85:   changePct(symbol: string, minutes: number): number | null {
86:     const series = this.samples.get(symbol);
87:     if (!series || series.length < 2) return null;
88:     const latest = series[series.length - 1]!;
89:     const target = latest.t - minutes * 60_000;
90:     if (latest.t - series[0]!.t < minutes * 60_000 * 0.75) return null;
91: 
92:     let reference: MomentumSample | undefined;
93:     for (const sample of series) {
94:       if (sample.t <= target) reference = sample;
95:       else break;
96:     }
97:     reference ??= series[0]!;
98:     if (reference.mid === 0) return null;
99:     return ((latest.mid - reference.mid) / reference.mid) * 100;
100:   }
101: 
102:   size(): number {
103:     return this.samples.size;
104:   }
105: }

107: export interface CandleScoreInput {
108:   symbol: string;
109:   /** closed M15 candles */
110:   m15: NormalizedCandle[];
111:   /** closed H1 candles */
112:   h1: NormalizedCandle[];
113:   quote: Quote;
114:   options: ScreenerOptions;
115: }
116: 
117: /**
118:  * Pure candle scoring for the final plan:
119:  *
120:  *   1. H1 EMA50 above/below EMA200  → trend direction
121:  *   2. M15 RSI 40–60 and price near M15 EMA50 → pullback
122:  *   3. spread below the limit → tradeable
123:  *
124:  * No take-profit, no M5, no momentum hard gate.
125:  */
126: export function scoreCandidate(input: CandleScoreInput): Candidate | null {
127:   const { symbol, m15, h1, quote, options } = input;
128:   if (m15.length < 60 || h1.length < 210) return null;
129: 
130:   const h1Closes = closes(h1);
131:   const h1Ema50 = lastFinite(ema(h1Closes, 50));
132:   const h1Ema200 = lastFinite(ema(h1Closes, 200));
133:   const h1Atr = lastFinite(atr(h1, 14));
134:   if (h1Ema50 === undefined || h1Ema200 === undefined || h1Atr === undefined || h1Atr <= 0) {
135:     return null;
136:   }
137: 
138:   const h1Trend = (h1Ema50 - h1Ema200) / h1Atr;
139:   if (Math.abs(h1Trend) < options.minTrendAtr) return null;
140:   const direction: Direction = h1Trend > 0 ? "buy" : "sell";
141:   const sign = direction === "buy" ? 1 : -1;
142:   const trendAtr = h1Trend * sign;
143: 
144:   const closeSeries = closes(m15);
145:   const m15Ema50 = lastFinite(ema(closeSeries, 50));
146:   const m15Atr = lastFinite(atr(m15, 14));
147:   const m15Rsi = lastFinite(rsi(closeSeries, 14));
148:   const close = closeSeries[closeSeries.length - 1];
149:   if (
150:     m15Ema50 === undefined ||
151:     m15Atr === undefined ||
152:     m15Atr <= 0 ||
153:     m15Rsi === undefined ||
154:     close === undefined
155:   ) {
156:     return null;
157:   }
158: 
159:   // Pullback zone: RSI in the middle of its range, price near EMA50.
160:   if (m15Rsi < options.rsiMin || m15Rsi > options.rsiMax) return null;
161:   const distanceAtr = (close - m15Ema50) / m15Atr;
162:   if (Math.abs(distanceAtr) > options.pullbackDistanceAtr) return null;
163: 
164:   const atrPct = atrPercent(m15, m15Atr);
165:   if (atrPct < options.minAtrPct || atrPct > options.maxAtrPct) return null;
166:   if (!spreadWithinLimit(symbol, quote, options)) return null;
167: 
168:   const trendScore = clamp(trendAtr / 1.2, 0, 1) * 40;
169:   const pullbackScore =
170:     clamp(1 - Math.abs(distanceAtr) / Math.max(options.pullbackDistanceAtr, 1e-9), 0, 1) * 25;
171:   const rsiScore = clamp(1 - Math.abs(m15Rsi - 50) / 10, 0, 1) * 20;
172:   const spreadScore = spreadQuality(symbol, quote, options) * 15;
173:   const score = trendScore + pullbackScore + rsiScore + spreadScore;
174:   if (score < options.minScore) return null;
175: 
176:   const reasons = [
177:     `H1 ${direction === "buy" ? "uptrend" : "downtrend"} ${trendAtr.toFixed(2)}×ATR`,
178:     `pullback ${distanceAtr.toFixed(2)}×ATR`,
179:     `RSI ${m15Rsi.toFixed(0)}`,
180:     `spread ${spreadLabel(symbol, quote)}`,
181:     `ATR ${atrPct.toFixed(3)}%`,
182:   ];
183: 
184:   return {
185:     symbol,
186:     direction,
187:     score,
188:     price: close,
189:     spreadPct: quote.spreadPct,
190:     spreadPips: spreadPips(symbol, quote),
191:     atr: m15Atr,
192:     atrPct,
193:     ema50: m15Ema50,
194:     h1Ema50,
195:     h1Ema200,
196:     rsi: m15Rsi,
197:     trendAtr,
198:     distanceAtr,
199:     reasons,
200:     candles: m15,
201:   };
202: }

217: export class Screener {
218:   readonly momentum = new MomentumTracker();
219:   lastScanAt = 0;
220:   lastScanDurationMs = 0;
221:   lastDiagnostics: ScanDiagnostics = {
222:     universe: 0,
223:     withQuote: 0,
224:     fresh: 0,
225:     prefiltered: 0,
226:     shortlist: 0,
227:     candleFails: 0,
228:     scored: 0,
229:     passed: 0,
230:     top: [],
231:   };
232: 
233:   constructor(
234:     private readonly tools: Tools,
235:     private readonly ticks: TickHub,
236:     private readonly options: ScreenerOptions,
237:   ) {}
238: 
239:   observe(quote: Quote): void {
240:     this.momentum.observe(quote);
241:   }
242: 
243:   async scan(universe: string[]): Promise<Candidate[]> {
244:     const started = Date.now();
245:     this.lastScanAt = started;
246: 
247:     const now = Date.now();
248:     type Pre = { quote: Quote; mom5: number | null; prelim: number };
249:     const pre: Pre[] = [];
250:     let withQuote = 0;
251:     let fresh = 0;
252: 
253:     for (const symbol of universe) {
254:       const quote = this.ticks.get(symbol);
255:       if (!quote) continue;
256:       withQuote += 1;
257:       if (now - quote.timestamp > this.options.maxQuoteAgeMs) continue;
258:       fresh += 1;
259:       if (!spreadWithinLimit(symbol, quote, this.options)) continue;
260: 
261:       const mom5 = this.momentum.changePct(symbol, 5);
262:       const activity = clamp(quote.ticks / 20, 0, 1);
263:       const move = mom5 === null ? 0.35 : clamp(Math.abs(mom5) / 0.08, 0, 1);
264:       const prelim = spreadQuality(symbol, quote, this.options) * 60 + activity * 20 + move * 20;
265:       pre.push({ quote, mom5, prelim });
266:     }
267: 
268:     pre.sort((a, b) => b.prelim - a.prelim);
269:     const shortlist = pre.slice(0, this.options.shortlistSize);
270: 
271:     const candidates: Candidate[] = [];
272:     let candleFails = 0;
273:     let scored = 0;
274:     for (const entry of shortlist) {
275:       const symbol = entry.quote.symbol;
276:       const m15Result = await this.tools.get_candles({
277:         symbol,
278:         timeframe: this.options.m15Timeframe,
279:         n: 180,
280:       });
281:       const h1Result = await this.tools.get_candles({
282:         symbol,
283:         timeframe: this.options.h1Timeframe,
284:         n: 260,
285:       });
286:       if (!m15Result.ok || !h1Result.ok) {
287:         candleFails += 1;
288:         continue;
289:       }
290: 
291:       const m15 = dropFormingCandle(
292:         m15Result.data,
293:         timeframeMs(this.options.m15Timeframe),
294:         now,
295:       );
296:       const h1 = dropFormingCandle(h1Result.data, timeframeMs(this.options.h1Timeframe), now);
297:       if (m15.length < 60 || h1.length < 210) {
298:         candleFails += 1;
299:         continue;
300:       }
301: 
302:       scored += 1;
303:       const candidate = scoreCandidate({
304:         symbol,
305:         m15,
306:         h1,
307:         quote: entry.quote,
308:         options: this.options,
309:       });
310:       if (candidate) candidates.push(candidate);
311:     }
312: 
313:     candidates.sort((a, b) => b.score - a.score);
314:     this.lastScanDurationMs = Date.now() - started;
315:     const capped = candidates.slice(0, this.options.maxCandidates);
316:     this.lastDiagnostics = {
317:       universe: universe.length,
318:       withQuote,
319:       fresh,
320:       prefiltered: pre.length,
321:       shortlist: shortlist.length,
322:       candleFails,
323:       scored,
324:       passed: capped.length,
325:       top: shortlist.slice(0, 6).map((entry) => ({
326:         symbol: entry.quote.symbol,
327:         prelim: Number(entry.prelim.toFixed(1)),
328:         spreadPips: Number(spreadPips(entry.quote.symbol, entry.quote).toFixed(2)),
329:         mom5: entry.mom5 === null ? null : Number(entry.mom5.toFixed(3)),
330:       })),
331:     };
332:     return capped;
333:   }
334: }

45: /**
46:  * Trend-following pullback entry.
47:  *
48:  * The screener has already checked H1 EMA50/EMA200, M15 RSI, distance to M15
49:  * EMA50 and spread. Entry has one job: require the last closed M15 candle to
50:  * confirm the trend direction, then derive the emergency stop and virtual
51:  * trail from volatility. There is deliberately no take-profit.
52:  */
53: export function decideEntry(input: {
54:   candidate: Candidate;
55:   quote: Quote;
56:   config: EntryConfig;
57:   now?: number;
58: }): EntryDecision {
59:   const { candidate, quote, config } = input;
60:   const rejects: string[] = [];
61:   const now = input.now ?? Date.now();
62: 
63:   const symbol = candidate.symbol;
64:   const side = candidate.direction;
65:   const sign = side === "buy" ? 1 : -1;
66:   const digits = digitsFor(symbol);
67:   const pip = pipSize(symbol, digits);
68: 
69:   if (!spreadWithinLimit(symbol, quote, config)) {
70:     rejects.push(`spread too wide`);
71:   }
72:   if (now - quote.timestamp > config.maxQuoteAgeMs) {
73:     rejects.push(`quote ${now - quote.timestamp}ms old`);
74:   }
75: 
76:   const m15 = candidate.candles;
77:   const last = m15[m15.length - 1];
78:   if (!last) {
79:     return { signal: null, rejects: ["M15 candles not ready"] };
80:   }
81: 
82:   const atrValue = candidate.atr;
83:   if (!Number.isFinite(atrValue) || atrValue <= 0) {
84:     return { signal: null, rejects: ["ATR not ready"] };
85:   }
86: 
87:   // The confirmation candle must have CLOSED in the trend direction.
88:   const confirmed = side === "buy" ? last.close > last.open : last.close < last.open;
89:   if (!confirmed) {
90:     rejects.push(
91:       `M15 close not ${side === "buy" ? "bullish" : "bearish"} (${last.open}→${last.close})`,
92:     );
93:   }
94: 
95:   if (candidate.rsi < config.rsiMin || candidate.rsi > config.rsiMax) {
96:     rejects.push(`RSI ${candidate.rsi.toFixed(0)} outside ${config.rsiMin}-${config.rsiMax}`);
97:   }
98:   if (Math.abs(candidate.distanceAtr) > config.pullbackDistanceAtr) {
99:     rejects.push(`price ${candidate.distanceAtr.toFixed(2)}×ATR from EMA50`);
100:   }
101: 
102:   const chaseAtr = Math.abs(quote.mid - last.close) / atrValue;
103:   if (chaseAtr > config.maxChaseAtr) {
104:     rejects.push(`chasing ${chaseAtr.toFixed(2)}×ATR from M15 close`);
105:   }
106: 
107:   if (rejects.length > 0) return { signal: null, rejects };
108: 
109:   const entry = roundPrice(side === "buy" ? quote.ask : quote.bid, digits);
110: 
111:   // Emergency stop is intentionally far away: it is the "program died" layer.
112:   // The broker minimum and current spread are hard floors.
113:   const emergencyDistance = Math.max(
114:     config.emergencySlAtrFactor * atrValue,
115:     config.minStopPips * pip,
116:     quote.spread * 3,
117:   );
118:   const emergencySl = roundPrice(entry - sign * emergencyDistance, digits);
119:   const slPips = Math.abs(entry - emergencySl) / pip;
120: 
121:   // Virtual trail is tighter than the emergency stop. It is the normal exit.
122:   const trailDistance = Math.max(
123:     config.trailAtrFactor * atrValue,
124:     config.trailMinPips * pip,
125:   );
126: 
127:   const reasons = [
128:     ...candidate.reasons,
129:     `M15 ${side === "buy" ? "bullish" : "bearish"} close confirm`,
130:     `emergency SL ${slPips.toFixed(1)}p`,
131:     `trail ${(trailDistance / pip).toFixed(1)}p`,
132:   ];
133: 
134:   return {
135:     signal: {
136:       symbol,
137:       side,
138:       entry,
139:       emergencySl,
140:       digits,
141:       pip,
142:       slPips,
143:       atr: atrValue,
144:       trailDistance,
145:       score: candidate.score,
146:       reasons,
147:       createdAt: now,
148:       expiresAt: now + 60_000,
149:     },
150:     rejects: [],
151:   };

import { categorize } from "../exness/catalog.js";
import { pipSize } from "../market/candles.js";
import type { Quote } from "../market/store.js";

export interface SpreadLimits {
  maxSpreadPips: number;
  maxSpreadPct: number;
}

/** Spread converted to pips. Only meaningful for FX; used for FX limits. */
export function spreadPips(symbol: string, quote: Quote): number {
  const pip = pipSize(symbol);
  if (!(pip > 0) || !Number.isFinite(quote.spread)) return Number.POSITIVE_INFINITY;
  return quote.spread / pip;
}

/**
 * FX uses an absolute pip limit (the plan's "below 2 pips"). Metals, indices,
 * crypto and stocks use a percentage limit, because "2 pips" means wildly
 * different things across those instruments.
 */
export function spreadWithinLimit(symbol: string, quote: Quote, limits: SpreadLimits): boolean {
  if (categorize(symbol) === "fx") {
    const pips = spreadPips(symbol, quote);
    return Number.isFinite(pips) && pips > 0 && pips <= limits.maxSpreadPips;
  }
  return (
    Number.isFinite(quote.spreadPct) &&
    quote.spreadPct > 0 &&
    quote.spreadPct <= limits.maxSpreadPct
  );
}

export function spreadLabel(symbol: string, quote: Quote): string {
  if (categorize(symbol) === "fx") {
    const pips = spreadPips(symbol, quote);
    return `${pips.toFixed(1)}p`;
  }
  return `${(quote.spreadPct * 100).toFixed(1)}bp`;
}

/** 1 = tight, 0 = at the limit. Used only to rank the prefilter shortlist. */
export function spreadQuality(symbol: string, quote: Quote, limits: SpreadLimits): number {
  if (categorize(symbol) === "fx") {
    const pips = spreadPips(symbol, quote);
    if (!Number.isFinite(pips) || limits.maxSpreadPips <= 0) return 0;
    return Math.max(0, Math.min(1, 1 - pips / limits.maxSpreadPips));
  }
  if (!Number.isFinite(quote.spreadPct) || limits.maxSpreadPct <= 0) return 0;
  return Math.max(0, Math.min(1, 1 - quote.spreadPct / limits.maxSpreadPct));
}

61:     // Fresh headers for every handshake; the signature is bound to the path.

78:     } catch (error) {
79:       this.handleError(error as Error);
80:       this.scheduleReconnect();
81:       return;
82:     }
83: 
84:     socket.on("open", () => {
85:       this.attempt = 0;
86:       this.startHeartbeat();
87:       this.options.onState?.("open");
88:       this.options.onOpen?.();
89:     });
90: 
91:     socket.on("message", (data, isBinary) => {

95:         this.options.onMessage(JSON.parse(raw), raw);

101:     socket.on("pong", () => {

103:     });
104: 
105:     socket.on("error", (error) => {
106:       this.handleError(error);
107:     });
108: 
109:     socket.on("close", (code, reason) => {
110:       this.stopHeartbeat();
111:       if (this.closedByClient) {

113:         return;
114:       }
115:       const detail = `${code}${reason.length ? ` ${reason.toString()}` : ""}`;

143:     const backoff = Math.min(1000 * 2 ** this.attempt, MAX_BACKOFF_MS);
144:     const delay = backoff + Math.floor(Math.random() * 300);
145:     this.attempt += 1;

150:   private startHeartbeat(): void {

164:   private stopHeartbeat(): void {

167:   }

169:   private handleError(error: Error): void {

123: 
124: ## Agents
125: 
126: | Agent | Responsibility |
127: | --- | --- |
128: | **Screener** | Runs at each M15 close. Prefilters all account instruments by fresh quote + spread, fetches M15 and H1 candles for the best 24, then requires: H1 EMA50 above/below EMA200 (trend), M15 RSI 40–60, price within 0.75×ATR of M15 EMA50, ATR in range, and FX spread ≤ 2 pips (non-FX spread ≤ 0.06%). |
129: | **Entry** | Requires the last **closed** M15 candle to be bullish for a buy / bearish for a sell. Rejects stale quotes, wide spreads, chasing > 1×ATR, and a non-confirming candle. Computes the emergency stop from 3×ATR and the virtual trail from 2×ATR (minimum 8 pips). No TP. |
130: | **Risk / trader** | Sizes 1% of virtual equity from the entry-to-emergency-stop distance, opens a market order with the emergency SL, then manages a **program-side virtual trailing stop**. It closes at the virtual stop, refreshes trail distance every M15 close, adopts agent-owned orphans, reconciles on restart, retries a missing emergency SLTP, and persists state. |
131: 
132: Important behaviour:
133: 
134: - **Universe = all instruments** the account can trade (335 here: FX, metals,
135:   indices, crypto, stocks, other). No symbol is hard-coded; the screener decides.
136: - **One position at a time** by default (`AGENT_MAX_POSITIONS=1`) and one per
137:   symbol. This deliberately replaces the earlier “unlimited entries” tuning.
138: - **Two protection layers.** The broker-side emergency SL is 3×ATR and is only a
139:   crash fallback. The normal exit is the virtual stop in code; it never moves
140:   backward and is checked on every manage tick.
141: - **No take-profit, no TP1, no partial close, no breakeven, no hard-stop TP.**
142:   Winners are managed only by the virtual trail.
143: - **One instrument per WebSocket subscription message**, token-bucketed at about
144:   20/s. Bad symbols are dropped individually with `4000`, not in batches.
145: - **Async execution** — the gateway subscribes to `/ws/events` before sending an
146:   order and correlates ACK / `transaction_event` by `client_request_id`, with
147:   operation polling as a fallback.
148: - **Watchdog** — the agent logs feed stalls; a closed/wedged tick socket is
149:   restarted after 45 seconds and resubscribed.
150: - **Kill switch** — `.cache/KILL` blocks entries and makes the agent close all
151:   account positions; `ot kill` performs both immediately.
152: 
153: ### Risk defaults
154: 
155: | Setting | Value |
156: | --- | --- |
157: | Virtual equity for sizing | 10,000 USD (`EXNESS_VIRTUAL_EQUITY`) |
158: | Risk per trade | 1.0% (`AGENT_RISK_PCT`) |
159: | Max lots per trade | 0.5 (`AGENT_MAX_LOTS`) |
160: | Max positions | 1 (`AGENT_MAX_POSITIONS`) |
161: | Max per symbol | 1 (`AGENT_MAX_PER_SYMBOL`) |
162: | Daily loss cap | 2% ≈ 200 USD (`AGENT_MAX_DAILY_LOSS_PCT`) |
163: | Consecutive-loss cooldown | 3 losses → 4 hours |
164: | FX spread limit | 2.0 pips (`AGENT_MAX_SPREAD_PIPS`) |
165: | Non-FX spread limit | 0.06% (`AGENT_MAX_SPREAD_PCT`) |

168: | RSI band | 40–60 (`AGENT_RSI_MIN`, `AGENT_RSI_MAX`) |
169: | Pullback to EMA50 | ≤ 0.75×ATR (`AGENT_PULLBACK_ATR`) |
170: | H1 trend separation | ≥ 0.05×H1 ATR (`AGENT_MIN_TREND_ATR`) |
171: | Max quote age | 30 s (`AGENT_MAX_QUOTE_AGE_MS`) |
172: | Margin buffer | ×3 |

12: function makeQuote(price: number, spread = 0.00008): Quote {

14:   const ask = price + spread / 2;
15:   return {
16:     symbol: "EURUSD",
17:     bid,
18:     ask,
19:     mid: (bid + ask) / 2,
20:     spread: ask - bid,
21:     spreadPct: ((ask - bid) / ((bid + ask) / 2)) * 100,
22:     timestamp: Date.now(),
23:     ticks: 30,
24:     firstMid: price,

26:   };

30:   return {
31:     time: new Date(Date.UTC(2026, 9, 29, 0, index * 15)).toISOString(),
32:     open,
33:     high: Math.max(open, close) + 0.00015,

41: function pullbackSeries(): NormalizedCandle[] {
42:   const out: NormalizedCandle[] = [];
43:   let previous = 1.08;
44:   for (let index = 0; index < 150; index += 1) {
45:     let close = 1.08 + index * 0.00003;
46:     if (index >= 124) close = 1.08 + 123 * 0.00003 - (index - 123) * 0.000015;
47:     if (index === 149) {
48:       close = 1.08 + 123 * 0.00003 - 25 * 0.000015 + 0.00012;
49:     }
50:     out.push(candle(index, previous, close));
51:     previous = close;
52:   }
53:   return out;
54: }
55: 
56: function steadySeries(count: number): NormalizedCandle[] {
57:   const out: NormalizedCandle[] = [];
58:   let previous = 1.08;

61:     out.push(candle(index, previous, close));

65: }

9: import { AgentJournal } from "../../agents/journal.js";
10: import { RiskExecutor } from "../../agents/risk-and-executor.js";
11: import { boolFlag, numberFlag, stringFlag, type ParsedArgs } from "../args.js";
12: import { createContext, printJson, type CommandContext } from "../context.js";
13: import { heading, keyValue, style } from "../render.js";
14: 
15: function universeFor(ctx: CommandContext, parsed: ParsedArgs): Promise<string[]> {
16:   const custom = stringFlag(parsed, "symbols", "");
17:   if (custom.trim()) {
18:     return Promise.resolve(
19:       custom
20:         .split(/[,\s]+/)
21:         .map((symbol) => symbol.trim().toUpperCase())
22:         .filter(Boolean),
23:     );
24:   }
25:   // Global universe: every instrument the account can trade. The screener is
26:   // responsible for choosing which pairs deserve an entry; nothing is pinned
27:   // to a hard-coded symbol list. Order matters: FX/metals are subscribed first
28:   // so the most liquid markets are live while the rest stream in.
29:   return ctx.catalog.catalog().then((catalog) => [
30:     ...catalog.byCategory.fx,
31:     ...catalog.byCategory.metals,
32:     ...catalog.byCategory.index,
33:     ...catalog.byCategory.crypto,
34:     ...catalog.byCategory.stock,
35:     ...catalog.byCategory.other,
36:   ]);
37: }
38: 
39: export async function runAgent(parsed: ParsedArgs): Promise<number> {
40:   const ctx = createContext(parsed);
41:   const live = boolFlag(parsed, "live");
42:   const once = boolFlag(parsed, "once");
43:   const runSeconds = Math.max(0, numberFlag(parsed, "for", 0));
44:   const scanSeconds = Math.max(10, numberFlag(parsed, "scan", 15 * 60));
45:   const config = loadAgentConfig(process.env, {
46:     scanIntervalMs: scanSeconds * 1000,
47:     // Without an explicit --scan override, anchor the next run to the M15 close.
48:     alignScanToM15: parsed.flags.scan === undefined,
49:   });
50: 
51:   const info = await ctx.client.resolveAccessPoint();
52:   const hubOptions = {
53:     accessPoint: info.accessPoint,
54:     identity: ctx.identity,
55:     accountId: ctx.config.accountId,
56:     cacheDir: ctx.config.cacheDir,
57:     verbose: ctx.verbose,
58:   };
59:   const snapshot = new SnapshotCache(ctx.client, ctx.config.accountId);
60:   const ticks = new TickHub(hubOptions);
61:   const events = new EventHub(hubOptions);
62:   const gateway = new ExecutionGateway(ctx.client, events, (line) => {
63:     if (ctx.verbose) console.error(style.dim(`[gw] ${line}`));
64:   });
65:   const tools = createTools({
66:     client: ctx.client,
67:     catalog: ctx.catalog,
68:     snapshot,
69:     ticks,
70:     accountId: ctx.config.accountId,
71:   });
72:   const tradeTools = new TradeTools({
73:     snapshot,
74:     catalog: ctx.catalog,
75:     gateway,
76:     accountId: ctx.config.accountId,
77:   });
78: 
79:   const initial = await snapshot.get(true);
80:   const equity = new EquityTracker(ctx.config.cacheDir, initial.currency);
81:   equity.loadToday();
82:   equity.record(initial, true);
83: 
84:   const timestamp = () => new Date().toISOString().slice(11, 19);
85:   const log = (line: string) => console.log(`  ${style.dim(timestamp())} ${line}`);
86:   const journal = new AgentJournal();
87: 
88:   const executor = new RiskExecutor({
89:     tools: tradeTools,
90:     marketTools: tools,
91:     ticks,
92:     equity,
93:     events,
94:     client: ctx.client,
95:     config,
96:     accountId: ctx.config.accountId,
97:     cacheDir: ctx.config.cacheDir,
98:     live,
99:     journal,
100:     log,
101:   });
102: 
103:   const universe = await universeFor(ctx, parsed);
104:   const engine = new AgentEngine({
105:     config,
106:     live,
107:     universe,
108:     cacheDir: ctx.config.cacheDir,
109:     tools,
110:     tradeTools,
111:     ticks,
112:     events,
113:     snapshot,
114:     equity,
115:     executor,
116:     journal,
117:     log,
118:   });
119: 
120:   if (once) {
121:     try {
122:       const { candidates, decisions, diagnostics } = await engine.scanOnce();
123:       if (ctx.json) {
124:         printJson({ candidates, decisions, diagnostics });
125:         return 0;
126:       }
127:       console.log(heading(`agent scan · ${universe.length} pairs`));
128:       console.log(
129:         style.dim(
130:           `  quote ${diagnostics.withQuote} · fresh ${diagnostics.fresh} · prefilter ${diagnostics.prefiltered} · ` +
131:             `shortlist ${diagnostics.shortlist} · candles gagal ${diagnostics.candleFails} · lolos ${diagnostics.passed}`,
132:         ),
133:       );
134:       if (diagnostics.top.length > 0) {
135:         console.log(
136:           style.dim(
137:             `  top prefilter ${diagnostics.top
138:               .map((entry) => `${entry.symbol} ${entry.prelim}`)
139:               .join(" · ")}`,
140:           ),
141:         );
142:       }
143:       if (candidates.length === 0) {
144:         console.log(style.dim("  tidak ada pair yang lolos screener"));
145:         return 0;
146:       }
147:       console.log(
148:         keyValue(
149:           candidates.map((candidate) => [
150:             `${candidate.symbol} ${candidate.direction}`,
151:             `${candidate.score.toFixed(1)} · spread ${candidate.spreadPips.toFixed(1)}p · RSI ${candidate.rsi.toFixed(0)} · ${candidate.reasons.join(" · ")}`,
152:           ]),
153:         ),
154:       );
155:       console.log();
156:       for (const decision of decisions) {
157:         console.log(
158:           decision.signal
159:             ? `  sinyal ${decision.symbol} ${decision.signal.side} entry ${decision.signal.entry} emergency SL ${decision.signal.emergencySl} trail ${decision.signal.trailDistance.toFixed(5)}`
160:             : style.dim(`  ${decision.symbol}: ${decision.rejects.join(" · ")}`),
161:         );
162:       }
163:       return 0;
164:     } finally {
165:       ticks.close();
166:       events.close();
167:       gateway.close();
168:     }
169:   }
170: 
171:   console.log(heading(`agent · ${live ? style.red("LIVE") : style.yellow("DRY-RUN")}`));
172:   console.log(
173:     keyValue([
174:       ["account", `${initial.name} ${style.dim(initial.accountId)} ${initial.isDemo ? style.yellow("DEMO") : style.green("LIVE")}`],
175:       ["pairs", `${universe.length} (semua instrumen)`],
176:       ["risk", `${config.riskPct}% of ${config.virtualEquity} USD virtual equity`],
177:       [
178:         "limits",
179:         `${config.maxPositions > 0 ? `max ${config.maxPositions}` : "unlimited"} positions · ` +
180:           `min score ${config.minScore} · shortlist ${config.shortlistSize} · daily -${config.maxDailyLossPct}% · ` +
181:           `${config.maxConsecutiveLosses} losses → cooldown`,
182:       ],
183:       ["trail", `virtual ${config.trailAtrFactor}×ATR (min ${config.trailMinPips}p) · emergency SL ${config.emergencySlAtrFactor}×ATR · no TP`],
184:       ["state", `${ctx.config.cacheDir}\\agent-state.json`],
185:     ]),
186:   );
187:   console.log(style.dim(`  ${live ? "orders will be sent to the broker" : "signals only, no orders (add --live to trade)"}`));
188:   console.log();
189: 
190:   const shutdown = () => {
191:     engine.stop();
192:   };
193:   process.once("SIGINT", shutdown);
194:   process.once("SIGTERM", shutdown);
195: 
196:   const stopTimer =
197:     runSeconds > 0 ? setTimeout(() => engine.stop(), runSeconds * 1000) : undefined;
198: 
199:   try {
200:     await engine.start();
201:     await engine.waitForStop();
202:   } finally {
203:     if (stopTimer) clearTimeout(stopTimer);
204:     process.removeListener("SIGINT", shutdown);
205:     process.removeListener("SIGTERM", shutdown);
206:     ticks.close();
207:     events.close();
208:     gateway.close();
209:   }
210: 
211:   console.log(style.dim("  agent stopped · state saved"));
212:   return 0;
213: }

1: export type PositionSide = "buy" | "sell";
2: 
3: /**
4:  * New best price for a position, never moving backwards.
5:  *
6:  * BUY tracks the highest bid; SELL tracks the lowest ask. The stop is always
7:  * derived from this recorded extreme, never from the current price.
8:  */
9: export function updateBest(
10:   side: PositionSide,
11:   best: number,
12:   bid: number,
13:   ask: number,
14: ): number {
15:   if (side === "buy") {
16:     if (!Number.isFinite(bid)) return best;
17:     return Number.isFinite(best) ? Math.max(best, bid) : bid;
18:   }
19:   if (!Number.isFinite(ask)) return best;
20:   return Number.isFinite(best) ? Math.min(best, ask) : ask;
21: }
22: 
23: /** ATR-based trail distance with an absolute minimum (e.g. 8 pips). */
24: export function trailDistanceFromAtr(atr: number, atrFactor: number, minDistance: number): number {
25:   const minimum = Number.isFinite(minDistance) && minDistance > 0 ? minDistance : 0;
26:   if (!Number.isFinite(atr) || atr <= 0 || !Number.isFinite(atrFactor) || atrFactor <= 0) {
27:     return minimum;
28:   }
29:   return Math.max(atr * atrFactor, minimum);
30: }
31: 
32: /**
33:  * Initial virtual stop. The emergency broker stop is the outer safety net, so
34:  * the program-side stop starts at the same level and only tightens after the
35:  * market prints a new favourable extreme. This mirrors the reference example:
36:  *
37:  *   BUY entry 1.0850, initial stop 1.0820
38:  *   best 1.0900 -> stop 1.0880
39:  *   best 1.0930 -> stop 1.0910
40:  *   price back to 1.0920 -> stop stays 1.0910
41:  */
42: export function initialVirtualStop(
43:   side: PositionSide,
44:   entry: number,
45:   emergencySl: number,
46: ): number {
47:   if (Number.isFinite(emergencySl) && emergencySl > 0) return emergencySl;
48:   return entry;
49: }
50: 
51: /** The stop implied by the recorded best price and current trail distance. */
52: export function virtualStopFor(
53:   side: PositionSide,
54:   best: number,
55:   trailDistance: number,
56: ): number {
57:   if (!Number.isFinite(best) || !Number.isFinite(trailDistance) || trailDistance < 0) {
58:     return Number.NaN;
59:   }
60:   return side === "buy" ? best - trailDistance : best + trailDistance;
61: }
62: 
63: /**
64:  * Advance a virtual stop, never loosening it. A shrinking ATR can tighten the
65:  * stop; a growing ATR can only hold it in place.
66:  */
67: export function advanceVirtualStop(
68:   side: PositionSide,
69:   currentStop: number,
70:   best: number,
71:   trailDistance: number,
72: ): number {
73:   const candidate = virtualStopFor(side, best, trailDistance);
74:   if (!Number.isFinite(candidate)) return currentStop;
75:   if (!Number.isFinite(currentStop)) return candidate;
76:   return side === "buy" ? Math.max(currentStop, candidate) : Math.min(currentStop, candidate);
77: }

83: export function virtualStopHit(

87:   ask: number,
88: ): boolean {
89:   if (!Number.isFinite(stop)) return false;
90:   return side === "buy" ? bid <= stop : ask >= stop;

134: /**

136:  * volume step so a trade can never risk more than the configured percentage.

138: export function computeLots(input: SizingInput): SizingResult {
139:   if (!(input.slPips > 0) || !(input.pipValuePerLot > 0) || !(input.volumeStep > 0)) {
140:     return { lots: 0, riskUsd: 0, reason: "invalid sizing inputs" };
141:   }
142:   const riskUsd = (input.equity * input.riskPct) / 100;
143:   const rawLots = riskUsd / (input.slPips * input.pipValuePerLot);
144:   let lots = roundVolumeDown(Math.min(rawLots, input.maxLots), input.volumeStep);
145:   if (lots > input.volumeMax) lots = roundVolumeDown(input.volumeMax, input.volumeStep);
146:   if (lots < input.volumeMin) {
147:     return {
148:       lots: 0,
149:       riskUsd,
150:       reason: `risk ${riskUsd.toFixed(2)} = ${rawLots.toFixed(3)} lot < volume_min ${input.volumeMin}`,
151:     };
152:   }
153:   return { lots, riskUsd: lots * input.slPips * input.pipValuePerLot };
154: }

156: /** Rate used to convert the instrument's quote currency into USD. */
157: export function quoteToUsdRate(
158:   quoteCurrency: string,
159:   quotes: Map<string, Quote>,
160: ): number | undefined {
161:   if (quoteCurrency === "USD") return 1;
162:   const direct = quotes.get(`${quoteCurrency}USD`);
163:   if (direct && direct.bid > 0) return direct.bid;
164:   const inverse = quotes.get(`USD${quoteCurrency}`);
165:   if (inverse && inverse.ask > 0) return 1 / inverse.ask;
166: 
167:   // Triangulate through a liquid USD pair. Example: CAD -> USD can be derived
168:   // from CADJPY / USDJPY even when the synthetic CADUSD symbol does not exist
169:   // or has not ticked yet. Sell the quote currency and buy USD, hence bid/ask.
170:   for (const pivot of ["JPY", "CHF", "EUR", "GBP", "AUD", "NZD", "CAD"]) {
171:     if (pivot === quoteCurrency) continue;
172:     const quotePivot = quotes.get(`${quoteCurrency}${pivot}`);
173:     const usdPivot = quotes.get(`USD${pivot}`);
174:     if (quotePivot && usdPivot && quotePivot.bid > 0 && usdPivot.ask > 0) {
175:       const rate = quotePivot.bid / usdPivot.ask;
176:       if (Number.isFinite(rate) && rate > 0) return rate;
177:     }
178:     const pivotQuote = quotes.get(`${pivot}${quoteCurrency}`);
179:     const pivotUsd = quotes.get(`${pivot}USD`);
180:     if (pivotQuote && pivotUsd && pivotQuote.ask > 0 && pivotUsd.bid > 0) {
181:       const rate = pivotUsd.bid / pivotQuote.ask;
182:       if (Number.isFinite(rate) && rate > 0) return rate;
183:     }
184:   }
185:   return undefined;
186: }

69: /**
70:  * Tick-only momentum memory. It is used only to rank the prefilter shortlist
71:  * (which pairs are active enough to be worth two candle requests); it is not a
72:  * hard screener criterion.

74: export class MomentumTracker {
75:   private readonly samples = new Map<string, MomentumSample[]>();
76: 
77:   observe(quote: Quote): void {
78:     const series = this.samples.get(quote.symbol) ?? [];
79:     const last = series[series.length - 1];
80:     if (last && quote.timestamp - last.t < SAMPLE_INTERVAL_MS) {
81:       last.mid = quote.mid;
82:       last.t = quote.timestamp;
83:       return;
84:     }
85:     series.push({ t: quote.timestamp, mid: quote.mid });
86:     const cutoff = quote.timestamp - MOMENTUM_WINDOW_MS;
87:     while (series.length > 1 && series[0]!.t < cutoff) series.shift();
88:     this.samples.set(quote.symbol, series);
89:   }
90: 
91:   changePct(symbol: string, minutes: number): number | null {
92:     const series = this.samples.get(symbol);
93:     if (!series || series.length < 2) return null;
94:     const latest = series[series.length - 1]!;
95:     const target = latest.t - minutes * 60_000;
96:     if (latest.t - series[0]!.t < minutes * 60_000 * 0.75) return null;
97: 
98:     let reference: MomentumSample | undefined;
99:     for (const sample of series) {
100:       if (sample.t <= target) reference = sample;
101:       else break;
102:     }
103:     reference ??= series[0]!;
104:     if (reference.mid === 0) return null;
105:     return ((latest.mid - reference.mid) / reference.mid) * 100;
106:   }
107: 
108:   size(): number {
109:     return this.samples.size;
110:   }
111: }

123: /**
124:  * Pure candle scoring for the final plan:
125:  *
126:  *   1. H1 EMA50 above/below EMA200  → trend direction
127:  *   2. M15 RSI 40–60 and price near M15 EMA50 → pullback
128:  *   3. spread below the limit → tradeable
129:  *
130:  * No take-profit, no M5, no momentum hard gate.
131:  */
132: export function scoreCandidate(input: CandleScoreInput): Candidate | null {
133:   const { symbol, m15, h1, quote, options } = input;
134:   if (m15.length < 60 || h1.length < 210) return null;
135: 
136:   const h1Closes = closes(h1);
137:   const h1Ema50 = lastFinite(ema(h1Closes, 50));
138:   const h1Ema200 = lastFinite(ema(h1Closes, 200));
139:   const h1Atr = lastFinite(atr(h1, 14));
140:   if (h1Ema50 === undefined || h1Ema200 === undefined || h1Atr === undefined || h1Atr <= 0) {
141:     return null;
142:   }
143: 
144:   const h1Trend = (h1Ema50 - h1Ema200) / h1Atr;
145:   if (Math.abs(h1Trend) < options.minTrendAtr) return null;
146:   const direction: Direction = h1Trend > 0 ? "buy" : "sell";
147:   const sign = direction === "buy" ? 1 : -1;
148:   const trendAtr = h1Trend * sign;
149: 
150:   const closeSeries = closes(m15);
151:   const m15Ema50 = lastFinite(ema(closeSeries, 50));
152:   const m15Atr = lastFinite(atr(m15, 14));
153:   const m15Rsi = lastFinite(rsi(closeSeries, 14));
154:   const close = closeSeries[closeSeries.length - 1];
155:   if (
156:     m15Ema50 === undefined ||
157:     m15Atr === undefined ||
158:     m15Atr <= 0 ||
159:     m15Rsi === undefined ||
160:     close === undefined
161:   ) {
162:     return null;
163:   }
164: 
165:   // Pullback zone: RSI in the middle of its range, price near EMA50.
166:   if (m15Rsi < options.rsiMin || m15Rsi > options.rsiMax) return null;
167:   const distanceAtr = (close - m15Ema50) / m15Atr;
168:   if (Math.abs(distanceAtr) > options.pullbackDistanceAtr) return null;
169: 
170:   const atrPct = atrPercent(m15, m15Atr);
171:   if (atrPct < options.minAtrPct || atrPct > options.maxAtrPct) return null;
172:   if (!spreadWithinLimit(symbol, quote, options)) return null;
173: 
174:   // Spread is a real cost, not just a screen: rejecting an edge that is mostly
175:   // eaten by the spread is what keeps a more aggressive scan profitable.
176:   const trailDistance = trailDistanceFromAtr(
177:     m15Atr,
178:     options.trailAtrFactor,
179:     options.trailMinPips * pipSize(symbol),
180:   );
181:   const spreadRatio = trailDistance > 0 ? quote.spread / trailDistance : Number.POSITIVE_INFINITY;
182:   if (!Number.isFinite(spreadRatio) || spreadRatio > options.maxSpreadTrailRatio) return null;
183: 
184:   const trendScore = clamp(trendAtr / 1.2, 0, 1) * 40;
185:   const pullbackScore =
186:     clamp(1 - Math.abs(distanceAtr) / Math.max(options.pullbackDistanceAtr, 1e-9), 0, 1) * 25;
187:   const rsiScore = clamp(1 - Math.abs(m15Rsi - 50) / 10, 0, 1) * 20;
188:   const spreadScore = spreadQuality(symbol, quote, options) * 15;
189:   const score = trendScore + pullbackScore + rsiScore + spreadScore;
190:   if (score < options.minScore) return null;
191: 
192:   const reasons = [
193:     `H1 ${direction === "buy" ? "uptrend" : "downtrend"} ${trendAtr.toFixed(2)}×ATR`,
194:     `pullback ${distanceAtr.toFixed(2)}×ATR`,
195:     `RSI ${m15Rsi.toFixed(0)}`,
196:     `spread ${spreadLabel(symbol, quote)}`,
197:     `ATR ${atrPct.toFixed(3)}%`,
198:     `cost ${(spreadRatio * 100).toFixed(0)}% trail`,
199:   ];
200: 
201:   return {
202:     symbol,
203:     direction,
204:     score,
205:     price: close,
206:     spreadPct: quote.spreadPct,
207:     spreadPips: spreadPips(symbol, quote),
208:     atr: m15Atr,
209:     atrPct,
210:     spreadRatio,
211:     ema50: m15Ema50,
212:     h1Ema50,
213:     h1Ema200,
214:     rsi: m15Rsi,
215:     trendAtr,
216:     distanceAtr,
217:     reasons,

235: export class Screener {
236:   readonly momentum = new MomentumTracker();
237:   lastScanAt = 0;
238:   lastScanDurationMs = 0;
239:   lastDiagnostics: ScanDiagnostics = {
240:     universe: 0,
241:     withQuote: 0,
242:     fresh: 0,
243:     prefiltered: 0,
244:     shortlist: 0,
245:     candleFails: 0,
246:     scored: 0,
247:     passed: 0,
248:     top: [],
249:   };
250: 
251:   constructor(
252:     private readonly tools: Tools,
253:     private readonly ticks: TickHub,
254:     private readonly options: ScreenerOptions,
255:   ) {}
256: 
257:   observe(quote: Quote): void {
258:     this.momentum.observe(quote);
259:   }
260: 
261:   async scan(universe: string[]): Promise<Candidate[]> {
262:     const started = Date.now();
263:     this.lastScanAt = started;
264: 
265:     const now = Date.now();
266:     type Pre = { quote: Quote; mom5: number | null; prelim: number };
267:     const pre: Pre[] = [];
268:     let withQuote = 0;
269:     let fresh = 0;
270: 
271:     for (const symbol of universe) {
272:       const quote = this.ticks.get(symbol);
273:       if (!quote) continue;
274:       withQuote += 1;
275:       if (now - quote.timestamp > this.options.maxQuoteAgeMs) continue;
276:       fresh += 1;
277:       if (!spreadWithinLimit(symbol, quote, this.options)) continue;
278: 
279:       const mom5 = this.momentum.changePct(symbol, 5);
280:       const activity = clamp(quote.ticks / 20, 0, 1);
281:       const move = mom5 === null ? 0.35 : clamp(Math.abs(mom5) / 0.08, 0, 1);
282:       const prelim = spreadQuality(symbol, quote, this.options) * 60 + activity * 20 + move * 20;
283:       pre.push({ quote, mom5, prelim });
284:     }
285: 
286:     pre.sort((a, b) => b.prelim - a.prelim);
287:     const shortlist = pre.slice(0, this.options.shortlistSize);
288: 
289:     const candidates: Candidate[] = [];
290:     let candleFails = 0;
291:     let scored = 0;
292:     for (const entry of shortlist) {
293:       const symbol = entry.quote.symbol;
294:       const m15Result = await this.tools.get_candles({
295:         symbol,
296:         timeframe: this.options.m15Timeframe,
297:         n: 180,
298:       });
299:       const h1Result = await this.tools.get_candles({
300:         symbol,
301:         timeframe: this.options.h1Timeframe,
302:         n: 260,
303:       });
304:       if (!m15Result.ok || !h1Result.ok) {
305:         candleFails += 1;
306:         continue;
307:       }
308: 
309:       const m15 = dropFormingCandle(
310:         m15Result.data,
311:         timeframeMs(this.options.m15Timeframe),
312:         now,
313:       );
314:       const h1 = dropFormingCandle(h1Result.data, timeframeMs(this.options.h1Timeframe), now);
315:       if (m15.length < 60 || h1.length < 210) {
316:         candleFails += 1;
317:         continue;
318:       }
319: 
320:       scored += 1;
321:       const candidate = scoreCandidate({
322:         symbol,
323:         m15,
324:         h1,
325:         quote: entry.quote,
326:         options: this.options,
327:       });
328:       if (candidate) candidates.push(candidate);
329:     }
330: 
331:     candidates.sort((a, b) => b.score - a.score);
332:     this.lastScanDurationMs = Date.now() - started;
333:     const capped = candidates.slice(0, this.options.maxCandidates);
334:     this.lastDiagnostics = {
335:       universe: universe.length,
336:       withQuote,
337:       fresh,
338:       prefiltered: pre.length,
339:       shortlist: shortlist.length,
340:       candleFails,
341:       scored,
342:       passed: capped.length,
343:       top: shortlist.slice(0, 6).map((entry) => ({
344:         symbol: entry.quote.symbol,
345:         prelim: Number(entry.prelim.toFixed(1)),
346:         spreadPips: Number(spreadPips(entry.quote.symbol, entry.quote).toFixed(2)),
347:         mom5: entry.mom5 === null ? null : Number(entry.mom5.toFixed(3)),
348:       })),
349:     };
350:     return capped;
351:   }
352: }

130: export function panel(

139:   const label = visibleLength(rawLabel) > total - 2 ? cutAnsi(rawLabel, total - 2) : rawLabel;

146:     ...content.map((line) => `${border("│")} ${fitLine(line, inner)} ${border("│")}`),
147:     `${border("╰")}${border("─".repeat(total - 2))}${border("╯")}`,
148:   ].join("\n");

151: /** Compose already-rendered panels into an equal-height row. */
152: export function row(panels: string[], gap = " "): string {
153:   if (panels.length === 0) return "";
154:   const blocks = panels.map((entry) => entry.split("\n"));
155:   const widths = blocks.map((block) =>
156:     Math.max(...block.map((line) => visibleLength(line))),
157:   );
158:   const height = Math.max(...blocks.map((block) => block.length));
159:   const out: string[] = [];

161:     out.push(
162:       blocks
163:         .map((block, index) => block[line] ?? " ".repeat(widths[index] ?? 0))
164:         .join(gap),
165:     );
166:   }
167:   return out.join("\n");
168: }

174:   return Array.from({ length: parts }, (_, index) => base + (index < remainder ? 1 : 0));

46: /**
47:  * Trend-following pullback entry.
48:  *
49:  * The screener has already checked H1 EMA50/EMA200, M15 RSI, distance to M15
50:  * EMA50 and spread. Entry has one job: require the last closed M15 candle to
51:  * confirm the trend direction, then derive the emergency stop and virtual
52:  * trail from volatility. There is deliberately no take-profit.
53:  */
54: export function decideEntry(input: {
55:   candidate: Candidate;
56:   quote: Quote;
57:   config: EntryConfig;
58:   now?: number;
59: }): EntryDecision {
60:   const { candidate, quote, config } = input;
61:   const rejects: string[] = [];
62:   const now = input.now ?? Date.now();
63: 
64:   const symbol = candidate.symbol;
65:   const side = candidate.direction;
66:   const sign = side === "buy" ? 1 : -1;
67:   const digits = digitsFor(symbol);
68:   const pip = pipSize(symbol, digits);
69: 
70:   if (!spreadWithinLimit(symbol, quote, config)) {
71:     rejects.push(`spread too wide`);
72:   }
73:   if (now - quote.timestamp > config.maxQuoteAgeMs) {
74:     rejects.push(`quote ${now - quote.timestamp}ms old`);
75:   }
76: 
77:   const m15 = candidate.candles;
78:   const last = m15[m15.length - 1];
79:   if (!last) {
80:     return { signal: null, rejects: ["M15 candles not ready"] };
81:   }
82: 
83:   const atrValue = candidate.atr;
84:   if (!Number.isFinite(atrValue) || atrValue <= 0) {
85:     return { signal: null, rejects: ["ATR not ready"] };
86:   }
87: 
88:   // Virtual trail is tighter than the emergency stop. It is the normal exit.
89:   const trailDistance = Math.max(
90:     config.trailAtrFactor * atrValue,
91:     config.trailMinPips * pip,
92:   );
93:   const spreadRatio = trailDistance > 0 ? quote.spread / trailDistance : Number.POSITIVE_INFINITY;
94:   if (spreadRatio > config.maxSpreadTrailRatio) {
95:     rejects.push(
96:       `spread cost ${(spreadRatio * 100).toFixed(0)}% of trail ` +
97:         `(max ${(config.maxSpreadTrailRatio * 100).toFixed(0)}%)`,
98:     );
99:   }
100: 
101:   // The confirmation candle must have CLOSED in the trend direction.
102:   const confirmed = side === "buy" ? last.close > last.open : last.close < last.open;
103:   if (!confirmed) {
104:     rejects.push(
105:       `M15 close not ${side === "buy" ? "bullish" : "bearish"} (${last.open}→${last.close})`,
106:     );
107:   }
108: 
109:   if (candidate.rsi < config.rsiMin || candidate.rsi > config.rsiMax) {
110:     rejects.push(`RSI ${candidate.rsi.toFixed(0)} outside ${config.rsiMin}-${config.rsiMax}`);
111:   }
112:   if (Math.abs(candidate.distanceAtr) > config.pullbackDistanceAtr) {
113:     rejects.push(`price ${candidate.distanceAtr.toFixed(2)}×ATR from EMA50`);
114:   }
115: 
116:   const chaseAtr = Math.abs(quote.mid - last.close) / atrValue;
117:   if (chaseAtr > config.maxChaseAtr) {
118:     rejects.push(`chasing ${chaseAtr.toFixed(2)}×ATR from M15 close`);
119:   }
120: 
121:   if (rejects.length > 0) return { signal: null, rejects };
122: 
123:   const entry = roundPrice(side === "buy" ? quote.ask : quote.bid, digits);
124: 
125:   // Emergency stop is intentionally far away: it is the "program died" layer.
126:   // The broker minimum and current spread are hard floors.
127:   const emergencyDistance = Math.max(
128:     config.emergencySlAtrFactor * atrValue,
129:     config.minStopPips * pip,
130:     quote.spread * 3,
131:   );
132:   const emergencySl = roundPrice(entry - sign * emergencyDistance, digits);
133:   const slPips = Math.abs(entry - emergencySl) / pip;
134: 
135:   const reasons = [
136:     ...candidate.reasons,
137:     `M15 ${side === "buy" ? "bullish" : "bearish"} close confirm`,
138:     `emergency SL ${slPips.toFixed(1)}p`,
139:     `trail ${(trailDistance / pip).toFixed(1)}p`,
140:   ];
141: 
142:   return {
143:     signal: {
144:       symbol,
145:       side,
146:       entry,
147:       emergencySl,
148:       digits,
149:       pip,
150:       slPips,
151:       atr: atrValue,
152:       trailDistance,
153:       score: candidate.score,
154:       reasons,
155:       createdAt: now,
156:       expiresAt: now + 60_000,
157:     },
158:     rejects: [],
159:   };
160: }
161: 
162: function roundPrice(value: number, digits: number): number {
163:   const factor = 10 ** digits;
164:   return Math.round(value * factor) / factor;
165: }

66: const MOMENTUM_WINDOW_MS = 15 * 60_000;

69: /**
70:  * Tick-only momentum memory. It is used only to rank the prefilter shortlist
71:  * (which pairs are active enough to be worth two candle requests); it is not a
72:  * hard screener criterion.
73:  */
74: export class MomentumTracker {
75:   private readonly samples = new Map<string, MomentumSample[]>();
76: 
77:   observe(quote: Quote): void {
78:     const series = this.samples.get(quote.symbol) ?? [];
79:     const last = series[series.length - 1];
80:     if (last && quote.timestamp - last.t < SAMPLE_INTERVAL_MS) {
81:       last.mid = quote.mid;
82:       last.t = quote.timestamp;
83:       return;
84:     }
85:     series.push({ t: quote.timestamp, mid: quote.mid });
86:     const cutoff = quote.timestamp - MOMENTUM_WINDOW_MS;
87:     while (series.length > 1 && series[0]!.t < cutoff) series.shift();
88:     this.samples.set(quote.symbol, series);
89:   }
90: 
91:   changePct(symbol: string, minutes: number): number | null {
92:     const series = this.samples.get(symbol);
93:     if (!series || series.length < 2) return null;
94:     const latest = series[series.length - 1]!;
95:     const target = latest.t - minutes * 60_000;
96:     if (latest.t - series[0]!.t < minutes * 60_000 * 0.75) return null;
97: 
98:     let reference: MomentumSample | undefined;
99:     for (const sample of series) {
100:       if (sample.t <= target) reference = sample;
101:       else break;
102:     }
103:     reference ??= series[0]!;
104:     if (reference.mid === 0) return null;
105:     return ((latest.mid - reference.mid) / reference.mid) * 100;
106:   }
107: 
108:   size(): number {
109:     return this.samples.size;
110:   }
111: }

113: export interface CandleScoreInput {

117:   /** closed H1 candles */

123: /**
124:  * Pure candle scoring for the final plan:
125:  *
126:  *   1. H1 EMA50 above/below EMA200  → trend direction
127:  *   2. M15 RSI 40–60 and price near M15 EMA50 → pullback
128:  *   3. spread below the limit → tradeable
129:  *
130:  * No take-profit, no M5, no momentum hard gate.
131:  */
132: export function scoreCandidate(input: CandleScoreInput): Candidate | null {
133:   const { symbol, m15, h1, quote, options } = input;
134:   if (m15.length < 60 || h1.length < 210) return null;
135: 
136:   const h1Closes = closes(h1);
137:   const h1Ema50 = lastFinite(ema(h1Closes, 50));
138:   const h1Ema200 = lastFinite(ema(h1Closes, 200));
139:   const h1Atr = lastFinite(atr(h1, 14));
140:   if (h1Ema50 === undefined || h1Ema200 === undefined || h1Atr === undefined || h1Atr <= 0) {
141:     return null;
142:   }
143: 
144:   const h1Trend = (h1Ema50 - h1Ema200) / h1Atr;
145:   if (Math.abs(h1Trend) < options.minTrendAtr) return null;
146:   const direction: Direction = h1Trend > 0 ? "buy" : "sell";
147:   const sign = direction === "buy" ? 1 : -1;
148:   const trendAtr = h1Trend * sign;
149: 
150:   const closeSeries = closes(m15);
151:   const m15Ema50 = lastFinite(ema(closeSeries, 50));
152:   const m15Atr = lastFinite(atr(m15, 14));
153:   const m15Rsi = lastFinite(rsi(closeSeries, 14));
154:   const close = closeSeries[closeSeries.length - 1];
155:   if (
156:     m15Ema50 === undefined ||
157:     m15Atr === undefined ||
158:     m15Atr <= 0 ||
159:     m15Rsi === undefined ||
160:     close === undefined
161:   ) {
162:     return null;
163:   }
164: 
165:   // Pullback zone: RSI in the middle of its range, price near EMA50.
166:   if (m15Rsi < options.rsiMin || m15Rsi > options.rsiMax) return null;
167:   const distanceAtr = (close - m15Ema50) / m15Atr;
168:   if (Math.abs(distanceAtr) > options.pullbackDistanceAtr) return null;
169: 
170:   const atrPct = atrPercent(m15, m15Atr);
171:   if (atrPct < options.minAtrPct || atrPct > options.maxAtrPct) return null;
172:   if (!spreadWithinLimit(symbol, quote, options)) return null;
173: 
174:   // Spread is a real cost, not just a screen: rejecting an edge that is mostly
175:   // eaten by the spread is what keeps a more aggressive scan profitable.
176:   const trailDistance = trailDistanceFromAtr(
177:     m15Atr,
178:     options.trailAtrFactor,
179:     options.trailMinPips * pipSize(symbol),
180:   );
181:   const spreadRatio = trailDistance > 0 ? quote.spread / trailDistance : Number.POSITIVE_INFINITY;
182:   if (!Number.isFinite(spreadRatio) || spreadRatio > options.maxSpreadTrailRatio) return null;
183: 
184:   const trendScore = clamp(trendAtr / 1.2, 0, 1) * 40;
185:   const pullbackScore =
186:     clamp(1 - Math.abs(distanceAtr) / Math.max(options.pullbackDistanceAtr, 1e-9), 0, 1) * 25;
187:   const rsiScore = clamp(1 - Math.abs(m15Rsi - 50) / 10, 0, 1) * 20;
188:   const spreadScore = spreadQuality(symbol, quote, options) * 15;
189:   const score = trendScore + pullbackScore + rsiScore + spreadScore;
190:   if (score < options.minScore) return null;
191: 
192:   const reasons = [
193:     `H1 ${direction === "buy" ? "uptrend" : "downtrend"} ${trendAtr.toFixed(2)}×ATR`,
194:     `pullback ${distanceAtr.toFixed(2)}×ATR`,
195:     `RSI ${m15Rsi.toFixed(0)}`,
196:     `spread ${spreadLabel(symbol, quote)}`,
197:     `ATR ${atrPct.toFixed(3)}%`,
198:     `cost ${(spreadRatio * 100).toFixed(0)}% trail`,
199:   ];
200: 
201:   return {
202:     symbol,
203:     direction,
204:     score,
205:     price: close,
206:     spreadPct: quote.spreadPct,
207:     spreadPips: spreadPips(symbol, quote),
208:     atr: m15Atr,
209:     atrPct,
210:     spreadRatio,
211:     ema50: m15Ema50,
212:     h1Ema50,
213:     h1Ema200,
214:     rsi: m15Rsi,
215:     trendAtr,
216:     distanceAtr,
217:     reasons,
218:     candles: m15,
219:   };
220: }

507:   async scanOnce(): Promise<{

510:     diagnostics: ScanDiagnostics;
511:   }> {

513:     this.deps.ticks.start(this.deps.universe);
514:     // Give the websocket time to subscribe the whole universe (one instrument
515:     // per message). A 5s wait only sees ~50 pairs on a 335-instrument account.
516:     const warmTarget = Math.min(this.deps.universe.length, 300);
517:     for (let i = 0; i < 240 && this.deps.ticks.quotesCount < warmTarget; i += 1) {
518:       await sleep(250);
519:     }
520:     this.deps.log(
521:       `ticks ${this.deps.ticks.state} · ${this.deps.ticks.quotesCount} quotes · ` +
522:         `${this.deps.ticks.subscribed.length} subscribed` +
523:         (this.deps.ticks.lastAckError ? ` · ack ${this.deps.ticks.lastAckError}` : ""),
524:     );
525:     const candidates = await this.screener.scan(this.deps.universe);
526:     const decisions: Array<{ symbol: string; signal: EntrySignal | null; rejects: string[] }> = [];
527:     // Check every screened pair, not just the first few: the screener is the
528:     // gate, so a single scan can preview every entry it would take.
529:     for (const candidate of candidates) {
530:       const quote = this.deps.ticks.get(candidate.symbol);
531:       if (!quote) continue;
532:       const decision = decideEntry({
533:         candidate,
534:         quote,
535:         config: entryConfigFrom(this.deps.config),
536:       });
537:       decisions.push({
538:         symbol: candidate.symbol,
539:         signal: decision.signal,
540:         rejects: decision.rejects,
541:       });
542:     }
543:     return { candidates, decisions, diagnostics: this.screener.lastDiagnostics };
544:   }

134: /**
135:  * Fixed-fractional sizing on the virtual risk equity. Always floors to the
136:  * volume step so a trade can never risk more than the configured percentage.
137:  */
138: export function computeLots(input: SizingInput): SizingResult {
139:   if (!(input.slPips > 0) || !(input.pipValuePerLot > 0) || !(input.volumeStep > 0)) {
140:     return { lots: 0, riskUsd: 0, reason: "invalid sizing inputs" };
141:   }
142:   const riskUsd = (input.equity * input.riskPct) / 100;
143:   const rawLots = riskUsd / (input.slPips * input.pipValuePerLot);
144:   let lots = roundVolumeDown(Math.min(rawLots, input.maxLots), input.volumeStep);
145:   if (lots > input.volumeMax) lots = roundVolumeDown(input.volumeMax, input.volumeStep);
146:   if (lots < input.volumeMin) {
147:     return {
148:       lots: 0,
149:       riskUsd,
150:       reason: `risk ${riskUsd.toFixed(2)} = ${rawLots.toFixed(3)} lot < volume_min ${input.volumeMin}`,
151:     };
152:   }
153:   return { lots, riskUsd: lots * input.slPips * input.pipValuePerLot };
154: }

156: /** Rate used to convert the instrument's quote currency into USD. */
157: export function quoteToUsdRate(
158:   quoteCurrency: string,
159:   quotes: Map<string, Quote>,
160: ): number | undefined {
161:   if (quoteCurrency === "USD") return 1;
162:   const direct = quotes.get(`${quoteCurrency}USD`);
163:   if (direct && direct.bid > 0) return direct.bid;
164:   const inverse = quotes.get(`USD${quoteCurrency}`);
165:   if (inverse && inverse.ask > 0) return 1 / inverse.ask;
166: 
167:   // Triangulate through a liquid USD pair. Example: CAD -> USD can be derived
168:   // from CADJPY / USDJPY even when the synthetic CADUSD symbol does not exist
169:   // or has not ticked yet. Sell the quote currency and buy USD, hence bid/ask.
170:   for (const pivot of ["JPY", "CHF", "EUR", "GBP", "AUD", "NZD", "CAD"]) {
171:     if (pivot === quoteCurrency) continue;
172:     const quotePivot = quotes.get(`${quoteCurrency}${pivot}`);
173:     const usdPivot = quotes.get(`USD${pivot}`);
174:     if (quotePivot && usdPivot && quotePivot.bid > 0 && usdPivot.ask > 0) {
175:       const rate = quotePivot.bid / usdPivot.ask;
176:       if (Number.isFinite(rate) && rate > 0) return rate;
177:     }
178:     const pivotQuote = quotes.get(`${pivot}${quoteCurrency}`);
179:     const pivotUsd = quotes.get(`${pivot}USD`);
180:     if (pivotQuote && pivotUsd && pivotQuote.ask > 0 && pivotUsd.bid > 0) {
181:       const rate = pivotUsd.bid / pivotQuote.ask;
182:       if (Number.isFinite(rate) && rate > 0) return rate;
183:     }
184:   }
185:   return undefined;
186: }

197:   if (direct && direct.bid > 0) return direct.bid;
198:   const inverse = quotes.get(`USD${baseCurrency}`);
199:   if (inverse && inverse.ask > 0) return 1 / inverse.ask;
200:   const quoteRate = quoteToUsdRate(quoteCurrency, quotes);
201:   if (quoteRate !== undefined && price > 0) return price * quoteRate;
202:   return undefined;
203: }

105:   async setSltp(
106:     positionId: string,

112:     if (patch.stopLoss !== undefined) body.stop_loss_price = priceString(patch.stopLoss, digits);
113:     if (patch.takeProfit !== undefined) body.take_profit_price = priceString(patch.takeProfit, digits);
114: 
115:     if (existing) {

117:       // TRADING_RULE_INVALID_PRICE_LEVELS means the broker rejected the level
118:       // (too close to market / wrong side); the caller keeps the old stop.
119:       return result;
120:     }

128:     );

328: export function spreadSpikes(ticks: TickHub): number {
329:   const quotes = ticks.store.all();
330:   if (quotes.length < 5) return 0;
331:   // Absolute threshold (5 bp) instead of a median multiple: exotic pairs are
332:   // structurally wide, so a relative measure would flag them permanently.
333:   return quotes.filter((quote) => Number.isFinite(quote.spreadPct) && quote.spreadPct >= 0.05)
334:     .length;
335: }

337: export function dailyCap(view: AccountView, equity: EquityTracker, capPct = 2): {
338:   start: number;
339:   change: number;
340:   cap: number;
341:   remaining: number;
342: } {
343:   const start = equity.startBalance || view.balance;
344:   const change = view.equity - start;
345:   // The agent sizes and caps on virtual risk equity, not the demo balance.
346:   const riskEquity = Number(process.env.EXNESS_VIRTUAL_EQUITY ?? 10_000);
347:   const cap = (riskEquity * capPct) / 100;
348:   return { start, change, cap, remaining: cap + Math.min(0, change) };
349: }

797: export function marketPanelLines(ticks: TickHub): string[] {
798:   const quotes = ticks.store.all().filter((quote) => Number.isFinite(quote.mid) && quote.mid > 0);
799:   // A first tick has firstMid === mid, so every symbol looks like a 0.00%
800:   // mover. Only rank instruments that have actually changed at least once.
801:   const movers = quotes
802:     .filter((quote) => quote.ticks > 1)
803:     .sort((a, b) => Math.abs(changePct(b)) - Math.abs(changePct(a)))
804:     .slice(0, 3)
805:     .map((quote) => `${quote.symbol} ${formatSignedPct(changePct(quote), 2)}`)
806:     .join(" · ");
807:   const spreads = quotes
808:     .map((quote) => quote.spreadPct * 100)
809:     .filter((value) => Number.isFinite(value) && value >= 0);
810:   const average = spreads.length
811:     ? spreads.reduce((sum, value) => sum + value, 0) / spreads.length
812:     : 0;
813:   const widest = quotes.reduce<Quote | undefined>(
814:     (best, quote) => (!best || quote.spreadPct > best.spreadPct ? quote : best),
815:     undefined,
816:   );
817:   const age = ticks.lastTickAt ? `${Date.now() - ticks.lastTickAt}ms` : "—";
818:   return [
819:     `quotes ${ticks.quotesCount} live · ${ticks.subscribed.length} ws · ${ticks.ticksPerSecond}/s`,
820:     `ticks ${ticks.state} · last ${age}`,
821:     movers ? `top ${movers}` : style.dim("menunggu tick"),
822:     `avg spread ${average.toFixed(1)}bp`,
823:     widest
824:       ? `wide ${widest.symbol} ${(widest.spreadPct * 100).toFixed(1)}bp`
825:       : style.dim("menunggu spread"),
826:   ];
827: }

12: function makeQuote(price: number, spread = 0.00008): Quote {
13:   const bid = price - spread / 2;
14:   const ask = price + spread / 2;
15:   return {
16:     symbol: "EURUSD",
17:     bid,
18:     ask,
19:     mid: (bid + ask) / 2,
20:     spread: ask - bid,
21:     spreadPct: ((ask - bid) / ((bid + ask) / 2)) * 100,
22:     timestamp: Date.now(),
23:     ticks: 30,
24:     firstMid: price,
25:     prevMid: price,
26:   };
27: }
28: 
29: function candle(index: number, open: number, close: number): NormalizedCandle {
30:   return {
31:     time: new Date(Date.UTC(2026, 9, 29, 0, index * 15)).toISOString(),
32:     open,
33:     high: Math.max(open, close) + 0.00015,
34:     low: Math.min(open, close) - 0.00015,
35:     close,
36:     volume: 100,
37:   };
38: }
39: 
40: /** Uptrend, a 25-bar drift back toward EMA50 (RSI ≈ 50), then a reclaim. */
41: function pullbackSeries(): NormalizedCandle[] {
42:   const out: NormalizedCandle[] = [];
43:   let previous = 1.08;
44:   for (let index = 0; index < 150; index += 1) {
45:     let close = 1.08 + index * 0.00003;
46:     if (index >= 124) close = 1.08 + 123 * 0.00003 - (index - 123) * 0.000015;
47:     if (index === 149) {
48:       close = 1.08 + 123 * 0.00003 - 25 * 0.000015 + 0.00012;
49:     }
50:     out.push(candle(index, previous, close));
51:     previous = close;
52:   }
53:   return out;
54: }
55: 
56: function steadySeries(count: number): NormalizedCandle[] {
57:   const out: NormalizedCandle[] = [];
58:   let previous = 1.08;
59:   for (let index = 0; index < count; index += 1) {
60:     const close = 1.08 + index * 0.00003;
61:     out.push(candle(index, previous, close));
62:     previous = close;
63:   }
64:   return out;
65: }
66: 
67: function flatSeries(count: number): NormalizedCandle[] {
68:   return Array.from({ length: count }, (_, index) => ({
69:     ...candle(index, 1.08, 1.08),
70:     high: 1.08001,
71:     low: 1.07999,
72:   }));
73: }

1: # open-trader
2: 
3: Terminal trading system for the **Exness Trader API**. Phase 1 (connection +
4: market data), Phase 2 (live monitoring dashboard) and Phase 3 (broker-side
5: trading tools + deterministic agents) are implemented.
6: 
7: The agents are **plain TypeScript rules**, not an LLM: at every M15 close a
8: screener ranks the whole instrument universe using H1 EMA50/EMA200 trend and an
9: M15 RSI/EMA50 pullback, an entry agent requires the M15 confirmation candle to
10: close in the trend direction, and a risk executor sizes the trade, places a
11: distant emergency stop, and manages a program-side virtual trailing stop. There
12: is no take-profit. `agent` is dry-run by default; only `--live` sends orders.
13: 
14: ```
15: open-trader · DEMO
16:   BALANCE / EQUITY / FREE MARGIN / POSITIONS
17:   SCREENER · ENTRY · TRADER        (side-by-side containers)
18:   AGENT LOG                        (what each agent is doing)
19:   POSITIONS                        (all open lots, live price, emergency SL, age)
20:   ACCOUNT · MARKET · RISK
21:   EQUITY / DRAWDOWN                (line charts, side by side)
22:   EVENTS · ORDERS                  (side by side)
23: ```
24: 
25: ## Quick start
26: 
27: ```powershell
28: npm install
29: npm run doctor
30: npm start                         # full-screen dashboard
31: ```
32: 
33: In a second terminal, start the agents:
34: 
35: ```powershell
36: npm run trade                     # same as: bin\ot.cmd agent --live
37: npm run scan                      # same as: bin\ot.cmd agent --once (read-only)
38: bin\ot.cmd agent --live --for 120 # bounded live session
39: ```

41: The agent scans at M15 boundaries (+3 seconds). Override the cadence only for
42: testing with `--scan <seconds>`; doing so disables boundary alignment.

44: `npm start` is the dashboard only. The dashboard reads
45: `.cache/agent-state.json`; the three containers and the activity log stay
46: populated while the agent runs, and show the last session (plus an `agent idle`
47: hint) when it is stopped.

60: ## Dashboard keys
61: 
62: The board is rendered as a scrollable viewport, so every section is available
63: even in a short terminal. The footer is pinned at the bottom.
64: 
65: | Key | Action |
66: | --- | --- |
67: | `q` / `Ctrl+C` | quit |
68: | `p` | pause / resume account polling |
69: | `a` | show / hide agent containers + log |
70: | `c` | show / hide equity + drawdown charts |
71: | `o` | show / hide orders |
72: | `e` | show / hide events |
73: | `r` | force a fresh REST snapshot |
74: | `x`, then `y` | arm / confirm kill switch: block entries + close every position (`n` cancels) |
75: | `↑` / `↓`, `j` / `k` | scroll one line |
76: | `PgUp` / `PgDn` | scroll ten lines |
77: | `g` / `G` | jump to top / bottom |
78: 
79: The kill switch is persisted in `.cache/KILL`. While it is on, the running agent
80: closes every open position (including positions it did not open) and refuses new
81: entries. Use `bin\ot.cmd unkill` to remove the flag. `bin\ot.cmd kill` does both
82: steps from one command even when the dashboard is not running.

124: ## Agents
125: 
126: | Agent | Responsibility |
127: | --- | --- |
128: | **Screener** | Runs at each M15 close. Prefilters all account instruments by fresh quote + spread, fetches M15 and H1 candles for the best 50, then requires: H1 EMA50 above/below EMA200 (trend), M15 RSI 30–70, price within 1.25×ATR of M15 EMA50, ATR in range, FX spread ≤ 6 pips (non-FX spread ≤ 0.10%), and spread cost ≤ 45% of the virtual trail. |
129: | **Entry** | Requires the last **closed** M15 candle to be bullish for a buy / bearish for a sell. Rejects stale quotes, wide spreads, a spread that eats the trail, chasing > 1.25×ATR, and a non-confirming candle. Computes the emergency stop from 3×ATR and the virtual trail from 2×ATR (minimum 8 pips). No TP. |
130: | **Risk / trader** | Sizes 1% of virtual equity from the entry-to-emergency-stop distance, opens a market order with the emergency SL, then manages a **program-side virtual trailing stop**. It closes at the virtual stop, refreshes trail distance every M15 close, adopts agent-owned orphans, reconciles on restart, retries a missing emergency SLTP, and persists state. |
131: 
132: Important behaviour:
133: 
134: - **Universe = all instruments** the account can trade (335 here: FX, metals,
135:   indices, crypto, stocks, other). No symbol is hard-coded; the screener decides.
136: - **Two positions at a time** by default (`AGENT_MAX_POSITIONS=2`) and one per
137:   symbol. Each position risks 1%; raise this deliberately, never by accident.
138: - **Two protection layers.** The broker-side emergency SL is 3×ATR and is only a
139:   crash fallback. The normal exit is the virtual stop in code; it never moves
140:   backward and is checked on every manage tick.
141: - **No take-profit, no TP1, no partial close, no breakeven, no hard-stop TP.**
142:   Winners are managed only by the virtual trail.
143: - **One instrument per WebSocket subscription message**, token-bucketed at about
144:   20/s. Bad symbols are dropped individually with `4000`, not in batches.
145: - **Async execution** — the gateway subscribes to `/ws/events` before sending an
146:   order and correlates ACK / `transaction_event` by `client_request_id`, with
147:   operation polling as a fallback.
148: - **Watchdog** — the agent logs feed stalls; a closed/wedged tick socket is
149:   restarted after 45 seconds and resubscribed.
150: - **Kill switch** — `.cache/KILL` blocks entries and makes the agent close all
151:   account positions; `ot kill` performs both immediately.
152: 
153: ### Risk defaults
154: 
155: | Setting | Value |
156: | --- | --- |
157: | Virtual equity for sizing | 10,000 USD (`EXNESS_VIRTUAL_EQUITY`) |
158: | Risk per trade | 1.0% (`AGENT_RISK_PCT`) |
159: | Max lots per trade | 0.5 (`AGENT_MAX_LOTS`) |
160: | Max positions | 2 (`AGENT_MAX_POSITIONS`) |
161: | Max per symbol | 1 (`AGENT_MAX_PER_SYMBOL`) |
162: | Daily loss cap | 2% ≈ 200 USD (`AGENT_MAX_DAILY_LOSS_PCT`) |
163: | Consecutive-loss cooldown | 3 losses → 4 hours |
164: | FX spread limit | 6.0 pips (`AGENT_MAX_SPREAD_PIPS`) |
165: | Non-FX spread limit | 0.10% (`AGENT_MAX_SPREAD_PCT`) |
166: | Spread cost cap | ≤ 45% of trail distance (`AGENT_MAX_SPREAD_TRAIL`) |
167: | Emergency broker stop | 3×M15 ATR, minimum 1 pip / 3× spread |
168: | Virtual trail | max(2×M15 ATR, 8 pips) (`AGENT_TRAIL_ATR`, `AGENT_TRAIL_MIN_PIPS`) |
169: | RSI band | 30–70 (`AGENT_RSI_MIN`, `AGENT_RSI_MAX`) |
170: | Pullback to EMA50 | ≤ 1.25×ATR (`AGENT_PULLBACK_ATR`) |
171: | H1 trend separation | ≥ 0.02×H1 ATR (`AGENT_MIN_TREND_ATR`) |
172: | Max quote age | 30 s (`AGENT_MAX_QUOTE_AGE_MS`) |
173: | Margin buffer | ×3 |
174: 
175: Trailing example: entry `1.0850`, initial virtual stop = emergency `1.0820`
176: (3×ATR). At `1.0900` the virtual stop becomes `1.0880`; at `1.0930` it becomes
177: `1.0910`; if price falls back to `1.0920`, the stop stays at `1.0910`. A buy
178: closes when bid ≤ virtual stop; a sell closes when ask ≥ virtual stop. The broker
179: emergency SL is **not** moved during normal trailing.
180: 
181: Agent state and audit trail:
182: 
183: ```
184: .cache/agent-state.json           managed positions, emergency SL/virtual stop, stats, journal
185: .cache/trades/YYYY-MM-DD.jsonl    open / trail / close / skip / error events
186: .cache/equity/YYYY-MM-DD.jsonl    equity samples for charts
187: .cache/events/YYYY-MM-DD.jsonl    raw runtime events
188: .cache/KILL                       persistent kill switch flag
189: ```
190: 
191: ## How it works
192: 
193: ```
194: src/
195: ├─ config.ts              .env loading (no dotenv) + validation
196: ├─ exness/
197: │  ├─ signing.ts          hex/PEM → Ed25519 key, EXN-DATA + EXN-SIGN headers
198: │  ├─ client.ts           access-point discovery + cache, signed REST, retry, rate limit
199: │  ├─ ws.ts               signed WebSocket handshake, heartbeat, reconnect + resubscribe
200: │  ├─ catalog.ts          instrument catalog + per-instrument conditions (cached)
201: │  └─ types.ts            subset of trading.public.yaml v1.0.2
202: ├─ market/
203: │  ├─ candles.ts          candle normalisation + pip/point helpers
204: │  ├─ indicators.ts       EMA/SMA/RSI/ATR
205: │  └─ store.ts            last tick per symbol, quotes, formatting
206: ├─ runtime/
207: │  ├─ hubs.ts             TickHub / EventHub, one-instrument subscriptions, token bucket
208: │  ├─ snapshot.ts         account snapshot cache (1200 ms TTL, invalidate)
209: │  └─ execution.ts        ACK/event correlation, operation polling, order gateway
210: ├─ tools/
211: │  ├─ index.ts            read-only account/catalog/candle tools
212: │  └─ trading.ts          open / patch-or-create SLTP / close, digits cache
213: ├─ monitor/equity.ts      daily equity samples + start balance
214: ├─ agents/
215: │  ├─ config.ts           thresholds and risk limits
216: │  ├─ screener.ts         H1 trend + M15 pullback + spread prefilter/ranking
217: │  ├─ entry.ts            M15 confirmation gate, 3×ATR emergency stop, 2×ATR trail
218: │  ├─ spread.ts           FX pip limit / non-FX percentage limit
219: │  ├─ risk-and-executor.ts sizing, gating, virtual trailing, adoption, kill close
220: │  ├─ engine.ts           M15 scan loop, manage loop, watchdog, state writer
221: │  ├─ journal.ts          per-agent activity feed for the dashboard
222: │  └─ trailing.ts         pure virtual stop / best-price / hit math
223: └─ cli/                   args, ANSI rendering, charts, commands, dashboard
224: ```
225: 
226: Behaviour worth knowing:
227: 
228: - **Signing** — `EXN-DATA` is serialized once; those exact bytes are signed and
229:   base64url-encoded (no padding) into `EXN-DATA`, with the Ed25519 signature in
230:   `EXN-SIGN`. `body_hash` is SHA-256 of the exact body.
231: - **Discovery** — `GET /v1/trading/access-point?account_id=…` against
232:   `EXNESS_DISCOVERY_URL`. The result is cached for 10 minutes and re-resolved
233:   once on a `401`.
234: - **Rate limits** — per-route sliding windows (candles 2/s, snapshot 2/s, orders
235:   4/s, global 10/s) plus `Retry-After` on `429`. Tick subscriptions use a
236:   separate 20/s token bucket; ticks are subscribed one instrument per message.
237: - **Money and volume are decimal strings** in requests/responses; only display
238:   formatting uses numbers, with `point_digits` from instrument conditions.
239: - **State is on disk** so a restarted agent re-adopts open positions from the
240:   trade log and `.cache/agent-state.json` instead of leaving them unmanaged. A
241:   virtual stop, best price, trail distance and emergency SL are persisted so a
242:   restart resumes the same protection rather than resetting it.
243: - **Reconciliation** — managed positions missing from the broker are finalized
244:   after two snapshot misses and a short grace period; positions opened by the
245:   agent but missing from memory are adopted from the trade log; positions the
246:   agent did not open are left alone unless the kill switch is active.
247:

10: /** Spread converted to pips. Only meaningful for FX; used for FX limits. */
11: export function spreadPips(symbol: string, quote: Quote): number {
12:   const pip = pipSize(symbol);
13:   if (!(pip > 0) || !Number.isFinite(quote.spread)) return Number.POSITIVE_INFINITY;
14:   return quote.spread / pip;
15: }
16: 
17: /**
18:  * FX uses an absolute pip limit. Metals, indices, crypto and stocks use a
19:  * percentage limit, because "pips" means wildly different things across those
20:  * instruments. The screener also caps spread as a fraction of the trail.
21:  */
22: export function spreadWithinLimit(symbol: string, quote: Quote, limits: SpreadLimits): boolean {
23:   if (categorize(symbol) === "fx") {
24:     const pips = spreadPips(symbol, quote);
25:     return Number.isFinite(pips) && pips > 0 && pips <= limits.maxSpreadPips;
26:   }
27:   return (
28:     Number.isFinite(quote.spreadPct) &&
29:     quote.spreadPct > 0 &&
30:     quote.spreadPct <= limits.maxSpreadPct
31:   );
32: }
33: 
34: export function spreadLabel(symbol: string, quote: Quote): string {
35:   if (categorize(symbol) === "fx") {
36:     const pips = spreadPips(symbol, quote);
37:     return `${pips.toFixed(1)}p`;
38:   }
39:   return `${(quote.spreadPct * 100).toFixed(1)}bp`;
40: }
41: 
42: /** 1 = tight, 0 = at the limit. Used only to rank the prefilter shortlist. */
43: export function spreadQuality(symbol: string, quote: Quote, limits: SpreadLimits): number {
44:   if (categorize(symbol) === "fx") {
45:     const pips = spreadPips(symbol, quote);
46:     if (!Number.isFinite(pips) || limits.maxSpreadPips <= 0) return 0;
47:     return Math.max(0, Math.min(1, 1 - pips / limits.maxSpreadPips));
48:   }
49:   if (!Number.isFinite(quote.spreadPct) || limits.maxSpreadPct <= 0) return 0;
50:   return Math.max(0, Math.min(1, 1 - quote.spreadPct / limits.maxSpreadPct));
51: }
