1: export type PositionSide = "buy" | "sell";
2: 
3: /**
4:  * New best price for a position, never moving backwards.
5:  *
6:  * BUY tracks the highest bid; SELL tracks the lowest ask. The stop is always
7:  * derived from this recorded extreme, never from the current price.
8:  */
9: export function updateBest(
10:   side: PositionSide,
11:   best: number,
12:   bid: number,
13:   ask: number,
14: ): number {
15:   if (side === "buy") {
16:     if (!Number.isFinite(bid)) return best;
17:     return Number.isFinite(best) ? Math.max(best, bid) : bid;
18:   }
19:   if (!Number.isFinite(ask)) return best;
20:   return Number.isFinite(best) ? Math.min(best, ask) : ask;
21: }
22: 
23: /** ATR-based trail distance with an absolute minimum (e.g. 8 pips). */
24: export function trailDistanceFromAtr(atr: number, atrFactor: number, minDistance: number): number {
25:   const minimum = Number.isFinite(minDistance) && minDistance > 0 ? minDistance : 0;
26:   if (!Number.isFinite(atr) || atr <= 0 || !Number.isFinite(atrFactor) || atrFactor <= 0) {
27:     return minimum;
28:   }
29:   return Math.max(atr * atrFactor, minimum);
30: }
31: 
32: /**
33:  * Initial virtual stop. The emergency broker stop is the outer safety net, so
34:  * the program-side stop starts at the same level and only tightens after the
35:  * market prints a new favourable extreme. This mirrors the reference example:
36:  *
37:  *   BUY entry 1.0850, initial stop 1.0820
38:  *   best 1.0900 -> stop 1.0880
39:  *   best 1.0930 -> stop 1.0910
40:  *   price back to 1.0920 -> stop stays 1.0910
41:  */
42: export function initialVirtualStop(
43:   side: PositionSide,
44:   entry: number,
45:   emergencySl: number,
46: ): number {
47:   if (Number.isFinite(emergencySl) && emergencySl > 0) return emergencySl;
48:   return entry;
49: }
50: 
51: /** The stop implied by the recorded best price and current trail distance. */
52: export function virtualStopFor(
53:   side: PositionSide,
54:   best: number,
55:   trailDistance: number,
56: ): number {
57:   if (!Number.isFinite(best) || !Number.isFinite(trailDistance) || trailDistance < 0) {
58:     return Number.NaN;
59:   }
60:   return side === "buy" ? best - trailDistance : best + trailDistance;
61: }
62: 
63: /**
64:  * Advance a virtual stop, never loosening it. A shrinking ATR can tighten the
65:  * stop; a growing ATR can only hold it in place.
66:  */
67: export function advanceVirtualStop(
68:   side: PositionSide,
69:   currentStop: number,
70:   best: number,
71:   trailDistance: number,
72: ): number {
73:   const candidate = virtualStopFor(side, best, trailDistance);
74:   if (!Number.isFinite(candidate)) return currentStop;
75:   if (!Number.isFinite(currentStop)) return candidate;
76:   return side === "buy" ? Math.max(currentStop, candidate) : Math.min(currentStop, candidate);
77: }

const enabled = Boolean(process.stdout.isTTY) && !("NO_COLOR" in process.env);

const CODES = {
  reset: "\u001b[0m",
  bold: "\u001b[1m",
  dim: "\u001b[2m",
  red: "\u001b[31m",
  green: "\u001b[32m",
  yellow: "\u001b[33m",
  blue: "\u001b[34m",
  magenta: "\u001b[35m",
  cyan: "\u001b[36m",
  gray: "\u001b[90m",
} as const;

type ColorName = keyof typeof CODES;

function paint(color: ColorName, text: string): string {
  if (!enabled) return text;
  return `${CODES[color]}${text}${CODES.reset}`;
}

export const style = {
  enabled,
  bold: (text: string) => paint("bold", text),
  dim: (text: string) => paint("dim", text),
  red: (text: string) => paint("red", text),
  green: (text: string) => paint("green", text),
  yellow: (text: string) => paint("yellow", text),
  blue: (text: string) => paint("blue", text),
  magenta: (text: string) => paint("magenta", text),
  cyan: (text: string) => paint("cyan", text),
  gray: (text: string) => paint("gray", text),
};

const ANSI_PATTERN = /\u001b\[[0-9;]*m/g;

export function visibleLength(text: string): number {
  return text.replace(ANSI_PATTERN, "").length;
}

export function pad(text: string, width: number, align: "left" | "right" = "left"): string {
  const diff = Math.max(0, width - visibleLength(text));
  return align === "right" ? " ".repeat(diff) + text : text + " ".repeat(diff);
}

export type Align = "left" | "right";

export interface TableOptions {
  align?: Record<number, Align>;
  headerColor?: boolean;
  indent?: string;
}

export function table(headers: string[], rows: string[][], options: TableOptions = {}): string {
  const widths = headers.map((header, index) =>
    Math.max(
      visibleLength(header),
      ...rows.map((row) => visibleLength(row[index] ?? "")),
    ),
  );

  const indent = options.indent ?? "";
  const line = (cells: string[], header = false): string => {
    const rendered = cells.map((cell, index) => {
      const align = options.align?.[index] ?? "left";
      const content = header && options.headerColor !== false ? style.bold(cell) : cell;
      return pad(content, widths[index] ?? 0, align);
    });
    return indent + rendered.join("  ").trimEnd();
  };

  const headerLine = line(headers, true);
  const separator = indent + widths.map((width) => "�"?".repeat(width)).join("  ");
  return [headerLine, style.gray(separator), ...rows.map((row) => line(row))].join("\n");
}

const BLOCKS = ["�-?", "�-,", "�-�", "�-,", "�-.", "�-+", "�-�", "�-^"];

export function sparkline(values: number[], width = 60): string {
  if (values.length === 0) return "";
  const sampled =
    values.length <= width
      ? values
      : Array.from({ length: width }, (_, index) => {
          const position = Math.round((index * (values.length - 1)) / (width - 1));
          return values[position]!;
        });

  const min = Math.min(...sampled);
  const max = Math.max(...sampled);
  const range = max - min;

  return sampled
    .map((value) => {
      if (range === 0) return BLOCKS[3]!;
      const index = Math.min(
        BLOCKS.length - 1,
        Math.max(0, Math.round(((value - min) / range) * (BLOCKS.length - 1))),
      );
      return BLOCKS[index]!;
    })
    .join("");
}

export function keyValue(pairs: Array<[string, string]>, width = 16): string {
  return pairs
    .filter(([, value]) => value !== undefined && value !== "")
    .map(([key, value]) => `  ${style.dim(pad(key, width))} ${value}`)
    .join("\n");
}

export function heading(text: string): string {
  return `\n${style.bold(text)}`;
}

export function success(text: string): string {
  return style.green(`�o" ${text}`);
}

export function failure(text: string): string {
  return style.red(`�o- ${text}`);
}

export function warn(text: string): string {
  return style.yellow(`! ${text}`);
}

export function info(text: string): string {
  return style.cyan(`�+' ${text}`);
}

export function formatDuration(ms: number): string {
  if (ms < 1000) return `${Math.round(ms)}ms`;
  return `${(ms / 1000).toFixed(2)}s`;
}

export function formatTime(epochMs: number): string {
  return new Date(epochMs).toISOString().replace("T", " ").replace("Z", " UTC");
}

export function clockTime(epochMs: number): string {
  return new Date(epochMs).toISOString().slice(11, 23);
}

export function terminalWidth(): number {
  const columns = process.stdout.columns ?? 120;
  return Math.max(60, Math.min(columns, 200));
}

export function clearScreen(): void {
  if (!process.stdout.isTTY) return;
  process.stdout.write("\u001b[2J\u001b[3J\u001b[H");
}

export function hideCursor(): void {
  if (process.stdout.isTTY) process.stdout.write("\u001b[?25l");
}

export function showCursor(): void {
  if (process.stdout.isTTY) process.stdout.write("\u001b[?25h");
}

export function moveHome(): void {
  if (process.stdout.isTTY) process.stdout.write("\u001b[H");
}

export function truncate(text: string, width: number): string {
  if (visibleLength(text) <= width) return text;
  return `${text.slice(0, Math.max(0, width - 1))}�?�`;
}

47:         flags[body] = true;
48:       }
49:       continue;
50:     }
51: 
52:     if (token.startsWith("-") && token.length > 1) {
53:       const body = token.slice(1);
54:       const next = rest[index + 1];
55:       if (BOOLEAN_FLAGS.has(body)) {
56:         flags[body] = true;
57:       } else if (next !== undefined && !next.startsWith("-")) {
58:         flags[body] = next;
59:         index += 1;
60:       } else {
61:         flags[body] = true;
62:       }
63:       continue;
64:     }
65: 
66:     positionals.push(token);
67:   }
68: 
69:   return { command, positionals, flags };
70: }
71: 
72: export function boolFlag(parsed: ParsedArgs, name: string): boolean {
73:   return parsed.flags[name] === true || parsed.flags[name] === "true";
74: }
75: 
76: export function stringFlag(parsed: ParsedArgs, name: string, fallback: string): string {
77:   const value = parsed.flags[name];
78:   return typeof value === "string" ? value : fallback;
79: }
80: 
81: export function numberFlag(parsed: ParsedArgs, name: string, fallback: number): number {
82:   const value = parsed.flags[name];
83:   if (typeof value !== "string") return fallback;
84:   const parsedValue = Number(value);
85:   return Number.isFinite(parsedValue) ? parsedValue : fallback;
86: }

1: # open-trader
2: 
3: Terminal trading system for the **Exness Trader API**. Phase 1 (connection +
4: market data), Phase 2 (live monitoring dashboard) and Phase 3 (broker-side
5: trading tools + deterministic agents) are implemented.
6: 
7: The agents are **plain TypeScript rules**, not an LLM: at every M15 close a
8: screener ranks the whole instrument universe using H1 EMA50/EMA200 trend and an
9: M15 RSI/EMA50 pullback, an entry agent requires the M15 confirmation candle to
10: close in the trend direction, and a risk executor sizes the trade, places a
11: distant emergency stop, and manages a program-side virtual trailing stop. There
12: is no take-profit. `agent` is dry-run by default; only `--live` sends orders.
13: 
14: ```
15: open-trader · DEMO
16:   BALANCE / EQUITY / FREE MARGIN / POSITIONS
17:   SCREENER · ENTRY · TRADER        (side-by-side containers)
18:   AGENT LOG                        (what each agent is doing)
19:   POSITIONS                        (all open lots, live price, emergency SL, age)
20:   ACCOUNT · MARKET · RISK
21:   EQUITY / DRAWDOWN                (line charts, side by side)
22:   EVENTS · ORDERS                  (side by side)
23: ```
24: 
25: ## Quick start
26: 
27: ```powershell
28: npm install
29: npm run doctor
30: npm start                         # full-screen dashboard
31: ```
32: 
33: In a second terminal, start the agents:
34: 
35: ```powershell
36: npm run trade                     # same as: bin\ot.cmd agent --live
37: npm run scan                      # same as: bin\ot.cmd agent --once (read-only)
38: bin\ot.cmd agent --live --for 120 # bounded live session
39: ```
40: 
41: The agent scans at M15 boundaries (+3 seconds). Override the cadence only for
42: testing with `--scan <seconds>`; doing so disables boundary alignment.
43: 
44: `npm start` is the dashboard only. The dashboard reads
45: `.cache/agent-state.json`; the three containers and the activity log stay
46: populated while the agent runs, and show the last session (plus an `agent idle`
47: hint) when it is stopped.
48: 
49: `.env` must contain:
50: 
51: ```ini
52: EXNESS_API_KEY=exnsk-...
53: EXNESS_PRIVATE_KEY=...            # 128-char hex key pair, 64-char hex seed, or PEM
54: EXNESS_ACCOUNT_ID=31000172947
55: EXNESS_DISCOVERY_URL=https://api.exness.com
56: ```
57: 
58: `EXNESS_API_SECRET` is still accepted as a fallback name for the private key.
59: 
60: ## Dashboard keys
61: 
62: The board is rendered as a scrollable viewport, so every section is available
63: even in a short terminal. The footer is pinned at the bottom.
64: 
65: | Key | Action |
66: | --- | --- |
67: | `q` / `Ctrl+C` | quit |
68: | `p` | pause / resume account polling |
69: | `a` | show / hide agent containers + log |
70: | `c` | show / hide equity + drawdown charts |
71: | `o` | show / hide orders |
72: | `e` | show / hide events |
73: | `r` | force a fresh REST snapshot |
74: | `x`, then `y` | arm / confirm kill switch: block entries + close every position (`n` cancels) |
75: | `↑` / `↓`, `j` / `k` | scroll one line |
76: | `PgUp` / `PgDn` | scroll ten lines |
77: | `g` / `G` | jump to top / bottom |
78: 
79: The kill switch is persisted in `.cache/KILL`. While it is on, the running agent
80: closes every open position (including positions it did not open) and refuses new
81: entries. Use `bin\ot.cmd unkill` to remove the flag. `bin\ot.cmd kill` does both
82: steps from one command even when the dashboard is not running.
83: 
84: ## Commands
85: 
86: > `npm run` on Windows silently drops `--flag value` arguments. For anything with
87: > options, use the wrapper: `bin\ot.cmd ...` (or `npx tsx src/cli/index.ts ...`).
88: 
89: | Command | What it does |
90: | --- | --- |
91: | `npm start` / `bin\ot.cmd dashboard` | full-screen dashboard; `--once` renders one frame |
92: | `bin\ot.cmd doctor` | discovery → account → catalog → snapshot → candles → live ticks |
93: | `bin\ot.cmd account` | account profile, mode, currency, leverage, access point |
94: | `bin\ot.cmd snapshot` | balance, equity, margins, positions and active orders |
95: | `bin\ot.cmd monitor positions` | one-shot positions, live quotes where available |
96: | `bin\ot.cmd monitor pnl --days 3` | equity chart + drawdown from the daily log |
97: | `bin\ot.cmd monitor risk` | daily loss cap, margin, exposure, kill switch |
98: | `bin\ot.cmd monitor agent` | persisted agent state and trade log |
99: | `bin\ot.cmd monitor log --once` | replay the persisted event log |
100: | `bin\ot.cmd monitor all --json` | machine-readable aggregate |
101: | `npm run scan` / `bin\ot.cmd agent --once` | read-only screener scan; prints candidates + diagnostics |
102: | `npm run trade` / `bin\ot.cmd agent --live` | continuous M15 screener → entry → risk, sends orders |
103: | `bin\ot.cmd agent --live --for 120` | bounded live session |
104: | `bin\ot.cmd agent --live --scan 15` | override scan cadence for testing (seconds) |
105: | `bin\ot.cmd agent --live --symbols EURUSD,XAUUSD` | restrict the universe |
106: | `npm run kill` / `bin\ot.cmd kill` | block entries and close every open position |
107: | `npm run unkill` / `bin\ot.cmd unkill` | remove `.cache/KILL`; entries allowed again |
108: | `bin\ot.cmd instruments --fx --search EUR` | instrument catalog (335 total, 175 FX) |
109: | `bin\ot.cmd candles EURUSD --tf M5 --count 60` | OHLC table + sparkline |
110: | `bin\ot.cmd ticker EURUSD XAUUSD --for 15` | live bid/ask, spread, tick count, age |
111: | `bin\ot.cmd watch --search JPY --limit 15` | live board, sorted by change |
112: | `bin\ot.cmd limits` | REST + WebSocket rate limits |
113: | `bin\ot.cmd events --for 30` | stream account/transaction/instrument events |
114: 
115: Global flags: `--verbose`, `--no-color`, `--json`.
116: 
117: Tests and typecheck:
118: 
119: ```powershell
120: npm test
121: npm run typecheck
122: ```
123: 
124: ## Agents
125: 
126: | Agent | Responsibility |
127: | --- | --- |
128: | **Screener** | Runs at each M15 close. Prefilters all account instruments by fresh quote + spread, fetches M15 and H1 candles for the best 50, then requires: H1 EMA50 above/below EMA200 (trend), M15 RSI 30–70, price within 1.25×ATR of M15 EMA50, ATR in range, FX spread ≤ 6 pips (non-FX spread ≤ 0.10%), and spread cost ≤ 45% of the virtual trail. |
129: | **Entry** | Requires the last **closed** M15 candle to be bullish for a buy / bearish for a sell. Rejects stale quotes, wide spreads, a spread that eats the trail, chasing > 1.25×ATR, and a non-confirming candle. Computes the emergency stop from 3×ATR and the virtual trail from 2×ATR (minimum 8 pips). No TP. |
130: | **Risk / trader** | Sizes 1% of virtual equity from the entry-to-emergency-stop distance, opens a market order with the emergency SL, then manages a **program-side virtual trailing stop**. It closes at the virtual stop, refreshes trail distance every M15 close, adopts agent-owned orphans, reconciles on restart, retries a missing emergency SLTP, and persists state. |
131: 
132: Important behaviour:
133: 
134: - **Universe = all instruments** the account can trade (335 here: FX, metals,
135:   indices, crypto, stocks, other). No symbol is hard-coded; the screener decides.
136: - **Two positions at a time** by default (`AGENT_MAX_POSITIONS=2`) and one per
137:   symbol. Each position risks 1%; raise this deliberately, never by accident.
138: - **Two protection layers.** The broker-side emergency SL is 3×ATR and is only a
139:   crash fallback. The normal exit is the virtual stop in code; it never moves
140:   backward and is checked on every manage tick.
141: - **No take-profit, no TP1, no partial close, no breakeven, no hard-stop TP.**
142:   Winners are managed only by the virtual trail.
143: - **One instrument per WebSocket subscription message**, token-bucketed at about
144:   20/s. Bad symbols are dropped individually with `4000`, not in batches.
145: - **Async execution** — the gateway subscribes to `/ws/events` before sending an
146:   order and correlates ACK / `transaction_event` by `client_request_id`, with
147:   operation polling as a fallback.
148: - **Watchdog** — the agent logs feed stalls; a closed/wedged tick socket is
149:   restarted after 45 seconds and resubscribed.
150: - **Kill switch** — `.cache/KILL` blocks entries and makes the agent close all
151:   account positions; `ot kill` performs both immediately.
152: 
153: ### Risk defaults
154: 
155: | Setting | Value |
156: | --- | --- |
157: | Virtual equity for sizing | 10,000 USD (`EXNESS_VIRTUAL_EQUITY`) |
158: | Risk per trade | 1.0% (`AGENT_RISK_PCT`) |
159: | Max lots per trade | 0.5 (`AGENT_MAX_LOTS`) |
160: | Max positions | 2 (`AGENT_MAX_POSITIONS`) |
161: | Max per symbol | 1 (`AGENT_MAX_PER_SYMBOL`) |
162: | Daily loss cap | 2% ≈ 200 USD (`AGENT_MAX_DAILY_LOSS_PCT`) |
163: | Consecutive-loss cooldown | 3 losses → 4 hours |
164: | FX spread limit | 6.0 pips (`AGENT_MAX_SPREAD_PIPS`) |
165: | Non-FX spread limit | 0.10% (`AGENT_MAX_SPREAD_PCT`) |
166: | Spread cost cap | ≤ 45% of trail distance (`AGENT_MAX_SPREAD_TRAIL`) |
167: | Emergency broker stop | 3×M15 ATR, minimum 1 pip / 3× spread |
168: | Virtual trail | max(2×M15 ATR, 8 pips) (`AGENT_TRAIL_ATR`, `AGENT_TRAIL_MIN_PIPS`) |
169: | RSI band | 30–70 (`AGENT_RSI_MIN`, `AGENT_RSI_MAX`) |
170: | Pullback to EMA50 | ≤ 1.25×ATR (`AGENT_PULLBACK_ATR`) |
171: | H1 trend separation | ≥ 0.02×H1 ATR (`AGENT_MIN_TREND_ATR`) |
172: | Max quote age | 30 s (`AGENT_MAX_QUOTE_AGE_MS`) |
173: | Margin buffer | ×3 |
174: 
175: Trailing example: entry `1.0850`, initial virtual stop = emergency `1.0820`
176: (3×ATR). At `1.0900` the virtual stop becomes `1.0880`; at `1.0930` it becomes
177: `1.0910`; if price falls back to `1.0920`, the stop stays at `1.0910`. A buy
178: closes when bid ≤ virtual stop; a sell closes when ask ≥ virtual stop. The broker
179: emergency SL is **not** moved during normal trailing.
180: 
181: Agent state and audit trail:
182: 
183: ```
184: .cache/agent-state.json           managed positions, emergency SL/virtual stop, stats, journal
185: .cache/trades/YYYY-MM-DD.jsonl    open / trail / close / skip / error events
186: .cache/equity/YYYY-MM-DD.jsonl    equity samples for charts
187: .cache/events/YYYY-MM-DD.jsonl    raw runtime events
188: .cache/KILL                       persistent kill switch flag
189: ```
190: 
191: ## How it works
192: 
193: ```
194: src/
195: ├─ config.ts              .env loading (no dotenv) + validation
196: ├─ exness/
197: │  ├─ signing.ts          hex/PEM → Ed25519 key, EXN-DATA + EXN-SIGN headers
198: │  ├─ client.ts           access-point discovery + cache, signed REST, retry, rate limit
199: │  ├─ ws.ts               signed WebSocket handshake, heartbeat, reconnect + resubscribe
200: │  ├─ catalog.ts          instrument catalog + per-instrument conditions (cached)
201: │  └─ types.ts            subset of trading.public.yaml v1.0.2
202: ├─ market/
203: │  ├─ candles.ts          candle normalisation + pip/point helpers
204: │  ├─ indicators.ts       EMA/SMA/RSI/ATR
205: │  └─ store.ts            last tick per symbol, quotes, formatting
206: ├─ runtime/
207: │  ├─ hubs.ts             TickHub / EventHub, one-instrument subscriptions, token bucket
208: │  ├─ snapshot.ts         account snapshot cache (1200 ms TTL, invalidate)
209: │  └─ execution.ts        ACK/event correlation, operation polling, order gateway
210: ├─ tools/
211: │  ├─ index.ts            read-only account/catalog/candle tools
212: │  └─ trading.ts          open / patch-or-create SLTP / close, digits cache
213: ├─ monitor/equity.ts      daily equity samples + start balance
214: ├─ agents/
215: │  ├─ config.ts           thresholds and risk limits
216: │  ├─ screener.ts         H1 trend + M15 pullback + spread prefilter/ranking
217: │  ├─ entry.ts            M15 confirmation gate, 3×ATR emergency stop, 2×ATR trail
218: │  ├─ spread.ts           FX pip limit / non-FX percentage limit
219: │  ├─ risk-and-executor.ts sizing, gating, virtual trailing, adoption, kill close
220: │  ├─ engine.ts           M15 scan loop, manage loop, watchdog, state writer
221: │  ├─ journal.ts          per-agent activity feed for the dashboard
222: │  └─ trailing.ts         pure virtual stop / best-price / hit math
223: └─ cli/                   args, ANSI rendering, charts, commands, dashboard
224: ```
225: 
226: Behaviour worth knowing:
227: 
228: - **Signing** — `EXN-DATA` is serialized once; those exact bytes are signed and
229:   base64url-encoded (no padding) into `EXN-DATA`, with the Ed25519 signature in
230:   `EXN-SIGN`. `body_hash` is SHA-256 of the exact body.
231: - **Discovery** — `GET /v1/trading/access-point?account_id=…` against
232:   `EXNESS_DISCOVERY_URL`. The result is cached for 10 minutes and re-resolved
233:   once on a `401`.
234: - **Rate limits** — per-route sliding windows (candles 2/s, snapshot 2/s, orders
235:   4/s, global 10/s) plus `Retry-After` on `429`. Tick subscriptions use a
236:   separate 20/s token bucket; ticks are subscribed one instrument per message.
237: - **Money and volume are decimal strings** in requests/responses; only display
238:   formatting uses numbers, with `point_digits` from instrument conditions.
239: - **State is on disk** so a restarted agent re-adopts open positions from the
240:   trade log and `.cache/agent-state.json` instead of leaving them unmanaged. A
241:   virtual stop, best price, trail distance and emergency SL are persisted so a
242:   restart resumes the same protection rather than resetting it.
243: - **Reconciliation** — managed positions missing from the broker are finalized
244:   after two snapshot misses and a short grace period; positions opened by the
245:   agent but missing from memory are adopted from the trade log; positions the
246:   agent did not open are left alone unless the kill switch is active.
247:

79: /**

84: export class MomentumTracker {
85:   private readonly samples = new Map<string, MomentumSample[]>();
86: 
87:   observe(quote: Quote): void {
88:     const series = this.samples.get(quote.symbol) ?? [];
89:     const last = series[series.length - 1];
90:     if (last && quote.timestamp - last.t < SAMPLE_INTERVAL_MS) {
91:       last.mid = quote.mid;
92:       last.t = quote.timestamp;
93:       return;
94:     }
95:     series.push({ t: quote.timestamp, mid: quote.mid });
96:     const cutoff = quote.timestamp - MOMENTUM_WINDOW_MS;
97:     while (series.length > 1 && series[0]!.t < cutoff) series.shift();
98:     this.samples.set(quote.symbol, series);
99:   }
100: 
101:   changePct(symbol: string, minutes: number): number | null {
102:     const series = this.samples.get(symbol);
103:     if (!series || series.length < 2) return null;
104:     const latest = series[series.length - 1]!;
105:     const target = latest.t - minutes * 60_000;
106:     if (latest.t - series[0]!.t < minutes * 60_000 * 0.75) return null;
107: 
108:     let reference: MomentumSample | undefined;
109:     for (const sample of series) {
110:       if (sample.t <= target) reference = sample;
111:       else break;
112:     }
113:     reference ??= series[0]!;
114:     if (reference.mid === 0) return null;
115:     return ((latest.mid - reference.mid) / reference.mid) * 100;
116:   }
117: 
118:   size(): number {
119:     return this.samples.size;
120:   }

133: /**
134:  * Pure candle scoring:
135:  *
136:  *   1. trend EMA50 above/below EMA200 -> trend direction
137:  *   2. screener RSI in the middle band and price near screener EMA50
138:  *   3. spread below the limit and cheap relative to the virtual trail
139:  *
140:  * No take-profit and no momentum hard gate.
141:  */
142: export function scoreCandidate(input: CandleScoreInput): Candidate | null {
143:   const { symbol, screener, trend, quote, options } = input;
144:   if (screener.length < 60 || trend.length < 210) return null;
145: 
146:   const trendCloses = closes(trend);
147:   const trendEma50 = lastFinite(ema(trendCloses, 50));
148:   const trendEma200 = lastFinite(ema(trendCloses, 200));
149:   const trendAtrValue = lastFinite(atr(trend, 14));
150:   if (
151:     trendEma50 === undefined ||
152:     trendEma200 === undefined ||
153:     trendAtrValue === undefined ||
154:     trendAtrValue <= 0
155:   ) {
156:     return null;
157:   }
158: 
159:   const trendSeparation = (trendEma50 - trendEma200) / trendAtrValue;
160:   if (Math.abs(trendSeparation) < options.minTrendAtr) return null;
161:   const direction: Direction = trendSeparation > 0 ? "buy" : "sell";
162:   const sign = direction === "buy" ? 1 : -1;
163:   const trendAtr = trendSeparation * sign;
164: 
165:   const screenerCloses = closes(screener);
166:   const screenerEma50 = lastFinite(ema(screenerCloses, 50));
167:   const screenerAtr = lastFinite(atr(screener, 14));
168:   const screenerRsi = lastFinite(rsi(screenerCloses, 14));
169:   const close = screenerCloses[screenerCloses.length - 1];
170:   if (
171:     screenerEma50 === undefined ||
172:     screenerAtr === undefined ||
173:     screenerAtr <= 0 ||
174:     screenerRsi === undefined ||
175:     close === undefined
176:   ) {
177:     return null;
178:   }
179: 
180:   // Pullback zone: RSI in the middle of its range, price near EMA50.
181:   if (screenerRsi < options.rsiMin || screenerRsi > options.rsiMax) return null;
182:   const distanceAtr = (close - screenerEma50) / screenerAtr;
183:   if (Math.abs(distanceAtr) > options.pullbackDistanceAtr) return null;
184: 
185:   const atrPct = atrPercent(screener, screenerAtr);
186:   if (atrPct < options.minAtrPct || atrPct > options.maxAtrPct) return null;
187:   if (!spreadWithinLimit(symbol, quote, options)) return null;
188: 
189:   // Spread is a real cost, not just a screen: rejecting an edge that is mostly
190:   // eaten by the spread is what keeps a more aggressive scan profitable.
191:   const trailDistance = trailDistanceFromAtr(
192:     screenerAtr,
193:     options.trailAtrFactor,
194:     options.trailMinPips * pipSize(symbol),
195:   );
196:   const spreadRatio = trailDistance > 0 ? quote.spread / trailDistance : Number.POSITIVE_INFINITY;
197:   if (!Number.isFinite(spreadRatio) || spreadRatio > options.maxSpreadTrailRatio) return null;
198: 
199:   const trendScore = clamp(trendAtr / 1.2, 0, 1) * 40;
200:   const pullbackScore =
201:     clamp(1 - Math.abs(distanceAtr) / Math.max(options.pullbackDistanceAtr, 1e-9), 0, 1) * 25;
202:   const rsiScore = clamp(1 - Math.abs(screenerRsi - 50) / 10, 0, 1) * 20;
203:   const spreadScore = spreadQuality(symbol, quote, options) * 15;
204:   const score = trendScore + pullbackScore + rsiScore + spreadScore;
205:   if (score < options.minScore) return null;
206: 
207:   const reasons = [
208:     `${options.trendTimeframe} ${direction === "buy" ? "uptrend" : "downtrend"} ${trendAtr.toFixed(2)}×ATR`,
209:     `pullback ${distanceAtr.toFixed(2)}×ATR`,
210:     `RSI ${screenerRsi.toFixed(0)}`,
211:     `spread ${spreadLabel(symbol, quote)}`,
212:     `ATR ${atrPct.toFixed(3)}%`,
213:     `cost ${(spreadRatio * 100).toFixed(0)}% trail`,
214:   ];
215: 
216:   return {
217:     symbol,
218:     direction,
219:     score,
220:     price: close,
221:     spreadPct: quote.spreadPct,
222:     spreadPips: spreadPips(symbol, quote),
223:     atr: screenerAtr,
224:     atrPct,
225:     spreadRatio,
226:     ema50: screenerEma50,
227:     trendEma50,
228:     trendEma200,
229:     rsi: screenerRsi,
230:     trendAtr,
231:     trendAtrValue,
232:     distanceAtr,
233:     reasons,
234:     candles: screener,
235:   };

277:   async scan(universe: string[]): Promise<Candidate[]> {
278:     const started = Date.now();
279:     this.lastScanAt = started;
280: 
281:     const now = Date.now();
282:     type Pre = { quote: Quote; mom5: number | null; prelim: number };
283:     const pre: Pre[] = [];
284:     let withQuote = 0;
285:     let fresh = 0;
286: 
287:     for (const symbol of universe) {
288:       const quote = this.ticks.get(symbol);
289:       if (!quote) continue;
290:       withQuote += 1;
291:       if (now - quote.timestamp > this.options.maxQuoteAgeMs) continue;
292:       fresh += 1;
293:       if (!spreadWithinLimit(symbol, quote, this.options)) continue;
294: 
295:       const mom5 = this.momentum.changePct(symbol, 5);
296:       const activity = clamp(quote.ticks / 20, 0, 1);
297:       const move = mom5 === null ? 0.35 : clamp(Math.abs(mom5) / 0.08, 0, 1);
298:       const prelim =
299:         spreadQuality(symbol, quote, this.options) * 60 + activity * 20 + move * 20;
300:       pre.push({ quote, mom5, prelim });
301:     }
302: 
303:     pre.sort((a, b) => b.prelim - a.prelim);
304:     const shortlist = pre.slice(0, this.options.shortlistSize);
305: 
306:     const candidates: Candidate[] = [];
307:     let candleFails = 0;
308:     let scored = 0;
309:     for (const entry of shortlist) {
310:       const symbol = entry.quote.symbol;
311:       const screenerResult = await this.tools.get_candles({
312:         symbol,
313:         timeframe: this.options.screenerTimeframe,
314:         n: 180,
315:       });
316:       const trendResult = await this.tools.get_candles({
317:         symbol,
318:         timeframe: this.options.trendTimeframe,
319:         n: 260,
320:       });
321:       if (!screenerResult.ok || !trendResult.ok) {
322:         candleFails += 1;
323:         continue;
324:       }
325: 
326:       const screener = dropFormingCandle(
327:         screenerResult.data,
328:         timeframeMs(this.options.screenerTimeframe),
329:         now,
330:       );
331:       const trend = dropFormingCandle(
332:         trendResult.data,
333:         timeframeMs(this.options.trendTimeframe),
334:         now,
335:       );
336:       if (screener.length < 60 || trend.length < 210) {
337:         candleFails += 1;
338:         continue;
339:       }
340: 
341:       scored += 1;
342:       const candidate = scoreCandidate({
343:         symbol,
344:         screener,
345:         trend,
346:         quote: entry.quote,
347:         options: this.options,
348:       });
349:       if (candidate) candidates.push(candidate);
350:     }
351: 
352:     candidates.sort((a, b) => b.score - a.score);
353:     this.lastScanDurationMs = Date.now() - started;
354:     const capped = candidates.slice(0, this.options.maxCandidates);
355:     this.lastDiagnostics = {
356:       universe: universe.length,
357:       withQuote,
358:       fresh,
359:       prefiltered: pre.length,
360:       shortlist: shortlist.length,
361:       candleFails,
362:       scored,
363:       passed: capped.length,
364:       top: shortlist.slice(0, 6).map((entry) => ({
365:         symbol: entry.quote.symbol,
366:         prelim: Number(entry.prelim.toFixed(1)),
367:         spreadPips: Number(spreadPips(entry.quote.symbol, entry.quote).toFixed(2)),
368:         mom5: entry.mom5 === null ? null : Number(entry.mom5.toFixed(3)),
369:       })),

371:     return capped;
372:   }
373: }

53:  * The screener has already checked the trend EMA50/EMA200, screener RSI,
54:  * distance to screener EMA50, ATR range and spread. Entry has one job: require
55:  * the last closed confirmation candle to agree with the trend direction, then
56:  * derive the broker emergency stop from the higher-timeframe ATR and the
57:  * virtual trail from the faster ATR. There is deliberately no take-profit.
58:  */
59: export function decideEntry(input: {
60:   candidate: Candidate;
61:   quote: Quote;

88:   }

4. `maxSpreadPct` 0.1 for non-FX: 0.1% is tight for crypto? BTC spread 0.01-0.05%, okay; indices maybe 0.02; stocks maybe 0.1. fine.
5. `rsiMin 30`, `rsiMax 70`: RSI score `1 - |rsi-50|/10` means RSI 30 gives 0; RSI 40 gives 0. rsi 50 gives 20. This biases to center. Good.
6. Score max: trend 40 + pullback 25 + rsi 20 + spread 15 = 100. Min 28. `trendAtr` min 0.02 gives trend score 0.67; pullback could 25; RSI 20; spread 15 => 60. So min 28 is easy. Aggressive.

8. `screener.length <60` for M1 = 60 min; okay.
9. `trend.length <210` = 52.5h.
10. The scan requests 180 M1 + 260 M15 per shortlisted symbol. At 50 shortlist, 100 requests at 2/s = 50s. Recent scans 7–9 full passes maybe 14–18 requests. Fine.
11. `maxQuoteAgeMs` 15s; scan uses `now` at start, not per candidate. For candidates late in scan, quote could be 30s old relative to entry check, which rejects. Entry `now` is current time; quote timestamp from scan start; if scan takes 30s, quote age > 15s -> rejects late candidates. That's a quality issue! Recent scan duration maybe 10-20s. The shortlist is processed sequentially; the last candidates' quotes are from scan start, 20s old, so `decideEntry` rejects them as stale. This reduces frequency and biases to first candidates (highest prelim, not score). Fix: refresh quote per candidate before entry, or use `ticks.get(symbol)` in engine entry step. Need inspect engine `scanAndEnter` to see.

1: # open-trader
2: 
3: Terminal trading system for the **Exness Trader API**. Phase 1 (connection +
4: market data), Phase 2 (live monitoring dashboard) and Phase 3 (broker-side
5: trading tools + deterministic agents) are implemented.
6: 
7: The agents are **plain TypeScript rules**, not an LLM: at every M15 close a
8: screener ranks the whole instrument universe using H1 EMA50/EMA200 trend and an
9: M15 RSI/EMA50 pullback, an entry agent requires the M15 confirmation candle to
10: close in the trend direction, and a risk executor sizes the trade, places a
11: distant emergency stop, and manages a program-side virtual trailing stop. There
12: is no take-profit. `agent` is dry-run by default; only `--live` sends orders.
13: 
14: ```
15: open-trader · DEMO
16:   BALANCE / EQUITY / FREE MARGIN / POSITIONS
17:   SCREENER · ENTRY · TRADER        (side-by-side containers)
18:   AGENT LOG                        (what each agent is doing)
19:   POSITIONS                        (all open lots, live price, emergency SL, age)
20:   ACCOUNT · MARKET · RISK
21:   EQUITY / DRAWDOWN                (line charts, side by side)
22:   EVENTS · ORDERS                  (side by side)
23: ```
24: 
25: ## Quick start
26: 
27: ```powershell
28: npm install
29: npm run doctor
30: npm start                         # full-screen dashboard
31: ```
32: 
33: In a second terminal, start the agents:
34: 
35: ```powershell
36: npm run trade                     # same as: bin\ot.cmd agent --live
37: npm run scan                      # same as: bin\ot.cmd agent --once (read-only)
38: bin\ot.cmd agent --live --for 120 # bounded live session
39: ```
40: 
41: The agent scans at M15 boundaries (+3 seconds). Override the cadence only for
42: testing with `--scan <seconds>`; doing so disables boundary alignment.
43: 
44: `npm start` is the dashboard only. The dashboard reads
45: `.cache/agent-state.json`; the three containers and the activity log stay
46: populated while the agent runs, and show the last session (plus an `agent idle`
47: hint) when it is stopped.
48: 
49: `.env` must contain:
50: 
51: ```ini
52: EXNESS_API_KEY=exnsk-...
53: EXNESS_PRIVATE_KEY=...            # 128-char hex key pair, 64-char hex seed, or PEM
54: EXNESS_ACCOUNT_ID=31000172947
55: EXNESS_DISCOVERY_URL=https://api.exness.com
56: ```
57: 
58: `EXNESS_API_SECRET` is still accepted as a fallback name for the private key.
59: 
60: ## Dashboard keys
61: 
62: The board is rendered as a scrollable viewport, so every section is available
63: even in a short terminal. The footer is pinned at the bottom.
64: 
65: | Key | Action |
66: | --- | --- |
67: | `q` / `Ctrl+C` | quit |
68: | `p` | pause / resume account polling |
69: | `a` | show / hide agent containers + log |
70: | `c` | show / hide equity + drawdown charts |
71: | `o` | show / hide orders |
72: | `e` | show / hide events |
73: | `r` | force a fresh REST snapshot |
74: | `x`, then `y` | arm / confirm kill switch: block entries + close every position (`n` cancels) |
75: | `↑` / `↓`, `j` / `k` | scroll one line |
76: | `PgUp` / `PgDn` | scroll ten lines |
77: | `g` / `G` | jump to top / bottom |
78: 
79: The kill switch is persisted in `.cache/KILL`. While it is on, the running agent
80: closes every open position (including positions it did not open) and refuses new
81: entries. Use `bin\ot.cmd unkill` to remove the flag. `bin\ot.cmd kill` does both
82: steps from one command even when the dashboard is not running.
83: 
84: ## Commands
85: 
86: > `npm run` on Windows silently drops `--flag value` arguments. For anything with
87: > options, use the wrapper: `bin\ot.cmd ...` (or `npx tsx src/cli/index.ts ...`).
88: 
89: | Command | What it does |
90: | --- | --- |
91: | `npm start` / `bin\ot.cmd dashboard` | full-screen dashboard; `--once` renders one frame |
92: | `bin\ot.cmd doctor` | discovery → account → catalog → snapshot → candles → live ticks |
93: | `bin\ot.cmd account` | account profile, mode, currency, leverage, access point |
94: | `bin\ot.cmd snapshot` | balance, equity, margins, positions and active orders |
95: | `bin\ot.cmd monitor positions` | one-shot positions, live quotes where available |
96: | `bin\ot.cmd monitor pnl --days 3` | equity chart + drawdown from the daily log |
97: | `bin\ot.cmd monitor risk` | daily loss cap, margin, exposure, kill switch |
98: | `bin\ot.cmd monitor agent` | persisted agent state and trade log |
99: | `bin\ot.cmd monitor log --once` | replay the persisted event log |
100: | `bin\ot.cmd monitor all --json` | machine-readable aggregate |
101: | `npm run scan` / `bin\ot.cmd agent --once` | read-only screener scan; prints candidates + diagnostics |
102: | `npm run trade` / `bin\ot.cmd agent --live` | continuous M15 screener → entry → risk, sends orders |
103: | `bin\ot.cmd agent --live --for 120` | bounded live session |
104: | `bin\ot.cmd agent --live --scan 15` | override scan cadence for testing (seconds) |
105: | `bin\ot.cmd agent --live --symbols EURUSD,XAUUSD` | restrict the universe |
106: | `npm run kill` / `bin\ot.cmd kill` | block entries and close every open position |
107: | `npm run unkill` / `bin\ot.cmd unkill` | remove `.cache/KILL`; entries allowed again |
108: | `bin\ot.cmd instruments --fx --search EUR` | instrument catalog (335 total, 175 FX) |
109: | `bin\ot.cmd candles EURUSD --tf M5 --count 60` | OHLC table + sparkline |
110: | `bin\ot.cmd ticker EURUSD XAUUSD --for 15` | live bid/ask, spread, tick count, age |
111: | `bin\ot.cmd watch --search JPY --limit 15` | live board, sorted by change |
112: | `bin\ot.cmd limits` | REST + WebSocket rate limits |
113: | `bin\ot.cmd events --for 30` | stream account/transaction/instrument events |
114: 
115: Global flags: `--verbose`, `--no-color`, `--json`.
116: 
117: Tests and typecheck:
118: 
119: ```powershell
120: npm test
121: npm run typecheck
122: ```
123: 
124: ## Agents
125: 
126: | Agent | Responsibility |
127: | --- | --- |
128: | **Screener** | Runs at each M15 close. Prefilters all account instruments by fresh quote + spread, fetches M15 and H1 candles for the best 50, then requires: H1 EMA50 above/below EMA200 (trend), M15 RSI 30–70, price within 1.25×ATR of M15 EMA50, ATR in range, FX spread ≤ 6 pips (non-FX spread ≤ 0.10%), and spread cost ≤ 45% of the virtual trail. |
129: | **Entry** | Requires the last **closed** M15 candle to be bullish for a buy / bearish for a sell. Rejects stale quotes, wide spreads, a spread that eats the trail, chasing > 1.25×ATR, and a non-confirming candle. Computes the emergency stop from 3×ATR and the virtual trail from 2×ATR (minimum 8 pips). No TP. |
130: | **Risk / trader** | Sizes 1% of virtual equity from the entry-to-emergency-stop distance, opens a market order with the emergency SL, then manages a **program-side virtual trailing stop**. It closes at the virtual stop, refreshes trail distance every M15 close, adopts agent-owned orphans, reconciles on restart, retries a missing emergency SLTP, and persists state. |
131: 
132: Important behaviour:
133: 
134: - **Universe = all instruments** the account can trade (335 here: FX, metals,
135:   indices, crypto, stocks, other). No symbol is hard-coded; the screener decides.
136: - **Two positions at a time** by default (`AGENT_MAX_POSITIONS=2`) and one per
137:   symbol. Each position risks 1%; raise this deliberately, never by accident.
138: - **Two protection layers.** The broker-side emergency SL is 3×ATR and is only a
139:   crash fallback. The normal exit is the virtual stop in code; it never moves
140:   backward and is checked on every manage tick.
141: - **No take-profit, no TP1, no partial close, no breakeven, no hard-stop TP.**
142:   Winners are managed only by the virtual trail.
143: - **One instrument per WebSocket subscription message**, token-bucketed at about
144:   20/s. Bad symbols are dropped individually with `4000`, not in batches.
145: - **Async execution** — the gateway subscribes to `/ws/events` before sending an
146:   order and correlates ACK / `transaction_event` by `client_request_id`, with
147:   operation polling as a fallback.
148: - **Watchdog** — the agent logs feed stalls; a closed/wedged tick socket is
149:   restarted after 45 seconds and resubscribed.
150: - **Kill switch** — `.cache/KILL` blocks entries and makes the agent close all
151:   account positions; `ot kill` performs both immediately.
152: 
153: ### Risk defaults
154: 
155: | Setting | Value |
156: | --- | --- |
157: | Virtual equity for sizing | 10,000 USD (`EXNESS_VIRTUAL_EQUITY`) |
158: | Risk per trade | 1.0% (`AGENT_RISK_PCT`) |
159: | Max lots per trade | 0.5 (`AGENT_MAX_LOTS`) |
160: | Max positions | 2 (`AGENT_MAX_POSITIONS`) |
161: | Max per symbol | 1 (`AGENT_MAX_PER_SYMBOL`) |
162: | Daily loss cap | 2% ≈ 200 USD (`AGENT_MAX_DAILY_LOSS_PCT`) |
163: | Consecutive-loss cooldown | 3 losses → 4 hours |
164: | FX spread limit | 6.0 pips (`AGENT_MAX_SPREAD_PIPS`) |
165: | Non-FX spread limit | 0.10% (`AGENT_MAX_SPREAD_PCT`) |
166: | Spread cost cap | ≤ 45% of trail distance (`AGENT_MAX_SPREAD_TRAIL`) |
167: | Emergency broker stop | 3×M15 ATR, minimum 1 pip / 3× spread |
168: | Virtual trail | max(2×M15 ATR, 8 pips) (`AGENT_TRAIL_ATR`, `AGENT_TRAIL_MIN_PIPS`) |
169: | RSI band | 30–70 (`AGENT_RSI_MIN`, `AGENT_RSI_MAX`) |
170: | Pullback to EMA50 | ≤ 1.25×ATR (`AGENT_PULLBACK_ATR`) |
171: | H1 trend separation | ≥ 0.02×H1 ATR (`AGENT_MIN_TREND_ATR`) |
172: | Max quote age | 30 s (`AGENT_MAX_QUOTE_AGE_MS`) |
173: | Margin buffer | ×3 |
174: 
175: Trailing example: entry `1.0850`, initial virtual stop = emergency `1.0820`
176: (3×ATR). At `1.0900` the virtual stop becomes `1.0880`; at `1.0930` it becomes
177: `1.0910`; if price falls back to `1.0920`, the stop stays at `1.0910`. A buy
178: closes when bid ≤ virtual stop; a sell closes when ask ≥ virtual stop. The broker
179: emergency SL is **not** moved during normal trailing.
180: 
181: Agent state and audit trail:
182: 
183: ```
184: .cache/agent-state.json           managed positions, emergency SL/virtual stop, stats, journal
185: .cache/trades/YYYY-MM-DD.jsonl    open / trail / close / skip / error events
186: .cache/equity/YYYY-MM-DD.jsonl    equity samples for charts
187: .cache/events/YYYY-MM-DD.jsonl    raw runtime events
188: .cache/KILL                       persistent kill switch flag
189: ```
190: 
191: ## How it works
192: 
193: ```
194: src/
195: ├─ config.ts              .env loading (no dotenv) + validation
196: ├─ exness/
197: │  ├─ signing.ts          hex/PEM → Ed25519 key, EXN-DATA + EXN-SIGN headers
198: │  ├─ client.ts           access-point discovery + cache, signed REST, retry, rate limit
199: │  ├─ ws.ts               signed WebSocket handshake, heartbeat, reconnect + resubscribe
200: │  ├─ catalog.ts          instrument catalog + per-instrument conditions (cached)
201: │  └─ types.ts            subset of trading.public.yaml v1.0.2
202: ├─ market/
203: │  ├─ candles.ts          candle normalisation + pip/point helpers
204: │  ├─ indicators.ts       EMA/SMA/RSI/ATR
205: │  └─ store.ts            last tick per symbol, quotes, formatting
206: ├─ runtime/
207: │  ├─ hubs.ts             TickHub / EventHub, one-instrument subscriptions, token bucket
208: │  ├─ snapshot.ts         account snapshot cache (1200 ms TTL, invalidate)
209: │  └─ execution.ts        ACK/event correlation, operation polling, order gateway
210: ├─ tools/
211: │  ├─ index.ts            read-only account/catalog/candle tools
212: │  └─ trading.ts          open / patch-or-create SLTP / close, digits cache
213: ├─ monitor/equity.ts      daily equity samples + start balance
214: ├─ agents/
215: │  ├─ config.ts           thresholds and risk limits
216: │  ├─ screener.ts         H1 trend + M15 pullback + spread prefilter/ranking
217: │  ├─ entry.ts            M15 confirmation gate, 3×ATR emergency stop, 2×ATR trail
218: │  ├─ spread.ts           FX pip limit / non-FX percentage limit
219: │  ├─ risk-and-executor.ts sizing, gating, virtual trailing, adoption, kill close
220: │  ├─ engine.ts           M15 scan loop, manage loop, watchdog, state writer
221: │  ├─ journal.ts          per-agent activity feed for the dashboard
222: │  └─ trailing.ts         pure virtual stop / best-price / hit math
223: └─ cli/                   args, ANSI rendering, charts, commands, dashboard
224: ```
225: 
226: Behaviour worth knowing:
227: 
228: - **Signing** — `EXN-DATA` is serialized once; those exact bytes are signed and
229:   base64url-encoded (no padding) into `EXN-DATA`, with the Ed25519 signature in
230:   `EXN-SIGN`. `body_hash` is SHA-256 of the exact body.
231: - **Discovery** — `GET /v1/trading/access-point?account_id=…` against
232:   `EXNESS_DISCOVERY_URL`. The result is cached for 10 minutes and re-resolved
233:   once on a `401`.
234: - **Rate limits** — per-route sliding windows (candles 2/s, snapshot 2/s, orders
235:   4/s, global 10/s) plus `Retry-After` on `429`. Tick subscriptions use a
236:   separate 20/s token bucket; ticks are subscribed one instrument per message.
237: - **Money and volume are decimal strings** in requests/responses; only display
238:   formatting uses numbers, with `point_digits` from instrument conditions.
239: - **State is on disk** so a restarted agent re-adopts open positions from the
240:   trade log and `.cache/agent-state.json` instead of leaving them unmanaged. A
241:   virtual stop, best price, trail distance and emergency SL are persisted so a
242:   restart resumes the same protection rather than resetting it.
243: - **Reconciliation** — managed positions missing from the broker are finalized
244:   after two snapshot misses and a short grace period; positions opened by the
245:   agent but missing from memory are adopted from the trade log; positions the
246:   agent did not open are left alone unless the kill switch is active.
247: 
248: ## Roadmap
249: 
250: - Phase 1 (done) — connection, account state, catalog, candles, live ticks, limits.
251: - Phase 2 (done) — persists quotes/candles/equity, instrument metadata, screener,
252:   monitoring views and the full-screen dashboard.
253: - Phase 3 (done) — market entries, broker-side emergency SLTP, close, ACK
254:   correlation, deterministic screener/entry/risk agents, orphan adoption, state.
255: - Phase 4 (done) — terminal dashboard with per-agent containers, journal, charts,
256:   events/orders and scrollable hotkeys.
257: - Phase 5 (done) — M15 close screener, H1 trend, M15 confirmation entry,
258:   program-side virtual trailing, kill-all-close, watchdog.
259: - Next — backtest module reusing `advanceVirtualStop` + `decideEntry`, then tune
260:   ATR multipliers and the M15 pullback band on historical H1/M15 data.
261: 
262: ## Security
263: 
264: - `.env` holds a live signing key: it is gitignored, never bundled and only read
265:   locally. Do not paste it into chats, issues or screenshots.
266: - The wrapper and CLI print only a key prefix (`exnsk-4b7c8c44…`).
267: - Rotate the key in Exness Key Management if it was ever exposed, then update
268:   `.env`. Use a demo account while iterating.
269: 
270: ## Troubleshooting
271: 
272: | Symptom | Meaning |
273: | --- | --- |
274: | `401/1001` | Signature mismatch — key format, payload bytes, body hash or base64url padding. |
275: | `401/1000` | API key missing/expired, or `EXN-DATA.api_key` ≠ `EXN-API-KEY`. |
276: | `403/1002` | API key has no access to this account/IP/scope. |
277: | `404/2000` | Account not found for this key. |
278: | `400/3005` | `REQUEST_INVALID_COUNT` — candles need `count` or `to`, not just `from`. |
279: | `400/3015` | Request rate limit. The client backs off and retries 3015 before surfacing it; run one live agent at a time because the broker bucket is account-wide. |
280: | `400/4000` | `MARKET_INSTRUMENT_NOT_FOUND` — a catalog symbol is not subscribable; dropped individually. |
281: | `400/4001` | `MARKET_TRADE_DISABLED` — instrument is visible but not tradable; the agent logs and skips it. |
282: | `400/5005` | Stop/take-profit is on the wrong side or too tight for the broker. |
283: | Repeated `503` | Service unavailable; retry later. |

162:   const sign = direction === "buy" ? 1 : -1;

170:   /** Token bucket: one instrument per message, about 20 subscriptions/s. */

175:     const now = Date.now();
176:     for (const [id, entry] of this.pending) {

193:     while (this.tokens >= 1 && this.queued.length > 0) {

196:       this.tokens -= 1;
197:       const id = `ticks-${this.sequence += 1}`;
198:       this.pending.set(id, { symbol, at: Date.now() });
199:       const ok = this.socket?.send({
200:         id,
201:         subscribe: { event: "ticks", instruments: [symbol] },
202:       });
203:       if (!ok) {

205:         this.queued.unshift(symbol);

207:       }
208:     }

210:     if (this.queued.length > 0) {
211:       this.pumpTimer = setTimeout(() => {

225:       instrument?: string;
226:       bid?: number;

233:       candidate.instrument === undefined

235:       const code = Number(candidate.code);
236:       const entry = candidate.id ? this.pending.get(candidate.id) : undefined;
237:       if (candidate.id && entry) {

239:         if (code === 200) {
240:           this.sent.add(entry.symbol);
241:         } else if (code === 3015) {
242:           // Rate limited: retry later, do not permanently drop the symbol.
243:           this.queued.push(entry.symbol);
244:         } else {
245:           this.failed.add(entry.symbol);

247:             `subscription failed for ${entry.symbol}: ${code} ${candidate.error_message ?? ""}`,
248:           );
249:         }
250:       }
251:       if (code !== 200) {
252:         this.lastAckError = `${code} ${candidate.error_message ?? ""}${
253:           entry ? ` (${entry.symbol})` : ""
254:         }`.trim();
255:         this.options.logger?.(
256:           `subscription rejected: ${this.lastAckError}${candidate.id ? ` (${candidate.id})` : ""}`,
257:         );
258:       }
259:       this.pumpSubscriptions();
260:       return;
261:     }
262: 
263:     if (
264:       typeof candidate.instrument !== "string" ||
265:       typeof candidate.bid !== "number" ||
266:       typeof candidate.ask !== "number"
267:     ) {
268:       return;
269:     }
270: 
271:     const quote = this.store.upsert({
272:       instrument: candidate.instrument,
273:       bid: candidate.bid,
274:       ask: candidate.ask,
275:       timestamp: candidate.timestamp ?? new Date().toISOString(),
276:     });
277:     this.window += 1;
278:     this.onQuote?.(quote);
279:   }

284: export type EventTone = "info" | "success" | "warn" | "error";
285: 
286: export interface RuntimeEvent {
287:   at: number;
288:   type: string;
289:   summary: string;
290:   tone: EventTone;
291:   raw: unknown;
292: }
293: 
294: function eventTime(raw: Record<string, unknown>): number {
295:   const value = raw.event_time;
296:   if (typeof value === "string") {
297:     const parsed = Date.parse(value);
298:     if (!Number.isNaN(parsed)) return parsed;
299:   }
300:   return Date.now();
301: }
302: 
303: export function summarizeEvent(raw: unknown): RuntimeEvent | null {
304:   if (!raw || typeof raw !== "object") return null;
305:   const event = raw as Record<string, unknown>;
306: 
307:   // Subscription acknowledgements: { id, code, error_message? }
308:   const rawCode = event.code;
309:   if ((typeof rawCode === "number" || typeof rawCode === "string") && event.event_type === undefined) {
310:     const code = Number(rawCode);
311:     if (code === 200) return null;
312:     return {
313:       at: Date.now(),
314:       type: "subscription",
315:       summary: `${String(event.id ?? "subscription")} rejected: ${String(code)} ${String(event.error_message ?? "")}`.trim(),
316:       tone: "error",
317:       raw,
318:     };
319:   }
320: 
321:   const type = typeof event.event_type === "string" ? event.event_type : "event";
322:   const at = eventTime(event);
323: 
324:   switch (type) {
325:     case "account_state_event": {
326:       const state = (event.payload as { account_state?: Record<string, string> } | undefined)
327:         ?.account_state;
328:       return {
329:         at,
330:         type,
331:         summary: `equity ${state?.equity ?? "?"} · balance ${state?.balance ?? "?"} · margin ${state?.used_margin ?? "?"}`,
332:         tone: "info",
333:         raw,
334:       };
335:     }
336:     case "trading_state_snapshot": {
337:       const payload = event.payload as
338:         | { positions?: unknown[]; orders?: unknown[]; account_state?: Record<string, string> }
339:         | undefined;
340:       return {
341:         at,
342:         type,
343:         summary: `${payload?.positions?.length ?? 0} positions · ${payload?.orders?.length ?? 0} orders · equity ${payload?.account_state?.equity ?? "?"}`,
344:         tone: "info",
345:         raw,
346:       };
347:     }
348:     case "transaction_event": {
349:       const status = typeof event.status === "string" ? event.status : "?";
350:       const okStatus = ["confirmed", "filled", "success"].includes(status);
351:       const failed = ["rejected", "failed"].includes(status);
352:       const detail = failed
353:         ? ` ${String(event.error_code ?? "")} ${String(event.error_message ?? "")}`.trimEnd()
354:         : "";
355:       return {
356:         at,
357:         type,
358:         summary: `${status} · op ${String(event.operation_id ?? "?")}${detail}`,
359:         tone: okStatus ? "success" : failed ? "error" : "warn",
360:         raw,
361:       };
362:     }
363:     case "instrument_event": {
364:       const instrument = typeof event.instrument === "string" ? event.instrument : "?";
365:       const action = typeof event.action === "string" ? event.action : "";
366:       return { at, type, summary: `${instrument} ${action}`.trim(), tone: "info", raw };
367:     }
368:     case "hmr_snapshot":
369:     case "hmr_update":
370:       return { at, type, summary: "instrument metadata refresh", tone: "warn", raw };
371:     default:
372:       return { at, type, summary: "", tone: "info", raw };
373:   }
374: }

376: function localDateKey(date = new Date()): string {
377:   const year = date.getFullYear();
378:   const month = String(date.getMonth() + 1).padStart(2, "0");
379:   const day = String(date.getDate()).padStart(2, "0");
380:   return `${year}-${month}-${day}`;
381: }
382: 
383: export function eventLogPath(cacheDir: string, date = new Date()): string {
384:   return path.join(cacheDir, "events", `${localDateKey(date)}.jsonl`);
385: }
386: 
387: export function readRecentEvents(cacheDir: string, limit = 20): RuntimeEvent[] {
388:   const file = eventLogPath(cacheDir);
389:   try {
390:     const lines = fs.readFileSync(file, "utf8").split(/\r?\n/).filter(Boolean);
391:     return lines
392:       .slice(-limit)
393:       .map((line) => {
394:         try {
395:           return JSON.parse(line) as RuntimeEvent;
396:         } catch {
397:           return null;
398:         }
399:       })
400:       .filter((event): event is RuntimeEvent => event !== null && event.summary !== "");
401:   } catch {
402:     return [];
403:   }
404: }
405: 
406: export class EventHub {
407:   readonly events: RuntimeEvent[] = [];
408:   state: SocketState = "closed";
409:   onEvent?: (event: RuntimeEvent) => void;
410: 
411:   private socket?: ExnessSocket;
412:   private readonly listeners = new Set<(event: RuntimeEvent) => void>();
413: 
414:   constructor(private readonly options: HubOptions & { instruments?: boolean }) {}
415: 
416:   /** Multiple consumers (dashboard, execution gateway) can listen at once. */
417:   on(listener: (event: RuntimeEvent) => void): () => void {
418:     this.listeners.add(listener);
419:     return () => this.listeners.delete(listener);
420:   }
421: 
422:   start(): void {
423:     if (this.socket) return;
424: 
425:     this.socket = new ExnessSocket({
426:       accessPoint: this.options.accessPoint,
427:       identity: this.options.identity,
428:       path: `/v1/server-events/accounts/${this.options.accountId}/ws/events`,
429:       autoReconnect: true,
430:       logger: this.options.verbose ? this.options.logger : undefined,
431:       onState: (state) => {
432:         this.state = state;
433:       },
434:       onOpen: () => {
435:         this.socket?.send({ id: "events-transactions", subscribe: { event: "transactions" } });
436:         this.socket?.send({ id: "events-account", subscribe: { event: "account_state" } });
437:         if (this.options.instruments) {
438:           this.socket?.send({
439:             id: "events-instruments",
440:             subscribe: { event: "instruments", instruments: ["all"] },
441:           });
442:         }
443:       },
444:       onMessage: (message) => this.handleMessage(message),
445:     });
446:     this.socket.connect();
447:   }
448: 
449:   close(): void {
450:     this.socket?.close();
451:     this.socket = undefined;
452:     this.state = "closed";
453:   }
454: 
455:   private handleMessage(message: unknown): void {
456:     const event = summarizeEvent(message);
457:     if (!event) return;
458: 
459:     this.events.push(event);
460:     if (this.events.length > 300) this.events.splice(0, this.events.length - 300);
461:     this.persist(event);
462:     this.onEvent?.(event);
463:     for (const listener of this.listeners) {
464:       try {
465:         listener(event);
466:       } catch {
467:         // A consumer must not break the event stream for others.
468:       }
469:     }
470:   }
471: 
472:   private persist(event: RuntimeEvent): void {
473:     if (!this.options.cacheDir) return;
474:     try {
475:       const file = eventLogPath(this.options.cacheDir);
476:       fs.mkdirSync(path.dirname(file), { recursive: true });
477:       fs.appendFileSync(file, `${JSON.stringify(event)}\n`);
478:     } catch {
479:       // Best effort: monitoring must never break because a log write failed.
480:     }
481:   }
482: }
