82: 
83: export interface ExecutorState {
84:   managed: ManagedPosition[];
85:   stats: RealizedStats;
86:   trailing: Array<{ at: number; symbol: string; positionId: string; sl: number }>;
87:   tradeLog: TradeLogEntry[];
88: }
89: 
90: export interface ExecutorDeps {
91:   tools: TradeTools;
92:   /** read-only market tools, used to refresh the trailing ATR */
93:   marketTools: Tools;
94:   ticks: TickHub;
95:   equity: EquityTracker;
96:   events: EventHub;
97:   client: ExnessClient;
98:   config: AgentConfig;
99:   accountId: string;
100:   cacheDir: string;
101:   live: boolean;
102:   journal?: AgentJournal;
103:   log: (line: string) => void;
104: }
105: 
106: export interface SizingInput {
107:   equity: number;
108:   riskPct: number;
109:   slPips: number;
110:   pipValuePerLot: number;
111:   volumeMin: number;
112:   volumeMax: number;
113:   volumeStep: number;
114:   maxLots: number;
115: }
116: 
117: export interface SizingResult {
118:   lots: number;
119:   riskUsd: number;
120:   reason?: string;
121: }
122: 
123: /**
124:  * Fixed-fractional sizing on the virtual risk equity. Always floors to the
125:  * volume step so a trade can never risk more than the configured percentage.
126:  */
127: export function computeLots(input: SizingInput): SizingResult {
128:   if (!(input.slPips > 0) || !(input.pipValuePerLot > 0) || !(input.volumeStep > 0)) {
129:     return { lots: 0, riskUsd: 0, reason: "invalid sizing inputs" };
130:   }
131:   const riskUsd = (input.equity * input.riskPct) / 100;
132:   const rawLots = riskUsd / (input.slPips * input.pipValuePerLot);
133:   let lots = roundVolumeDown(Math.min(rawLots, input.maxLots), input.volumeStep);
134:   if (lots > input.volumeMax) lots = roundVolumeDown(input.volumeMax, input.volumeStep);
135:   if (lots < input.volumeMin) {
136:     return {
137:       lots: 0,
138:       riskUsd,
139:       reason: `risk ${riskUsd.toFixed(2)} = ${rawLots.toFixed(3)} lot < volume_min ${input.volumeMin}`,
140:     };
141:   }
142:   return { lots, riskUsd: lots * input.slPips * input.pipValuePerLot };
143: }
144: 
145: /** Rate used to convert the instrument's quote currency into USD. */
146: export function quoteToUsdRate(
147:   quoteCurrency: string,
148:   quotes: Map<string, Quote>,
149: ): number | undefined {
150:   if (quoteCurrency === "USD") return 1;
151:   const direct = quotes.get(`${quoteCurrency}USD`);
152:   if (direct && direct.bid > 0) return direct.bid;
153:   const inverse = quotes.get(`USD${quoteCurrency}`);
154:   if (inverse && inverse.ask > 0) return 1 / inverse.ask;
155: 
156:   // Triangulate through a liquid USD pair. Example: CAD -> USD can be derived
157:   // from CADJPY / USDJPY even when the synthetic CADUSD symbol does not exist
158:   // or has not ticked yet. Sell the quote currency and buy USD, hence bid/ask.
159:   for (const pivot of ["JPY", "CHF", "EUR", "GBP", "AUD", "NZD", "CAD"]) {
160:     if (pivot === quoteCurrency) continue;
161:     const quotePivot = quotes.get(`${quoteCurrency}${pivot}`);
162:     const usdPivot = quotes.get(`USD${pivot}`);
163:     if (quotePivot && usdPivot && quotePivot.bid > 0 && usdPivot.ask > 0) {
164:       const rate = quotePivot.bid / usdPivot.ask;
165:       if (Number.isFinite(rate) && rate > 0) return rate;
166:     }
167:     const pivotQuote = quotes.get(`${pivot}${quoteCurrency}`);
168:     const pivotUsd = quotes.get(`${pivot}USD`);
169:     if (pivotQuote && pivotUsd && pivotQuote.ask > 0 && pivotUsd.bid > 0) {
170:       const rate = pivotUsd.bid / pivotQuote.ask;
171:       if (Number.isFinite(rate) && rate > 0) return rate;
172:     }
173:   }
174:   return undefined;
175: }
176: 
177: /** USD value of one base-currency unit, used for a conservative margin check. */
178: export function baseToUsdRate(
179:   baseCurrency: string,
180:   price: number,
181:   quoteCurrency: string,
182:   quotes: Map<string, Quote>,
183: ): number | undefined {
184:   if (baseCurrency === "USD") return 1;
185:   const direct = quotes.get(`${baseCurrency}USD`);
186:   if (direct && direct.bid > 0) return direct.bid;
187:   const inverse = quotes.get(`USD${baseCurrency}`);
188:   if (inverse && inverse.ask > 0) return 1 / inverse.ask;
189:   const quoteRate = quoteToUsdRate(quoteCurrency, quotes);
190:   if (quoteRate !== undefined && price > 0) return price * quoteRate;
191:   return undefined;
192: }
193: 
194: function parseNumber(value: string | null | undefined, fallback: number): number {
195:   const parsed = Number(value ?? "");
196:   return Number.isFinite(parsed) && parsed > 0 ? parsed : fallback;
197: }
198: 
199: function dealProfit(deal: Deal): number {
200:   const profit = Number(deal.profit?.amount ?? 0);
201:   const commission = Number(deal.commission ?? 0);
202:   return (Number.isFinite(profit) ? profit : 0) + (Number.isFinite(commission) ? commission : 0);
203: }
204: 
205: function candleBoundary(timeframe: Timeframe, now = Date.now()): number {
206:   const duration = timeframeMs(timeframe);
207:   return Math.floor(now / duration) * duration;
208: }
209: 
210: function roundStopAway(value: number, digits: number, side: PositionSide): number {
211:   const factor = 10 ** digits;
212:   return (side === "buy" ? Math.floor(value * factor) : Math.ceil(value * factor)) / factor;
213: }
214: 
215: function improved(side: PositionSide, next: number, current: number, epsilon: number): boolean {
216:   return side === "buy" ? next > current + epsilon : next < current - epsilon;
217: }
218: 
219: export class RiskExecutor {
220:   readonly managed = new Map<string, ManagedPosition>();
221:   stats: RealizedStats = {
222:     trades: 0,
223:     wins: 0,
224:     losses: 0,
225:     flats: 0,
226:     netProfit: 0,
227:     consecutiveLosses: 0,
228:     pausedUntil: 0,
229:   };
230: 
231:   private readonly busy = new Set<string>();
232:   private readonly realized = new Map<string, number>();
233:   private readonly killAttempts = new Map<string, number>();
234:   private trailing: Array<{ at: number; symbol: string; positionId: string; sl: number }> = [];
235:   private tradeLog: TradeLogEntry[] = [];
236: 
237:   constructor(private readonly deps: ExecutorDeps) {
238:     deps.events.on((event) => this.trackDeals(event.raw));
239:   }
240: 
241:   // ------------------------------------------------------------------ state
242: 
243:   restore(state: Partial<ExecutorState> | null | undefined): void {
244:     if (!state) return;
245:     if (state.stats) this.stats = { ...this.stats, ...state.stats };
246:     if (Array.isArray(state.trailing)) this.trailing = state.trailing.slice(-20);
247:     if (Array.isArray(state.tradeLog)) this.tradeLog = state.tradeLog.slice(-50);
248: 
249:     for (const position of state.managed ?? []) {
250:       if (!position.positionId || !position.symbol) continue;
251:       const entry = Number(position.entry);
252:       if (!Number.isFinite(entry) || entry <= 0) continue;
253: 
254:       const side: PositionSide = position.side === "sell" ? "sell" : "buy";
255:       const sign = side === "buy" ? 1 : -1;
256:       const digits = Number(position.digits) || 5;
257:       const pip = Number(position.pip) || pipSize(position.symbol, digits);
258:       const trailDistance =
259:         Number(position.trailDistance) > 0
260:           ? Number(position.trailDistance)
261:           : this.deps.config.trailMinPips * pip;
262:       const atrValue =
263:         Number(position.atr) > 0
264:           ? Number(position.atr)
265:           : trailDistance / Math.max(1, this.deps.config.trailAtrFactor);
266:       const emergencySl =
267:         Number(position.emergencySl) > 0
268:           ? Number(position.emergencySl)
269:           : entry - sign * Math.max(atrValue * this.deps.config.emergencySlAtrFactor, pip);
270:       const trailStop =
271:         Number(position.trailStop) > 0 ? Number(position.trailStop) : emergencySl;
272: 
273:       this.managed.set(position.positionId, {
274:         positionId: position.positionId,
275:         symbol: position.symbol,
276:         side,
277:         entry,
278:         volume: Number(position.volume) || 0,
279:         step: Number(position.step) || 0.01,
280:         digits,
281:         pip,
282:         emergencySl,
283:         slOrderId: position.slOrderId,
284:         trailStop,
285:         trailDistance,
286:         best: Number(position.best) || entry,
287:         atr: atrValue,
288:         openedAt: Number(position.openedAt) || Date.now(),
289:         // Force a fresh trail ATR read on the first manage tick after a restart.
290:         lastAtrSyncAt: 0,
291:         lastStopEnsureAt: 0,
292:         score: Number(position.score) || 0,
293:         closing: false,
294:       });
295:     }
296:   }
297: 
298:   statePayload(): ExecutorState {
299:     return {
300:       managed: [...this.managed.values()],
301:       stats: { ...this.stats },
302:       trailing: this.trailing.slice(-20),
303:       tradeLog: this.tradeLog.slice(-50),
304:     };
305:   }
306: 
307:   hasSymbol(symbol: string): boolean {
308:     for (const position of this.managed.values()) {
309:       if (position.symbol === symbol) return true;
310:     }
311:     return false;
312:   }
313: 
314:   get count(): number {
315:     return this.managed.size;
316:   }
317: 
318:   private killActive(): boolean {
319:     return fs.existsSync(path.join(this.deps.cacheDir, "KILL"));
320:   }
321: 
322:   // --------------------------------------------------------------- gating
323: 
324:   pausedReason(now = Date.now()): string | undefined {
325:     if (this.stats.pausedUntil > now) {
326:       const minutes = Math.ceil((this.stats.pausedUntil - now) / 60_000);
327:       return `cooldown ${minutes}m after ${this.stats.consecutiveLosses} losses`;
328:     }
329:     return undefined;
330:   }
331: 
332:   tradingAllowed(view: AccountView): { ok: boolean; reason?: string } {
333:     if (this.killActive()) {
334:       return { ok: false, reason: "kill switch (.cache/KILL)" };
335:     }
336:     const paused = this.pausedReason();
337:     if (paused) return { ok: false, reason: paused };
338:     if (view.tradeMode !== "enabled") return { ok: false, reason: `trade_mode ${view.tradeMode}` };
339:     if (view.status !== "active") return { ok: false, reason: `status ${view.status}` };
340:     if (
341:       this.deps.config.maxPositions > 0 &&
342:       view.positions.length >= this.deps.config.maxPositions
343:     ) {
344:       return { ok: false, reason: `max ${this.deps.config.maxPositions} positions` };
345:     }
346:     const start = this.deps.equity.startBalance || view.balance;
347:     const change = view.equity - start;
348:     const cap = (this.deps.config.virtualEquity * this.deps.config.maxDailyLossPct) / 100;
349:     if (change <= -cap) {
350:       return { ok: false, reason: `daily loss ${change.toFixed(2)} ≤ -${cap.toFixed(2)}` };
351:     }
352:     return { ok: true };
353:   }
354: 
355:   // ---------------------------------------------------------------- open
356: 
357:   async open(
358:     signal: EntrySignal,
359:     view: AccountView,
360:   ): Promise<{ ok: boolean; reason?: string; managed?: ManagedPosition; result?: OperationResult }> {
361:     if (!this.deps.live) return { ok: false, reason: "dry-run: orders disabled" };
362:     const gate = this.tradingAllowed(view);
363:     if (!gate.ok) return { ok: false, reason: gate.reason };
364:     if (Date.now() > signal.expiresAt) return { ok: false, reason: "signal expired" };
365:     if (this.deps.config.maxPerSymbol > 0) {
366:       const perSymbol = view.positions.filter(
367:         (position) => position.instrument === signal.symbol,
368:       ).length;
369:       if (perSymbol >= this.deps.config.maxPerSymbol) {
370:         return {
371:           ok: false,
372:           reason: `${signal.symbol} already has ${perSymbol} position(s)`,
373:         };
374:       }
375:     }
376: 
377:     const quote = this.deps.ticks.get(signal.symbol);
378:     if (!quote || Date.now() - quote.timestamp > this.deps.config.maxQuoteAgeMs) {
379:       return { ok: false, reason: "quote stale" };
380:     }
381:     if (!spreadWithinLimit(signal.symbol, quote, this.deps.config)) {
382:       return { ok: false, reason: "spread too wide" };
383:     }
384:     // The signal's entry must still be reachable; otherwise the setup is gone.
385:     // Compare the price we would actually pay/receive (not the mid), so the
386:     // normal bid/ask spread never counts as a chase.
387:     const execution = signal.side === "buy" ? quote.ask : quote.bid;
388:     if (Math.abs(execution - signal.entry) > this.deps.config.maxChaseAtr * signal.atr) {
389:       return { ok: false, reason: "entry moved too far" };
390:     }
391: 
392:     let conditions;
393:     try {
394:       conditions = await this.deps.tools.conditions(signal.symbol);
395:     } catch (error) {
396:       return { ok: false, reason: `conditions: ${error instanceof Error ? error.message : error}` };
397:     }
398: 
399:     const digits = conditions.point_digits ?? signal.digits;
400:     const pip = pipSize(signal.symbol, digits);
401:     // Round the emergency stop with the broker's real precision, away from the
402:     // entry. This is the exact value sent in the order and shown on the board.
403:     const emergencySl = roundStopAway(signal.emergencySl, digits, signal.side);
404:     const contractSize = parseNumber(conditions.contract_size, 100_000);
405:     const volumeMin = parseNumber(conditions.volume_min, 0.01);
406:     const volumeMax = parseNumber(conditions.volume_max, 100);
407:     const volumeStep = parseNumber(conditions.volume_step, 0.01);
408:     const quoteCurrency = conditions.quote_currency ?? signal.symbol.slice(3);
409:     const baseCurrency = conditions.base_currency ?? signal.symbol.slice(0, 3);
410: 
411:     let quotes = new Map(this.deps.ticks.store.all().map((entry) => [entry.symbol, entry] as const));
412:     let quoteRate = quoteToUsdRate(quoteCurrency, quotes);
413:     if (quoteRate === undefined && quoteCurrency !== "USD") {
414:       // The conversion pair may simply not have ticked yet on a wide universe.
415:       await this.deps.ticks
416:         .ensure([`${quoteCurrency}USD`, `USD${quoteCurrency}`], 1500)
417:         .catch(() => []);
418:       quotes = new Map(this.deps.ticks.store.all().map((entry) => [entry.symbol, entry] as const));
419:       quoteRate = quoteToUsdRate(quoteCurrency, quotes);
420:     }
421:     if (quoteRate === undefined) {
422:       return { ok: false, reason: `no ${quoteCurrency}/USD conversion for sizing` };
423:     }
424:     const pipValuePerLot = contractSize * pip * quoteRate;
425:     const sizing = computeLots({
426:       equity: this.deps.config.virtualEquity,
427:       riskPct: this.deps.config.riskPct,
428:       slPips: signal.slPips,
429:       pipValuePerLot,
430:       volumeMin,
431:       volumeMax,
432:       volumeStep,
433:       maxLots: this.deps.config.maxLotsPerTrade,
434:     });
435:     if (sizing.reason || sizing.lots <= 0) {
436:       return { ok: false, reason: sizing.reason ?? "size 0" };
437:     }
438: 
439:     const baseRate = baseToUsdRate(baseCurrency, quote.mid, quoteCurrency, quotes);
440:     if (baseRate !== undefined) {
441:       const leverage = Number(view.leverage);
442:       const marginPerLot = (contractSize * baseRate) / (leverage > 0 ? leverage : 500);
443:       const required = sizing.lots * marginPerLot * this.deps.config.marginBuffer;
444:       if (required > view.freeMargin) {
445:         return { ok: false, reason: `margin ${required.toFixed(2)} > free ${view.freeMargin.toFixed(2)}` };
446:       }
447:     }
448: 
449:     const beforeIds = new Set(view.positions.map((position) => position.position_id));
450:     const result = await this.deps.tools.open({
451:       symbol: signal.symbol,
452:       side: signal.side,
453:       volume: sizing.lots,
454:       stopLoss: emergencySl,
455:       comment: `ot-${signal.side}-${signal.score.toFixed(0)}`,
456:     });
457: 
458:     if (!result.ok) {
459:       this.log({
460:         at: Date.now(),
461:         action: "error",
462:         symbol: signal.symbol,
463:         side: signal.side,
464:         reason: `open rejected ${result.errorCode ?? ""} ${result.errorMessage ?? result.status}`.trim(),
465:         ok: false,
466:       });
467:       return { ok: false, reason: result.errorMessage ?? result.status, result };
468:     }
469: 
470:     let position = this.findOpenedPosition(result, signal.symbol, beforeIds);
471:     if (!position) {
472:       this.deps.tools.invalidateSnapshot();
473:       try {
474:         const fresh = await this.deps.tools.view(true);
475:         position = fresh.positions.find(
476:           (entry) => entry.instrument === signal.symbol && !beforeIds.has(entry.position_id),
477:         );
478:       } catch {
479:         // fall through: the position exists but the snapshot is rate limited
480:       }
481:     }
482:     if (!position) {
483:       return { ok: false, reason: "confirmed but position not found", result };
484:     }
485: 
486:     const entry = Number(position.open_price ?? signal.entry);
487:     const sltp = result.data?.orders?.find(
488:       (order) => order.order_type === "sltp" && order.position_id === position!.position_id,
489:     );
490:     const trailDistance = Math.max(
491:       signal.trailDistance,
492:       this.deps.config.trailMinPips * pip,
493:     );
494:     const managed: ManagedPosition = {
495:       positionId: position.position_id,
496:       symbol: signal.symbol,
497:       side: signal.side,
498:       entry,
499:       volume: Number(position.volume),
500:       step: volumeStep,
501:       digits,
502:       pip,
503:       emergencySl,
504:       slOrderId: sltp?.order_id,
505:       trailStop: initialVirtualStop(signal.side, entry, signal.emergencySl),
506:       trailDistance,
507:       best: entry,
508:       atr: signal.atr,
509:       openedAt: Date.now(),
510:       lastAtrSyncAt: candleBoundary(this.deps.config.trailTimeframe),
511:       lastStopEnsureAt: sltp?.order_id ? Date.now() : 0,
512:       score: signal.score,
513:     };
514:     this.managed.set(managed.positionId, managed);
515: 
516:     this.log({
517:       at: Date.now(),
518:       action: "open",
519:       symbol: managed.symbol,
520:       positionId: managed.positionId,
521:       side: managed.side,
522:       volume: managed.volume,
523:       price: entry,
524:       sl: managed.emergencySl,
525:       reason:
526:         `risk ${sizing.riskUsd.toFixed(2)} USD · emergency ${signal.slPips.toFixed(1)}p · ` +
527:         `trail ${(trailDistance / pip).toFixed(1)}p · score ${signal.score.toFixed(1)}`,
528:       ok: true,
529:     });
530:     // A cached snapshot from before the open does not contain the new position;
531:     // mark it dirty so the manage loop cannot mistake it for a closed trade.
532:     this.deps.tools.invalidateSnapshot();
533:     return { ok: true, managed, result };
534:   }
535: 
536:   // ---------------------------------------------------------------- manage
537: 
538:   /**
539:    * Re-attach positions the agent opened but lost from its managed map (state
540:    * file removed, snapshot race after an open, or a restart mid-trade). The
541:    * trade log is the source of truth for entry/initial stop, so adoption never
542:    * touches positions that were not opened by this agent.
543:    */
544:   private adoptOrphans(view: AccountView): void {
545:     const known = new Set(this.managed.keys());
546:     const opened = new Map<string, TradeLogEntry>();
547:     for (const entry of this.tradeLog) {
548:       if (entry.action === "open" && entry.positionId && entry.ok !== false) {
549:         opened.set(entry.positionId, entry);
550:       }
551:     }
552:     for (const position of view.positions) {
553:       if (known.has(position.position_id)) continue;
554:       const entry = opened.get(position.position_id);
555:       if (!entry || !entry.symbol || !entry.price || !entry.sl) continue;
556:       if (entry.side !== position.direction) continue;
557: 
558:       const symbol = entry.symbol;
559:       const side: PositionSide = entry.side === "buy" ? "buy" : "sell";
560:       const sign = side === "buy" ? 1 : -1;
561:       const riskDistance = Math.abs(entry.price - entry.sl);
562:       if (!(riskDistance > 0)) continue;
563:       const sltp = view.orders.find(
564:         (order) =>
565:           order.order_type === "sltp" &&
566:           order.position_id === position.position_id &&
567:           order.state === "placed",
568:       );
569:       const brokerSl = Number(sltp?.stop_loss_price ?? 0);
570:       const priceText = String(position.open_price ?? entry.price);
571:       const digits = priceText.includes(".") ? priceText.split(".")[1]!.length : 5;
572:       const pip = pipSize(symbol, digits);
573:       // Old signals used a 1.5×ATR stop; reconstruct an approximate ATR so the
574:       // new 2×ATR trail is in the right ballpark. Broker SL, if already moved,
575:       // is kept as the virtual stop to preserve protection.
576:       const approxAtr = riskDistance / Math.max(1, this.deps.config.emergencySlAtrFactor);
577:       const trailDistance = trailDistanceFromAtr(
578:         approxAtr,
579:         this.deps.config.trailAtrFactor,
580:         this.deps.config.trailMinPips * pip,
581:       );
582:       const emergency = Number(entry.sl) || brokerSl || entry.price - sign * riskDistance;
583:       const trailStop = brokerSl > 0 ? brokerSl : emergency;
584: 
585:       const managed: ManagedPosition = {
586:         positionId: position.position_id,
587:         symbol,
588:         side,
589:         entry: entry.price,
590:         volume: Number(position.volume),
591:         step: 0.01,
592:         digits,
593:         pip,
594:         emergencySl: emergency,
595:         slOrderId: sltp?.order_id,
596:         trailStop,
597:         trailDistance,
598:         best: entry.price,
599:         atr: approxAtr,
600:         openedAt: Date.parse(position.create_time) || entry.at,
601:         lastAtrSyncAt: 0,
602:         lastStopEnsureAt: 0,
603:         score: 0,
604:       };
605:       this.managed.set(managed.positionId, managed);
606:       this.log({
607:         at: Date.now(),
608:         action: "open",
609:         symbol,
610:         positionId: managed.positionId,
611:         side,
612:         volume: managed.volume,
613:         price: managed.entry,
614:         sl: managed.emergencySl,
615:         reason: "adopted orphan position",
616:         ok: true,
617:       });
618:       this.deps.log(`adopt ${symbol} ${side} ${managed.volume} lot (${managed.positionId})`);
619:     }
620:   }
621: 
622:   /**
623:    * Kill switch: close every open position and stop entries. The KILL file is
624:    * persistent, so the agent keeps closing anything that appears while it is on.
625:    */
626:   private async closeAll(view: AccountView): Promise<void> {
627:     const now = Date.now();
628:     const openIds = new Set(view.positions.map((position) => position.position_id));
629: 
630:     for (const position of view.positions) {
631:       const lastAttempt = this.killAttempts.get(position.position_id) ?? 0;
632:       if (now - lastAttempt < 10_000) continue;
633:       this.killAttempts.set(position.position_id, now);
634:       const result = await this.deps.tools.close(position.position_id);
635:       if (result.ok) {
636:         this.log({
637:           at: Date.now(),
638:           action: "close",
639:           symbol: position.instrument,
640:           positionId: position.position_id,
641:           side: position.direction,
642:           volume: Number(position.volume),

24: const METALS = /^(XAU|XAG|XPT|XPD)/;

27: export function categorize(symbol: string): InstrumentCategory {
28:   if (METALS.test(symbol)) return "metals";
29:   if (CRYPTO.test(symbol)) return "crypto";
30:   if (/^[A-Z]{6}$/.test(symbol)) return "fx";
31:   if (/\d/.test(symbol)) return "index";
32:   if (/^[A-Z.]{1,5}$/.test(symbol)) return "stock";
33:   return "other";
34: }

36: /** Display precision heuristic, used when instrument conditions are not cached yet. */
37: export function digitsFor(symbol: string): number {
38:   const category = categorize(symbol);
39:   if (category === "fx") return symbol.endsWith("JPY") ? 3 : 5;
40:   if (category === "metals") return symbol.startsWith("XAU") ? 2 : 3;
41:   if (category === "crypto") return 2;
42:   if (category === "index") return 1;
43:   if (category === "stock") return 2;
44:   return 4;
45: }

55: export class CatalogService {

60:   constructor(

66:     this.conditionsDir = path.join(cacheDir, "conditions");
67:   }
68: 
69:   async catalog(options: { force?: boolean } = {}): Promise<Catalog> {
70:     if (this.cachedCatalog && !options.force) return this.cachedCatalog;
71: 
72:     if (!options.force) {
73:       const cached = this.readJson<Omit<Catalog, "byCategory"> & { byCategory?: Catalog["byCategory"] }>(
74:         this.catalogFile,
75:       );
76:       if (cached && Date.now() - cached.fetchedAt < CATALOG_TTL_MS && Array.isArray(cached.instruments)) {
77:         this.cachedCatalog = cached.byCategory
78:           ? (cached as Catalog)
79:           : buildCatalog(cached.instruments, cached.fetchedAt);
80:         return this.cachedCatalog;
81:       }
82:     }
83: 
84:     const response = await this.client.get<InstrumentListResponse>(
85:       `/v1/configuration/accounts/${this.accountId}/instruments`,
86:     );
87:     const catalog = buildCatalog(response.instruments ?? [], Date.now());
88:     this.cachedCatalog = catalog;
89:     this.writeJson(this.catalogFile, catalog);
90:     return catalog;
91:   }
92: 
93:   async instruments(options: { force?: boolean } = {}): Promise<string[]> {
94:     return (await this.catalog(options)).instruments;
95:   }
96: 
97:   async fxPairs(options: { force?: boolean } = {}): Promise<string[]> {
98:     return (await this.catalog(options)).byCategory.fx;
99:   }
100: 
101:   async conditions(symbol: string, options: { force?: boolean } = {}): Promise<InstrumentConditions> {
102:     const upper = symbol.toUpperCase();
103:     const file = path.join(this.conditionsDir, `${upper}.json`);
104:     if (!options.force) {
105:       const cached = this.readJson<CachedConditions>(file);
106:       if (cached && Date.now() - cached.fetchedAt < CONDITIONS_TTL_MS) return cached.conditions;
107:     }
108: 
109:     const conditions = await this.client.get<InstrumentConditions>(
110:       `/v1/configuration/accounts/${this.accountId}/instruments/${encodeURIComponent(upper)}/conditions`,
111:     );
112:     this.writeJson(file, { fetchedAt: Date.now(), conditions });
113:     return conditions;
114:   }
115: 
116:   async digits(symbol: string): Promise<number> {
117:     try {
118:       const conditions = await this.conditions(symbol);
119:       if (typeof conditions.point_digits === "number") return conditions.point_digits;
120:     } catch {
121:       // Fall back to the heuristic; display precision must never break the UI.
122:     }
123:     return digitsFor(symbol);
124:   }
125: 
126:   private readJson<T>(file: string): T | null {
127:     try {
128:       return JSON.parse(fs.readFileSync(file, "utf8")) as T;
129:     } catch {
130:       return null;
131:     }
132:   }
133: 
134:   private writeJson(file: string, value: unknown): void {
135:     try {
136:       fs.mkdirSync(path.dirname(file), { recursive: true });
137:       fs.writeFileSync(file, JSON.stringify(value, null, 2));
138:     } catch {
139:       // Cache is best-effort only.
140:     }
141:   }
142: }
143: 
144: export function buildCatalog(instruments: string[], fetchedAt = Date.now()): Catalog {
145:   const byCategory: Record<InstrumentCategory, string[]> = {
146:     fx: [],
147:     metals: [],
148:     crypto: [],
149:     index: [],
150:     stock: [],
151:     other: [],
152:   };
153:   for (const instrument of instruments) {
154:     byCategory[categorize(instrument)].push(instrument);
155:   }
156:   return { fetchedAt, instruments, byCategory };
157: }

29: function applyManualEnv(contents: string): void {

Excellent! Root cause found:

`subscription failed for AAPL: 4000 MARKET_INSTRUMENT_NOT_FOUND` → the server closes the socket with 1008 (policy violation) whenever we subscribe to an invalid instrument. The catalog includes AAPL which the tick stream doesn't know (perhaps stock CFD symbols differ). Because the subscription queue restarts from the beginning each reconnect (symbols set retains all, sent cleared), the invalid symbol keeps killing the connection in a loop. Result: 0 quotes forever.

Fixes:
1. Don't include invalid instruments in the universe; filter the catalog to instruments that the account can actually trade/stream. We can validate via REST conditions? Or more robust: on `MARKET_INSTRUMENT_NOT_FOUND` (4000) treat as permanently failed (already does `failed.add`), but the socket closes before processing further? The log shows `subscription failed for AAPL` then socket closed (1008). It seems the server terminates the connection on an invalid subscription. Since `failed.add(AAPL)` is set in the message handler, but then `onState !== open` clears `failed`, so next reconnect re-queues AAPL. That's the loop.

So:
- Never clear `failed` on reconnect (keep permanent failures across reconnects).
- Filter the universe upfront: build a validated tick universe by checking `instruments` from catalog against what? We can just let failed set persist; after one connection attempt the bad symbol is dropped and subsequent reconnects skip it. But the connection close happens at AAPL which is early alphabetically (instruments sorted?). The catalog likely includes many invalid stock symbols. Each reconnect would discover one more bad symbol per connection, then reconnect; 335 symbols with maybe dozens of invalid ones → dozens of reconnects before the feed stabilizes. Better: validate the universe at startup by sending subscriptions and detecting failures, but the server kills the socket on the first bad one.

Better approach: don't subscribe to stock/index/crypto instruments that aren't streamable? The catalog comes from the account's instruments endpoint, which should only list tradable instruments. Yet AAPL is listed but not available on the tick feed. Maybe the tick feed requires a different symbol (e.g., "AAPL.US" or "#AAPL"). Hmm.

Alternative: use REST to get quotes? There's a quotes endpoint maybe. But the user wants frequency and signals; restricting the universe to FX + metals + crypto + indices would help. We can filter by category and only include symbols that exist on the tick feed. Actually the safest: only subscribe to instruments for which we successfully get a quote; discover via a small batch approach. But the server closes on invalid.

Could use a "probe" approach: subscribe one symbol at a time and wait for ack, dropping failures. But a single bad symbol closes the whole socket anyway; we can handle that by keeping the failed set persistent and reconnecting. That converges after N bad symbols, but each cycle ~1.1s and up to maybe 100 bad symbols → 2 minutes. Acceptable one-time, then cached to disk (tick-universe.json) to avoid repeats.

## [Subscribe To WebSocket Events | Exness Public Trader API](https://www.exness-api.com/documentation/subscribe-to-websocket-events)

On this page

# Subscribe To WebSocket Events

Use the dedicated ticks WebSocket endpoint for live prices, and the server events endpoint for trading, account, instrument, and HMR events.

## WebSocket endpoints ​

|Use case |WebSocket path |Subscription payload |
| --- | --- | --- |
|Live ticks |`/v1/server-events/accounts/{account_id}/ws/ticks` |`id` \+ `subscribe.event = ticks` \+ `subscribe.instruments` |
|Transactions |`/v1/server-events/accounts/{account_id}/ws/events` |`id` \+ `subscribe.event = transactions` |
|Account state |`/v1/server-events/accounts/{account_id}/ws/events` |`id` \+ `subscribe.event = account_state` |
|Instrument updates |`/v1/server-events/accounts/{account_id}/ws/events` |`id` \+ `subscribe.event = instruments` \+ optional `subscribe.instruments` |

...

The signed path inside `EXN-DATA` must exactly match the WebSocket connection path.

Exness API Developer Portal Exness API Developer Portal

*
* Trading API

Ticks subscription
POST
/v1/server-events/accounts/:account_id/ws/ticks
This OpenAPI operation models the WebSocket subscription command message. The actual WebSocket connection handshake is signed as a GET request. The signed path field in EXN-DATA must exactly match the WebSocket connection path: /v1/server-events/accounts/{account_id}/ws/ticks .
/v1/server-events/accounts/:account_id/ws/ticks
Use this stream only for live ticks. Do not subscribe to transactions , account_state , instruments , or hmr through this stream.
Ticks subscription provides realtime Bid/Ask prices for subscribed instruments. Initial state:
/v1/server-events/accounts/:account_id/ws/ticks
* Upon successful subscription, the server sends the last tick for each subscribed instrument.

This SDK currently covers the main Public Trader API workflows:

* signed REST requests
* trading access point discovery
* trading REST methods
* configuration REST methods
* history REST methods

Compatibility note:

* the SDK now uses the current `limits` endpoint

...

await ticks.connect();
ticks.subscribe('ticks-1', ['BTCUSD']);

...

events.subscribeTransactions('transactions-1');
events.subscribeInstruments('instruments-1', [instrument]);
ticks.subscribe('ticks-1', [instrument]);

...

* Signed WebSocket `GET` handshakes must use an empty `EXN-IDEMPOTENCY-KEY` . `X-Request-ID` may still be sent separately for tracing.
* The ticks stream uses the legacy subscribe payload:

```json
{
  "id": "ticks-1",
  "subscribe": {
    "event": "ticks",
    "instruments": ["BTCUSD"]
  }
}
```

* A `{"id":"...","code":200}` WebSocket message is treated as a subscribe ACK, not as an error.

* **Account management** : Access account details, including balance, used margin, currency, and leverage.
* **Market data** : Subscribe to real-time and historical market data, static instrument data, and Flexible Higher Margin Requirements (HMR) status.
* **Trading operation** : Perform critical trading functions such as placing, updating, and cancelling orders programmatically.
* **Instruments** : Available instruments can be found by [calling the instrument list](https://www.exness-api.com/reference/get-available-instrument-list) , which will return the names of instruments available for the selected account.

The current API version does not support stock and indices instruments.

**Protocols and endpoints**  
The API operates using two primary communication protocols:

* REST API: Used for stateful requests such as placing orders or retrieving account histories.
* WebSocket API: Used for low-latency, real-time data streaming (e.g., live price feeds).

In constructor, load failures file. `HubOptions` has cacheDir.

```ts
private loadFailures(): void {
  if (!this.options.cacheDir) return;
  try {
    const raw = JSON.parse(fs.readFileSync(path.join(this.options.cacheDir, "tick-unsupported.json"), "utf8"));
    if (Array.isArray(raw)) for (const s of raw) if (typeof s === "string") this.failed.add(s.toUpperCase());
  } catch {}
}
private markFailed(symbol: string): void {
  if (this.failed.has(symbol)) return;
  this.failed.add(symbol);
  this.persistFailures();
}
private persistFailures(): void {
  if (!this.options.cacheDir) return;
  try {
    fs.mkdirSync(this.options.cacheDir, { recursive: true });
    fs.writeFileSync(path.join(this.options.cacheDir, "tick-unsupported.json"), JSON.stringify([...this.failed].sort(), null, 2));
  } catch {}
}
```

```ts
const COMMODITY = /^(XAU|XAG|XPT|XPD|XAL|XCU|XNG|XNI|XPB|XZN|USOIL|UKOIL|XBR|XTI)/;
const CRYPTO_BASES = ["BTC","ETH","BCH","LTC","XRP","ADA","SOL","DOT","DOGE","AVAX","LINK","UNI","TRX","MATIC","SHIB","ATOM","EOS","XLM","XMR","ZEC","DASH","ETC","BNB","APT","ARB","OP","SUI","PEPE","USDT","USDC"];
const QUOTES = new Set(["USD","EUR","JPY","GBP","CHF","AUD","NZD","CAD","CNH","CNY","KRW","THB","ZAR","TRY","SEK","NOK","DKK","PLN","HUF","CZK","MXN","SGD","HKD","ILS","RUB","BTC","ETH","XAU","XAG","USDT","USDC"]);
function isCrypto(symbol: string): boolean {
  for (const base of CRYPTO_BASES) {
    if (!symbol.startsWith(base)) continue;
    const quote = symbol.slice(base.length);
    if (quote.length >= 3 && QUOTES.has(quote)) return true;
  }
  return false;
}
```

"USDT" prefix + "RY"? No, USDTRY = U S D T R Y; starts with "USDT" then "RY" not quote; but also starts with "USD"? Not in crypto bases except USDT/USDC. So false → fx. Good.

```ts
export function categorize(symbol: string): InstrumentCategory {
  if (COMMODITY.test(symbol)) return "metals";
  if (isCrypto(symbol)) return "crypto";
  if (/^[A-Z]{6}$/.test(symbol)) return "fx";
  if (/\d/.test(symbol)) return "index";
  return "stock";
}
```

```ts
export type InstrumentCategory = "fx" | "metals" | "crypto" | "index" | "stock" | "other";

const COMMODITY = /^(XAU|XAG|XPT|XPD|XAL|XCU|XNG|XNI|XPB|XZN|USOIL|UKOIL|XBR|XTI)/;
const CRYPTO_BASES = [...];
const CRYPTO_QUOTES = new Set([...]);

function isCrypto(symbol: string): boolean {
  for (const base of CRYPTO_BASES) {
    if (!symbol.startsWith(base)) continue;
    const quote = symbol.slice(base.length);
    if (quote.length >= 3 && CRYPTO_QUOTES.has(quote)) return true;
  }
  return false;
}

export function categorize(symbol: string): InstrumentCategory {
  if (COMMODITY.test(symbol)) return "metals";
  if (isCrypto(symbol)) return "crypto";
  if (/^[A-Z]{6}$/.test(symbol)) return "fx";
  if (/\d/.test(symbol)) return "index";
  return "stock";
}

/** The public API does not serve stock or index instruments. */
export function apiInstruments(catalog: Catalog): string[] {
  return [
    ...catalog.byCategory.fx,
    ...catalog.byCategory.metals,
    ...catalog.byCategory.crypto,
    ...catalog.byCategory.other,
  ];
}
```

# open-trader

Terminal trading system for the **Exness Trader API**. The dashboard and the
live agent run in **one process**:

```powershell
npm install
npm start
```

`npm start` renders the full-screen board and starts the M1/M15 agent against
the account in `.env`. It is demo-first and deterministic (plain TypeScript
rules, no LLM). Use it on a demo account while tuning; profitability is not
guaranteed.

## What it does

```
M1 close �"?�"?�-� screener (M15 trend + M1 pullback + spread)
          �"?�"?�-� entry (M1 confirmation)
          �"?�"?�-� risk (1% sizing, broker emergency SL)
          �"?�"?�-� trader (virtual trailing stop, no TP)
```

- **Screener** scans the whole account universe at every M1 close (+2 s),
  ranks fresh, liquid quotes, then rejects weak trend/pullback/spread setups.
- **Entry** requires the last closed M1 candle to agree with the M15 trend.
- **Risk** sizes 1% of virtual equity from the broker-stop distance and opens a
  market order with a **broker emergency stop-loss**. It never sends a
  take-profit.
- **Trader** manages a program-side **virtual trailing stop** on every tick.
  It starts at the trail distance and only ratchets in the trade direction.
  A position closes when the market trades through the virtual stop.
- The broker SL is the crash safety net; the dashboard shows both the broker SL
  and the live `TS VIRT` level on every position row.

## Dashboard

```
open-trader A� DEMO
  BALANCE / EQUITY / FREE MARGIN / POSITIONS
  SCREENER A� ENTRY A� TRADER        (side-by-side containers)
  AGENT LOG
  POSITIONS                        (SL broker + TS VIRT + distance)
  ACCOUNT A� MARKET A� RISK
  EQUITY / DRAWDOWN
  EVENTS A� ORDERS
```

The board is scrollable and the footer stays pinned. The agent is interactive:
it only trades when `stdout` is a TTY. `--once` (or a non-TTY run) is a
read-only snapshot.

### Keys

| Key | Action |
| --- | --- |
| `q` / `Ctrl+C` | quit the dashboard and stop the agent |
| `p` | pause / resume account polling |
| `a` | show / hide agent containers + log |
| `c` | show / hide equity + drawdown charts |
| `o` | show / hide orders |
| `e` | show / hide events |
| `r` | force a fresh REST snapshot |
| `x`, then `y` | arm / confirm kill switch: block entries + close every position (`n` cancels) |
| `u` | remove the kill switch flag (`unkill`) |
| `�+`` / `�+"`, `j` / `k` | scroll one line |
| `PgUp` / `PgDn` | scroll ten lines |
| `g` / `G` | jump to top / bottom |

The kill switch is persisted in `.cache/KILL`. While it is on, the agent closes
every open position (including positions it did not open) and refuses new
entries. `u` removes the flag; `x`/`y` turns it on.

### Other invocations

```powershell
npm start -- --once        # one read-only frame, no agent, exits
npm start -- --for 30      # interactive, auto-exit after 30 s
```

There are no other application commands. `npm test` and `npm run typecheck`
exist for development.

## Configuration

`.env` must contain:

```ini
EXNESS_API_KEY=exnsk-...
EXNESS_PRIVATE_KEY=...            # 128-char hex key pair, 64-char hex seed, or PEM
EXNESS_ACCOUNT_ID=31000172947
EXNESS_DISCOVERY_URL=https://api.exness.com
```

`EXNESS_API_SECRET` is still accepted as a fallback name for the private key.
`EXNESS_ACCESS_POINT` can pin the access point and skip discovery.

### Strategy defaults

All values are environment-overridable; the defaults are tuned for the demo
account.

| Setting | Default | Env |
| --- | --- | --- |
| Screener / confirmation / trail timeframe | `M1` | `AGENT_SCREENER_TF`, `AGENT_CONFIRM_TF`, `AGENT_TRAIL_TF` |
| Trend timeframe | `M15` | `AGENT_TREND_TF` |
| Scan alignment | M1 close + 2 s | `AGENT_SCAN_INTERVAL_MS` (fallback) |
| Manage cadence | 1 s | `AGENT_MANAGE_INTERVAL_MS` |
| Shortlist / candidates | 50 / 24 | `AGENT_SHORTLIST`, `AGENT_MAX_CANDIDATES` |
| Minimum score | 28 | `AGENT_MIN_SCORE` |
| RSI band | 30�?"70 | `AGENT_RSI_MIN`, `AGENT_RSI_MAX` |
| Pullback to M1 EMA50 | �% 1.5A-ATR | `AGENT_PULLBACK_ATR` |
| M15 trend separation | �%� 0.02A-ATR | `AGENT_MIN_TREND_ATR` |
| FX / non-FX spread | �% 6 pips / �% 0.10% | `AGENT_MAX_SPREAD_PIPS`, `AGENT_MAX_SPREAD_PCT` |
| Spread cost | �% 45% of trail | `AGENT_MAX_SPREAD_TRAIL` |
| Virtual trail | max(2A-M1 ATR, 8 pips) | `AGENT_TRAIL_ATR`, `AGENT_TRAIL_MIN_PIPS` |
| Broker emergency SL | 3A-M15 ATR, min 10 pips / 3A- spread | `AGENT_EMERGENCY_SL_ATR`, `AGENT_MIN_STOP_PIPS` |
| Max chase | 2A-ATR | `AGENT_MAX_CHASE_ATR` |
| Max quote age | 15 s | `AGENT_MAX_QUOTE_AGE_MS` |
| Virtual equity for sizing | 10,000 USD | `EXNESS_VIRTUAL_EQUITY` |
| Risk per trade | 1% | `AGENT_RISK_PCT` |
| Max lots per trade | 0.5 | `AGENT_MAX_LOTS` |
| Max positions / per symbol | 2 / 1 | `AGENT_MAX_POSITIONS`, `AGENT_MAX_PER_SYMBOL` |
| Daily loss cap | 2% �%^ 200 USD | `AGENT_MAX_DAILY_LOSS_PCT` |
| Consecutive-loss cooldown | 3 losses �+' 4 h | `AGENT_MAX_CONSECUTIVE_LOSSES`, `AGENT_COOLDOWN_MINUTES` |
| Margin buffer | A-3 | �?" |

`minAtrPct` / `maxAtrPct` (`AGENT_MIN_ATR_PCT`, `AGENT_MAX_ATR_PCT`) reject
instruments whose M1 ATR is too quiet or too wild.

### Trailing behaviour

- **BUY** tracks the highest bid; the virtual stop ratchets only upward.
- **SELL** tracks the lowest ask; the virtual stop ratchets only downward.
- A new M1 ATR is read at each closed M1 candle. If ATR shrinks, the stop may
  tighten; if ATR grows, the stop does not loosen.
- A BUY closes when `bid �% TS VIRT`; a SELL closes when `ask �%� TS VIRT`.
- The broker emergency SL is **not** moved during normal trailing.

Example: a BUY entry at `1.0850` with an 8-pip trail has `TS VIRT` at `1.0842`
when management starts. At `1.0900` it becomes `1.0892`; at `1.0930` it becomes
`1.0922`. If price falls back to `1.0920`, the stop stays at `1.0922`.

## Agent state and audit

```
.cache/agent-state.json           managed positions, broker SL / virtual stop, stats, journal
.cache/trades/YYYY-MM-DD.jsonl    open / trail / close / protect / skip / error events
.cache/equity/YYYY-MM-DD.jsonl    equity samples for charts
.cache/events/YYYY-MM-DD.jsonl    raw runtime events
.cache/KILL                       persistent kill switch flag
```

State is written after every manage tick and on clean shutdown. A restart
restores managed positions, the virtual stop, best price, trail distance and the
emergency SL, then reconciles them against the broker. Agent-owned orphans are
adopted from the trade log; positions the agent did not open are left alone
unless the kill switch is active.

## Rate limits and resilience

- Account-wide REST limits: global 10/s, candles 2/s, snapshot 2/s, order
  mutations 4/s.
- WebSocket tick subscriptions are token-bucketed at 20/s and sent one
  instrument per message; a bad symbol is dropped with `4000`, not in a batch.
- `400/3015 REQUEST_RATE_LIMIT` is retried with 1.5 s �+' 3 s �+' 6 s backoff (capped
  at 10 s). The manage loop also backs off for 15 s if the shared bucket is
  saturated. Run only one live agent per account.
- The watchdog logs feed stalls and restarts a closed/wedged tick socket after
  45 s, then resubscribes.
- Async execution subscribes to `/ws/events` before sending an order and
  correlates the ACK / `transaction_event` by `client_request_id`, with polling
  as a fallback. Orders send only `stop_loss_price` (no take-profit).

| --- | --- |
| `401/1001` | Signature mismatch �?" key format, payload bytes, body hash or base64url padding. |
| `401/1000` | API key missing/expired, or `EXN-DATA.api_key` �%� `EXN-API-KEY`. |
| `403/1002` | API key has no access to this account/IP/scope. |
| `404/2000` | Account not found for this key. |
| `400/3005` | `REQUEST_INVALID_COUNT` �?" candles need `count` or `to`, not just `from`. |
| `400/3015` | Request rate limit. Wait for the built-in backoff and run one agent only. |
| `400/4000` | `MARKET_INSTRUMENT_NOT_FOUND` �?" a catalog symbol is not subscribable; dropped individually. |
| `400/4001` | `MARKET_TRADE_DISABLED` �?" instrument is visible but not tradable; skipped. |
| `400/5005` | Stop/take-profit is on the wrong side or too tight for the broker. |
| Repeated `503` | Service unavailable; retry later. |

## Security

- `.env` holds a live signing key: it is gitignored, never bundled and only read
  locally. Do not paste it into chats, issues or screenshots.
- The CLI prints only a key prefix (`exnsk-�?�`).
- Rotate the key in Exness Key Management if it was ever exposed, then update
  `.env`. Iterate on a demo account.

```ts
private async trendCandles(symbol, now): Promise<NormalizedCandle[] | null> {
  const tfMs = timeframeMs(this.options.trendTimeframe);
  const boundary = Math.floor(now / tfMs) * tfMs;
  const cached = this.trendCache.get(symbol);
  if (cached && cached.boundary === boundary) return cached.candles;
  const result = await this.tools.get_candles({symbol, timeframe: this.options.trendTimeframe, n: 260});

  const candles = dropFormingCandle(result.data, tfMs, now);
  if (candles.length < 210) return null;
  this.trendCache.set(symbol, { boundary, candles });
  return candles;
}
```
